reports.title: The $\mathrm{L}^1$-Stokes Semigroup
reports.abstract: We study the Stokes operator with no-slip boundary conditions on the spaces $\mathrm{L}_{σ,n}(Ω)$ and ${\mathrm{L}^1(Ω,\mathbb{C}^d)}/{\nabla \mathrm{W}^{1,1}(Ω,\mathbb{C})}$, where $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ is an arbitrary bounded $\mathrm{C}^{1,α}$-domain. We show that the Stokes operator on $\mathrm{L}^1_{σ,n}(Ω)$ does not generate a $\mathrm{C}_0$-semigroup, even though the resolvent problem is uniquely solvable. In stark contrast, its realization on ${\mathrm{L}^1(Ω,\mathbb{C}^d)}/{\nabla \mathrm{W}^{1,1}(Ω,\mathbb{C})}$ generates a compact, analytic $\mathrm{C}_0$-semigroup, which leaves $\mathrm{L}^1_{σ,n}(Ω)$ invariant. The key point is that these two realizations, which are canonically identified for $1<p<\infty$ through the Helmholtz decomposition, cease to be equivalent at the endpoint $p=1$. This leads to genuinely different functional analytic properties. Our result provides the first positive generation theorem for the Stokes operator with no-slip boundary conditions in a pure $\mathrm{L}^1$-setting on a bounded domain and settles a problem that had remained open for nearly fifty years; see, e.g., \cite{Koz:01,DHP:01}. In this sense, it completes the theory of the Stokes semigroup across the full scale of solenoidal Lebesgue spaces on (smooth) bounded domains. As an intermediate step, some results on the space of Radon measures are obtained. The proof combines the sun-dual construction with a precise analysis of the failure of the Helmholtz decomposition in $\mathrm{L}^1$, the celebrated result of Abe and Giga \cite{AG:12} on the Stokes semigroup on $\mathrm{C}_{σ,0}(Ω)$ and the regularity theory refinements for the Stokes operator recently developed by Breit and the second author \cite{BG:25}.
reports.workSummary: 本文分析有界 $C^{1,\alpha }$ 域上无滑移 Stokes 算子在端点 $L^1$ 的两个实现。对无散向量场空间 $L^1_{\sigma ,n}(\Omega )$，作者证明算子闭、稠密定义、可逆且谱为正，但负算子不生成 $C_0$ 半群；对商空间 $L^1(\Omega ;C^d)/\nabla W^{1,1}(\Omega )$，则通过 $C_{\sigma ,0}$ 的 sun-dual 构造得到有界、紧且解析的 $C_0$ 半群，并证明其保持嵌入的无散子空间。核心差异来自 $L^1$ 中 Helmholtz 分解失效：商实现可由对偶半群控制，而向量场实现会在缩放到半空间后违反已知 resolvent 障碍。

Helmholtz 分解失效与梯度商空间
sun-dual 半群与 Radon 测度对偶
紧解析半群的嵌入不变性

reports.breakthrough: 论文首次在有界域的纯 $L^1$ 框架中同时厘清两个自然 Stokes 实现的相反行为：无散向量场实现不生成 $C_0$ 半群，而梯度商实现生成紧解析 $C_0$ 半群。这个端点分裂说明 $p=1$ 时把商空间与无散场“规范识别”会丢失半群性质，而 sun-dual 正好提供了可工作的替代空间。
reports.limitations: 结果限于有界 $C^{1,\alpha }$ 域和无滑移边界条件；商空间半群的 $L^1$ 具体刻画依赖有界域的紧性，作者明确指出不能无缝推广到无界域。非生成结论针对 $C_0$ 半群，不等同于所有弱拓扑或更细商空间拓扑下都不存在演化。

reports.title: Transport and flow for horizontal Sobolev contact velocities in Carnot groups
reports.abstract: We establish new well-posedness results for transport and flow equations driven by contact vector fields on Carnot groups. The velocity fields are assumed to have horizontal Sobolev regularity, namely Sobolev regularity only along the horizontal directions determined by the stratified geometry of the group. In the broader sub-Riemannian setting, results of this type were previously known only for Heisenberg groups. Our proof relies on the theory of renormalized solutions as originally introduced by DiPerna and Lions in the Euclidean setting.
reports.workSummary: 本文把 DiPerna–Lions 的输运方程重整化理论推广到 Carnot 群中的水平 Sobolev contact 速度场。作者先在分层 Lie 代数上把左不变向量场换成右不变表达，利用 contact 条件控制高阶换序项；随后用群卷积 mollifier 展开输运方程的 commutator，把误差写成水平差商和由接触结构消失的余项。关键引理证明 commutator 在局部 $L^1$ 中趋于零，因此每个有界分布解都是 renormalized solution。最后结合 renormalization 与散度、增长条件，得到 $L^\theta $ 分布解的存在唯一性，并进一步得到 regular Lagrangian flow 的存在和唯一性。

水平 Sobolev 差商展开

reports.breakthrough: 论文证明在一般 Carnot 群中，只沿水平方向具有 Sobolev 正则性的 contact 速度场就足以恢复输运方程的 renormalization；接触条件精确补偿了缺失的竖直导数。由此把此前主要在欧氏空间或 Heisenberg 群成立的分布解与流理论推进到完整的分层非交换几何。
reports.limitations: 速度场需要 contact 结构、水平 Sobolev 可积性、散度的时间积分 $L\infty $ 控制及正文(6.4)中的增长条件；结论针对 Carnot 群和相应 Haar 测度，不能直接用于任意次黎曼流形。commutator 论证依赖有限步长分层结构，未覆盖仅有 BV 水平正则性或缺少接触约束的速度场。

reports.title: On 2D Scattering for a Critical Nonlinear Schrödinger Flow
reports.abstract: We study modified scattering for the two-dimensional defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLS) with the gauge-invariant, scattering-critical nonlinearity $|u|u$. We prove that the remodulated interaction representation has a local $L^2$ limit for general data in $Σ=H^1\cap\F^{-1}H^1$. For radial data, we prove convergence in $L^p(\R^2)$ for every $2<p<\infty$.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究二维 defocusing、散射临界非线性 |u|u 的 NLS 在一般 $\Sigma =H^1\cap F^{-1}H^1$ 数据下的 modified scattering，并在径向数据下加强到所有 $2<p<\infty $ 的 $L^p$ 收敛。作者先利用已有的 Fourier-side modified profile 极限，把自由演化 U(−t) 与非线性长程相位 $e^{i\Phi _t(u)}$ 分离；通过 dyadic annulus 分解将 $F^{-1}(\dot$ $B^{-1}_{2,\infty })$ 收敛转换成局部 $L^2$ 和加权 $L^2$ 收敛。径向部分把修正 profile 分解成三个由 $(1-\Delta )^{-1}$ 控制的项，利用径向性保持、二维散射估计和 Strauss–Lions 点态衰减得到远场 $L^p$ 收敛，再以局部 $L^\infty $ 有界性与局部 $L^2$ 收敛插值处理原点。

reports.limitations: 一般数据结论是局部 $L^2$ 与加权 $L^2$ 收敛，所有 $L^p（2<p<\infty ）$的增强需要径向对称性和额外 $F^{-1}H^1$ 条件。结果针对二维 defocusing 的 |u|u 临界流及已知的全局解，不覆盖非径向大数据的全局 $L^p$ 收敛、聚焦情形或散射算子的逆构造。

reports.title: Stable determination of damping and potential coefficients in a semilinear wave equation
reports.abstract: We consider an inverse problem for a semilinear wave equation with time-independent damping, linear potential, and nonlinear potential coefficients in a bounded domain of $\mathbb{R}^n$ for $n\geq 2$. The main objective is to establish stability estimates for the simultaneous recovery of these coefficients from the associated Dirichlet-to-Neumann map. Our approach combines second-order linearization with suitably constructed geometric optics and asymptotic solutions. We establish Hölder-type stability estimates for the recovery of each of the three coefficients appearing in the semilinear wave equation under suitable a priori bounds on these coefficients. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first stability result for simultaneous determination of time-independent damping, linear and nonlinear potentials in a semiliner wave equation.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究有界域中带时间无关阻尼、线性势和非线性势的半线性波方程，并从非线性 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 映射同时稳定恢复三个系数。作者先对 DN 映射作一阶和二阶线性化，利用伴随问题得到含系数差的积分恒等式；再构造带大频率参数的 geometric optics 与渐近解，把恒等式化为沿光线的衰减 X-ray/射线变换估计。阻尼差先由加权射线积分恢复，线性势借助已知阻尼估计消去误差后恢复，非线性势则从二阶项和二次能量估计得到。最后用射线变换稳定性和 Sobolev 插值得到三个系数的 Hölder 型 $L\infty $ 稳定性。
techniques: DN 映射的一阶/二阶线性化
伴随波方程积分恒等式
geometric optics 与高频渐近展开
衰减 X-ray/射线变换稳定性

reports.breakthrough: 论文把同一个非线性 DN 映射中的三种系数按线性化阶数分层恢复：阻尼由一阶项的带衰减射线积分确定，线性势在扣除阻尼误差后确定，非线性势由二阶线性化的主振荡项确定。由此获得同时恢复三系数的定量 Hölder 稳定性，而不只是唯一性。

reports.title: Speed and stability of segregated waves in a pressure-based model of heterogeneous cell populations
reports.abstract: We consider a minimal pressure-based model of heterogeneous cell populations consisting of proliferative and non-proliferative cells with different mobilities. The model is formulated as a system of reaction--cross--diffusion equations describing the spatio-temporal dynamics of the cell densities. The model is known to admit one-dimensional travelling wave solutions with strictly segregated components: non-proliferative cells occupy a finite region at the leading edge, while proliferative cells remain at the rear. However, the speed, parameter dependence, and stability of these waves remain poorly understood. In this work, we derive an almost explicit variational bound on the wave speed by reformulating the problem as a free-boundary problem for a generalised porous--Fisher equation. The estimates we obtain apply to general pressure laws and growth kinetics, agree closely with the results of numerical simulations, and become sharp in the incompressible limit, where we formally recover a fully explicit characterisation of the wave speed. We then analyse the stability of the waves to show that segregated waves are stable only when non-proliferative cells are more mobile than proliferative cells. Finally, motivated by numerical observations of finger-like protrusions, we investigate the stability of incompressible segregated circular waves through asymptotic shape-perturbation analysis. This yields explicit expressions for the pressure, interface velocity, and growth rates of angular modes, thereby making evident the destabilisation mechanisms that may lead to the emergence of fingering instability. Interestingly, we find that, in contrast with the one-dimensional case, the stability of such circular waves is not determined solely by the relative value of the mobility coefficients, and thus instabilities may arise irrespective of which cell type has the larger mobility.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究压力驱动的异质细胞群模型中严格分离的一维行波和不可压圆形波。作者把两类细胞的反应–交叉扩散系统化为自由边界压力问题，在行波坐标中用单调剖面和 $w(u)=-u'$ 将波速问题化为带移动边界的广义 porous–Fisher 方程；Benguria–Depassier 型试验函数给出一般压力律和增长率下的变分波速上下界。随后在 $\gamma \to \infty $ 的不可压极限中形式求出显式波速和压力/界面速度，并线性化圆形界面，按角向 Fourier 模式计算扰动增长率。数值实验比较波速界和指状不稳定性。

reports.title: Pathwise Global-in-Time Existence for the generalised KPZ Equation in the Full Subcritical Regime
reports.abstract: We provide a pathwise proof of global-in-time well-posedness for the generalised KPZ equation in the full subcritical regime by an adaptation of the strategy recently applied to the generalised Parabolic Anderson Model in [ES26]. Since this strategy relies crucially on the assumption that control of the supremum norm is sufficient to continue the solution, the main additional ingredient required is a treatment of the initial layer for gKPZ with merely $L^\infty$ initial data, rather than the more usual setting of $C^θ$ initial data with $θ> 0$. Our approach is based on an expansion around a deterministic profile followed by the introduction of an integrating factor in order to remove the terms which have critical scaling at time $0$. For pedagogical purposes, we first demonstrate the proof techniques in the case of the standard $(1+1)$-dimensional KPZ equation before turning to the more computationally involved case of generalised KPZ.
reports.workSummary: 本文证明空间周期广义 KPZ 方程在完整次临界范围内的路径级全局存在性和局部 Lipschitz 解映射。作者在正则结构框架中先处理平滑模型，利用对称性和模型重整化定义；对一般 $C^\theta $ 初值，短时固定点理论给出局部解与爆破替代。关键初始层分析把解展开在只含梯度平方的确定性 profile 周围，引入积分因子消除 $t=0$ 附近临界缩放的交叉项，并验证这些变换与重整化兼容。平滑模型上建立 supremum norm 比较原理和不爆破估计，再通过模型逼近把结论传给任意对称模型。

reports.title: Long-time asymptotics of nonlinear Fokker-Planck equations with inhomogeneous diffusion and natural boundary conditions
reports.abstract: In this paper, we study the long-time asymptotics for nonlinear Fokker-Planck equations with spatial inhomogeneous diffusion, based on the law of energy dissipation. First, we derive a priori positive lower and upper bounds for solutions of the equations. Next, we give a sufficient condition for deriving the exponential decay of the dissipation function. Finally, we investigate whether the given sufficient condition is essential or not by numerical computation.

reports.title: Well--posedness for the continuum Calogero--Moser equations by parabolic regularization
reports.abstract: We prove that the focusing and defocusing continuum Calogero--Moser equations are globally well-posed in $H^s_+(\mathbb R)$ for every integer $s\geq 3$. In the focusing case, this requires the initial data to satisfy the mass condition $$\|q_0\|_{L^2}^2<2π.$$ Our proof is based on a parabolic regularization of the equation, uniform \textit{a--priori} estimates for the regularized solutions, and a Bona--Smith type approximation argument.
reports.workSummary: 本文用抛物正则化证明连续 Calogero–Moser 方程在 $H^s_+(R)、s\ge 3$ 中的全局适定性。作者先利用 Cauchy–Szegő 投影的尖锐乘积估计建立低阶能量的 coercivity，聚焦情形正好要求质量 $||q_0||^{2}_2<2\pi $。对加入 $-i\epsilon \partial _x^{2}$ 的正则化方程，收缩映射给出光滑局部解；守恒量和投影乘积交换估计依次控制 $L^{2}、Ḣ^{1/2}、H^{2}$ 及更高 $H^s$ 范数，并用 bootstrap 把界延拓到任意有限时间。最后对频率截断初值采用 Bona–Smith 比较，证明 $q_\epsilon $ 在 $C_tH^s$ 中 Cauchy，极限满足原方程；差分能量给出唯一性和连续依赖。

抛物正则化和收缩映射
守恒量驱动的 Sobolev a priori bounds
非局部投影交换/乘积估计
Bona–Smith 频率截断逼近
reports.breakthrough: 论文给出一条完全基于抛物正则化的 CCM 高正则全局构造：正则化耗散同时提供局部光滑解和可传递的 uniform bounds，尖锐质量阈值控制聚焦能量，Bona–Smith 极限则把这些 bounds 可靠地传到无耗散非局部方程。
reports.limitations: 聚焦情形必须满足严格质量阈值 $||q_0||^{2}_2<2\pi $，结论针对整数 $s\ge 3$ 的 $H^s_+$ 数据和一维全空间；论文不处理阈值等号、低于三阶正则性或质量超阈值的聚焦解。正则化和极限证明依赖 Cauchy–Szegő 投影结构，不能直接迁移到一般非局部非线性。

steps.claim: 低阶 CCM 能量在聚焦质量阈值下具有 coercivity。
steps.route: 将非线性项写成 $C_+(|q|^{2})$ 的投影乘积，应用尖锐估计 $||C_+(fg)||_2\le (2\pi )^{-1/2}||f||_2||$ $|\partial |^{1/2}g||_2$，把非线性负项吸收到 $Ḣ^{1/2}$ 主项；严格质量小于 $2\pi $ 保证剩余系数为正。

steps.route: 正则化线性部分带 $\epsilon \partial _x^{2}$ 平滑，收缩映射给出局部解$；L^{2}$ 能量因耗散项 $-2\epsilon ||q_x||^{2}$ 单调下降。随后用守恒量、投影交换估计和低阶 coercivity 同时闭合 $Ḣ^{1/2}$ 与 $H^{2}$ bootstrap，再逐阶提升到 $H^s$。

reports.title: Gradient estimates for the Lagrangian mean curvature equation with Lipschitz critical phase
reports.abstract: Let $n\ge3$. We prove a priori interior gradient estimate for the Lagrangian mean curvature equation \[ \sum_{i=1}^n\arctanλ_i(D^2u)=θ(x) \] under the critical and supercritical phase condition $θ\ge (n-2)π/2$, assuming only that the Lipschitz norm of the prescribed phase is bounded.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究相位函数仅具 Lipschitz 正则性时的 Lagrangian mean curvature 方程 ∑ arctan $\lambda _i(D^{2}u)=\theta (x)$。在临界/超临界相位 $\theta \ge (n-2)\pi /2$ 下，作者利用相位水平集的 (n−1)-凸性、特征值对称多项式的迹估计和 $p=(1+|Du|^{2})^{1/2}$ 的加权散度不等式，控制临界相位附近可能退化的区域。对 p 乘以截断函数并积分分部，结合半凸性给出的点值梯度估计和 Lipschitz 相位振荡，得到 $B_1$ 内梯度由 osc u 与 Lip $\theta $ 控制的内估计；再结合已有 Hessian 估计和逼近，推出二阶界与连续粘性解的正则性。
techniques: 临界相位下的 (n−1)-凸性
Hessian 特征值对称多项式迹估计
截断积分与 Lipschitz 相位误差控制
半凸性点值梯度估计
reports.breakthrough: 论文去掉了临界相位附近通常要求的二阶相位导数或 $|D\theta |$ 随 $\theta -\Theta _c$ 衰减的附加条件，只假设 $\theta $ 的 Lipschitz 范数有界；关键是把相位梯度误差直接放进加权散度不等式，并用相位缺口的截断尺度吸收它。
reports.limitations: 定理针对光滑解的内梯度估计，要求 $n\ge 3、\theta \ge (n-2)\pi /2、\theta <$ $n\pi /2、u$ 振荡有界及 $\theta $ 的 Lipschitz 界；连续粘性解需额外通过逼近使用结果，不覆盖次临界相位或边界梯度估计。Hessian 界还依赖外部已有的 critical-phase Hessian theorem。

steps.claim: 临界/超临界相位条件使 Hessian 特征值满足可用于积分估计的 (n−1)-凸性和特征值序关系。
steps.route: 把相位方程写成 arctan 特征值之和，利用 $\theta \ge \Theta _c$ 的相位几何得到 $\sigma _j(D^{2}u)\ge 0（j\le n-1）$以及最大特征值控制最小特征值。代入线性化矩阵和 Newton 变换的迹，得到 Q、F 的非负性及统一迹上界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–4页 Section 1–2、相位几何引理及公式(2.6)–(2.7)。

steps.claim: $p=(1+|Du|^{2})^{1/2}$ 满足带相位 Lipschitz 误差的散度不等式。
steps.route: 对 p、方程和线性化系数逐项微分，使用相位方程消掉二阶导数的主组合；剩余的 $D\theta $ 项由 $|D\theta |\le K$ 控制，Newton 矩阵迹估计把它压成 tr Q。由此得到 $div(FDp)\ge -C K tr Q$，并可在截断区域对 p 的高值部分进行积分。
steps.evidence: PDF 第4–6页 Lemma 2.1、公式(2.8)及其证明中的相位微分计算。

steps.claim: 对高梯度区域的截断积分给出 $B_1$ 内 |Du| 的统一上界。
steps.route: 选取 $\phi =\theta -\Theta _c$ 的局部缺口并在 $\phi >0$ 区域用半径 $\delta =min(1/4,\phi /(2K))$，这样相位在小球内保持正缺口，方程给出 $D^{2}u$ 的下半界。半凸性点值估计把 |Du(x)| 转换成振荡项加 $\delta $ $cot(\delta /2)$ 项；对 $\phi $ 的分层积分再用散度不等式控制总量，最终使所有层的贡献只依赖 n、M、K。
steps.evidence: PDF 第6–8页 Theorem 1.1 证明，尤其公式(3.6)及 $\phi 、\delta $ 的截断参数构造。

steps.claim: 梯度界可与 Hessian 估计结合，产生内二阶界和粘性解正则性。
steps.route: 将 Theorem 1.1 的梯度上界代入 critical/supercritical 相位的已有 Hessian 估计，得到 $B_{1/2}$ 的 $D^{2}u$ $L\infty $ 界。对连续粘性解用严格超临界相位和光滑逼近，统一继承梯度/二阶估计后取极限。

reports.title: A counterexample to Kenig's conjecture for the Laplace double-layer operator
reports.abstract: Layer potentials provide a classical approach to boundary value problems for Laplace's equation on Lipschitz domains. Kenig's 1994 spectral-radius conjecture for the double-layer operator would ensure operator-norm convergence of the associated Neumann series on mean-zero $L^2$ densities when the boundary is connected. We disprove this conjecture by constructing a bounded simply connected planar Lipschitz domain whose double-layer operator on arclength $L^2$ has essential spectral radius strictly greater than $1/2$. More precisely, for every $t>1/2$ sufficiently close to $1/2$, we obtain such a domain with $\pm i t$ in its Fredholm essential spectrum. The construction starts from smooth graphs whose shapes repeat under translation. In the limit of separated scales, refinement makes solutions of adjoint resolvent equations grow with fixed forcing. The graph slopes remain uniformly bounded. A computer-assisted certificate proves this growth through an inequality for Hermitian $2\times2$ matrices. Its strict margin at $- i/2$ persists at nearby spectral parameters. Normalisation and a Floquet transform then give compactly supported densities with small residuals on the full graphs. We insert rescaled segments of successive graphs into one bounded boundary, where these densities form a weakly null sequence of approximate eigenvectors. The same spectral conclusion holds on a single periodic Lipschitz graph. The certificate combines continuous estimates, exact rational arithmetic and rigorous interval enclosures.
reports.workSummary: 本文反驳 Kenig 关于平面 Lipschitz 域 Laplace 双层算子谱半径的猜想。作者先在周期光滑图上研究双层算子的 Floquet/周期分解，把自相似图形的 resolvent 问题转化为由局部周期算子组成的块算子。一个经过计算机辅助验证的 Hermitian $2\times 2$ 矩阵不等式保证在 −i/2 附近存在固定强迫下增长的 adjoint resolvent；周期密度经 Floquet 变换得到小残差的近似本征向量。随后把不同尺度的图段按几何衰减插入一个有界单连通 Lipschitz 边界，使这些密度弱趋零而残差趋零，故 $\pm it$ 属于 Fredholm essential spectrum，essential spectral radius 大于 1/2。

块 Toeplitz/直接积分算子极限
Hermitian $2\times 2$ 矩阵计算机辅助证书
resolvent 增长与近似本征向量

reports.breakthrough: 论文构造出保持统一 Lipschitz 斜率、却含无穷多分离细尺度的有界单连通域；这些尺度把周期图上的 resolvent 增长转化为边界双层算子在 $\pm it（t>1/2）$处的 Fredholm essential spectrum，从而真正否定谱半径$\le 1/2$ 的猜想。
reports.limitations: 反例是二维平面上的特定 Lipschitz 域，结论依赖 arclength $L^{2}$ 双层算子及计算机辅助矩阵证书，不能推出一般光滑域或其他边界积分算子的谱性质。构造给出谱半径下界和非收敛性反例，不提供所有 Lipschitz 域的完整谱分类。

steps.claim: 周期光滑图上的双层算子可分解为适合 Floquet 分析的周期核/直接积分算子。
steps.route: 对形如 $F(x)=mx+h(x)$ 的平移周期图，将跨周期核按整数平移求和并在 period-one 密度空间定义 $P_F；Floquet$ 变换把全图算子拆成准动量参数族，便于把局部图形改变写成算子块的强收敛极限。

steps.claim: 存在固定强迫使周期图 adjoint resolvent 在 −i/2 附近具有严格增长。
steps.route: 把候选周期密度的 Fourier 模式代入 resolvent 方程，连续估计归结为一个 Hermitian $2\times 2$ 矩阵的正定/负定不等式；计算机辅助区间证书给出严格余量，因此解的范数相对于固定右端可任意放大。严格余量对邻近谱参数保持，得到 t>1/2 的同样增长。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–4页摘要和 Theorem 1.1 策略；PDF 第8–12页 Section 3、Proposition 3.1–3.3 及矩阵证书。

steps.claim: 周期图上可构造归一化密度序列，其双层算子残差趋于零而密度弱趋零。
steps.route: 将大尺度周期 resolvent 解截断并用 Floquet 变换恢复到物理图，归一化后残差由截断边界和周期近似误差组成并趋于零；平移不同周期段后，支撑逐渐分离，故在 $L^{2}$ 中弱收敛到零。
steps.evidence: PDF 第10–15页 Section 3–4、Floquet 变换、resolvent 归一化构造和 Theorem 1.1 的近似本征向量讨论。

steps.claim: 把多尺度周期图段嵌入单一有界 Lipschitz 边界后$，\pm it$ 属于 Fredholm essential spectrum。
steps.route: 在 $x=0$ 附近插入按几何尺度缩放的周期图段，斜率统一有界且边界保持 Lipschitz；将每个周期近似本征密度搬到对应段，残差仍趋于零且序列弱零。Weyl/Fredholm 判据于是排除 $D_\Gamma \mp it I$ 的 Fredholm 性，得到 $\pm it\in \sigma _ess$，并推出 $r_ess\ge t$。

reports.title: Shape optimization of light structures with general Hooke's laws
reports.abstract: For the minimum-compliance shape optimization problem it was established recently [\textit{Duke Math.\ J.} 172 (2023), 43--103] that a sequence of approximately optimal shapes of exact volume \(\e\) converges to a limiting generalized shape, which is represented by a possibly diffuse probability measure, as \(\e \todown 0\). This generalized shape minimizes the so-called light-structures compliance functional, which --- as conjectured by Bouchitté --- is expressed in terms of a relaxed integrand, reflecting that optimal shapes must only involve ``lower-dimensional'' structures, like the Michell-type trusses that are well known in the engineering domain. However, the aforementioned result only applies for the simplest isotropic quadratic energy density, that is, the squared Frobenius norm, in dimensions two and three. The present work extends the relaxation result to the entire class of (isotropic or anisotropic) elasticity tensors and to any dimension, thus solving Bouchitté's conjecture in full generality. Since the previous work relied on explicit formulas for the relaxed integrands (due to Allaire, Kohn, and Strang), which are not available in the general case, several new arguments and substantial modifications of the original approach are required. We also significantly simplify and streamline other parts of the original argument, in addition to clarifying some related statements in the literature.
reports.workSummary: 本文解决一般各向同性或各向异性 Hooke 定律、任意维数下轻结构最小顺应度问题的 relaxation。作者把精确体积 $\epsilon $ 的结构编码为材料概率测度与对称应力场，先建立带 div 约束的极限泛函和 relaxed integrand；补偿紧性与 Young measure 给出近似极小结构的弱*紧性。下界部分利用应力–测度对的紧性$、H^{-1}$ 散度控制和 Reshetnyak 下半连续性得到极限顺应度不低于 relaxed 泛函；上界则从极限最优测度和应力恢复序列，通过周期局部单元、Fourier/Legendre 估计和体积修正构造 recovery sequence。最后证明最小值收敛并得到概率测度意义下的最优广义形状。
techniques: 应力测度化与 div 约束
凸分析/Hashin–Shtrik 负界
补偿紧性与 Young measures
Reshetnyak 下半连续性

reports.breakthrough: 论文把轻结构 compliance 的 Bouchitté relaxation 从二维/三维 Frobenius 能量推广到任意维和一般正定 Hooke 张量，不依赖 Kohn–Strang 可显式计算的特殊 integrand；抽象 relaxed integrand、div-quasiconvex 结构和恢复序列共同给出完整的 $\Gamma $ 型上下界。
reports.limitations: 极限对象是概率测度和应力场表示的广义形状，未保证由普通可测实体结构实现；恢复序列和最小值收敛依赖线性弹性、正定 Hooke 张量、固定载荷和精确体积约束。文章不解决有限 $\epsilon $ 的唯一最优形状、工程制造尺度或非线性材料。

steps.claim: 极限 compliance 泛函可由应力测度和 relaxed integrand 表示，并存在一个极限最优概率测度。
steps.route: 把材料密度 $\epsilon ^{-1}L^n⟂\omega $ 与支撑在对称矩阵上的应力 $\sigma $ 组合成 $(\sigma ,\mu )$，用 $div(\sigma \mu )=f$ 的分布约束描述平衡；正定性给出总变差控制，直接法和 Reshetnyak 下半连续性得到极限应力/测度对及其最小值。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–5页 Theorem 1.1、Section 2、Proposition 2.5 及极限问题(1.5)、应力表示(5.1)。

steps.claim: 任意近似最小结构的材料概率测度沿子列弱*收敛到极限最优测度，且给出下界。
steps.route: 对近似结构选取伴随应力 $\sigma _\epsilon $，使能量有界并令 $div(\sigma _\epsilon $ $\mu _\epsilon )$ 在 $H^{-1}$ 有界；补偿紧性保证 $\mu _\epsilon 、\sigma _\epsilon \mu _\epsilon $ 同时收敛，div 约束传到极限。对 $j^*$ 的积分使用凸性和 Reshetnyak 下半连续性，得到 $C(\mu )\le liminf$ $C_\epsilon (\mu _\epsilon )$。
steps.evidence: PDF 第6–9页 Proposition 3.1、Proposition 3.2 及公式中的 $\mu _\epsilon /\sigma _\epsilon $ 紧性条件。

steps.claim: 每个极限最优测度都有满足精确体积的 recovery sequence，给出上界。
steps.route: 先由最优应力测度的极分解和 div 约束构造有限网络/局部周期应力单元，使单元平均匹配 $\sigma $；再用 Hooke 张量的一般凸对偶估计控制单元能量，最后通过小尺度稀释和体积修正把材料量调回 $\epsilon $。该序列的概率测度弱*趋于 $\mu $，能量上 limsup 不超过 $C(\mu )$。

reports.title: The Trudinger inequality is true for $M^{1,s}$ spaces
reports.abstract: We prove the Trudinger inequality with exponent $\frac{s}{s-1}$ for $M^{1,s}$ Sobolev spaces on metric measure spaces under the sole measure growth assumption $μ(B(x,r))\ge br^s$. This improves the previously known exponential integrability with power one. Our argument also yields sharp asymptotic bounds for the Sobolev constants as $p\uparrow s$. On doubling spaces, we further remove the connectedness assumption from the Trudinger inequality associated with a $(1,p)$-Poincaré inequality when $p<s$. An Ahlfors regular counterexample shows that this extension fails at the critical exponent $p=s$.
reports.workSummary: 本文在仅假设球测度下界 $\mu (B(x,r))\ge b$ $r^s$ 的一般度量测度空间中证明 $M^{1,s}$ 的 Trudinger 指数可积性，并给出 p↑s 时 Sobolev 常数的精确渐近。作者从 Hajłasz 梯度不等式出发，用 g 的 dyadic level sets 和 Chebyshev 估计构造分层振荡控制；在临界 $p=s$ 时把每层增量累加成指数级尾界，得到指数 $s/(s-1)（s\le 1$ 时为连续性）估计。对局部球和 doubling 空间，作者将该分层论证与 (1,p)-Poincaré 不等式拼接，去掉传统连通性假设；最后给出 Ahlfors 正则反例说明临界 $p=s$ 下更强的 Poincaré 推论会失败。

reports.title: The equivalence of solutions to fractional and logarithmic Helmholtz equations
reports.abstract: We show the following equivalence of solutions to general fractional Helmholtz equations: $u$ is a solution to $$A^su=λ^su$$ for \textit{some} fixed $0<s<2$ and some $λ>0$ if and only if $u$ is a solution to the same equation for \textit{all} $s\neq0$. Furthermore, we show as well that $u$ equivalently solves the logarithmic Helmholtz equation $$\log(A)u=(\logλ)u.$$ Here, $A$ is a nonnegative, linear operator on a Banach space $X$. In particular, our results hold whenever $A=-L$, where $L$ is the infinitesimal generator of a $C_0$-semigroup in a Banach space $X$ satisfying mild assumptions that are typical in applications. As a particular case, we recover known results for the fractional Laplacian $(-Δ)^s$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$. More importantly, we provide a list of examples of other fractional power operators in settings where the Fourier transform is not available and for which our theorems apply. These include fractional powers and logarithms of second order elliptic operators in bounded domains, Laplace--Beltrami operators on Riemannian manifolds, space-time master equations, the discrete Laplacian, and fractional derivatives.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究一般 Banach 空间上的非负线性算子 A 的 fractional Helmholtz 方程 $A^s$ $u=\lambda ^s u$ 与 logarithmic Helmholtz 方程 $log(A)u=(log$ $\lambda )u$。作者利用 Balakrishnan 积分定义正分数幂，并通过分数幂的闭合/组合关系证明：若某个 0<s<2 的幂方程成立，则所有正指数和在可定义范围内的幂方程都成立；当 A 可逆时，负幂方程与由负幂半群生成元定义的 log(A) 方程等价。随后用 s→0 的导数定义建立正幂到对数方程的蕴含，并在 $C_0$ 半群生成元、椭圆算子、Laplace–Beltrami、离散 Laplacian 等例子中说明适用范围。

reports.title: Nonlinear Schrödinger systems with all attractive forces
reports.abstract: In this paper we investigate in a systematic way the solution structure of nonnegative solutions for coupled nonlinear Schrödinger systems in the all attractive regime. For all frequencies equal case we obtain results on Morse index of synchronized positive vector solutions and nonnegative semi-vector solutions as well as their kernel of linearized systems at these solutions. We establish a variational characterization of synchronized positive vector solutions and as applications we give a new existence result about positive vector solutions for the general systems with arbitrary frequencies. We also examine the synchronization phenomenon of positive vector solutions, and prove that if the interaction matrix has exactly one positive eigenvalue, any positive vector solution is synchronized. Finally we provide examples of domains for which synchronization of positive solutions fails to hold if the interaction matrix has at least two positive eigenvalues. Our results reveal the effect of the spectral information of the interaction matrix of the couplings and geometry of a domain on the solution structure.

reports.title: Completion of DNA replication is constrained by the spatiotemporal organisation of origin firing
reports.abstract: DNA replication requires the coordination of origin firing and fork progression to ensure the entire genome is timely duplicated before cell division. Yet origin firing is stochastic, giving rise to the classical random completion problem of how probabilistic local events can nevertheless ensure reliable genome duplication. Although several biological mechanisms have been proposed to resolve this problem, a quantitative account of how heterogeneous initiation and fork speed govern the persistence of the final unreplicated regions is still lacking. To address this gap, we introduce a population-level kinetic framework that extends KJMA nucleation-and-growth models by tracking unreplicated intervals over size, genomic position and time. We establish well-posedness of the resulting mean-field system and global existence for compatible data. Notably, by introducing a local initiation mass function, we quantify how the density and spatial organisation of origin firing constrain replication completion, yielding novel and sharp upper bounds on both the worst-locus unreplicated fraction and locuswise near-completion time. These results provide a rigorous and computable foundation for mapping vulnerabilities in replication completion and relating persistent unreplicated regions to replication stress and genome instability.
reports.workSummary: 本文把随机复制起点和复制叉推进写成一维群体平均动力学。作者先从带长度、位置和时间变量的未复制区间密度出发，通过左右复制叉的输运和起点/合并项把尺寸变量积分消去，得到未复制比例、叉密度与给定起点率 I(x,t)、叉速 v(x,t) 的耦合系统。正文先用固定点证明局部温和解唯一且连续依赖初值，再把叉密度除以未复制比例，沿特征线化为线性输运，从而延拓到任意有限时间。最后用反向因果锥上的起点质量 $m_I$ 给出最坏位置的未复制率和近完成时间 $T\epsilon $ 上界，并将该界用于期望复制时间和 Repli-seq 型数值比较。

reports.title: Remarks on a Liouville-type theorem by Chae and Wolf for stationary Navier-Stokes equations
reports.abstract: In this note, we revisit a Liouville-type theorem of Chae and Wolf for stationary Navier-Stokes equations in $\mathbb{R}^3$ [J. Differential Equations 261 (2016) 5541-5560]. We show that their logarithmic improvement of the classical $L^{9/2}$ condition is part of a substantially broader weighted framework. More precisely, we prove that a solution $u\in\dot H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$ is necessarily trivial whenever $$ \int_{\mathbb{R}^3}|u(x)|^{9/2}\,ω(|u(x)|)\,dx< +\infty, $$ for every positive, nondecreasing and bounded weight $ω$ satisfying a mild growth condition near the origin. This structural condition encompasses the logarithmic weight due to Chae and Wolf, as well as a hierarchy of iterated-logarithmic weights and (genuinely) non-logarithmic examples, including a dyadic weight. Our result identifies a broader class of weighted integrability conditions under which the triviality of stationary Navier-Stokes solutions follows, and shows that the mechanism underlying the Chae-Wolf improvement is not intrinsically tied to a specific logarithmic weight or to a single logarithmic scale.
reports.workSummary: 本文重新证明静态三维 Navier–Stokes 的 Liouville 型结论。作者允许权函数 $\omega $ 为连续、单调且有界，并只要求其在速度趋零处满足 $\omega (s)^{-1}$ 不超过对数增长；在 $u\in Ḣ^{1}(R^{3})$ 且 $∫|u|^{9/2}\omega (|u|)<\infty $ 时证明 u 恒为零。证明先用 Sobolev 嵌入和权函数的逆函数性质把加权临界可积性提升到一族 $L^p$ 控制，再在大环带上对方程作截断测试，把梯度项 $I_{2}$ 与压力/对流项 $I_{1}$ 分开。Chae–Wolf 的环带衰减引理控制 $I_{2}$，权函数分层和 Hölder/Young 估计控制 $I_{1}$，最后令环带半径趋于无穷使两项消失。

Sobolev 嵌入和权函数逆函数估计

Chae–Wolf 环带梯度衰减引理

reports.breakthrough: 论文把 Chae–Wolf 的单一对数权推广为满足(H1)–(H3)的整个权函数类，并明确展示对数迭代权和非对数 dyadic 权都足以触发平凡性；因此 Liouville 判据的改进来自权函数在小速度区的可控退化，而不依赖某个固定的对数公式。
reports.limitations: 结论只针对全空间 $R^{3}$ 的静态、无外力方程和 $u\in Ḣ^{1}$ 的解，权函数必须满足连续单调有界及(H3)的小参数对数上界；核心环带估计使用三维 Sobolev 与特定压力/对流结构，不能直接覆盖时变 Navier–Stokes、有限区域、外力或任意非单调权。

reports.title: A globally defined polyconvex isotropic energy satisfying the true-stress-true-strain monotonicity condition (TSTS-M++)
reports.abstract: Polyconvexity is a standard ingredient in the variational existence theory of finite elasticity, whereas true-stress-true-strain monotonicity (TSTS-M++) requires a positive incremental Cauchy-stress response. These two constitutive restrictions are independent, and Wollner, Holzapfel and Neff left open whether a compressible isotropic energy defined on the whole of $\mathrm{GL}^{+}(3)$ can satisfy both. We give an explicit affirmative answer. For every $μ>0$ and $k>0$, the stored-energy function $W_k(F)=\fracμ{2k}\bigl[\exp\bigl(k(\lVert F\rVert^2+3J^{-1}+J-7)\bigr)-1\bigr]$, $J=\det F$, is polyconvex and strictly rank-one convex. Its Cauchy-stress response satisfies TSTS-M++ globally if and only if $k\ge 1/(8\sqrt{3})$. In this regime every symmetric Cauchy stress corresponds to a unique positive-definite stretch, while the reference stretch is stress free with positive infinitesimal shear and bulk moduli. Stress bijectivity has the strictly smaller sharp threshold $k_{\mathrm{B}}\approx 0.00827233304$: at equality the stress map is a global homeomorphism with a nondifferentiable inverse, and above it the map is a global $C^{\infty}$ diffeomorphism. Thus, for $k_{\mathrm{B}}\le k<1/(8\sqrt{3})$, the map $V\mapstoσ(V)$ remains globally bijective while TSTS-M++ fails at finite strain. In the TSTS-M++ regime, every prescribed inner radius of a finite plane-strain annulus with a traction-free outer wall has a unique radial equilibrium, and its inner pressure increases smoothly and strictly from zero to infinity.
reports.workSummary: 本文给出三维 GL⁺(3) 上一个显式压缩各向同性储能族，并同时分析 polyconvexity、严格 rank-one convexity、TSTS-M++ 和应力可逆性。能量把 $||F||^{2}、3(det$ $F)^{-1}$ 与 det F 组成内函数，再套用随参数 $\kappa $ 变化的凸增指数；作者先在独立 minor 变量(F,Cof F,det F)上构造凸延拓，证明全域 polyconvexity 和沿 rank-one 线的严格凸性。随后改用正定伸长的 Hencky 对数变量，计算主应力切线和非共轴模量，将 TSTS-M++ 化成一个正定性判据，得到精确阈值 $\kappa *=1/(8\sqrt 3)$。最后通过 properness、局部微分同胚和单连通覆盖证明应力映射的全局双射，并另行求出较小的应力双射阈值 $\kappa B$。

reports.limitations: 结果限于三维、各向同性、可压缩的这一指数能量族和正定伸长变量；阈值是该族的构成本征结论，不等于所有材料模型的普适常数。文中全局应力反演不直接给出任意边值问题的能量极小器存在性，环形/球形平衡还需附加几何与无摩擦边界设定；失效构造也只说明 TSTS-M++ 的有限应变阈值。

reports.title: Determination of Wave Speed from interior sources
reports.abstract: We consider the wave equation with variable wave speed in Euclidean space, with point sources modeled by Dirac delta initial displacement data. There are three special subsets of the whole space: (1) the source set where the delta initial conditions are supported, (2) the unknown set where the wave speed is not known a priori, and (3) the receiver set where the waves are measured. The inverse problem is to reconstruct the wave speed uniquely in the unknown set from an unlabeled collection of waves generated by point sources and measured in the receiver set. We use propagation of singularities and sharp finite speed of propagation to reduce this data to geometric travel-time data, whose form depends on how the three sets lie in relation to each other. We give three scenarios where this procedure leads to unique determination of the wave speed.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究由未知介质中的内部点源激发、在接收集合上观测的变速波方程。源集合、未知集合和接收集合可以彼此不同，波的标签也被抹去。作者把点源 Dirac 初值产生的波视为时空双曲算子的分布解，先用全局双曲性、分布初值适定性和尖锐有限传播速度确定波到达前的空区，再用实主型算子的奇性传播识别首次到达时刻。核心 Theorem 1.1 证明无标记波数据等价于从源到接收点的 Riemannian travel-time 数据；随后在全数据、简单流形和严格凸域等三种布局中调用相应距离刚性结果，得到波速唯一性。
techniques: 双曲时空的全局双曲性与分布初值适定性
尖锐有限传播速度
实主型算子的波前集/奇性传播
首次到达时间与共形 Riemann 距离识别
无标记 travel-time 数据的几何刚性
reports.breakthrough: 论文的关键推进是无需给源和振幅逐一配标签，仍能从每个接收点附近的波前首次出现时间恢复源到接收点的距离函数；这把一个无标记 PDE 逆问题直接降为几何距离数据，并在全数据情形不要求简单性、凸性或非捕获假设即可得到唯一波速。
reports.limitations: 波速需为满足统一上下界(1)的 $C\infty $ 正函数，源和接收集合是 $R^n$ 中非空开集，观测时间 T 需超过 M 倍欧氏直径。部分数据的 Corollary 1.3–1.4 还要求简单 Riemann 度量、光滑域、严格凸性或域外波速已知；结论是唯一性而非稳定重建，也没有覆盖不光滑系数或有限噪声。

steps.claim: 点源波的支集在到达距离锥之外为空，并且其 Cauchy 问题在分布意义下唯一适定。
steps.route: 把变速波算子写成共形 Lorentz 度量的正常双曲算子；Lemma 2.1 给出每个时间切片为 Cauchy 超曲面，Lemma 2.2 用光滑初值逼近定义唯一分布解，Lemma 2.3 再把因果支集性质延伸到 Dirac 初值。

steps.claim: 点源解在初始光锥上的波前集正好是 lifted light cone LLC。
steps.route: 传播奇性定理把解的波前集限制在主符号的特征集，并沿零双特征线延拓；从(0,y)的 Dirac 奇性出发，Proposition 3.4 证明所有且仅有沿该光锥的特征协向量保持奇性，因而接收点首次可见的奇性不能早于也不会晚于相应零测地线。
steps.evidence: 第3节 Proposition 3.4 及式(19)–(24)（PDF 第9–10页）；第2节 Lemma 2.5 的奇性传播（PDF 第8页）。

steps.claim: 首次到达时间 Tc(y,z) 等于共形度量 gc 的 Riemann 距离 dc(y,z)。
steps.route: 有限传播先给 $Tc\ge dc$；再用 Hopf–Rinow 选取从 y 到 z 的最短 gc 测地线，把它提升为 Lorentz 零测地线，并用 Proposition 3.4 的光锥波前集在该时刻构造不可消去奇性，得到 $Tc\le dc$，二者合并即得等式。

reports.title: Notes on linear elliptic equations with $L^2$-gradient perturbations and singular zero-order coefficients
reports.abstract:
In this paper, we study the existence, uniqueness, and quantitative estimates for weak solutions to linear elliptic Dirichlet problems of the form \[ -\operatorname{div}(γ
abla u)+\langle 
ablaφ+\mathbf{H},
abla uangle+(c+α)u=f \quad	ext{ in }U, \quad\; u=0 \quad	ext{on }\partial U, \] where $U\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ is bounded, $γ\in[1,\infty)$ is a constant, $φ\in H^{1,2}(U)\cap L^\infty(U)$, $\mathbf{H}\in L^p(U,\mathbb{R}^d)$ for some $p \in (d, \infty)$, and $c\in L^1(U)$ with $c\ge0$. A key feature of this setting is that the drift contains the low-regularity term $
ablaφ$, which is only assumed to belong to $L^2(U,\mathbb{R}^d)$, while the zero-order coefficient is merely integrable. We prove that, even under these rough assumptions, well-posedness and quantitative energy and $L^2$ estimates remain valid. In addition, by using a previously established interpolation result, we characterize a trade-off between the integrability of the source term $f$ and that of the zero-order coefficient $c$, and show that well-posedness together with the corresponding quantitative estimates hold under these interpolated assumptions.
reports.workSummary: 本文处理有界区域上的线性椭圆 Dirichlet 问题，其中漂移含仅在 $L^{2}$ 中的梯度项 $\nabla \phi +H$，零阶系数 c 只要求 $L^{1}$ 且非负。作者的主要构造是指数权 $\eta =k$ $exp(-\phi /\gamma )$：将原弱形式乘以 $\eta $ 后$，\nabla \phi $ 项与权导数抵消，方程变成扩散系数 $\gamma \eta $、漂移 $\eta H$ 和零阶项 $\eta (c+\alpha )$ 的加权椭圆方程。借助该变换，正文把已有的粗系数适定性和 divergence-free/Harnack 估计迁移回来，得到存在唯一性$、L^{2}/$梯度$/L\infty $ 量化估计；再结合插值定理，给出源 f 与 c 的可积性折衷及相应正则性。
techniques: 指数权变换吸收 $L^{2}$ 梯度漂移
加权弱形式与系数等价性

截断逼近和弱紧性

reports.title: Threshold for the existence of scattering states for inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equations without gauge invariance
reports.abstract: We consider the asymptotic behavior of solutions to inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equations with non-gauge-invariant nonlinearities. The spatial coefficient in the nonlinear term may have different orders of singularity at the origin and decay at infinity. Under a coercivity condition involving the coefficient and the nonlinearity, we show that no scattering states exist for the equation below a Strauss-type threshold determined by the decay at infinity. Our class includes nonlinearities with a dominant non-oscillatory component. We also prove a complementary small-data scattering result above this threshold, using non-admissible Strichartz estimates in Lorentz spaces adapted to the singular coefficient.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究不具 gauge invariance 的非线性非齐次 Schrödinger 方程 $i\partial tu+½\Delta u=K(x)F(u)$。系数 K 在原点和无穷远允许不同幂次，非线性满足 Lipschitz 型条件(A1)，并在(A2)中要求 K(x)F(z)具有固定相位的强制性下界。作者证明：当 p 低于由 K 在无穷远衰减决定的 Strauss 型指数 $pst(b\infty )$ 时，满足指定渐近条件的非零散射态不存在；当 p 高于同一阈值并满足参数兼容性时，借助适配奇异系数的非可容许 Lorentz–Strichartz 估计，对自由演化小的数据做压缩映射，得到全局解和 $L^{2}$ 散射。两部分分别由时空测试函数矛盾法与 Duhamel 固定点完成。

reports.title: Rate of convergence of a fully discrete structure-preserving midpoint scheme for the stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation
reports.abstract: The stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (sLLG) equation is a strongly nonlinear stochastic PDE with a non-convex pointwise constraint arising in the theory of micromagnetics. We analyse a fully discrete, structure-preserving finite element approximation of the sLLG equation with coloured multiplicative Stratonovich noise on a bounded interval. The method utilises continuous piecewise affine finite elements, mass lumping, and midpoint time discretisation to preserve the unit-length constraint exactly at the finite element nodes. Under suitable regularity assumptions on the initial data and the noise, we establish uniform higher-moment stability and develop an error analysis for the scheme. The analysis exploits the geometric structure of the equation and the stochastic midpoint discretisation. For every $γ\in(0,\frac12)$, we prove first-order spatial convergence and temporal convergence of order $γ$ in the natural discrete energy norm, locally in mean square on events of arbitrarily large probability and, consequently, in probability. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first convergence-rate result for a fully discrete structure-preserving finite element scheme solving the stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation.
reports.workSummary: 本文分析一维有色乘性 Stratonovich 噪声下随机 Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert 方程的全离散有限元 midpoint 方法。作者采用质量集中的连续 P1 元和时间中点离散，使每个节点的磁化长度严格保持为1；随后以离散拉普拉斯能量测试配合离散 BDG 不等式，得到与网格 h、时间步 k 无关的高阶矩稳定性。误差被分成插值误差和离散误差，漂移项用质量集成/乘积插值估计，随机 midpoint 缺陷则在停止事件上逐项改写成 Itô 积分、增量平方项和双增量项。最终在任意 $\gamma <1/2$ 下得到能量范数中的 $h+k^\gamma $ 收敛（局部大概率事件上均方，进而依概率）。

reports.title: Singular Extremal Solutions on Thin Ellipsoids with Varying Nonlinearities
reports.abstract: Let $N=m+1$ and consider the thin ellipsoid \[ Ω_\varepsilon=\{(y,x_N)\in\mathbb R^m\times\mathbb R:\ |y|^2+\varepsilon^{-2}x_N^2<1\}. \] We prove that in every sufficiently large dimension, for every sufficiently small $\varepsilon>0$, there exists a smooth positive, strictly increasing, strictly convex, superlinear nonlinearity $f_\varepsilon$ for which the extremal solution in $Ω_\varepsilon$ is an unbounded $H^1_0$ solution. Combining this result with Dancer's thin-domain regularity theorem for the Gelfand nonlinearity $f(t)=e^t$, we obtain on the same sufficiently thin ellipsoids a bounded Gelfand extremal solution and an unbounded extremal solution for another nonlinearity. Thus, in this two-part sense, Brézis' Open Problem~6.1 is resolved in every sufficiently large dimension.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究高维薄椭球上的半线性 Dirichlet 极值解。作者先把薄椭球缩放为圆柱域，围绕常边界问题 $-\Delta q=\Lambda _{0}(q+q^{2})$ 构造随边界参数变化的最小正解分支，再用三种尺度的 blow-up 分析控制分支的径向幅度和尾部。高维条件 $m\ge m1\ge 17$ 使 Hardy 不等式与薄方向 Poincaré gap 合起来给出分支一致的 Jacobi 算子 coercivity；加权 Lyapunov–Schmidt 构造也提供阈值附近的模型。最后把边界参数推进到极值端点：若端点有界，椭圆正则性和统一谱隙会继续分支，矛盾，因此得到 $H01\cap L3$ 但不属于 $L\infty $ 的半稳定极值解，并与 Gelfand 非线性的有界性结果组合解决 Brézis 问题的两部分。

reports.title: Solutions of Duhamel's formula with a sum of mappings
reports.abstract: Semilinear evolution equations are solved by means of the variation of constants formula under the action of smoothing linear operators and a finite number of nonlinearities operating between chosen Banach spaces of a given family. Admissible spaces of initial conditions are determined for the existence and uniqueness of a suitable notion of solution. Its maximal time of existence, short time and blow up time profiles, global extendibility and regularity are analyzed. For extrapolated fractional power scale of Banach spaces the fulfillment of the corresponding Cauchy problem is shown. Chosen applications to the modified viscous Cahn-Hilliard equation in R^N, the evolution of cell population of varying genotype and the semilinear Schrödinger equation are presented.
reports.workSummary: 本文建立带有限个非线性映射之和的 Duhamel 公式抽象理论。在线性解析半群生成的外推分数幂 Banach 标度 $E\sigma $ 中，作者允许每个 Fi 作用于不同的相空间 $E^{\alpha i}$ 并落在 $E^{\beta i}$，用奇异卷积指数 d(·,·) 描述半群平滑和非线性增长的匹配。正文先估计 Duhamel 映射的积分项和时间连续性，再在带 $t^{d(\gamma ,\alpha i)}$ 权的 Banach 球上做压缩映射，得到局部唯一 $\gamma -solution$；通过时间平移、Volterra 型差分估计和有限时刻范数控制，延拓为最大解并给出有限爆破时范数发散。外推分数幂尺度中还证明该积分解具有时间导数，随后应用于高阶 Cahn–Hilliard、细胞群体和 Schrödinger 模型。

reports.title: The Dirichlet problem for a non-commutative elliptic operator in the ball
reports.abstract: In this paper we establish a necessary and sufficient condition for the solvability of the Dirichlet problem in the unit ball $\mathbb{B}$ for the second order system $\partial_{\underline{x}} f\partial_{\underline{x}}=0$, where $\partial_{\underline{x}}$ stands for the Clifford-algebra valued Dirac operator in $\mathbb{R}^m$. We prove that the problem admits a solution whenever the boundary data belong to $C^1(\partial\mathbb{B})$. Conversely, we construct explicit counterexamples showing that solvability may fail if this smoothness assumption on the boundary is not satisfied. Moreover, in contrast with the standard commutative setting, we show how that solutions exhibit a regularity one order less than the boundary data, when the latter belong to $C^{k,ν}(\partial\mathbb{B})$.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究 Clifford 代数值 inframonogenic 函数在单位球中的 Dirichlet 问题，方程是 sandwich 算子 $\partial x f$ $\partial x=0$。作者先利用 Dirac 算子平方为负 Laplacian、Clifford 反自同构 $\Psi $ 的代数恒等式以及 Almansi 型分解，把零边界的三次单调部分写成 $(1-|x|^{2})\eta $，其中 $\eta $ 是双侧 monogenic 函数。由此将一般边界值解表示成 Poisson 延拓 P[g] 加上 $\Psi ^{-1}(\partial xP[g]\partial x)$ 的显式修正项。该表示给出连续边界数据的必要充分极限条件；对 $C^{1}$ 边界数据，调和函数 Hessian 的边界衰减保证条件成立并得到唯一解；构造 Fourier 级数型调和函数展示连续但非 $C^{1}$ 数据可能失败，并进一步证明 $C^{k,\nu }$ 数据的解损失一阶 Hölder 正则性。

reports.limitations: 主要结论针对单位球、Clifford 代数值 inframonogenic 方程和文中定义的 sandwich 算子；显式 $\Psi ^{-1}$ 在奇维与偶维的代数性质不同，偶维部分只能给出简短处理。边界正则性结论依赖球的 Poisson 核和光滑球面，不直接覆盖一般区域、非零下阶项或低于连续边界数据的函数空间。

reports.title: Asymmetric Periodic Water Waves in Finite Depth
reports.abstract: We consider the full two-dimensional water-wave equations in finite depth, with and without surface tension. Water waves have been studied mathematically for more than two centuries. Reflection symmetry remains a common assumption in constructions of periodic steady waves, although asymmetric profiles have been observed in experiments and numerical computations. We construct families of periodic stationary solutions whose free surfaces have no axis of reflection, in both the pure-gravity and capillary--gravity cases. To the best of our knowledge, this provides the first rigorous construction of asymmetric periodic pure-gravity waves for the full two-dimensional water-wave problem in finite depth. The proof combines localized vorticity laws with a Lyapunov--Schmidt reduction. In the pure-gravity case, we introduce a small background shear flow to obtain an invertible boundary operator and couple the interior and free-surface approximations at leading order.
reports.workSummary: 本文构造有限深二维 Euler 水波方程中的周期稳态自由表面，并证明表面没有任何竖直反射轴。作者把局部涡量集中在若干小圆盘中，用 Green 函数和周期镜像构造主近似；纯重力情形加入小背景剪切，使边界算子可逆，并把内部涡量与自由表面条件在首阶耦合。正文先建立非局部混合边界问题的 Schauder 可解性，再对近似场的误差做压缩映射修正。Lyapunov–Schmidt 约化把剩余有限维方程化为周期 Kirchhoff–Routh 函数的临界点条件，最后用非退化临界点随 $\epsilon $ 扰动的位置选择消去涡核系数，得到纯重力及毛细–重力两类无轴对称周期波。

reports.title: Necessary and Sufficient Condition of Existence for the Quadrature Surfaces Free Boundary Problem in Riemannian Geometry
reports.abstract: We generalize to the setting of compact Riemannian manifolds a recent result of Barkatou on quadrature surfaces. Following the geometric and variational framework recently developed by Djité and Seck, we formulate the quadrature surface free boundary problem as a shape optimization problem on a compact Riemannian manifold. Using the Riemannian $RC$-GNP condition introduced in \cite{DjiteSeck2026} and the stability results established therein, we prove that the quadrature surface problem $QS(f,k)$ admits a solution strictly containing the totally convex hull $C$ of the support of $f$ if and only if the following integral condition holds: \[ \int_C f(x)\,dv(g) > k |\partial C|_g, \] where $dv(g)$ is the Riemannian volume element and $|\partial C|_g$ is the perimeter of $C$ with respect to the metric $g$. This work extends the results of Barkatou et al. (2005) by replacing the Euclidean space with a Riemannian manifold. We also provide explicit examples on the round sphere where the condition can be verified explicitly. This paper complements the recent works \cite{DjiteSeck2026} and \cite{DjiteSeck2026b} by establishing a sharp necessary and sufficient condition in the spirit of the Euclidean result of Barkatou.
reports.workSummary: 本文把紧致非负曲率 Riemann 流形上的 Laplace–Beltrami quadrature surface 自由边界问题转成域形状优化。给定非负源 f、其全凸包 C 和边界通量常数 k，作者在满足 RC-GNP 的 admissible class 中以 Dirichlet 能量减去 $k^{2}$ 体积构造泛函。紧性和 Dirichlet 解对域的 $H^{1}$ 稳定性使直接法得到最优域；形状导数给出自由边界上的梯度条件。随后用 C 与候选域的接触比较、Hopf 边界引理以及非负曲率下周长严格增大性质，证明若且唯若 ∫C f $dv_g>k|\partial C|_g$，则最优域严格包含 C 且在新边界满足 $|\nabla u|=k$。
techniques: RC-GNP 几何紧性与 Hausdorff 收敛
Dirichlet 问题 $H^{1}$ 稳定性
直接法和能量下半连续性
形状导数与自由边界最优性
比较原理、Hopf 引理和全凸包接触分析
reports.breakthrough: 论文把欧氏 quadrature surface 判据推广到紧致非负曲率 Riemann 流形，并得到精确的必要充分条件 $∫_C$ $f,dv_g>k|\partial C|_g$；曲率假设正好用于把严格包含 C 的域的边界测度与 C 分开，从而闭合充分性与必要性的几何缺口。
reports.limitations: 结果要求紧致、连通、单连通且截面曲率非负的流形，源 $f\in L^{2}_g$ 为正且支集全凸包 C 严格凸；admissible class 必须满足 RC-GNP 和稳定性假设，边界正则性与经典形状导数也需额外满足。论文给出存在性判据而非稳定性、数值算法或一般曲率符号下的完整理论。

reports.title: Necessary and Sufficient Condition of Existence for the $p$-Laplacian Quadrature Surfaces Free Boundary Problem in Riemannian Geometry
reports.abstract: We generalize the necessary and sufficient condition of existence for the quadrature surfaces free boundary problem to the case of the $p$-Laplacian operator in Riemannian geometry. Following the shape optimization approach of Barkatou for the Euclidean case and the Riemannian framework recently developed by Djité and Seck, we formulate the $p$-Laplacian quadrature surface problem as a shape optimization problem on a compact Riemannian manifold. Using the Riemannian $RC$-GNP condition, the stability results, and the $p$-Laplacian shape derivative formula from \cite{DjiteSeck2026b}, we prove that the $p$-Laplacian quadrature surface problem $QS_p(f,k)$ admits a solution strictly containing the totally convex hull $C$ of the support of $f$ if and only if \[ \int_C f(x)\,dv(g) > k^{p-1} |\partial C|_g, \] for $1 < p < \infty$, under suitable regularity and stability assumptions. This extends the Euclidean result of Barkatou for $p=2$ and the Riemannian result of Djité and Seck to the nonlinear $p$-Laplacian setting. Explicit examples on the round sphere are provided, including the computation of the radial $p$-harmonic solution and the boundary flux.
reports.workSummary: 本文将 Riemann 流形上的 quadrature surface 自由边界问题从 Laplace–Beltrami 算子推广到 p-Laplacian。给定 $f\in L^p$、全凸包 C 和常数 k，作者在满足 RC-GNP 与 boundary-flux stability 的 admissible class 中以 p-能量减去 $k^{p}$ 体积建立形状泛函。首先证明域紧性和 p-Laplacian Dirichlet 解的 $W^{1,p}$ 稳定性，直接法得到最优域；接着通过 p-能量形状导数和第一阶变分获得边界梯度条件。最后用 p-Laplacian 比较原理、Hopf 引理和接触处几何比较，证明存在严格包含 C 的解当且仅当 ∫C $f,dv_g>k^{p-1}|\partial C|_g$。

reports.limitations: 结论要求紧致连通单连通、非负截面曲率的 Riemann 流形$，f\in L^p$ 非负且 C 严格凸，并假设 admissible class 满足 RC-GNP 与 (SC) 边界通量稳定性。p-Laplacian 的边界正则性和 Hopf 引理需文中光滑性/非退化梯度条件；未覆盖一般曲率、退化接触或不稳定 admissible 类，也未研究稳定性与数值近似。

reports.title: Interior $W^{2,p}$ regularity for the sigma-$2$ equation
reports.abstract: We prove that continuous $2$-convex solutions of the $σ_{2}$ equation with a density bounded above and below by positive constants belong to $W^{2,1}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ in every dimension. If, in addition, the density is continuous, the solutions belong to $W^{2,p}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ for every $1<p<\infty$.
reports.workSummary: 本文证明 $\sigma _{2}$ Hessian 方程的连续 2-凸解具有内部二阶 Sobolev 正则性。对 Hessian 测度满足 $\lambda \le f\le \Lambda $ 的解，作者先用 2-凸性和 Hessian 测度弱连续性得到分布 Hessian 的局部 $W^{1,1}$ 控制，并将方程写成凹算子 $G(D^{2}u)=\sqrt \sigma _{2}(D^{2}u)$。随后在球内构造带截断的光滑近似方程，使密度从粗糙数据逐步逼近目标；对线性化方程使用 trace-dependent quotient 计算、最大值原理与局部边界 Hessian 估计，获得 $D(H^{p/2}(Du))$ 的统一局部界。紧性和弱极限把该估计传回原连续解，给出任意有界正密度下 $W^{2,1}_loc$，以及连续密度下所有有限 p 的 $W^{2,p}_loc$。

reports.limitations: 结论是内部正则性，要求 u 连续且 2-凸、密度正且有界$；W^{2,p}$ 版本还要求 f 连续并依赖其局部模连续性。证明在球内进行，不给出边界正则性、全局估计、密度仅可测时的 p>1 提升，也不处理 $\sigma k(k\ne 2)$ 的同样结论。

reports.title: Second-order regularity for weighted widely degenerate problems with explicit $u$-dependence
reports.abstract: We consider local weak solutions of widely degenerate elliptic PDEs of the type \begin{equation} \label{equazione mia} \mathrm{div}\Biggl(|x|^β(|Du|-1)^{p-1}_+\frac{Du}{|Du|}\Biggr)=\frac{|u|^{q-2}u}{|x|^α} \ \ \text{ in }Ω, \end{equation} where $2\leq p<n$, $α,β>0$ are fixed exponents, $Ω$ is an open subset of $\mathbb{R}^n,$ that contains the origin, $n>2,$ and $( \ \cdot \ )_+$ stands for the positive part. We establish a higher differentiability result for the composition of the gradient with a suitable function that vanishes in the unit ball for the gradient, under appropriate assumptions on the datum. The novelty here with respect to previous papers on the subject is that the right-hand side explicitly depends on the solution $u$ and we have a mismatch between the weight on the left-hand side and the right-hand side.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究含双重空间权和显式 u 依赖的广泛退化椭圆方程。方程的主部是 $|x|^\beta (|Du|-1)_+^{p-1}Du/|Du|$，右端含 $|x|^{-\alpha }|u|^{q-2}u$，原点同时存在退化权与奇异源。作者证明局部弱解的梯度经过截断函数 $H^{p/2}_s$ 后获得一阶 Sobolev 可微性。核心先在正则化权 $\epsilon +|x|^\beta $ 和平滑源上，对局部差商测试建立 $H^{p/2}(Du)$ 的统一估计；广义 Hölder 与无权 Sobolev 嵌入把两个空间权解耦。最后令平滑和非退化参数消失，通过弱紧性、局部强收敛及边界数据恢复原解的局部估计。

reports.title: Dimension free weak-type endpoint estimates for the vectors of the Dunkl--Riesz transform
reports.abstract: Let $R\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ be a reduced root system, $G$ the associated finite reflection group, and $k\ge0$ a $G$-invariant multiplicity function. We develop a Dunkl analogue of the obstacle/partial-balayage method of Ouyang, Spector, and Stockdale (https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.18068) for the Euclidean fractional Laplacian. For $0<s<2$, nonnegative $f\in L^1(ν_k)\cap L^2(ν_k)$, and $λ>0$, we obtain a decomposition \[ f=μ+(-Δ_k)^{s/2}u, \qquad 0\leμ\leλ, \] with $μ=λ$ on $Ω=\{u>0\}$ and \[ λν_k(Ω)\le\|f\|_{L^1(ν_k)}. \] As an application, we prove that the vector Dunkl--Riesz transform $\mathcal R_k=\nabla_k(-Δ_k)^{-1/2}$ is of weak type $(1,1)$ with constant at most $(M_k+2)$, where \[ M_k=\#\{α\in R_+:k(α)>0\}. \] For $G$-invariant functions, the reflection terms vanish and the same argument gives the universal constant $2$. We further establish a dimension-free weak-type $(1,1)$ estimate for the Dunkl--Schrödinger Riesz transform.
reports.workSummary: 本文把 Ouyang–Spector–Stockdale 的 obstacle/partial-balayage 思路推广到 Dunkl 分数 Laplacian。对非负 $f\in L^{1}(\nu k)\cap L^{2}(\nu k)$，作者在 $0\le v\le \lambda $ 的凸集上最小化分数 Dunkl 能量减去 ∫fv 和 $\lambda ∫v$，先用正跳核表示、Markov 性质和 $L^{1}–$能量插值得到 coercivity，再以弱紧性取得唯一障碍势 u。Euler–Lagrange 关系在接触区 {u>0} 给出余量 $\mu =\lambda $，且 Dunkl 反射项使自然梯度只在反射扩张 $\Omega ♯$ 外消失。最后把 $\mu $ 与 $A_k^{s/2}u$ 的分解代入热半群/平方函数表示，利用 $L^{2}$ 等距和反射局部化控制超水平集，得到向量 Dunkl–Riesz 变换的弱型(1,1)常数 Mk+2；G 不变数据时反射项消失，常数降为2。

reports.limitations: 一般数据的 Mk+2 上界未被声称最优，反射扩张是方法带来的损失；分解要求 $f\in L^{1}\cap L^{2}、0<s<2$ 和非负障碍上界 $\lambda ，G$ 不变的常数2 只适用于对称数据。结果基于固定 Euclidean 根系、Dunkl 测度和全空间算子，不直接覆盖非对称势、有限域或端点 $s=2$。

reports.title: Planar Gross--Pitaevskii traveling waves at every subsonic speed
reports.abstract: For every subsonic speed $c\in(0,\sqrt2)$, we prove the existence of a finite-energy traveling wave for the planar Gross--Pitaevskii equation. This resolves the longstanding problem of the existence of prescribed-speed traveling-wave solutions in two dimensions, explicitly stated as open by Mariş (Ann. of Math., 2013) and Bellazzini and Ruiz (Amer. J. Math., 2023). The proof relies essentially on the energy estimate \begin{equation*} E(ψ)\le C_J\bigl(I_c(ψ)+\ind(ψ)\bigr), \qquad c\in J, \end{equation*} where $E$ is the energy, $I_c$ the action at speed $c$, $\ind$ the real Morse index, $J$ is any compact interval contained in $(0,\sqrt2)$, and $C_J$ is a positive constant depending only on $J$. We also prove finite-bubble compactness, including splitting of the energy, action, potential energy, and momentum, and attainment of the action among nonconstant waves of Morse index at most one.
reports.workSummary: 本文解决二维 Gross–Pitaevskii 行波的预定速度问题。作者把有限能量行波的二维方程沿水平线切片为带横向残差的复值一维方程，先用一维精确解的刚性和固定长度 cell 分类，把横向能量、残差、负方向与几何增长分别记账；再用 Morse 指标限制负 cell 的总数，得到 $E(\psi )\le C_J(I_c(\psi )+ind(\psi ))$。这个估计控制了几乎处处速度序列的能量逃逸，结合局部非消失和 Fatou 极限，遂把 Bellazzini–Ruiz 的几乎处处存在提升到每个 $0<c<\sqrt 2$，并进一步证明有限 bubble 分解和指标至多一的最小作用量波。

reports.limitations: 论证在平面 $R^{2}$、归一化有限能量解以及严格次声速 $c\in (0,\sqrt 2)$ 内进行，常数依赖速度的紧子区间；存在性沿用已有几乎处处速度解和非消失结果，未覆盖声速端点、超声速、一般维数或唯一性/动力学稳定性。

reports.title: A growth gap for anisotropic minimal graphs
reports.abstract: We prove a growth gap for the gradient of entire anisotropic minimal graphs. For each $n\geq2$ and each smooth uniformly elliptic parametric integrand $Φ$ on $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$, there is an exponent $α=α(n,Φ)>0$ such that every smooth nonaffine entire $Φ$-minimal graph $u:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ satisfies $\sup_{B_R^n}|Du|\geq cR^α$ for all $R\geq R_0$, for some constants $c>0$ and $R_0<\infty$ depending on the solution. In particular, gradient growth $o(R^α)$ forces flatness, resolving a conjecture of Mooney and the author. The result holds in every dimension, without any assumption that $Φ$ is close to the Euclidean area integrand.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究一般光滑、正一齐次且一致椭圆的各向异性最小图。作者先把整个图的下方集通过校准转成全局各向异性周长极小集，再建立 Jacobi 场与其倒数满足的椭圆不等式。均值估计排除归一化次解把最大值集中到零测集，墙刚性和极小边界紧性把任何退化极限识别为半空间；由此证明倒数竖直 Jacobi 场在固定尺度上要么由中心值控制、要么在放大半径后至少翻倍。迭代这个比较得到梯度的幂次增长间隙，低于该幂次的整个图只能是仿射。
techniques: 校准与全局各向异性周长最小性
各向异性 Jacobi 方程和倒数次解
Sobolev/Moser 均值估计
墙接触刚性与极小边界紧性
固定尺度倍增迭代与 Liouville 结论
reports.breakthrough: 论文在不要求 integrand 接近欧氏面积、也不要求偶对称的条件下，给出所有维数统一的梯度增长间隙：非仿射整个图必有 $sup_{B_R}|Du|\ge cR^\alpha $。证明把奇异极限处的最大值集恢复和墙刚性结合起来，得到此前缺少的固定尺度倍增机制。
reports.limitations: 结果要求图光滑、参数 integrand 固定且光滑正一齐次并一致椭圆$；\alpha $仅由紧性论证存在，未给出有效数值、最优值或接近面积 integrand 时的定量行为。二维情形调用已有 Bernstein 定理，本文新紧性机制的非平凡范围主要是 $n\ge 3$，且不处理非光滑图或一般极小流。

reports.title: Non-uniqueness for the Complex Ginzburg-Landau Equation
reports.abstract: We show that singularities of the three-dimensional cubic complex Ginzburg-Landau equation developing from smooth initial data can induce non-uniqueness of solutions after the time of blowup. The solutions we study start as backward self-similar solutions, and the source of the non-uniqueness is an unstable eigenvalue of the linearization around the forward self-similar profile generated by the singularity. We establish the existence of this eigenvalue, and hence the non-uniqueness, by a computer-assisted proof for specific values of the parameters in the equation. The work is in part motivated by similarities to conjectured behavior for the Navier-Stokes equation, with which the complex Ginzburg-Landau equation shares several important properties, such as an energy inequality and the scaling symmetry.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究三维立方复 Ginzburg–Landau 方程在奇异时间后的非唯一延拓。作者先以径向常微分方程和区间 Newton 方法构造 backward 自相似剖面 Q，再匹配具有相同无穷远主项的 forward 剖面 Q̂；对 Q̂ 的线性化算子把谱问题写成零点函数 $H(\lambda )$，用解析性、区间包围和绕数一证明存在正实部不稳定特征值。随后在加权 $H^{2}$ 空间将线性化半群分解为稳定/不稳定子空间，以 Duhamel 映射压缩构造衰减但非零的扰动 $\phi $；缩放回原变量后，未扰动 forward 解与含 $\phi $ 的解在 $t=0$ 具有同一初值，却在 t>0 不同，并满足局部适定弱解性质。

reports.title: The entropy production is not always monotone for the Kac equation
reports.abstract: In 1966, McKean conjectured that the entropy production of Kac's caricature of a Maxwellian gas is nonincreasing in time \cite{McKean66}. We disprove this conjecture for the standard uniform-angle Kac equation. Our counterexamples are smooth, strictly positive, even mixtures of two Gaussians at different temperatures. We also show that every entropy derivative beyond the first violates its expected sign at some time along the same solution. The initial densities can be chosen with unit mass and second moment. mass and second moment.

reports.title: An Inverse Problem for Determining the Piston Speed from a Given Lipschitz Leading Shock
reports.abstract: We analyze an inverse problem for determining the piston speed and the associated flow field from a prescribed leading shock and the initial data in a shock tube. The gas flow is described by the isentropic Euler equations (i.e., the $p$-system), while the trajectory of the leading shock is prescribed as a given Lipschitz curve. Under an Oleĭnik-type entropy condition on the leading shock, we develop a modified wavefront tracking scheme to construct the flow field behind the shock. This construction enables us to determine the corresponding piston speed and the associated flow field.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究一维等熵 Euler p-system 的逆活塞问题：给定小 BV 扰动的 Lipschitz 领先激波轨迹和初始静止气体，反推出活塞速度及激波后的熵解流场。作者围绕领先激波后的参考状态建立两族波曲线和 forward-backward Riemann 解，将激波速度的变化转成小的 1、2 族弱波。再用带总弱波强度、相互作用乘积和活塞速度变差项的 Glimm 型泛函控制波相互作用；Oleinik 型速度条件确保反向稀疏波强度衰减，同族波前通过特征线距离估计保持分离。离散参数趋零后，近似流场在局部 L1 收敛、活塞速度在 BV 中收敛，得到满足熵条件的逆问题解和速度稳定性估计。

reports.title: Non-decaying weak solutions to the 2D quasi-geostrophic equations
reports.abstract: We investigate weak solutions to the two-dimensional quasi-geostrophic equations without dissipation. We establish global existence of weak solutions for temperature bounded and lacking spatial decay and velocity in the space $L^2_{ul}(\mathbb{R}^2)$. Our methods rely on a spectral Serfati identity, which we use to establish uniform $L^2_{ul}$ bounds on a sequence of velocities satisfying the dissipative equations. These bounds, combined with a maximum principle on the scalar temperature, allow us to pass to the zero-dissipation limit, giving global-in-time weak solutions.

reports.title: Local Well-Posedness of the Boundary Layer Equations for Dilatant Power-Law Fluids
reports.abstract: We establish the local-in-time existence and uniqueness of monotone solutions to the two-dimensional nonstationary boundary-layer equations for a dilatant power-law fluid in a periodic half-space for $1<n<\frac{7}{3}$. Under Oleinik's monotonicity condition and suitable weighted Sobolev assumptions on the initial data and outer flow, we construct solutions through tangential regularization and derive uniform a priori estimates. A suitable good unknown compensates for the loss of one tangential derivative caused by the normal velocity. By combining weighted energy estimates, the Faà di Bruno formula, and the maximum and minimum principles, we control the nonlinear degenerate diffusion term $\partial_y^2(ω^n)$, whose effective diffusion coefficient vanishes as $ω=\partial_yu$ decays at infinity, and propagate the weighted monotonicity of the vorticity. Within this exponent range, our result partially resolves the eleventh open problem posed by Oleinik and Samokhin \cite{OAO} on the existence and uniqueness of solutions to nonstationary boundary-layer systems for dilatant fluids.
reports.workSummary: 本文证明周期半空间中稀释型幂律流体二维非定常边界层方程的局部存在唯一性。对满足 Oleinik 单调性 $\partial _y$ u>0 的解，作者把非线性扩散写成退化系数 $n\omega ^{n-1}\partial _y^{2}\omega $，并加入小切向黏性 $\epsilon ^{2}\partial _x^{2}$ 构造正则化系统。法向导数使用加权能量估计，纯切向最高阶导数因法向速度 $v=-\partial _y^{-1}\partial _x u$ 产生导数损失，于是引入 good unknown $g^s_\epsilon =\partial _x^s\omega _\epsilon -(\partial _y\omega _\epsilon /\omega _\epsilon )\partial _x^s(u_\epsilon -U)$ 消除主损失。配合 Faà di Bruno 展开、边界兼容性、最大/最小值原理，得到独立于 $\epsilon $ 的加权 Sobolev 和单调性界；Aubin–Lions 极限给出原方程，最后对差解用通量平均线性化和 ḡ 能量不等式证明唯一性。

reports.title: Rotating vortex patches: rigidity, bifurcation, and unified structures
reports.abstract: This monograph presents a systematic account of several classical and recent developments in the theory of rotating vortex patches, or V-states, for the two-dimensional Euler equations and related active scalar models. Its purpose is both expository and structural: we revisit some of the foundational results of the subject, provide detailed proofs and alternative formulations, and present more recent results within a common analytical framework. We begin with Euler vortex patches and the contour dynamics formulation of rigidly rotating solutions. We then develop two complementary approaches to the V-state equation, based on Cauchy integrals and conformal mappings, and discuss their connections with potential theory and Faber polynomials. These tools are used to revisit classical examples, including Rankine vortices and Kirchhoff ellipses, as well as rigidity and classification results. A substantial part is devoted to Burbea construction of noncircular V-states via bifurcation theory. The final part develops a unified approach to rotating patches for a broad class of incompressible active scalar equations. Structural properties of the interaction kernel, in particular complete monotonicity and the resulting spectral factorization, yield a common bifurcation framework encompassing the Euler, generalized surface quasi-geostrophic, quasi-geostrophic shallow-water, and related models.
reports.workSummary: 这部专著系统整理二维 Euler 旋转涡斑和相关 active scalar 的 V-state 理论。前半部分从 Cauchy–Pompeiu/Plemelj 公式和外部共形映射出发，把刚性旋转边界方程改写为 Cauchy 积分、Faber 多项式和边界泛函；由此给出椭圆刻画、角速度刚性及 Burbea m 重对称分支的 Hölder/解析正则性证明。后半部分把相同构造推广到一类径向相互作用核：完全单调性先通过 Bernstein 表示把线性化 Fourier 系数因子化为通用函数 $ϕ_n$ 的积分，再用二阶 ODE 比较原理证明 $ϕ_n$、谱系数的正性和严格递减，从而确定简单核、Fredholm 指数零与横截性，最后再次应用 Crandall–Rabinowitz 得到各 m 的局部分支。

reports.title: Polynomial mixing for the 3D damped cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation with degenerate noise
reports.abstract: We prove polynomial mixing for the defocusing damped cubic stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the three-dimensional torus under saturating smooth finite rank Brownian forcing. The mixing rate is measured in the $p$-Wasserstein metric induced by the $H^1$ distance for every $1\le p<\infty$. We also obtain sharp geometric characterizations of saturation. The proof is based on a polynomial mixing criterion built on a stable--compact decomposition of the exact solution differences with polynomial moment control of the logarithmic path amplification. Dense Malliavin range allows the compact defect to be compensated by finite-dimensional Cameron--Martin shifts, producing a block multiplier with negative mean logarithm. A logarithmic transportation gauge, combined with a renewal--reset coupling scheme, then yields mixing at every prescribed polynomial order in the weaker $L^2$ distance. A stationary regularity gain to $H^{2-}$ then enables us to upgrade the convergence to $H^1$.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究三维环面上的 defocusing damped cubic stochastic NLS，在噪声仅作用于有限个光滑空间剖面的退化情形下建立任意阶多项式混合。作者先对精确解差构造 Bogoliubov 型 stable–compact 分解，将不可收缩部分压缩为紧缺陷；再用终点 Malliavin 导数的稠密值域以有限维 Cameron–Martin 位移补偿该缺陷，得到平均对数收缩。统一不可约性提供重置，抽象判据把局部负对数漂移转为任意多项式速度；最后用平稳四波恒等式得到 $H^{2-}$ 正则性，把 $L^{2}$ 耦合提升到 $H^{1}$ Wasserstein。

reports.title: MIT bag model and infinite mass limit in non-smooth domains
reports.abstract: The work is devoted to the study of Dirac operators with MIT bag boundary conditions in Euclidean domains with compact Lipschitz boundaries in arbitrary dimensions. It is shown that such operators are self-adjoint on suitable definition domains and can be recovered as the norm-resolvent limits of Dirac operators in the whole space with a large mass term outside the domain, under the assumption that an associated Robin-Laplacian eigenvalue has a prescribed asymptotic behavior with respect to a parameter in the boundary condition. This assumption is shown to hold for a class of non-smooth domains, which includes convex domains and, more generally, domains that can be "locally convexified" by suitable diffeomorphisms. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the first infinite mass interpretation for the MIT bag model in the sense of resolvent convergence for non-smooth domains. Most results are extended to the generalized MIT bag boundary conditions with the help of the recently established congruence transform.

reports.title: Polynomial mixing for the weakly damped stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the whole space
reports.abstract: We consider the weakly damped stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS) equation on the real line, driven by a noise that is white in time and smooth in space. Assuming that the noise is sufficiently non-degenerate, we prove that the equation has a unique stationary measure in the class of probability measures concentrated on $H^2$, and establish polynomial mixing in the dual-Lipschitz metric over $H^1$. We do not impose any restriction on the size of the damping. The proof is based on a coupling argument, whose key ingredient is a Foiaş-Prodi-type estimate in the $H^1$-norm, derived by means of a Lyapunov functional adapted to the linearized NLS dynamics. To compensate for the loss of compactness, we combine this estimate with a truncated Poincaré inequality and a space-time weight function quantifying the spatial decay of solutions.

reports.title: Stability of Magnetizable Piezoelectric Beam Systems with Two Fractional Infinite Memory Terms
reports.abstract: In this paper, we investigate a class of magnetizable piezoelectric beam systems with two fractional infinite memory terms, whose fractional orders are denoted by \(θ_1, θ_2 \in [0,1]\). By introducing the Dafermos history variable, we construct an augmented state space and reformulate the system as an abstract evolution equation. The well-posedness of the system is established via semigroup theory. Through a frequency-domain analysis, we characterize the asymptotic behavior of the solutions. We show that the system is exponentially stable if \(θ_1 = θ_2 = 1\), and is polynomially stable in all other cases, with the explicit decay rate \(t^{-\frac{1}{2-2θ_0}}\), where \(θ_0 = \min\{θ_1, θ_2\}\). Furthermore, the optimality of the obtained decay rate is verified.
reports.workSummary: 论文把带两个分数阶无限记忆项的磁化压电梁抽象为含位移、速度、电位移、速度及两条历史变量的 Hilbert 空间演化方程。Dafermos 历史变量把 Volterra 记忆变为自治生成元，作者先用耗散性、Lumer–Phillips 定理和 Lax–Milgram 证明收缩 C0 半群适定；再用频域反证和分数阶插值证明当任一记忆阶低于1时的多项式衰减，并在指数型核下用谱序列验证最优性。两阶都等于1时，虚轴预解一致有界，得到指数稳定。

reports.title: Continuation and reduction of steady vortex sheets under metric deformations on a disk
reports.abstract: We study the local continuation of a steady vortex sheet under a prescribed deformation $g_s= e^{2σ_s}g_{\mathrm{e}}$ of a conformal metric on the unit disk. Representing the moving sheet by a normal graph, we formulate the streamline and Bernoulli conditions as a nonlinear residual whose two components have different Sobolev orders. If the two one-sided tangential velocities of the reference sheet do not vanish simultaneously, the derivative of the unnormalized residual is Fredholm of index two. Fixing the mean normal displacement and the total circulation gives an index-zero problem; when the normalization differential restricted to the unnormalized kernel is onto $\mathbb{R}^2$, we obtain a parameter-dependent Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction. This yields a locally unique normalized branch in the nondegenerate case and explicit first- and second-order necessary conditions in the degenerate case. For a rotationally symmetric reference metric and a concentric circular sheet, the linearized problem separates into Fourier blocks and only finitely many modes can be resonant. In the constant-curvature disk family, every mode $k\geq2$ is nonresonant, whereas the first mode produces a two-dimensional reduced problem. The two first-mode kernel profiles are normal traces of ambient Killing fields, but they do not generate fixed-boundary symmetries or, by themselves, a nonconcentric branch.

reports.title: Modulated Gibbs Measure and Mean-Field Limit for 3D Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck Equations
reports.abstract: We introduce a modulated Gibbs measure for the usual tensorized initial data for stochastic Newton's systems with singular repulsive interactions. Using the uniform-in-$N$ partition-function estimates of Wang--Zhao \cite{wang2026uniform}, we show that the modulated Gibbs measure and its tensorized reference are $O(N^{-1})$-close in normalized relative entropy. A stability argument then transfers propagation of chaos from modulated Gibbs measures to tensorized data and other initial laws at the same entropy scale. Combined with the weighted BBGKY estimates of Bresch--Jabin--Soler \cite{bresch2025new}, this yields the first cutoff-free mean-field limit and propagation of chaos for the three-dimensional Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck (VPFP) equation on an $N$-independent short-time interval.
reports.workSummary: 论文为具有奇异排斥 Riesz 相互作用的随机 Newton 系统引入相对于给定单粒子密度的 modulated Gibbs 初始律。均匀 N 无关的配分函数界把 Gibbs 倾斜与张量积参考律之间的归一化相对熵控制在 $O(N^{-1})；modulated$ free energy 的演化恒等式把该控制传给带速度扩散的 N 粒子方程。作者用熵稳定性和 Donsker–Varadhan 不等式先把 Gibbs 初律的 chaos 转移到一般熵相近初律，再调用加权 BBGKY 估计，得到三维无截断 VPFP 在 N 无关短时间内的 mean-field limit。

reports.title: On the cost of reaching an attainable state for the boundary-controlled 1-D heat equation
reports.abstract: We consider the heat equation in an interval of the real line, with null initial condition, and Dirichlet boundary controls. We study the cost of reaching an attainable state at some time $T>0$. Precisely, given a state in the interval that we know is reachable by suitable boundary controls, we estimate the size of the smallest controls that reach it, in terms of an appropriate norm of this state. Our estimate is optimal in some sense as the time horizon goes to $0$.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究一维区间上零初值、两端 Dirichlet 边界控制热方程的可达状态控制代价。作者利用已知可达空间等于菱形复域上的 Bergman 函数限制，把控制构造转化为两个复域 Bergman 空间在重叠正方形上的分离问题。核心是对加权限制算子的伴随建立带 $exp(\kappa *L^{2}/T)$ 的下界：先解无界象限/菱形上的 Poisson 方程并控制分离奇点，再通过 Aikawa–Hayashi–Saitoh 积分变换把两份全纯函数还原成边界热控制，得到任意可达目标的快速时间控制代价，并进一步推出零可控估计。

reports.title: Nonlinear profiles on solutions to the surface quasi-geostrophic equation
reports.abstract: The quasi-geostrophic equation is well known as a model for predicting potential temperature around low-pressure systems in high-latitude regions. When diffusion effects are added to this equation, it serves as a model for potential temperature at the sea surface. In either case, the nonlinear term represents the effect of the Coriolis force. This paper yields nonlinear profile in solutions to the surface quasi-geostrophic equation. This profile is determined uniquely from the perspective of large-time behavior of solutions. Components of solutions are arranged sequentially from slow to fast decay based on the parabolic scale. Then such an expansion is determined uniquely. Since the equation is subcritical in the context of large-time effects, the main components exhibit linear features. Nonlinear characteristics appear in components that have a smaller effect on solutions. From the perspective of the correlation between spacetime variables, nonlinear profiles exhibit characteristics that are distinctly different from those of linear profiles. Moreover, the nonlinear effects of this equation are expected to be weaker than those of other equations with the same scale due to their spatial structure. The main theorem publishes minute, but unique rotational flow arising from the Coriolis force.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究二维耗散表面准地转方程 $\theta t+R⊥\theta \cdot \nabla \theta =\Delta \theta $ 的大时间展开。在线性热核轮廓 $\Theta _{0}、\Theta _{1}、\Theta _{2}、\Theta _{3}$ 之外，作者从非线性卷积中提取一个具有旋转结构的三阶 profile $J3=J3L+J3H$；其中低频部分表现为二阶热核导数，高频部分由含时间积分和 resolvent 型核的非局部表达给出。通过 Riesz 变换加权估计、时间卷积分解、矩消去和重整化，证明在 $|x|^{3}$ 初始矩有限时余项达到 $o(t^{-\gamma q-3/2})$，再增加四阶矩得到 $O(t^{-\gamma q-2}log$ t) 误差。

reports.title: A model of a multiphase medium based on the closure of moment chains for the Vlasov-Poisson equations
reports.abstract: We propose a method for closing moment chains for the Vlasov-Poisson kinetic system (the Landau fluid model), which yields a hyperbolic system of equations at each subsequent step. This system is interpreted as a multicomponent medium, where each component has its own density, velocity, and pressure. The coupling between the components is mediated by an electric field. The principle of closing moment chains is that the final component of the fluid is assumed to be pressureless.
reports.workSummary: 论文提出一维无碰撞 Vlasov–Poisson 方程的 Landau-fluid 多相矩链闭合。作者从动理学方程导出所有 Hamburger 矩方程，在奇数阶 $j=2k-1$ 处令 Hölder 不等式取等价条件 $(M_j)^2=M_{j-1}M_{j+1}$，从而递归表达更高矩。闭合矩系统具有一个重复特征值和零特征值，随后改写成 k 个密度/速度/压力组分通过电场耦合的守恒形式，并证明后续矩方程成为前面系统的结果。文末用冷等离子体、双流体热流和高斯分布说明不同闭合层级的含义。
techniques: Vlasov–Poisson 矩方程积分
Hölder 等号条件闭合
矩变量到多相密度/速度/压力变量的变换
非严格双曲矩阵谱计算
守恒律与分布假设下的示例闭合
reports.breakthrough: 提出一种可在任意奇数阶闭合、保持非严格双曲结构且让后续矩方程成为逻辑后果的多相 Landau-fluid 模型；最后一个组分自然呈现为无压力介质，给出从动理学矩链到多相守恒系统的统一解释。
reports.limitations: 这是基于矩链等号假设的模型构造，论文不证明该闭合系统逼近原 Vlasov–Poisson 解，也不分析闭合系统的完整适定性、稳定性或 Landau 阻尼；多相变量中的高阶“密度/速度”具有模型含义，未必对应真实粒子相。

steps.claim: Vlasov–Poisson 方程的矩满足递推方程 (2)，其中第 i 阶方程依赖 $M_{i+1}$。
steps.route: 将动理学输运方程乘以 $v^i$ 后对速度积分，速度导数项分部产生 $-iEM_{i-1}$，空间输运产生 $M_{i+1}$ 的通量，因此得到未闭合矩链。

reports.title: Ill-Posedness of the Euler Equations Linearized around Homogeneous Steady States
reports.abstract: Let $L^2_m(\mathbb{R}^2)$ be the space of square-integrable functions on $\mathbb{R}^2$ with $m$-fold rotational symmetry. Let $\overlineω(r,θ) = r^{-α}f(θ)$ be a homogeneous steady state of the two-dimensional incompressible Euler equations with $(m\cdot l)$-fold rotational symmetry. If $f(θ)$ is a constant function we say that $\overlineω$ is a radial power-law vortex. We prove that the incompressible Euler equations in vorticity form, linearized around any homogeneous steady state $\overlineω$ that is not a radial power-law vortex, are ill-posed on $L^2_m(\mathbb{R}^2)$ for any $m\geq 2$, any $l\geq 1$ and $α\in (0,1)$.
reports.workSummary: 论文考察二维不可压 Euler 涡量方程在非径向幂律齐次稳态附近的线性化。对于 $\alpha \in (0,1)、m-fold$ 对称扰动和背景的 (m·l)-fold 对称性，作者将线性化写成输运算子 L0 加 Biot–Savart 非局部项 K。齐次流函数在奇异射线上有简单零点，使背景涡量角向奇异；作者先构造适配的局部 X/Y 空间与射线迹定理，证明 K 的定义域落在严格闭子空间，随后用径向积分把 $Lϕ\omega \in L^{2}$ 转为一个角变量分布方程，显示若速度迹不为零则解必有不可积奇异，从而 Lϕ 的最大定义域不稠密，线性 Cauchy 问题不适定。
techniques: 齐次 Euler 稳态的极坐标结构
Biot–Savart 映射的局部 Sobolev 控制
射线迹算子 X→Y
奇异射线角向分布方程

reports.breakthrough: 证明所有非径向幂律的齐次稳态在指定对称 $L^{2}$ 空间上的 Euler 线性化都因定义域不稠密而不适定，明确把 ill-posedness 归因于奇异射线上的速度迹障碍，并排除了将这些稳态用于 Vishik 非唯一性机制的路径。
reports.limitations: 结论限于 $\alpha \in (0,1)、m\ge 2$ 及背景具有 (m·l)-fold 对称且扰动位于 $L^{2}_m$；端点 $\alpha =1、\alpha >1$ 的分布解释以及完全去除对称限制均未处理。径向幂律涡旋和 $\alpha =3/2$ 的椭圆族也不在结论内。

steps.claim: 非径向齐次稳态在 $\alpha \in (0,1)$ 的奇异射线附近具有角函数 g 的简单零点，涡量因而产生不可积的导数奇异。
steps.route: 齐次流函数写成 $r^{2-\alpha }g(\theta )$，稳态方程给出 $f=(1-\alpha )B$ $g^{-\alpha /(2-\alpha )}/(2-\alpha )$；分类结果保证非径向背景有零射线$，\alpha \in (0,1)$ 时该零点简单，故 f′ 的奇异阶强于 f。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5–6页公式(2)–(4)及关于简单零点的论述。

steps.claim: Biot–Savart 非局部项 K 的定义域不稠密于 $L^{2}_m$。
steps.route: 把 $K\omega $ 在极坐标写成 $r^{-1-\alpha }(f'v\theta -\alpha fvr)$，比较 g、f 和 f′ 在奇异角度的幂次；若该奇异性可消去，则必有角速度迹在射线上为零。Biot–Savart 映射到 X 加射线迹 X→Y 连续，于是 D(K) 落在严格闭子空间 ker(T∘KBS*)。
steps.evidence: PDF 第7页 Proposition 3.1；PDF 第8–10页 Proposition 3.3 与 Lemma 3.2，尤其公式(5)–(7)。

steps.claim: 若线性化 $Lϕ\omega =L0\omega +K\omega $ 属于 $L^{2}$，则速度角分量在每条奇异射线上的迹必须为零。
steps.route: 假设存在非零速度迹，选径向测试函数 ϕ 并把极坐标方程(8)乘以 rϕ 后积分，定义 W,A,H,U,V 五个角函数；分部积分把问题化为 $g'A-(2-\alpha )gW'-f'V+\alpha fU=H$，再利用 $V(\theta _{0})\ne 0$ 提取主奇异项。
steps.evidence: PDF 第10–11页 Lemma 3.4 及公式(8)–(9)。

steps.claim: 上述角向分布方程迫使 $W\notin L^{2}$，产生矛盾，因此 Lϕ 最大定义域不稠密并且线性问题不适定。
steps.route: 在简单零点坐标 $x=\theta -\theta _{0}$ 下，方程化为 $xB'(x)=I(x)-V(\theta _{0})x^{-2/(2-\alpha )}$；将其从 x 积分到固定端点$，L^{2}$ 的 I 只能产生 $x^{-1/2}$ 型可控项，而非零 V 项强迫 $B(x)~x^{-2/(2-\alpha )}$。由于指数小于−1，B 不在 $L^{2}$，排除非零迹；稠密性随即失败，不能生成强连续半群。

reports.title: Large-time behavior of solutions to bipolar Euler-Poisson equations with space-dependent damping
reports.abstract: This paper is concerned with the Cauchy problem for the one-dimensional bipolar Euler-Poisson equations with space-dependent damping, which arise in the hydrodynamic model of semiconductors. Notably, the two pressure functions are allowed to be different, and the doping profile is nonzero. By means of the time-weighted energy method with carefully chosen weights, we prove that if the initial perturbation around a constant steady-state is small enough, the Cauchy problem admits a unique global smooth solution, which converges to the constant steady-state at algebraic decay rates. We show that the decay rates coincide with those established for the constant-coefficients damping case, thereby overcoming the influence of spatially dependent damping on the decay rates of the solutions. A key feature is that no smallness of the space-dependent damping coefficients is required.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究带空间依赖阻尼的一维双极 Euler–Poisson 半导体模型。两种压力函数允许不同，掺杂剖面取常数，阻尼系数 $\alpha _i(x)$ 仅要求正、有界并趋向同一正常数，且其偏离与导数满足 $H^{1}/L^{1}/L\infty $ 控制。作者先从远场 ODE 识别电流的指数尾部，构造紧支撑修正 (n̂,Ĵ) 消除由非零远场电流造成的 $L^{2}$ gap；再以密度扰动的反导数 $N_i$ 和电场 E 建立强耦合二阶系统。三组时间权重能量估计分别控制低阶、时间导数和高阶空间导数，Gronwall 闭合小数据延拓，最终得到全局光滑解及与常系数情形相同的代数衰减。

reports.limitations: 结论要求平坦常掺杂 $D(x)=D̂$、压力函数 $C^{3}$ 且严格递增、两端阻尼趋向同一正常数，并且初始扰动及远场电流足够小；非平坦掺杂会带来未处理的能量障碍。结果是在一维全空间小数据框架下，未覆盖大数据、边界域或不同远场阻尼极限。

reports.title: The periodic Wulff problem in two dimensions
reports.abstract: We characterize the minimizers of the anisotropic perimeter in the flat torus under an area constraint. We show that, depending on the area, the periodic global minimizer undergoes two phase transitions, changing from a droplet (a rescaled Wulff shape) to a flat band wrapping around the torus in a preferred direction determined by the anisotropy (lamellar phase), and finally to a bubble (the complement of a rescaled Wulff shape). For certain non-symmetric surface tensions, the lamellar phase is absent altogether; for other non regular surface tensions, there exist infinitely many minimizing configurations coexisting with the lamellar phase.
reports.workSummary: 论文完整刻画二维平坦环面上给定面积的各向异性周期 Wulff 问题。用 Wulff 形 K 的格宽 w(K) 和临界面积 $\alpha (K)=w(K)^2/(4|K|)$，作者证明小面积最小集是缩放 Wulff 形，中间面积是由最优整数方向决定的斜向条带，大面积是反向缩放 Wulff 形的补集；当 $\alpha (K)>1/2$ 时条带相变区消失。对均匀椭圆表面张力，正则性和各向异性平均曲率先迫使边界曲率恒号，再按凸集、平行线分类；一般张力通过统一椭圆近似与 BV 紧性传递存在性。非椭圆情形可能出现额外甚至无限多个最小构型。
techniques: 各向异性 Wulff 不等式
格宽与 Minkowski/几何数论估计

reports.limitations: 对一般非均匀椭圆表面张力，论文证明列出的构型确为最小者，但不声称它们穷尽全部最小者；唯一性仅在 uniformly elliptic 条件下成立。结果限于二维平坦环面和各向异性周长，Ohta–Kawasaki 应用只覆盖小 $\gamma $ 且层状相唯一的情形。

steps.route: 用 Wulff 不等式计算平面缩放 K 的周长，用整数方向 z 的环面直线长度 |z| 计算层状集边界周长 ϕ(z)+ϕ(−z)，再对 z 取最小得到格宽；补集通过反射张力 $ϕ̃(x)=ϕ(-x)$ 把面积 M 转为 1−M。

steps.claim: 均匀椭圆张力下任一最小集的边界为 $C^{2}$，且欧氏曲率恒号。
