reports.title: Gradient flow approach to Landau equation: A cross-product structure
reports.abstract: We introduce a cross-product Landau gradient that commutes with Gaussian mollification. For the hard-potential interaction kernels of the form $A(|v-v_*|)\sim \langle v-v_*\rangle^γ|v-v_*|^2$ with $γ\in(-\infty,1]$, this construction yields a variational characterisation of the gradient-flow structure of the spatially homogeneous Landau equation. The cross-product gradient induces the same gradient-flow geometry as that introduced by Carrillo, Delgadino, Desvillettes and Wu (2024), while providing a different representation of the Landau gradient. The main advantage of this formulation is that it requires only weighted $L^1$-control. We also discuss a similar variational characterisation for the GENERIC structure of the fuzzy Landau equations.
reports.workSummary: 本文处理空间齐次 Landau 方程的梯度流表示。作者把投影张量 $|v-v*|^{2}\Pi ⊥$ 改写为叉积 $(v-v*)\times (\cdot )\times (v-v*)$，在三维速度空间定义 cross-Landau gradient，并围绕该结构分析高斯卷积、作用量和熵链式法则。正文先建立与高斯卷积精确交换的球面微分结构，再用径向核的卷积界控制 A0，随后对测度曲线和 grazing rate 做正则化、链式法则极限，最终得到作用量加熵耗散的变分不等式及等号刻画；文末说明同一机制如何延伸到 fuzzy Landau 的 GENERIC 结构。
techniques: 叉积型 Landau 梯度与球面微分
质心/相对坐标变换

reports.breakthrough: 核心新结论是：在 $A0(|v-v*|)∼〈v-v*〉^\gamma 、\gamma \le 1$ 的正则化硬势核下，叉积梯度与高斯 mollifier 的交换性足以把 Landau 梯度流的变分刻画降到加权 L1 控制，并且其二次型、曲线作用量和原投影梯度产生同一 Onsager 几何。由此 Theorem 1.1 的等号条件精确恢复 H-solution，而不再依赖既有方法中的额外 Lp 沿曲线假设。
reports.limitations: 主证明固定三维空间，虽在 Remark 1.2 给出用斜对称矩阵推广到 $d\ge 3$ 的形式，但未在正文展开完整高维论证。核必须满足 (1.2) 的正则化径向比较；作者明确指出奇异幂核 $A0=|v-v*|^\gamma $ 的一般范围不享有所需交换子界。定理还要求加权 L1、有限初始熵和作用量/耗散可积性，结论是变分刻画而非独立的全局存在唯一性定理。

reports.title: Littlewood--Paley operators and semigroup maximal operators on CMO spaces associated to Schödinger operators
reports.abstract: Let $L=-Δ+V$ be a Schrödinger operator on $\mathbb{R}^n$, where $Δ$ is the Laplacian and $V$ satisfies the reverse Hölder inequality ${\rm RH}_q$ for some $q>n/2$. In this paper, we study the behavior of the Littlewood--Paley operators $s_L$ and $S_L$, as well as the semigroup maximal operator $T^*_L$, on the space ${\rm CMO}_L(\mathbb{R}^n)$ associated with the Schrödinger operator $L$. It is known from previous work that these operators are bounded on ${\rm BMO}_L(\mathbb{R}^n)$. Our main result shows that they are, in fact, mappings from ${\rm CMO}_L(\mathbb{R}^n)$ into itself. To prove this, we develop several equivalent characterizations of ${\rm CMO}_L(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and employ a refined decomposition that partitions the parameter interval at $r_Bρ(x_B)$, instead of the customary $r_B^2$ or $ρ(x_B)^2$. The new strategy allows us to overcome a key technical obstacle that arises when applying existing methods to the ${\rm CMO}_L$ setting.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究 Schrödinger 算子 $L=-\Delta +V（V\in RH_q、q>n/2）$关联的 $CMO_L(R^n)$ 端点空间。作者先从 $BMO_L$ 的五个消失条件出发，建立带小尺度、大尺度和中心位置约束的等价刻画，再逐一处理 Littlewood–Paley 方函数 $s_L$、面积函数 $S_L$ 与半群极大算子 $T_L*。s_L$ 的难点是常数部分 $s_L(1)$ 在 $r_B\le \rho (x_B)$ 时的控制，正文用 $r_B\rho (x_B)$ 分裂时间积分并结合 $tLe^{-tL}$ 的消去与平滑估计$；S_L$ 和 $T_L*$ 则把同一球分解、热核尾部界和 $L^{2}/$极大函数有界性改造成对应端点估计，最终证明三类算子都保持 $CMO_L$。

reports.title: Classification of Solutions to a Critical Fourth-Order Equation on Complete Non-compact Manifolds
reports.abstract: We study the critical biharmonic equation \[ Δ^2 u=u^{\frac{n+4}{n-4}}, \] on a complete, connected, and non-compact Riemannian manifold \((M^n,g)\) of dimension \(n\geq 5\) with non-negative Ricci curvature. We establish an optimal pointwise second-order derivative estimate by Bernstein's method and the continuity method. Using invariant tensors, we derive a differential inequality that yields a rigidity result. More precisely, if there exists a positive finite energy solution, then the manifold is isometric to the Euclidean space \(\mathbb{R}^n\), and the solution is given by \[ u(x)= \frac{ \left[λ^2 n(n-4)(n^2-4)\right]^{\frac{n-4}{8}} } {\left(1+λ|x-x_0|^2\right)^{\frac{n-4}{2}}}, \qquad λ>0,\quad x_0\in\mathbb{R}^n . \]
reports.workSummary: 论文分类非紧完备流形上的临界四阶方程 $Delta^2$ $u=u^{(n+4)/(n-4)}$。在 $n>=5、Ricci$ 曲率非负的条件下，作者先用最大值原理和 Bernstein 连续性论证得到 Delta u 的符号与 Hessian 控制，再构造不变量张量并对其微分不等式做截断积分，迫使流形达到欧氏刚性；最后在 $R^n$ 上解等式情形并得到标准 bubble。

reports.title: The Short Wave equation on the half-line by the Unified Transform Method
reports.abstract: We study the initial-boundary value problem for the Short Wave equation on the half-line $x\ge 0$. A distinctive feature of this problem is that the boundary $x=0$ cannot be characterized \emph{a priori} as an inflow or outflow boundary: its character is determined dynamically by the sign of the unknown trace $u(0,t)$. This leads to different analyticity properties of the associated eigenfunctions and, consequently, to different spectral formulations in the regimes $u(0,t)\le0$ and $u(0,t)\ge0$. Using the Unified Transform Method (aka the Fokas method), we formulate the solution in terms of matrix Riemann--Hilbert problems. We construct the associated spectral functions, derive the global relations, and show how the solution is reconstructed from the corresponding Riemann--Hilbert problem. In the case $u(0,t)\le0$, the solution is determined by the initial data alone (assuming an appropriate decay as $x\to \infty$), whereas for $u(0,t)\ge0$, compatible boundary data are also required for the construction.
reports.workSummary: 本文用统一变换法处理半直线上的 Short Wave 方程初边值问题。边界 $x=0$ 的入流/出流性质由未知迹 u(0,t) 的符号动态决定，因此作者分别构造 $u(0,t)\le 0$ 和 $u(0,t)\ge 0$ 两套特征函数解析性、谱函数和全局关系。正文先对 Lax 对在 $k=\infty 、k=0$ 附近作变换并建立初值/边界谱映射，再以全局关系拼接谱数据，形成带实轴或附加小圆跳跃的矩阵 Riemann–Hilbert 问题；最后通过 RH 解在 $k=0、\infty $ 的展开恢复 u、m 和坐标变换，并证明负边界迹时初值唯一决定解、非负时在兼容边界数据和 RH 可解条件下存在唯一表示。

reports.breakthrough: 论文的具体新结论是把边界迹 u(0,t) 的符号识别为半直线 SW 问题的谱分叉机制：负号区间的 RH 问题只需初值谱数据，正号区间则出现由边界谱函数决定的小圆跳跃并必须满足兼容关系。由此得到两套不同解析结构下的重构、唯一性和条件存在性结果，而不是把边界预先固定成单一入流类型。

reports.title: Solvability of Semilinear Elliptic Equations on Infinite Graphs
reports.abstract: We develop a constructive method for solving semilinear elliptic equations $Δu(x)=f(x,u(x))$ on locally finite, connected infinite graphs with layered structure. Using Eidelheit's theorem, we establish coupling criteria ensuring that arbitrary initial-layer data extend to global solutions for every $f$. We apply combinatorial criteria to prove solvability on leafless infinite trees, integer lattices, the triangular and hexagonal lattices, and a Cayley graph of the discrete Heisenberg group. We further establish solvability for a broad class of Cayley graphs of semidirect products $G\cong\mathbb Z\ltimes_θH$. In particular, $Δu=e^u$ has infinitely many solutions on $\mathbb Z^2$, but none of finite energy. We also extend the method to the bi-Laplacian under two-step coupling conditions, to the $p$-Laplacian under a unique-neighbor condition, and to magnetic Laplacians.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究局部有限、连通且具有分层结构的无限图上 $\Delta u=f(x,u(x))$ 的全局可解性。作者把图拉普拉斯按层写成相邻层耦合算子，利用 Eidelheit 定理把每个耦合算子的有限行独立性转成满射，再逐层解出下一层，从而任意指定一层或两层数据都能延拓为全局解。正文又用有限子式和唯一完美匹配给出组合判据，应用于无叶树、整数/三角/六边形格点、离散 Heisenberg 图及半直积 Cayley 图；最后说明双拉普拉斯、p-拉普拉斯和磁拉普拉斯的相应延拓机制。
techniques: 分层图与块三对角拉普拉斯
Frechet 空间上的 Eidelheit 满射定理
有限行独立与有限子式判据
唯一完美匹配和三角矩阵
逐层构造全局非线性解
两步耦合及 p-拉普拉斯标量反演
reports.breakthrough: 主要新结论是一个对任意非线性 f 的构造性全局延拓定理：在全球耦合条件成立时，N 分层图上任意初始层数据、Z 分层图上任意相邻两层数据，都可逐层延拓为全局解。有限行独立被精确等价为非零满行子式，唯一完美匹配提供可检验的图组合充分条件；因此 $Z^{2}$ 上 $\Delta u=e^u$ 有无穷多个全局解，但有限能量条件反而不可能成立。
reports.limitations: 结论在全体乘积空间 $R^V$ 的逐点拓扑中成立，不提供正性、增长、可和性或能量控制；作者在第5节明确留下加权 ℓp/指定增长空间中的定量右逆问题。双拉普拉斯需要两步耦合条件$，p\ne 2$ 时一般有限行线性满射不能直接替代唯一邻居的逐点反演；Cayley 图的判据也依赖给定分层与生成集。

steps.claim: 分层图上的方程可化成只含相邻三层的块递推，并把求下一层转化为耦合算子的满射问题。

steps.claim: 耦合算子满射当且仅当其每个有限行子集线性独立，并等价于存在非零满行子式；唯一完美匹配给出直接充分条件。
steps.route: 将每层函数空间识别为可数乘积 Frechet 空间，验证 Eidelheit 定理的连续性和有限支撑半范数条件；有限行独立即坐标泛函独立。对有限 U 去掉零列后应用最大子式判据，唯一匹配使 Leibniz 展开只剩一个非零项。

steps.claim: 这些组合条件确实导出具体图上的全局解存在性及扩展版本。

reports.title: Fefferman--Stein type inequalities via area and maximal functions for Schrödinger operators with applications
reports.abstract: In this paper, we establish a Fefferman--Stein inequality in terms of area function and non-tangential maximal function associated with the Schrödinger operator $\mathcal{L} = -Δ+ V$ on stratified Lie groups $\mathcal G$, where $Δ$ denotes the sub-Laplacian on $\mathcal G$ and $V$ is a nonnegative locally integrable function. As an application, we extend this inequality to the tensor product $\mathcal G_1 \times \mathcal G_2$ of two stratified Lie groups and develop atomic decompositions associated with the Schrödinger operator for functions in the Orlicz space $L\log^{+}L(\mathcal G_1 \times \mathcal G_2).$ Using these atomic decompositions, we further prove weak-type endpoint estimates for the area integral operator and the Riesz transforms associated with the Schrödinger operator on $L\log^{+}L(\mathcal G_1 \times \mathcal G_2),$ thereby extending the celebrated result of R.\,Fefferman and E.M.\,Stein \cite{FSt1982} to the setting of singular integrals with non-smooth kernels.
reports.workSummary: 本文在分层 Lie 群上研究 Schrödinger 算子 $L=-\Delta +V$ 的面积函数与非切向极大函数之间的 Fefferman–Stein 型分布不等式，并将其推广到两个群的张量积。正文先用子拉普拉斯 Poisson 半群作用于水平集指示函数，构造适配非交换群和非负势的截断函数，再通过能量恒等式、弱导数和 $good-\lambda $ 区域分解得到 Theorem 1.1。产品空间上作者重复这一机制并得到 Theorem 1.2 和面积函数弱端点估计，随后构造 L $log^+L$ 的算子适配原子分解，最后用 Davies–Gaffney 衰减、原子估计和 Journe 覆盖证明面积算子及双 Riesz 变换的弱型端点界。
techniques: Schrödinger/子拉普拉斯 Poisson 半群
非切向极大函数与面积函数分布不等式
水平集 $good-\lambda $ 截断与能量积分
弱导数、Tonelli/Fubini 和热核估计
产品空间原子分解
Davies–Gaffney 衰减与弱端点估计
reports.breakthrough: 论文的核心进展是把 Fefferman–Stein 分布不等式推进到带非负局部可积势的分层 Lie 群，并进一步在产品群上获得 L $log^+L$ 弱端点理论。关键构造不是沿用欧氏 bump 函数，而是用 $e^{-t\sqrt -\Delta }(\chi _{E_\lambda })$ 的取值范围设计截断；这同时适应非交换几何与 L 的非卷积势项，并支撑后续算子适配原子和非光滑核 Riesz 变换的全球端点估计。
reports.limitations: 假设是分层 Lie 群$、V\ge 0$ 且 V 局部可积，端点结论针对文中定义的 Schrödinger 面积/极大函数和产品算子；原子分解还要求 L $log^+L\cap L^{2}$。作者指出欧氏证明中的紧支撑卷积恒等式在一般分层群不存在，因此不能把其证明直接延伸到更一般的非自伴算子或任意核；文章也不提供超出这些算子设置的定量强型端点范围。

reports.title: On the singular limit of the Camassa-Holm equation
reports.abstract: We study the singular limit of the Camassa--Holm equation as the length scale $\ell$ tends to zero. Although the formal limit is the Burgers equation with flux $3u^2/2$, we show that, for a class of smooth initial data, convergence to entropy solutions fails after the shock formation, even along subsequences in local space-time $L^1$.
reports.workSummary: 本文研究 Camassa–Holm 方程长度尺度 ℓ→0 的奇异极限。形式上方程趋于通量为 $3u^{2}/2$ 的 Burgers 方程；作者选取初始动量 $u0-\ell^{2}u0$ 在所有小 ℓ 上保持同号的非平凡 $H^{3}\cap L^{1}$ 数据，借此得到全局光滑 CH 流。证明先从动量符号、质量和三次 Hamiltonian 导出 uℓ 与 ℓuℓx 的统一 Lp 界，再用局部能量守恒和空间截断建立能量紧性；若假设震后收敛到 Burgers 熵解，则能量损失迫使缺陷密度 $w\ell=\ell^{2}(u\ellx)^{2}$ 留下正质量，极限方程又强迫 $w_x=0$，有限空间质量与正质量矛盾，因而不存在该收敛子列。
techniques: Helmholtz Green 函数与动量输运
质量/三次 Hamiltonian 守恒
统一 Lp 与斜率尺度估计
局部能量守恒和空间尾部紧性
缺陷密度弱极限
Burgers 熵解冲击与分布极限
reports.breakthrough: 具体突破是证明光滑、守恒的 Camassa–Holm 流在 Burgers 冲击时间之后，即使取任意 $\ell_n↓0$ 子列，也不能在局部时空 $L^{1}$ 强收敛到 Burgers 唯一熵解。障碍由 $\ell^{2}u_x^{2}$ 形成的正缺陷能量承担：它不能逃到无穷远，却在极限方程中被迫空间均匀，最终只能为零，与能量损失留下的正质量冲突。
reports.limitations: 定理要求 $u0\in H^{3}\cap L^{1}$ 非平凡且所有小 ℓ 的初始动量同号；结论只排除趋向 Burgers 熵解的子列，不排除 CH 族向别的极限收敛。证明针对全局光滑同号动量流，不能直接覆盖会波破的初值或耗散弱解；文中也明确对比了另一种 Hamiltonian regularized Burgers 方程。

steps.route: 用 Lax–Oleinik 极小点公式证明冲击处存在两个不同极小点，得到向下跳跃；再对二次熵对使用 BV 链式法则和 Rankine–Hugoniot 速度，跳跃集上的熵产生为 $-(u--u+)^{3}/4$，从而积分得到严格能量损失。

steps.route: 动量方程保持符号，卷积表示 $u\ell=G\ell*m\ell$ 给出 $\ell|u\ellx|\le |u\ell|$；质量守恒与局部能量/三次 Hamiltonian 守恒分别控制 L1、H1 和 L3，插值得到 uℓ 与 ℓuℓx 在 $p\in [1,3]$ 的统一界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2页 Theorem 2.6；第7–8页式(3.1)–(3.9)和 Uniform estimates 小节。

steps.claim: 局部时空 L1 收敛假设会升级为全局时空 L2 收敛，并迫使尺度能量缺陷 $w\ell=\ell^{2}(u\ellx)^{2}$ 保留正质量。

reports.title: An Inverse Random Source Problem for the Moore-Gibson-Thompson Equation Driven by Fractional Brownian Motion
reports.abstract: In this paper, we consider an inverse random source problem for the stochastic Moore-Gibson-Thompson equation driven by fractional Brownian motion with Hurst index $H \in (0, 1)$ of the form $f_1(x)g_1(t)\dot{B}^H(t)+f_2(x)g_2(t)$. Given the random source, existence and uniqueness of mild solutions are verified. For the inverse problem, the uniqueness of recovering the strength $f_i(x)$ if the time functions $g_i$ are known and $g_i(t)$ if the spatial functions $f_i$ are known when $H \in(0,1)$ from the boundary flux on a special nonempty open subset is proved.

reports.title: Exact Asymptotics for the 2D Euclidean Random Matching Problem
reports.abstract: We determine the exact first-order asymptotics of the expected optimal cost in two-dimensional random bipartite matching, for every finite power cost $q \ge 1$, on the flat torus. In the endpoint case $q=1$, this answers a question by Talagrand, in the periodic case. The argument involves the closely related asymptotics of the energy of the solution of the $p$-Poisson equation with a regularized white-noise source. In the limit of vanishing regularization parameter, we identify this energy as the solution of a Variational Martingale Problem on a limiting Gaussian filtration, whose value is characterized by a parabolic Monge-Ampère flow.

reports.title: Low-Temperature Large Deviations for the Two-Dimensional Wick-Ordered Cubic Wave Equation
reports.abstract: We prove a trajectory large deviation principle, in the low-temperature limit, for the two-dimensional Wick-ordered defocusing cubic nonlinear wave equation, with initial data drawn from the invariant Gibbs measure. We further show that asymptotically vanishing high-frequency perturbations of the Gibbs initial data, with the same static rate function, generate a continuum of distinct mass-shifted trajectory rate functions.

reports.title: Controllability for 2D water waves: effects of bottom topography and constant vorticity
reports.abstract: In this paper we consider two-dimensional water waves, under the action of gravity and surface tension. We prove a controllability result for irrotational waves in a fluid domain with finite depth and general bottom topography. The result holds for an open and dense set of bottom topographies in $H^{s+1/2}(\mathbb{T})$ (where $s$ is sufficiently large) that do not touch the free surface. We point out that the bottom topographies that we allow for are not necessarily small perturbations of the flat bottom case: this leads to many technical difficulties, since the eigenvalues of the Dirichlet-Neumann operator at a still free surface with general bottom topography are not explicit, nor are they necessarily close (for low frequencies) to the eigenvalues of the corresponding operator for the flat bottom case. In turn, this leads to a more involved argument to prove Ingham-type estimates, which are needed to prove observability, and motivates the restriction mentioned above on the admissible bottom topographies. We also prove a controllability result for waves with constant vorticity in a fluid domain with flat bottom topography.

reports.title: The capillary $L_p$ dual Minkowski problem for $p>q$ in higher dimensions
reports.abstract: We prove existence and uniqueness for the capillary $L_p$ dual Minkowski problem for $p>q$ and contact angle $θ\in (0,\fracπ{2})$ in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$, $n\geq 3$. We reduce it to a Monge-Ampère type equation with a Robin boundary condition on the unit spherical cap, by building a new auxiliary function to obtain the $C^2$ estimate for $p>q$ in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ ($n\geq 3$), we then prove that there exists a unique smooth solution that solves this problem provided $θ\in (0, \fracπ{2})$.

reports.title: Exact high-order GPT cancellation in noncircular multilayers
reports.abstract: This paper is concerned with exact high-order generalized polarization tensor (GPT) cancellation in two-dimensional noncircular multilayers with finite positive isotropic coating conductivities. We first prove that, for every admissible cyclically symmetric core--shell geometry, there exists a unique positive coating conductivity for which the structure is weakly neutral to every uniform incident field. For higher orders, we establish locally unique coating conductivities that cancel the complete \(K\)-contracted GPTs (K-CGPTs) block on a broad class of fixed noncircular multilayers with cyclic symmetry. This includes homothetic multilayers generated by strictly star-shaped symmetric domains, without assuming that the geometry is close to concentric disks. We also replace the near-background condition by a small-core condition covering finite, insulating, and perfectly conducting cores. By varying selected interface modes together with the coating conductivities near a radial GPT-vanishing structure, we further construct exact families with neither rotational nor reflection symmetry. For three coatings, the relevant nondegeneracy conditions and an explicit chiral example are rigorously certified. Finally, we show that the resulting cancellation yields enhanced near-cloaking for every entire harmonic incident field. A set of certified numerical examples fully corroborates the theoretical predictions established in this work.

reports.title: Chain rule symmetry for singular SPDEs from multi-indices to decorated trees
reports.abstract: In these lecture notes, we review the recent results around the chain rule for the generalised KPZ equation and the geometric KPZ equation. We introduce the main ideas of Regularity Structures via a B-series type expansion and the two main combinatorial sets for encoding this expansion: decorated trees and multi-indices. Then, we explain how the chain rule was first understood via integration by parts and diagrammatic computations. For the generalised KPZ equation, a scalar-valued equation, we use multi-indices to derive a characterisation in terms of iterations of covariant derivatives. The same characterisation for decorated trees is more involved and requires the use of operadic and homological tools. We summarise the main arguments of this proof.
reports.workSummary: 这份讲义整理奇异 SPDE 中从多重指标到装饰树的 chain rule symmetry。作者先用正规性结构和 B-series 展开编码广义 KPZ 的重整化项，再用积分分部和 elementary differentials 建立多重指标的链式法则；随后定义由微分同胚作用不变的几何子空间，证明它是组合映射 $phi_hat_geo$ 的核。最后以组合协变导数生成该核，并通过带微分的 operad 同调把它识别为 Lie-admissible operad，从而解释几何 KPZ 反项的局部性。

reports.title: The Fenchel Game of Underdamped Langevin Dynamics: Insights into Accelerated Convergence
reports.abstract: For $(Q_t,P_t)$ governed by suitably damped underdamped Langevin dynamics, we quantify the convergence in KL divergence of the positional marginal to a $σ$-strongly log-concave target $π(dq) = \frac{1}{Z}e^{-V(q)}dq$ as \begin{align*} \operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_t) \| π) \leq e^{-\sqrtσ t}\operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_{0}, P_{0})\, \|\, Π_0), \end{align*} where $Π_0$ denotes an appropriately selected reference measure. When $π$ is merely log-concave, the estimate \begin{align*} \operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_t) \| π) \leq \frac{τ^2}{t^2}\operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_τ, P_τ)\, \|\, Π_τ) \end{align*} is derived, where $Π_τ$ denotes another correspondingly chosen reference measure at time $τ> 0$. Both rates match precisely the canonical rates of the corresponding accelerated gradient flows in $\mathbb{R}^d$. They are achieved by the novel interpretation of the underdamped Langevin dynamics as a combination of strategies in an online sampling game and by estimating the KL divergence using a cost function informed by fictitious competitors.

reports.title: Global mild solutions and the semiclassical limit for the Fermi--Dirac BGK model
reports.abstract: We prove global existence of mild solutions to the spatially inhomogeneous Fermi--Dirac BGK equation for arbitrary-size Pauli-admissible initial data with finite mass and kinetic energy, allowing both vacuum and locally saturated zero-temperature states. The construction relies on a moment-compatible regularization of the local equilibrium that preserves the Pauli bound and uniform moment control while remaining consistent up to the saturation boundary. The solutions satisfy mass, momentum, and energy conservation and, under an additional finite spatial second-moment assumption, an entropy-gap H-theorem on the full Pauli interval. Under uniform moment and entropy bounds, we further prove that, after extraction of a subsequence, quantum mild solutions converge strongly in phase space, uniformly on bounded time intervals, to a mild solution of the classical BGK equation.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究空间非齐次 Fermi-Dirac BGK 方程。对任意满足 Pauli 约束、有限质量和动能的初值，作者先刻画可实现的质量-动量-能量区域及饱和边界，再在宏观参数层面对局部平衡作保持 Pauli 上界的正则化；沿特征线构造近似方程并以紧性取极限，得到全局温和解、守恒律和熵缺口不等式。最后在一致矩和熵界下令 hbar 趋于 0，通过截断、速度尾部控制和强收敛识别为经典 BGK 温和解。

reports.title: Well-posedness and exponential stability for abstract evolution equations with delay in the nonlinear source: frictional and viscoelastic cases
reports.abstract: In this paper, we establish the well-posedness and exponential stability of a class of semilinear neutral abstract evolution equations with constant time delay. Two damping mechanisms are considered: frictional damping of the form $CC^*u_t$ and viscoelastic damping with memory. Under suitable assumptions, we prove global well-posedness and exponential decay of solutions for sufficiently small initial data. This result is of considerable importance, as it provides a unified framework for the analysis of a wide class of neutral systems arising in structural mechanics, seismic isolation, and control theory. The abstract results are illustrated by some concrete examples. The analysis relies on a combination of semigroup theory, energy estimates, Duhamel's formula, and Gronwall-type arguments.
reports.workSummary: 论文建立带常时滞和非线性源的半线性中性抽象演化方程的局部适定性、全局小数据解和指数稳定性。摩擦阻尼与带记忆的黏弹阻尼分别由两个抽象模型表示；作者把方程改写到历史状态 Hilbert 空间，先用稳定半群和 Duhamel 公式得到局部解，再对含延迟源能量加入历史积分项，通过 Gronwall 和小数据 bootstrap 延拓并得到指数衰减。最后把抽象结果应用于 Duffing 梁、地震隔离黏弹波和板方程。

reports.title: Formation and structural stability of nondegenerate neckpinches
reports.abstract: In this paper, we study the formation, precise asymptotics, and structural stability of neckpinch singularities in mean curvature flow. Motivated by the static rigidity of cylindrical self-shrinkers established by Colding, Ilmanen and Minicozzi, we first prove a dynamical rigidity result: mean curvature flow of hypersurfaces that are initially graphically close to a generalized cylinder on a sufficiently large scale, subject to a localized quadratic upward bending, inevitably develop a neckpinch singularity in finite time. We also establish sharp asymptotic expansions for the profile functions of these locally evolving graphs. We show that the rescaled graphical radius converges to a specific polynomial profile with quadratic bending, proving that the resulting singularities are nondegenerate. Finally, we establish an openness theorem showing that nondegenerate neckpinches are structurally stable under C^2 perturbations of the initial data. Combined with recent density theorems for the 3-dimensional mean curvature flow by Szekelyhidi, our results confirm that nondegenerate neckpinches constitute a generic and stable phenomenon in 3-dimensional mean curvature flow.

reports.title: Quantitative Estimates of the Field Excited by an Emitter in the Narrow Region Between Two Strictly Convex Inclusions in Two Dimensions
reports.abstract: We consider the field enhancement due to the presence of an emitter of the dipole type near two perfectly conducting inclusions with $C^{2,γ}$ boundaries in two dimensions. We derive estimates of field enhancement in the narrow region and prove that the field is enhanced by a factor $\varepsilon^{-1/2}$ in the region far from the emitter. We construct a harmonic barrier to control the dipole term instead of using the Kelvin transformation. We also study how the location of the emitter affects the field on the shortest line segment connecting two inclusions.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究二维两个严格凸完美导体夹缝中点偶极发射器激发的场增强。作者把解分解为 Neumann 偶极场、夹缝几何场和校正调和场，先精确估计基本夹缝函数 q 的梯度，再用积分恒等式把系数 c 化为发射器位置处的 grad q，最后构造不依赖圆形几何的调和屏障控制校正项。由此得到发射器附近、远离发射器和过渡区的梯度界，并比较水平与垂直偶极方向以及发射器离开接触点时短线段上的场。

reports.title: On solutions of the modified Helmholtz equation in a planar domain
reports.abstract: A criterion for the convexity of a two-dimensional domain is proved in terms of the solution of a boundary value problem for the modified Helmholtz equation.
reports.workSummary: 论文证明二维有界 Lipschitz 域的凸性可以完全由边界值为 1 的 modified Helmholtz 解 $v_mu$ 的梯度判据刻画。必要性从 $w_mu=-mu^{-1} log$ $v_mu$ 出发：梯度不等式使 $w_mu$ 超调和，Varadhan 极限把它送到边界距离函数，非凸域构造出的内切圆弧违反超调和性。充分性先在光滑凸域用局部坐标和最大值原理验证所有 mu 的边界梯度不等式，再以外逼近和单调比较去除边界光滑性。
techniques: 对数变换与超调和性
Varadhan 边界距离极限
平均值性质反证
最大值原理边界梯度估计
Lipschitz 域光滑逼近
reports.breakthrough: 把原先只要求光滑边界的高参数判据提升为二维 Lipschitz 域的充要凸性标准，并且在凸域一侧证明判据对所有 mu>0 都成立。
reports.limitations: 结论针对二维有界 Lipschitz 域及常数 Dirichlet 边界数据，必要性使用大 mu 渐近，充分性依赖二维几何和 modified Helmholtz 标量方程；没有处理非恒定边界值、无界域或高维的一般 Lipschitz 版本。

steps.claim: 若不等式 |grad $v_mu|<=mu$ $v_mu$ 对所有充分大的 mu 成立，则 $w_mu=-mu^{-1}log$ $v_mu$ 是超调和函数。
steps.route: 由方程 Delta $v_mu-mu^2$ $v_mu=0$ 计算 -Delta $w_mu=mu^2-|grad$ $v_mu|^2/v_mu^2$；代入梯度假设使右端非负，得到 $w_mu$ 的超调和性。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 2 页 Section 2、equation (1) 和 log transform proof。

steps.claim: 非凸域会违反上述判据。
steps.route: 选择边界端点连成但穿出域外的线段，在其上构造从内部相切且曲率为负的光滑子域；其距离函数在接触点附近 Laplacian 为正。若判据成立，Varadhan 极限会使该距离函数超调和，矛盾。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 2-3 页 Section 2，内切圆构造及 Lemmas 14.16-14.17 的应用。

steps.claim: 在光滑凸域中，不等式对每个 mu>0 成立。
steps.route: 在边界点用内法向坐标和凸性控制二阶边界曲率，结合 $v_mu=1$ 的边界值得到法向导数的 Hopf 型上界；再用最大值原理把 |grad $v_mu|^2-mu^2$ $v_mu^2$ 的内部正部排除。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 3-4 页 Section 3、boundary claim and maximum-principle argument。

reports.title: Uniform bounds for a thermo-diffusive system beyond exponential growth
reports.abstract: In this paper, we prove a global-in-time uniform bound for solutions to a thermo-diffusive system in the whole space with bounded nonnegative initial data. The result allows exponential reaction rates and a range of superexponential rates determined by the diffusivities. This extends the recent results of La, Roquejoffre, and Ryzhik \cite{LRR24} and of Leontev and Ryzhik \cite{LR26} beyond their strictly subexponential range.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究全空间 thermo-diffusive 系统 $u_t=nu$ Delta u-u $g(v)、v_t=kappa$ Delta v+u g(v) 在温度扩散快于燃料扩散时的长期有界性。作者将反应源的两个热势写成 $F=G_nu*q$ 和 $H=G_kappa*q$，沿抛物锥把 H 分成近锥有界部分和远锥小 BMO 部分；John-Nirenberg 指数积分把 BMO 控制提升为温度分布尾界，增长指数由两种高斯衰减平衡给出 $rho*=kappa/(kappa-nu)$。最后结合 hot-cold 迭代、Martin-Pierre 平滑估计和局部抛物正则性完成全局温度界。

reports.title: Liouville Theorem for the Constant $Q/R$-Curvature Equation
reports.abstract: We study positive entire solutions of the flat constant $Q/R$-curvature equation in dimension $n\geq5$. We prove that the weak superharmonicity condition $-Δu\geq0$ already forces every nonconstant solution to be admissible. With this automatic admissibility, we classify all such solutions as positive constants or standard bubbles. We also show that the weak superharmonicity condition is structurally necessary. Once it is removed, there is a one-parameter family of positive radial entire solutions near every positive constant. These solutions converge to a positive constant at infinity, while both $-Δu$ and $-Δ(u^{(n-2)/(n-4)})$ change sign infinitely many times.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究 $n>=5$ 维平坦常数 Q/R-曲率方程的正整解。作者先在弱超调和条件 -Delta $u>=0$ 下将方程改写成协作椭圆系统，利用势表示、Kelvin 变换和移动平面得到可去奇点与球对称刚性；随后以 P-function 升级重新获得 admissibility，最终分类为正常数或标准 bubble。作者还精确构造去掉符号条件后靠近常数的一参数径向散射族，说明弱超调和性是结构性必要条件。

reports.title: Generalized functions in a Non-Archimedean field
reports.abstract: Ultrafunctions are generalized functions defined on a non-Archimedean field extending R. They provide a framework for treating problems that fall outside the classical theory of distributions. In this paper we introduce an improved notion of ultrafunctions which refines the previous constructions. This new approach allows a more flexible functional framework than the one used in other papers and yields a more flexible functional setting. In particular, this approach allows us to prove the existence of ultrafunction solutions for several classes of ill-posed evolution problems arising in partial differential equations.
reports.workSummary: 论文提出在扩张实数的非阿基米德域上构造改进 ultrafunction 的统一框架。作者先建立有序非阿基米德场、Lambda-limit 和 Euclidean numbers，再以 hyperfinite 函数空间定义点值积分、广义导数、正则/光滑子空间及反导数；多变量部分证明积分、Poincare 不等式、Gauss 散度定理和与 Schwartz 分布的对应。应用章节把该框架用于边值问题、变分最小化和 ill-posed 演化方程，最后给出 hyperfinite grid 模型与逼近引理。

reports.title: Global large solutions of the Cauchy problem for the NS-NPP equations with Fujita-Kato type initial data
reports.abstract: In this paper, we prove the global well-posedness of the Cauchy problem for the NS-NPP equations with some large Fujita-Kato type initial data. Specifically, we show that there exist two positive constants $c_{0}$ and $C_{0}$ such that if the initial data $(u_{0}, N_{0}, P_{0})$ satisfies the following condition: \begin{equation*} \left(\|u_0\|_{\dot{H}^{-1+\frac{d}{2}}}+\|N_{0}-P_{0}\|_{\dot{H}^{-2+\frac{d}{2}}}\right)\exp\left\{C_{0}\big(\|N_{0}+P_{0}\|_{\dot{H}^{-2+\frac{d}{2}}}^2+1\big)\right\} \leq c_{0}, \end{equation*} then the NS-NPP equations admits a unique global solution. This result implies global existence of solutions without any smallness conditions imposed on the sum of initial particle densities of negative and positive electric charge in the framework of Sobolev spaces.

reports.title: On the Invertibility of the Potential-Density Mapping for the Vlasov-Poisson System in Analytic Spaces
reports.abstract: We develop the mathematical analysis of the Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory introduced by Manfredi [J. Plasma Phys., 86.2 (2020), 825860201] in the setting of Vlasov equations with a time-dependent exterior potential. In this context, we establish the invertibility of the potential-density mapping for the Vlasov-Poisson system on $\mathbb{T}^d \times \mathbb{R}^d$ when the exterior potential is (real-)analytic in the space variable. We also recover a Runge-Gross type Theorem for the Vlasov-Poisson equation for smooth (real-)analytic in time exterior potential. The surjectivity of the potential-density mapping is an inverse problem for the Vlasov-Poisson equation: we find the electric field that generates a given density profile on a given time interval.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究环面乘速度空间上的 Vlasov-Poisson 势-密度映射。空间变量解析的情形下，作者用质量守恒和动量守恒导出外势差满足带密度权的椭圆方程，再对两条相同密度解的差在解析范数中做时间依赖半径的 Gronwall 估计，证明映射单射；时间解析情形通过逐阶 Taylor 系数恢复 Runge-Gross 型结论。对给定目标密度，作者反向耦合 Vlasov 方程和椭圆外势方程，以 Cauchy-Kowalevski 型迭代构造势，证明局部满射，并给出有限正则性逆映射非 Hölder 的障碍。

reports.title: Strong convergence rates of tamed exponential Euler schemes for superlinear hyperbolic SPDEs
reports.abstract: In this paper, we prove pathwise uniform convergence at rates up to $1/2$ for tamed exponential Euler schemes for semilinear hyperbolic stochastic evolution equations with superlinearly growing nonlinearities and multiplicative noise. We take the term hyperbolic to mean that the leading operator generates a contractive $C_0$-semigroup but no parabolic smoothing occurs. Under local Lipschitz, polynomial growth, coercivity, and monotonicity conditions on the nonlinearities, we establish pathwise uniform strong error estimates of the form \begin{equation*} \Big(\mathbb{E}\max_{0\le j \le N} \|U(t_j)-U^j\|_X^p\Big)^{1/p} \lesssim \sqrt{k} \end{equation*} on a Hilbert space $X$ for $p\in [2,\infty)$. Here, $U$ is the mild solution and $U^j$ is the tamed exponential Euler approximation at time $t_j=jk$ with step size $k>0$. This extends previous convergence results for non-parabolic SPDEs from globally to locally Lipschitz nonlinearities, allowing both drift and diffusion to grow polynomially. In a stochastic Kato framework, we further establish local and global well-posedness as well as uniform a priori estimates for the mild solution and its approximation. Applications to nonlinear stochastic transport, Airy, wave-type, and dissipatively damped nonlinear Schrödinger equations are included, covering different nonlinearities-stopped and fractionally tamed schemes. For the Klein-Gordon equation with cubic velocity damping, this complements previous results obtained for additive noise.

reports.title: Differentiability of Lipschitz mappings into metric spaces: area and co-area formulas
reports.abstract: We give a self-contained exposition of metric differentiability for Lipschitz mappings from sets in Euclidean spaces into arbitrary metric spaces, together with the corresponding area and co-area formulas. The novelty is a new metric implicit function theorem for mappings into metric spaces, which is then used to give a direct and geometric proof of the co-area formula for Lipschitz mappings into metric spaces.

reports.title: Fluctuating Kinetic Theory: A Poissonian Stochastic Boltzmann Equation
reports.abstract: We introduce a nonlinear Poissonian fluctuating Boltzmann equation whose noise encodes both the fluctuations and the path large-deviation rate function of the underlying hard-sphere gas. Unlike the Gaussian-noise equations commonly studied in fluctuating hydrodynamics, the present equation raises a new difficulty: a Poisson random measure produces jumps that may destroy the nonnegativity of the solution. To address this problem, we construct a finite-dimensional coarse-grained jump process and prove its well-posedness and nonnegativity. For each fixed mesh, this process satisfies a good path large-deviation principle. We then fix a regularized velocity cutoff and study the asymptotic behavior of the discrete rate functions as the mesh is refined. On a class of biased regular paths, their limit is the corresponding cutoff Boltzmann large-deviation rate function associated with the hard-sphere gas. This establishes the consistency of the coarse-grained fluctuating Boltzmann model with the underlying particle system at the level of path large deviations.
reports.workSummary: 论文构造带 Poisson 碰撞噪声的随机 Boltzmann 模型。作者先把速度空间截断并划分有限网格，用守恒的输运通道和碰撞通道定义有限维跳跃过程；再证明非负性、质量守恒、非爆炸和路径唯一性。固定网格时，Poisson 变分表示把跳跃过程的概率代价写成受控骨架方程上的相对熵积分，从而得到良好路径大偏差原理。随后在固定速度截断下，将网格密度和控制插值到连续碰撞空间，证明离散速率函数在 biased regular paths 上具有下极限和恢复序列，收敛到截断 Boltzmann 大偏差作用。

reports.title: Exact Analytic Solution for the Time-Fractional Hunter-Saxton Equation with Caputo derivative
reports.abstract: A time fractional extension of the Hunter Saxton equation is examined, in which the temporal derivative of u_x is replaced by a Caputo derivative of order 0 < alpha <= 1. This modification introduces memory effects into a model traditionally associated with director field dynamics in nematic liquid crystals. By employing a fractional separation of variables strategy together with the exponential spatial profile phi(x) = exp(b+x), which cancels the nonlinear structure exactly, the governing nonlinear partial differential equation is reduced to a fractional relaxation ODE, whose closed form solution is the one-parameter Mittag Leffler function. The exact analytic solution is derived algebraically from the separation process. This appears to be the first exact closed form solution of the Caputo time fractional Hunter Saxton equation. The result is validated symbolically using the MathHandbook computer-algebra system. Quantitative analysis in both the fractional (0 < alpha < 1) and classical (alpha -> 1) limits demonstrates how fractional-order memory slows temporal relaxation relative to the exponential baseline. The solution provides a reliable benchmark for numerical schemes and clarifies how fractional dynamics influence nonlinear wave propagation in orientationally ordered fluids.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究带 Caputo 时间分数阶导数的 Hunter–Saxton 方程。作者从可分离形式 $u(x,t)=psi(t)phi(x)+c$ 出发，选取满足 phi $prime=phi$ double $prime=phi$ 的指数空间模态 $phi(x)=exp(b+x)$，使两个二次非线性项逐项抵消，原偏微分方程因此退化为 Caputo 分数阶松弛方程。该方程由一参数 Mittag–Leffler 函数精确求解，作者随后用初值、经典 $alpha=1$ 极限和 MathHandbook 符号展开核验残差，并比较分数阶记忆造成的慢衰减。

reports.title: Semilinear wave equations on the Witten bubble spacetime
reports.abstract: We initiate the study of nonlinear wave equations on the Witten bubble spacetime (also known as the "bubble of nothing"), which is an $\mathrm{SO}(3,1)\times \mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric solution to the Einstein vacuum equations in $(4 + 1)$ dimensions. This spacetime was introduced by Witten to model the semiclassical instability of the Kaluza--Klein spacetime $\mathbf{R}^{3+1}\times S^1$ (which is classically stable by work of Huneau--Stingo--Wyatt (arXiv:2307.15267)). We prove a small-data global existence result without symmetry assumptions and an improved decay result for $\mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric solutions to a class of semilinear equations satisfying a version of the null condition. Key to the proof are novel estimates for the linear wave equation, which has been studied in the physics literature by Bhawal and Viveshwara and in the mathematics literature by Bachelot (arXiv:1601.03682).
reports.workSummary: 论文在 Witten bubble 时空上研究线性及满足 null condition 的半线性波方程。作者先把几何写成适合 constant-tau 与 hyperboloidal foliation 的坐标和能量，利用 twisted current 得到基本 $\partial tau$ 能量估计；在 U(1) 对称部分进一步建立 rp 型加权估计，处理 bubble 附近的零模和边界通量，导出能量与点态衰减。随后以 U(1) 对称/非对称分解和 bootstrap 控制半线性源项：小初值在非对称情形全局存在但允许多项式时间增长，在 U(1) 对称情形获得全局存在、无穷远极限及改进衰减。

reports.limitations: 结果针对固定 Witten bubble 背景、充分光滑衰减的小初值和满足特定 null condition 的二次导数非线性；非 U(1) 对称部分只得到多项式时间增长，改进衰减需要对称性。论文没有处理大数据、背景几何扰动、任意二次非线性或由此产生的散射完备性。

reports.title: Wasserstein Stability and Free Boundaries in Measure-Parameterized Bilevel Obstacle Problems
reports.abstract: We study obstacle-constrained variational problems whose reduced energies depend on a probability law through a lower-level optimizer. Uniform strong convexity yields a single-valued Lipschitz follower response, while convexity and a Poincare inequality give a unique upper-level policy. A type-Lipschitz reduced marginal then implies Lipschitz continuity of the policy map from the 1-Wasserstein metric to the energy space. In a one-dimensional linear-obstacle subclass, the policy derivative is the positive part of a cumulative forcing. Single crossing makes the coincidence set an interval. An algebraic crossing of order m gives a $W_1^{1/m}$ modulus for its endpoint; odd-power examples show that this exponent is sharp, while a transversal crossing recovers Lipschitz stability. For empirical laws on compact subsets of $\mathbb{R}^k$, dimension-dependent Wasserstein bounds yield finite-sample rates for policies and thresholds. At a transversal population root, the empirical threshold is asymptotically linear, with an explicit influence function and central limit theorem. For higher-dimensional regular patches, a conditional level-set argument gives local Hausdorff stability when a nondegenerate switching function is available. An explicit quadratic firm response produces a nonlinear corporate-tax schedule with an endogenous zero-tax region and a Wasserstein-stable threshold. The tax illustration is analytic and uses no empirical calibration.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究概率律参数化的双层障碍变分问题。下层 follower 问题在一致强凸和参数 Lipschitz 假设下有唯一响应，作者将其代回上层能量，利用 Poincare 不等式和凸性得到唯一的 obstacle policy，并证明从 1-Wasserstein 距离到能量空间的 Lipschitz 稳定性。在一维线性障碍子类中，政策导数写成累计 forcing 的正部，单交叉使 coincidence set 成为区间；进一步用横截或高阶代数交叉控制自由边界的 Lipschitz/Hölder 位移，并将这些确定性界传递到经验测度和企业税率例子。

reports.limitations: 稳定性依赖一致强凸、可积参数 Lipschitz 导数、Poincare 条件及相应的 obstacle 正则性；一维精确自由边界公式需要连续单交叉或累计 forcing 假设，高维结果只在预先给定的非退化 level-set patch 上成立。论文的经验测度速率也受紧支集和类型空间维数限制。

reports.title: Neumann--Dirichlet eigenvalue comparison at the first Dirichlet threshold in the plane
reports.abstract: Let $Ω\subset\mathbb R^2$ be a bounded connected Lipschitz domain, and let $\{μ_j(Ω)\}_{j\geq1}$ and $\{λ_j(Ω)\}_{j\geq1}$ denote the Neumann and Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalues, respectively, counted with multiplicity. We prove that $$ μ_3(Ω)<λ_1(Ω), $$ thereby removing the simple-connectivity assumption from the previously known planar result at the first Dirichlet threshold. We also establish a three-spectrum counting inequality relating the Dirichlet, Neumann, and conductivity spectra.
reports.workSummary: 论文证明任意有界连通平面 Lipschitz 域的第三个 Neumann 特征值严格小于第一个 Dirichlet 特征值，因而去除了既有结果对单连通性的要求。核心做法是把多连通域的谐一形式缺陷吸收到边界各分量取常值的 conductivity gradient 空间，建立相对 Helmholtz 分解；随后构造一阶算子，其标量侧平方分解为 conductivity 与正 Neumann 拉普拉斯，向量侧的 div–curl 形式又包含两份 Dirichlet 试探空间，由 min–max 得到三谱计数不等式。最后在 conductivity 第一特征值与 Dirichlet 第一特征值的两种相对位置下，分别用尖锐等周估计或各向同性子空间论证排除等号。

reports.title: Compact implicit high-resolution numerical scheme for multicomponent transport problems with Langmuir sorption
reports.abstract: We present a compact implicit high-resolution finite volume scheme for one-dimensional multicomponent transport problems with nonlinear Langmuir sorption. The method combines a second order compact implicit discretization with WENO reconstruction and a time limiter for the treatment of steep gradients and discontinuities. A special attention is given to the Courant number used in the limiter, where local characteristic Courant numbers based on the eigenvalues of the inverse retardation matrix are considered. The compact implicit schemes are compared with analogous explicit first and second order methods. Numerical experiments show second order convergence for smooth solutions and demonstrate that the implicit approach can be used with significantly larger Courant numbers. The method is also applied to a three-component displacement chromatography problem with sharp concentration fronts.
reports.workSummary: 论文提出用于带 Langmuir 吸附的多组分一维输运系统的紧致隐式高分辨率有限体积方法。守恒变量在新时间层通过局部二阶紧致界面公式更新，每个网格单元只需局部 Newton/Gauss–Seidel 求解；WENO 重构根据局部平滑性调节空间 stencil，time limiter 在大 Courant 数或陡峭前沿处把二阶修正压回稳健的一阶上风形式。数值部分比较隐式/显式、一阶/二阶和 WENO 变体，并用高斯初值、线性 benchmark 和三组分 displacement chromatography 测试收敛、效率与尖锐前沿捕获。

reports.title: High-Dimensional Families of Minimal Surfaces of Arbitrary Genus in Round Spheres
reports.abstract: We prove the existence of arbitrarily high-dimensional families of minimal surfaces of any prescribed genus and conformal structure in even-dimensional round spheres. More precisely, let $n\geq2$ and let $Σ$ be any closed Riemann surface of genus $g$. We construct a sequence of degrees $d_\ell\to+\infty$ such that, for every $\ell$, there exists a complex manifold of complex dimension $2d_\ell+n^2(1-g)$ consisting of linearly full branched superminimal immersions of $Σ$ into $\mathbb S^{2n}$ of degree $d_\ell$. In particular, this yields parametrized families of linearly full branched minimal immersions whose dimensions tend to infinity.

reports.title: Assessing Nonlinear Elimination Preconditioning for Trust-Region Phase-Field Fracture
reports.abstract: Each quasi-static load step of phase-field fracture is a bound-constrained minimization of a nonconvex, coupled displacement-damage energy under an irreversibility bound on the damage. Monolithic Newton stalls once the nonlinearity localizes at the advancing crack front, and staggered (alternate-minimization) schemes converge slowly there. We present an on-demand nonlinear-elimination preconditioned trust-region Newton method: an energy Steihaug-Toint trust region, a primal-dual active set for irreversibility, and a bound-constrained field-split sweep that eliminates an algebraically-identified "hard set" spanning both fields before each step. The elimination is applied on demand -- triggered by the coupled Newton's own stalling and otherwise skipped -- so the method reduces to monolithic Newton at no surcharge where the step is already healthy. We find the robustness to come from the energy trust region: with that globalization fixed, monolithic Newton already completes every loading history without cutbacks, where residual-merit Newton death-spirals, alternate minimization stalls, and the full-field sweep loses robustness. Against that well-globalized baseline, the on-demand elimination cuts outer nonlinear iterations by 19-25% (brittle) and 17% (ductile), with always-on elimination reaching 26-28% and about $39\%$ at the ductile nucleation step. Measured machine-independently, as a full-mesh-equivalent assembly-work proxy rather than wall-clock, it is competitive with -- not faster than -- monolithic Newton (within about 10%), whereas an always-on sweep adds up to 30%. Nonlinear elimination is thus an iteration-reduction mechanism whose overhead the on-demand gate bounds, with no demonstrated total-work advantage over well-globalized monolithic Newton.
reports.workSummary: 论文评估相场断裂的 on-demand nonlinear-elimination trust-region Newton 求解器。每个准静态载荷步被写成带 damage irreversibility bound 的 displacement–damage 能量最小化；外层采用 Steihaug–Toint trust region 和 primal–dual active set，非线性消元只在耦合 Newton 由 crack-front hard set 引起停滞时触发，并用 KKT residual merit 做 sweep safeguard。作者在 AT1、AT2 脆性和强耦合延性 E-P-PD 试验上比较 MONO、MSPIN 与 NEPIN，报告 outer nonlinear iterations 减少，但 full-mesh-equivalent assembly-work 与 well-globalized monolithic Newton 近似持平。

reports.title: Asymptotics of Ground States for Helium-Like and Bosonic Atoms in a Two-Cluster Region
reports.abstract: We study the asymptotic behavior of positive ground states of $N$-particle atomic Coulomb Hamiltonians in a two-cluster region. For the $N$-particle ground state $ψ$, its one-particle density $ρ$, and $(N-1)$-particle ground state $φ$, we show that for $0<α<1$, as $|x_N|\to\infty$, $ψ(x_1,\dots,x_N)/\sqrt{ρ(x_N)}= φ(x_1,\dots,x_{N-1})+O(|x_N|^{-2+α} \ln |x_N|)$ uniformly in the region $|x_i|\le |x_N|^α$. In the region $|x_i|\le R_0\ln |x_N|$, the convergence rate is $O(|x_N|^{-2} (\ln |x_N|)^2)$. We also establish an $O(|x_N|^{-2})$ bound on the squared $L^2$ error. These results hold both below the essential spectrum and at threshold.
reports.workSummary: 论文研究 Coulomb 原子 N 粒子正 ground state 在一个粒子远离其余粒子的 two-cluster 区域中的定量因子化。设 $u(x_N)$ 是 N−1 粒子 ground state phi 与 N 粒子波函数 psi 的投影，作者用 Feynman–Kac 表示把 psi 与 $e^(-t(H_{N-1}-Delta_N/2-U-E_N))psi$ 比较，并以 Brownian 最大不等式和 Coulomb 势的精细替换控制误差，在膨胀区域 $|x_i|\le |x_N|^alpha$ 上得到 $O(|x_N|^(-2+alpha)$ $log|x_N|)$ 的比值误差。另一路对一粒子密度 rho 和投影 u 建立分布不等式与有效势微分不等式，再用最大值原理得到 L2 误差 $O(|x_N|^-2)$，因此结果同时覆盖束缚态和阈值情形。

reports.title: On Besov and Triebel-Lizorkin spaces associated with the Grushin operator
reports.abstract: In this article, we define classical and non-classical Besov and Triebel--Lizorkin spaces associated with the Grushin operator with or without drift. We establish various characterisations of these spaces, and study their complex interpolation, embedding properties, and fractional Leibniz rules.
reports.workSummary: 论文在带或不带 drift 的 Grushin 算子框架下定义 classical 与 non-classical Besov/Triebel–Lizorkin 空间。作者用热半群核估计、频率分解和加权平方函数建立这些空间的范数刻画，再将 dyadic pieces 的估计组合成嵌入、实插值和复插值定理。随后通过差分/热半群表示获得 fractional Leibniz 规则，并区分非临界指数条件与端点失败情形。整个论证的主线是先控制 Grushin 热半群在各向异性尺度上的衰减，再将单尺度估计累加为函数空间结构。

reports.title: A discontinuous Galerkin approximation of the Dean--Kawasaki equation
reports.abstract: We introduce and analyse an arbitrary order spatial discontinuous Galerkin (dG) method for the Dean--Kawasaki equation, a highly singular SPDE modelling density fluctuations of $N$ diffusing particles in the regime of large particle number $N \gg 1$. Our starting point is a general procedure for discretising multiplicative, divergence-form noise on finite element spaces whilst preserving its cross-variation structure at the discrete level; the construction is explicit, elementwise, applies to continuous and discontinuous spaces alike, and extends to general mobilities. Using it, we prove weak error estimates of order $O(h^p)$ between fluctuations of the semi-discrete scheme and those of the underlying particle system, together with a correction that is exponentially small in the scaling regime $Nh^d \gg 1$ and arises because the scheme does not preserve positivity. The resulting method is locally and globally conservative and applies on unstructured simplicial meshes. Quantitative numerical experiments support the analysis, and further experiments illustrate the method beyond the scope of the theory: indicator function observables, external and interaction potentials, convection-dominated regimes and reflecting boundary conditions.
reports.workSummary: 论文为奇异 Dean–Kawasaki SPDE 构造任意阶空间 discontinuous Galerkin 近似。核心是把 divergence-form 的乘性噪声按有限元梯度空间分解，利用加权质量矩阵的正半定平方根逐单元构造离散 noise，使 cross-variation 在离散层面保持正确结构。作者证明半离散 dG-DK 方程的弱存在与矩估计，并给出全局/局部质量守恒。弱误差分析用连续和离散 backward heat flows 抵消 drift，再以 dG energy norm、L-infinity 概率界和 moment recursion 比较粒子经验测度与数值 fluctuation，得到 $O(h^p)$ 数值误差及 N $h^d$ 大时指数小的负值误差。
techniques: 加权质量矩阵平方根的噪声构造
对称 interior-penalty dG 离散
Dean–Kawasaki cross-variation 保持
backward adjoint heat flow
moment recursion 与 L-infinity 概率估计
reports.breakthrough: 给出适用于任意多项式阶、连续或不连续有限元空间的显式结构保持噪声 lifting，并首次把它与 dG Dean–Kawasaki 方案的弱误差分析结合，证明 $O(h^p)$ fluctuation 误差和在 N $h^d≫1$ 区域指数小的负密度修正。
reports.limitations: 理论是空间半离散的，未分析时间离散；interior-penalty dG 没有离散 maximum principle，因此需要 Assumption dG2 的网格/粒子尺度限制，数值解可能出现负值。弱误差定理主要针对多项式 moment observables、扩散粒子和规则周期网格，外势、相互作用、反射边界等实验超出主定理范围。

reports.title: Interface foliation near a minimal isoparametric hypersurface for the Allen-Cahn equation
reports.abstract: Let $(M,g)$ be a closed Riemannian manifold of positive Ricci curvature. Let $f$ be a proper isoparametric function on $M$, and $Γ$ the unique level set of $f$ which is a minimal hypersurface. For any positive integer $k$, and $λ>0$ large enough, we construct a solution of the Allen-Cahn equation $ Δu + λ(u-u^3 ) =0$ which is constant along the level sets of $f$ and has exactly $k$ nodal components. We prove that the nodal components approach the minimal isoparametric hypersurface $Γ$ as $λ\rightarrow \infty$ and the energy is uniformly bounded for all such solutions.
reports.workSummary: 论文在正 Ricci 曲率闭 Riemann 流形上研究沿 proper isoparametric function 的 Allen–Cahn 解。对 level-set 常值的 f-invariant 函数，作者把椭圆 PDE 化为带单调 mean-curvature coefficient h 的一维 ODE，并用 shooting/phase-plane 构造任意固定 nodal multiplicity k 的全局解。通过 discrepancy D(w) 的单调性、临界点衰减、Sturm comparison 和区间分解，证明大 lambda 时所有零点集中到唯一 $h=0$ 的 minimal isoparametric hypersurface；最后控制每个单调区间的梯度与势能，得到固定零点数下的统一能量界。

Allen–Cahn ODE shooting
discrepancy function 单调性
Sturm–Picone comparison
相图角度与能量区间估计

reports.title: A class of port-Hamiltonian systems with general time delays
reports.abstract: We define a class of infinite dimensional linear port-Hamiltonian delay systems, give a characterization for such systems, and provide an easily verifiable sufficient condition to belong to this class, thereby extending the study by Breiten, Hinsen and Unger in [IEEE Trans. Autom. Control vol. 69, no. 12 (2024), pp. 8924-8930, doi: 10.1109/TAC.2024.3464332]. The results rely on the operator semigroup theoretic treatment of linear delay PDEs.
reports.workSummary: 论文定义带一般时间延迟的无限维线性 port-Hamiltonian 系统。延迟由有限变差算子值测度表示，作者把原 delay equation 提升到 $H\times L2([-tau,0];H)$ 的抽象 Cauchy 问题，证明相应算子生成 C0-semigroup，从而得到 classical/mild well-posedness。随后在延迟历史上引入由正自伴算子 Omega 加权的 Hamiltonian，利用积分分部把 port-Hamiltonian 条件化为一个耗散不等式；该不等式给出一般延迟核的充要刻画。若无延迟部分相对于延迟测度足够耗散，则选择 $Omega=|d$ eta|I 得到易检查的充分条件，最后将结论专门化到有限/无限离散 point delays。

reports.limitations: 理论针对线性系统、有限时间延迟窗和有界变差延迟算子，Hamiltonian 权重需正自伴；论文没有处理非线性、无限时间 horizon、一般 Hamiltonian 或 delay-dependent stability 的完整理论。离散延迟的矩阵判据在无限维情形仍需额外算子域与可和性条件。

reports.title: Continuum Limit of Nonlocal Electrostatics in Random Media
reports.abstract: We derive a two-scale continuum limit for the electrostatic energy of random charge density fields that are stationary and ergodic under lattice translations. Each microscopic cell is charge neutral in every realization, while its dipole moment may fluctuate and have a nonzero mean. Under assumptions on the stationary microscopic potential and the finite-volume fields, the local and nonlocal energies converge almost surely to deterministic limits. The local limit consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic Coulomb energy and a cell-depolarization term, whereas the effective polarization determines the nonlocal limit. The cell-depolarization terms cancel in the total energy, which consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic cell energy and the macroscopic electrostatic field energy. The deterministic specialization recovers the periodic two-scale limit. For an independent-cell random-displacement model, we verify the assumptions of the continuum-limit theorem and show that centered microscopic fluctuations can change the local energy without changing the effective polarization or the nonlocal energy.
reports.workSummary: 论文建立具有晶格平移平稳遍历性的随机电荷密度场的两尺度连续静电能极限。每个微观 cell 在每个 realization 中电中性，但 dipole 可随机波动；作者用 lattice ergodic theorem 将 cell dipole 平均识别为确定性 effective polarization p。局部能量的 thermodynamic limit 保留 ensemble-averaged microscopic Coulomb energy，并出现 cell depolarization 项；非局部材料点相互作用先收敛到 polarized-cell 离散能，再在 epsilon 趋零时收敛到由 p 生成的宏观 electrostatic field energy。局部的正 depolarization 与非局部的负项相消，得到总能量的 deterministic continuum formula，并在 periodic 与 independent-cell random-displacement 模型中验证假设。

两尺度 local/nonlocal energy decomposition
cell polarization 与 Poisson field

reports.limitations: 结果依赖固定立方 reference cell、晶格平移遍历性、电中性和 Section 3 的微观势/有限体场正则性假设；独立位移模型是静态 ensemble，不是含时间相关性的 atomistic Gibbs dynamics。论文没有覆盖非立方材料点、带长程 cell correlations 的动力学随机场或脱离这些假设的边界几何。

reports.title: Polynomial Bohnenblust--Hille bounds for product of cyclic groups
reports.abstract: Fix an integer $K\ge2$, and let $C_K^n =\{(e^{\frac{2πij}{K}})_{j=0}^{K-1}\}^n$ be the product of cyclic groups of order $K$. For a Fourier character $χ_α$, let $s(α)$ be the number of active coordinates. We give a self-contained proposed proof that the dimension-free Bohnenblust--Hille constants governed by interaction order grow polynomially: if $p_d=2d/(d+1)$ and \[ γ_2=\frac12, \qquad γ_K=\frac{K\log(K-1)}{4(K-2)}\quad(K\ge3), \] then the $\ell^{p_d}$ norm of Fourier coefficients $\{\hat f(α)\}$ is bounded by $L^\infty$ norm of $f$ multiplied by $C(K) d^{4γ_K+5}$. The constant $C(K)$ is actually at most of the order $K^{5/2}$.
reports.workSummary: 论文提出 product of cyclic groups 上 polynomial Bohnenblust–Hille bound 的一条 self-contained proof route。对 interaction order 分层后，作者把 Potts hypercontractivity、固定低阶 spectral projection 和 mixed-norm interpolation 接入加权 graded square function。随机把 active coordinates 二染色，保留每个局部 Fourier degree 并以 exact ancestry 回收 parent coefficient；binomial central capture 与 Potts entropy contraction 控制高 interaction levels。低阶层先单独闭合，高阶部分通过 uniform contraction 和 bootstrap 得到 weighted square-function $O(d^3)$，最后将权重还原为 coefficient $l^p$ 范数，得到固定 K 时 $C(K)d^(4$ $gamma_K+5)$ 的 proposed polynomial bound。
techniques: Potts hypercontractivity
interaction-order Fourier projections
weighted row–column square-function bootstrap
random coordinate bicoloring and exact ancestry

reports.limitations: 论文标题和 Theorem 1.1 将结果称为 proposed proof，结论只对每个固定 K 成立，常数和指数均随 K 变差；证明依赖既有 Potts hypercontractivity、低 interaction-level estimate 和 projection estimate，不能直接宣称 uniform-K 或非交换群版本。AI 曾参与 Section 5 [19] 的探索性证明开发，但数学内容由作者核验并编辑。

analyses.title: Sharp Hessian integrability for fully nonlinear elliptic supersolutions in low dimensions
analyses.abstract: We settle the planar sharp Hessian-integrability conjecture of Armstrong, Silvestre, and Smart [\emph{Comm. Pure Appl. Math.} \textbf{65} (2012), 1169--1184] for viscosity supersolutions of fully nonlinear uniformly elliptic equations. If $κ=Λ/λ$, then the optimal exponent in the $W^{2,ε}$ regularity theory in the plane is exactly $$ ε_2(κ)=\frac{2}{κ+1}. $$ The same mechanism reaches the known upper obstruction in dimension three throughout the full range $1\le κ\le 4$ and therefore gives $$ ε_3(κ)=\frac{3}{2κ+1} \qquad(1\leκ\le4). $$ Beyond this threshold, it yields a closed algebraic lower bound and identifies the precise spectral configuration responsible for the remaining gap. The proof introduces a spectrally resolved continuum-in-opening mechanism for contact geometry. Throughout the contact evolution, the vertex Jacobian retains the negative index of the Hessian and its mean negative curvature---data erased by the classical pointwise reduction---and these variables are optimized only after integration over all openings. This reduces the analysis to a finite family of explicit one-dimensional kernels whose critical exponents recover the sharp planar threshold, identify the exact three-dimensional regime above, and expose a broader principle for extracting second-order regularity from the spectral geometry of contact sets.

analyses.title: Optimal Spectral Lower Bounds and Nonradial Nonlinear Asymptotic Stability of a Family of Three-Dimensional Keller--Segel Self-Similar Blow-Up Solutions
analyses.abstract: This paper studies the spectral properties and nonlinear asymptotic stability of a family of finite-time self-similar blow-up solutions to the three-dimensional Keller--Segel system constructed by matching interior and exterior profiles within the framework of matched asymptotic expansions. For every sufficiently large matching index $n$, the full linearized operator around the stationary state $U_n$ in self-similar variables is analyzed on $L^2(\mathbb R^3)$. Sturm zero counting in the radial mode, a wave operator that reduces the nonlocal $l=1$ equation to a local equation, and a Mellin--Newton quadratic form for all $l\ge2$ show that, after the scaling and translation modes and the finitely many genuinely unstable radial modes are removed, the remaining spectrum is separated from the imaginary axis by a positive distance. In addition, the optimal lower bound on the real parts of the spectrum is $1/4$ in every mode $l\ge2$. On the stable subspace, an exponentially decaying semigroup and a modified energy equivalent to the $L^2$ norm are constructed, and the logarithmic asymptotic decay rate of the semigroup norm is proved to equal the stable spectral gap. Finally, modulation equations, $H^2$ energy estimates, control of the scaling derivative, and Brouwer's no-retraction theorem yield nonradial nonlinear asymptotic stability of the corresponding self-similar blow-up solutions after the initial coefficients in the finitely many unstable radial directions have been chosen suitably.

analyses.title: Threshold phenomena for least energy solutions of a doubly critical Neumann problem with a critical absorption term
analyses.abstract: We investigate the existence and nonexistence of least energy solutions for a doubly critical Neumann problem with a critical absorption term. We consider a positive function $u$ defined on a smooth bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ with $n\ge 5$, satisfying $-Δu + λu = u^{2^* - 1} -αu^{2^\sharp-1}$ inside $Ω$, with Neumann boundary condition $\nabla u\cdot ν= u^{2^\sharp -1}$ on $\partialΩ$, where $λ>0$, $α\ge0$, $2^*=\frac{2n}{n-2}$ is the critical Sobolev exponent and $2^\sharp=\frac{2(n-1)}{n-2}$ denotes the critical trace exponent. The simultaneous presence of the interior and boundary critical exponents together with this critical absorption term creates a new interaction between competing concentration mechanisms. In particular, the absorption term has the same critical trace exponent as the boundary nonlinearity, but with the opposite sign and acting in the interior of $Ω$. Consequently, it competes with the boundary mean curvature correction at the same asymptotic order in the energy expansion, leading to a sharp threshold phenomenon. Combining several analytic techniques and geometric tools, we prove the existence of a threshold value $α_{0}=α_{0}(λ,Ω)\in(0,+\infty)$ such that the problem admits a least energy solution if $α<α_{0}$, and no least energy solution if $α>α_{0}$. Moreover, the problem also has a least energy solution at $α=α_0$ provided $α_0> C(n)\max_{\partial Ω} H$, where $C(n)$ is a positive constant depending only on $n$ and $H$ is the mean curvature on $\partialΩ$.

analyses.title: Fully discrete stochastic maximal regularity and $H^\infty$-calculus for second-order elliptic operators
analyses.abstract:
This paper establishes the fully discrete stochastic maximal $L^p$-regularity and the accompanying sharp maximal estimate for numerical approximations of parabolic stochastic partial differential equations. We consider the spatial finite element discretization $A_h$ of a general second-order elliptic operator $A=-
abla \cdot a
abla +b\cdot 
abla +c$ with Dirichlet boundary conditions on a smooth, bounded, convex domain in $\mathbb{R}^3$, coupled with a broad class of temporal schemes, including rational approximations and the exponential Euler method. To obtain these optimal discrete regularity results, we establish a bounded $H^\infty$-calculus for the discrete spatial operator $A_h$, uniformly in the mesh size $h$. As a direct byproduct, we also establish the discrete-in-space stochastic maximal regularity for the corresponding spatial semi-discretizations.

analyses.title: Sharp spectral-scale stability for parabolic equations with measure-valued delay
analyses.abstract: We study the dependence of parabolic solution operators on a finite signed measure describing the delay law. For a positive self-adjoint generator with compact inverse, a weighted dyadic spectral sum characterizes the norm of the semigroup-integrated memory perturbation. An exact realization identity transfers the matching lower estimate to two positive point delays in a fixed linear equation, using a common smooth, finite-spectral history. For the Dirichlet Laplacian on a nonempty bounded open set, the sharp worst-case modulus on a bounded ball of continuous $L^2$-valued histories is $d\sqrt{\log(e/d)}$, where $d$ is the bounded-Lipschitz distance between the delay measures. This is a rough-history endpoint result: logarithmic spatial regularity of order $γ>1/2$ restores resolution-uniform Lipschitz stability in the linear model. The critical order $γ=1/2$ retains a square-root double-logarithmic loss. More generally, a reciprocal-square summability criterion over occupied spectral bands gives the exact weighted threshold, including sparse spectra. Consequences include sharp finite-resolution Lipschitz constants, worst-case errors for prescribed midpoint quadrature of the memory measure, and semilinear upper estimates under Hilbert-space-valued local Lipschitz assumptions. The results distinguish sensitivity to the delay law from spatial approximation error and do not preclude uniform approximation of positive-time states on rough history balls.

analyses.title: On Decay of the Local Mean Oscillations of the Vorticity Direction in Critical Navier-Stokes Flows
analyses.abstract: We isolate and analyze the geometric PDE governing the evolution of the vorticity direction in the 3D incompressible (unforced) Navier-Stokes equations (NSE), restricted to the case of a critical spatial point singularity where the vorticity magnitude concentrates as $O(|x|^{-2})$, inhabiting the critical Lorentz space $L^{3/2, \infty}$. The PDE consists of the Harmonic Map Heat Flow (HMHF) into the sphere supplemented with the fluid transport, cross-diffusion and tangential strain. The question is whether the NSE mechanics can propagate logarithmic decay of the local mean oscillations of the direction -- the condition $\xiVec \in \bmo_{1/|\log r|}$ which (in this setting) was shown in the companion paper to prevent finite time blow-up. The key observations are that the $O(|x|^{-2})$ concentration, factored out of the viscous cross-diffusion, generates an outward radial drift $4ν\, x/|x|^2$ at the core and that the HMHF nonlinearity is harmless for the quantity $\frac12|\xiVec - e|^2$, which is a subsolution on any hemisphere. This yields a transfer theorem: the $\bmo_{1/|\log r|}$ regularity of the direction at the core, uniformly up to the singular time, is controlled by a logarithmic modulus in time of the direction at the inner scale, together with the physical strain. Crucially, the strain enters the direction equation only through its tangential component $P_{\xiVec^\perp} S\xiVec$, which vanishes precisely when the direction is an eigenvector of the strain tensor. Since this includes the eigenvector carrying the maximal stretching, the result is in contrast to the classical geometric regularity criteria which are built on depleting the full vortex-stretching term and thus confined to configurations of weak stretching.

analyses.title: Two global stability theorems for small-data $3D$ compressible Euler solutions: Unique maximal globally hyperbolic developments with gradient-blowup & smooth global existence in the entire spacetime
analyses.abstract: We prove a pair of complementary small-data stability theorems describing the global future and past structure of classical solutions to the isentropic, spherically symmetric $3D$ compressible Euler equations. We allow any equation of state with positive sound speed, except that our shock-formation results do not apply to the Chaplygin gas. Our first theorem concerns open sets of smooth Cauchy data that are perturbations of trivial data with vanishing velocity and constant positive density. The perturbed data have finite kinetic energy, and the perturbed density is equal to a positive constant plus a signed ``asymptotically flat'' tail. Our main theorem yields a complete description of the existence and uniqueness of the maximal globally hyperbolic development (MGHD) of the data. The boundary of the MGHD contains hypersurfaces that extend to spatial infinity on which our solutions develop gradient-singularities. This is the first MGHD existence-uniqueness-stability result for shock-forming solutions for any multi-$D$ quasilinear wave system. While prior works have yielded local portions of ``candidate'' MGHDs, neither the existence nor the uniqueness of an MGHD can be inferred from local considerations. Our second theorem considers analogous data with the opposite sign of the $1/r$ density tail. We prove global existence throughout spacetime, to both the future and past. The solution's asymptotic behavior towards null infinity is not linear, but rather is distorted by a logarithmic bending of the sound cones away from the flat Minkowski ones, leading to logarithmically enhanced dispersion. This is the first small-data global existence result in the entire spacetime for any $3D$ quasilinear wave system that fails to satisfy the null condition and the weak null condition. The main mechanism of stabilization is a global-in-spacetime rarefaction effect, tied to the $1/r$ tail.

analyses.title: Global existence and finite-time blow-up for a strongly damped wave--MGT system with fully subcritical logarithmic nonlinearity
analyses.abstract: We study a coupled strongly damped wave--Moore--Gibson--Thompson (MGT) system with logarithmic source $f(u)=|u|^{γ-2}u\ln|u|$ in the full Sobolev-subcritical range $2<γ<2^*:=2n/(n-2)$. The main difficulty is that, in this full range, the logarithmic nonlinearity does not admit the standard compactness and difference estimates available in the lower subcritical regime. Using the augmented variable $w=v+τv_t$, we derive the exact energy-dissipation identity for the strongly damped system and exploit the associated coupled potential-well structure. For the local theory, a Faedo--Galerkin scheme combined with a closed nonlinear differential inequality and a spatial domain-splitting argument yields local existence. The strong damping provides the additional regularity needed to prove uniqueness throughout the full subcritical range and to establish a continuation principle. Below the well depth $d_α$, we then obtain a sharp dynamical dichotomy: solutions with initial data in the stable set exist globally and decay exponentially, whereas solutions with initial data in the unstable set blow up in finite time. The blow-up argument reveals a structural cancellation specific to the augmented formulation: once the logarithmic contribution is reconstructed through the exact energy identity, the unfavorable MGT residual in Levine's concavity functional is absorbed algebraically. This allows the concavity method to close without imposing any additional sign condition on the initial velocities.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究带强阻尼的 wave–Moore–Gibson–Thompson 耦合系统，在完整 Sobolev 次临界范围 $2<\gamma <2*=2n/(n-2)$ 下处理对数源 $f(u)=|u|^{\gamma -2}u$ log|u|。正文先以增广变量 $w=v+\tau v_t$ 建立精确能量耗散恒等式，第 2 节用 Faedo–Galerkin、域分割和闭合微分不等式得到局部适定与延拓准则，第 4 节构造耦合势阱，第 5 节用稳定/不稳定集合证明全局衰减和有限时爆破。Theorems 2.7–2.8 给出势阱下的全局—爆破二分。

Faedo–Galerkin 逼近

analyses.breakthrough: 关键结果覆盖整个次临界 $\gamma $ 区间：强阻尼不仅提供局部正则性与唯一性，还使对数非线性在增广能量中形成可用的势阱；低于井深 $d_\alpha $ 时，稳定集解全局指数衰减，不稳定集解因增广变量中的结构性抵消在有限时间爆破。

analyses.title: Critical fractional $p$-Hardy Sobolev equations: Global compactness and multiplicity of positive solutions
analyses.abstract: We study the critical fractional $p$-Hardy-Sobolev equation \begin{equation}\tag{$\mathcal{P}$}\label{a-main} (-Δ_p)^s u -μ\dfrac{|u|^{p-2}u}{|x|^{sp}}=\dfrac{|u|^{p^*_s(α)-2}u}{|x|^α}+f \;\mbox{ in }\,\mathbb{R}^d, \quad u\in \mathcal{D}^{s,p}(\mathbb{R}^d), \end{equation} where $1<p<\infty$, $0<s<1$, $0\leqα<sp<d$, $μ>0$, $p^*_s(α):= p(d-α)/(d-sp)$ is the critical Hardy-Sobolev exponent, and $f$ is a nontrivial nonnegative functional in $(\mathcal{D}^{s,p}(\mathbb{R}^d))^*$. We first establish global compactness results for Palais-Smale sequences associated with the corresponding energy functional. When $α>0$, the loss of compactness is described by dilations of solutions of the Hardy-Sobolev limit problem. The case $α=0$ has a different structure: in addition to Hardy profiles, pure Sobolev profiles may occur when the centre of concentration escapes from the Hardy singularity relative to its scale. We give a direct centre-scale analysis of these two concentration regimes and obtain the corresponding energy decomposition and profile separation. As an application, under an explicit smallness assumption on $f$, we first obtain a positive solution for \eqref{a-main} with negative energy. We then construct a nonlinear path based on hidden convexity whose energy remains strictly below the first bubbling threshold. A minimax argument, combined with the global compactness theorem, then yields a second distinct positive solution for \eqref{a-main}.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究临界分数阶 p-Hardy–Sobolev 方程中 Palais–Smale 序列的全局紧性与正解多重性。方程含 Hardy 权 $|x|^{-sp}$、临界指数 $p_s*(\alpha )$ 和非负泛函 f；正文第 1–3 节建立分数阶 Sobolev/Hardy 工具和 PS 分解，第 4 节按尺度与中心位置分析浓缩，第 5–6 节将 profile decomposition 应用于 $\alpha >0$ 的 Hardy $bubble、\alpha =0$ 时逃离奇点的纯 Sobolev bubble，并用变分阈值获得 Theorems 1.1–1.4 的正解存在/多重性。

analyses.breakthrough: 论文明确分离了两种此前容易混淆的失紧机制$：\alpha >0$ 时浓缩中心随尺度锁在 Hardy 奇点$，\alpha =0$ 时中心相对尺度逃离奇点并产生纯 Sobolev profile；该中心—尺度分析给出精确能量分解，并把不同阈值下的正解构造连接起来。
analyses.limitations: 参数需 $1<p<\infty 、0<s<1、0\le \alpha <sp<d、\mu >0$ 且 f 为非平凡非负对偶泛函$；\alpha =0$ 的额外逃逸 profile 使紧性更弱，多重性结论依赖文中能量阈值/小扰动条件，不能简化为一般临界方程的无条件存在。

analyses.title: Sharp dispersive estimates for wave equation on lattice graphs with high dimension
analyses.abstract: Schultz [Comm.~Pure~Appl.~Math., 1998] first established dispersive estimates for the fundamental solution of the discrete wave equation on lattice graphs $\Z^d$ for $d=2,3$, which can be seen as a discrete analogue of the classical dispersive estimate for the Euclidean wave equation. His result was extended by Bi, Cheng and Hua to $d=4$ and $5$. In this paper, we give complete answers to all the remaining dimensions, including $d=5$. Our estimate is sharp for every $d\geq 5$. Moreover, the proof remains valid for the upper bound of the case for $d=4$.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究高维晶格图 $Z^d$ 上离散波方程基本解 $G_d(x,t)$ 的尖锐色散衰减。正文第 1 节把离散 Fourier 相位 $\omega (\xi )$ 写在环面上并陈述 $d\ge 5$ 的指数 $\sigma _d=(2d+1)/6$；第 2 节准备 Poisson 求和与振荡积分引理，第 3–4 节把核分成低频/高频，在高频中将一维 Fourier 变换局部化到可能驻点区间并按坐标乘积估计，第 5 节在 $\xi *=(\pi /2,…,\pi /2)$ 附近构造各向异性尺度证明下界。Theorem 1.1 给出所有 $d\ge 5$ 的上界和尖锐性，并顺带推出 $d=4$ 的带对数上界。

analyses.title: Low Mach number limit for a compressible two-fluid model with algebraic closure and ill-prepared initial data in critical Besov spaces
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the low Mach number limit for a compressible two-fluid model with algebraic closure in the $d$-dimensional torus with $d \geq 2$. For large and ill-prepared initial data in critical Besov spaces, we prove that, provided that the Mach number is sufficiently small, the rescaled compressible two-fluid flow exists in critical Besov spaces for any finite time not exceeding the lifespan of the incompressible flow. Moreover, the rescaled compressible two-fluid flow converges to the incompressible Navier--Stokes flow as the Mach number tends to zero. The proof is based on a high-middle-low frequency analysis of the densities and velocity field, combined with a filtering technique involving wave operators. The main novelty is the derivation of new a priori estimates for the high-middle frequency part of the solution to the compressible two-fluid model, depending explicitly on time, the frequency parameter and the Mach number. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that proves (almost) global convergence for large and ill-prepared initial data in the low Mach number limit for compressible two-fluid model in critical framework.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究带代数闭合关系的可压缩两流体模型在临界 Besov 空间中的低马赫数极限，允许大数据和 ill-prepared 初值。正文第 1 节给出重标度方程与 Theorem 1.1，第 2–5 节建立临界乘积、声学/流体分解和高—中—低频先验估计，第 6 节用 wave operator filtering 消去快速声学振荡，第 7 节把压缩流与不可压 Navier–Stokes 解比较并得到收敛。主结果是在马赫数足够小时，压缩两流体解存在至不可压流的寿命，并在有限时间上收敛到不可压 Navier–Stokes 流。

高/中/低频能量分离
声学 wave-operator filtering
相对差值估计

analyses.breakthrough: 新意是对大而非准备初值同时控制高频密度、临界中频和低频声学模态；显式依赖时间、频率截断和马赫数的高—中频估计让 filtering 后的快速波项可被吸收，达到几乎全局的低马赫收敛。
analyses.limitations: 结果依赖临界 Besov 数据、代数闭合模型、周期域和马赫数足够小，并只保证不超过不可压流寿命的存在与收敛；声学层的频率参数及 ill-prepared 初值需满足文中兼容条件，不能直接推到任意边界域或超临界数据。

steps.route: 将密度扰动和速度散度组成线性声学对，应用过滤算子把 $e^{\pm it/\epsilon }$ 的相位从慢变量中移出；Propositions 6.1–6.4 分别控制过滤后的高频、时间导数和交换子误差。

analyses.title: Strong and Weak-Type Dispersive Estimates for the Energy-Critical Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation with an Inverse-Square Potential
analyses.abstract: We prove dispersive estimates for the three-dimensional defocusing energy-critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation associated with $\mathcal L_a=-Δ+a|x|^{-2}$. For nonnegative potentials, we extend the known finite-$p$ theory to the endpoint $L^1\to L^\infty$. For negative potentials in the global well-posedness range, set $σ=\frac12-\sqrt{\frac14+a}$. We obtain the free strong decay rate for $2<p<3/σ$ and the limiting Lorentz estimate from $L^{(3/σ)',1}$ to $L^{3/σ,\infty}$. The restriction $p<3/σ$ is sharp for strong Lebesgue decay. The proof combines a finite-interval bootstrap, nonlinear real interpolation on bounded energy sets, and endpoint Sobolev--Lorentz estimates adapted to $\mathcal L_a$.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究三维带逆平方势 $L_a=-\Delta +a|x|^{-2}$ 的 defocusing 能量临界 NLS，重点是传播子的强/弱型色散端点及其对非线性解衰减的影响。正文第 1 节按 $a\ge 0$ 与 −1/4<a<0 分出范围，第 2 节用径向 Bessel 表示、角向投影和 adapted Sobolev/Strichartz 估计建立线性工具，第 3 节在有界能量球上做非线性差值和 real interpolation，第 4 节用 Duhamel 分段 bootstrap 推到强 Lebesgue 范围、吸引势的弱 Lorentz 端点及非负势的 $L\infty $ 端点。

Lorentz 强/弱型色散估计
适配 Sobolev 与 Strichartz
非线性 real interpolation

analyses.breakthrough: 论文把逆平方势的角向零模与高角模态分开处理：非负势获得 $L1\to L\infty $ 端点，吸引势在 $p<3/\sigma '$ 的强衰减和 $p=3/\sigma $ 的 Lorentz 弱端点闭合，并用显式奇异谐振函数证明强范围的 $p=3/\sigma $ 阈值不可提高。
analyses.limitations: 吸引势只在 −1/4<a<0 且处于全局适定范围内讨论，端点目标必须使用 Lorentz 空间；负势的强 Lebesgue 衰减在 $p\ge 3/\sigma $ 被明确反例阻断，非负势的 $L\infty $ 结论则需要适配 Sobolev 空间和相应额外可积初值。

steps.claim: 传播子 $U_a(t)$ 在吸引势的临界指数 $p*=3/\sigma $ 处满足从 $L^{p*',1}$ 到 $L^{p*,\infty }$ 的弱型衰减，且高角模态可由 $L1\to L\infty $ 与 L2 酉性插值得到。
steps.route: 对球面平均 P0 用径向 Bessel 核 $j_{-\sigma }$ 的小/大参数界，得到 $|x|^{-\sigma }|y|^{-\sigma }$ 的 Lorentz 控制；对 $Q=I-P0$ 使用高角核的 $L1\to L\infty $ 界和 L2 酉性，实插值后合并两部分。

steps.claim: 能量类解在有限时间区间拥有适配的全局时空范数，非线性 Duhamel 项可放入对应 Lorentz 源空间。
steps.route: 利用 Hardy 不等式处理 $|x|^{-2}$，以 Strichartz 和 adapted Sobolev 估计控制 $L_a^{1/2}u；Lemma$ 2.4 给出 $a\ge 0$ 的全局空间时间界，a<0 时给出非端点 Lorentz 界，保证 $|u|^4u$ 的时间可积性。

analyses.title: Higher order KdV-type equations with Robin boundary conditions on $\mathbb{R}^+$
analyses.abstract: We study the initial boundary value problem (IBVP) for the higher order Korteweg--de Vries type equation \[\partial_tu+(-1)^{j+1}\partial_x^{2j+1}u+\frac12\partial_x(u^2)=0,\qquad j\in\mathbb{N},\] on the right half line, subject to the Robin boundary conditions \[(\partial_x+γ)\partial_x^{\ell-1}u(t,0)=\varphi_\ell(t),\qquad 1\le\ell\le j,\] where $γ\in\mathbb{R}$ is common to all boundary conditions. We prove local well posedness for \[u_0\in H^s(\mathbb{R}^+),\qquad \varphi_\ell\in H^{\frac{s+j-\ell}{2j+1}}(0,T),\qquad -j+\frac14<s<\frac32.\] In particular, the regularity range extends the low regularity theory for the higher order Dirichlet IBVP to Robin boundary conditions. The main ingredient is an explicit unified transform representation for the higher order IBVP with Robin boundary conditions. The Robin hierarchy couples adjacent boundary traces and leads, in each spectral sector, to a nontrivial system for the unknown boundary transforms. Rather than computing the inverse of this system, we resolve precisely the linear combination required by the unified transform representation through Lagrange interpolation at the rotated spectral points. This yields an exact factorization in which the dependence on the Robin parameter is concentrated in the single factor $(k-iγ)^{-1}$. Consequently, the only possible Robin pole is $k=iγ$, which contributes the residue mode \[e^{-γx+γ^{2j+1}t}\] exactly when $j$ is odd and $γ>0$. Combining this representation with linear estimates in modified Fourier restriction spaces and higher order KdV bilinear estimates yields the low regularity well posedness result. The representation also recovers the classical KdV formulas with Robin and Neumann boundary data when $j=1$ and is formally consistent with the higher order Dirichlet representation under the reciprocal Robin limit.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究半直线 R+ 上带 Robin 边界层级的高阶 KdV 型初边值问题$：u_t+(-1)^{j+1}\partial _x^{2j+1}u+\partial _x(u^{2})/2=0$，并令相邻边界迹满足 $(\partial x+\gamma )\partial x^{\ell-1}u(t,0)=\phi \ell(t)$。正文先把统一变换法的全局关系化成每个谱扇区的代数系统，再利用共同 Robin 参数的插值结构直接提取所需线性组合，随后在修正限制空间中建立线性和双线性估计，最后以短时间压缩映射得到 UTM 意义下的局部适定性、唯一性和连续依赖，覆盖 −j+1/4<s<3/2 的低正则范围。
techniques: 统一变换法（UTM）与谱扇区分解
Robin 边界迹递推和拉格朗日插值
振荡积分与时间局部化估计
修正 Bourgain/限制空间中的双线性估计
压缩映射与局部适定性
analyses.breakthrough: 关键新结论是：共同 Robin 参数使边界系统无需显式求整矩阵逆，就能通过两次拉格朗日插值得到带唯一可能极点因子 $k/(k-i\gamma )$ 的精确边界因子化；这一结构把高阶 Robin 层级的显式 UTM 表示和低正则局部理论连接起来，并允许在没有角点兼容条件的数据拓扑中闭合非线性论证。
analyses.limitations: 结果限于所有层级共享同一个 Robin 参数且该结构满足文中条件；作者明确指出不同参数的边界递推失去单参数多项式因子化，当前构造不能直接覆盖。正则性也限于 −j+1/4<s<3/2，较高正则需要另加角点兼容条件，且结论是局部时间理论。

steps.route: 第二次插值把各旋转点的边界项合并成 $k^{2j+1-\ell}/(k-i\gamma )$ 因子，并单独处理极点落入轮廓时的留数；这同时验证了扇区几何、初值项和 Robin 边界项的匹配。
