analyses.title: Strong Galerkin Approximation, Malliavin Regularity, and Blow-Up for a Mixed Local--Nonlocal Stochastic Wave Equation
analyses.abstract: We investigate the dynamical behavior of a class of semilinear stochastic wave equations on a bounded smooth domain $\Ocal\subset\R^d$ driven by additive trace-class noise, where the elastic response is governed by a \emph{mixed local--nonlocal} operator $\Acal=-θΔ+β(-Δ)^s$ with $s\in(0,1)$. A fundamental challenge in this setting is that the local and nonlocal operators do not commute on bounded domains: the natural Dirichlet basis fails to diagonalize the restricted fractional Laplacian. Consequently, we first establish the \emph{strong} convergence of the resulting non-diagonal, dense Galerkin approximation scheme. Leveraging these uniform energy bounds, we rigorously derive the associated Itô energy identity. In the defocusing regime ($\varepsilon = +1$), this strong approximation yields global well-posedness on the energy-subcritical range, providing a unique probabilistically strong solution in the energy space $V \times H$. Within this variational framework, we conduct an analysis of the Malliavin regularity, showing $(u(t), v(t)) \in \mathbb{D}^{1,2}(V) \times \mathbb{D}^{1,2}(H)$, and leverage fractional Sobolev embeddings to prove that the one-dimensional probability law of $u(t, x_0)$ is absolutely continuous via the Bouleau--Hirsch criterion. In stark contrast, for the focusing regime ($\varepsilon = -1$), we establish local well-posedness and prove a rigorous dichotomy: under a negativity condition on the initial energy, either pathwise explosion occurs with positive probability in finite time, or the energy norm possesses an infinite second moment before an explicit critical time $T^*$. Finally, we observe how the dense Galerkin interaction matrices pose unique structural challenges for spatial statistical inference.
analyses.workSummary: 本文处理有界光滑区域上的混合局部–非局部随机波方程，空间算子为 $A=-\theta \Delta +\beta (-\Delta )^s，0<s<1$；局部 Laplace 与谱分数 Laplace 在有界域上不交换，因此作者使用非对角稠密 Galerkin 近似。正文先建立算子型范数与有限维能量估计，再用 Itô 能量恒等式和紧性/强收敛得到能量解；在散焦情形进一步证明全局概率强解、Malliavin 可微性及一维点值分布绝对连续，在聚焦情形则用势阱和能量负性给出最大解与爆破解。
techniques: 非对角 Galerkin 逼近
混合局部–分数算子能量法
Itô 能量恒等式与一致估计
Malliavin 变分方程
势阱法与爆破替代
analyses.breakthrough: 核心结论是把不交换的局部与非局部算子放进同一稠密 Galerkin 框架，并在不借助共同特征基的情况下取得强收敛；在此基础上，作者把散焦全局能量控制、Malliavin 正则性和聚焦有限时间爆破准则连成一条可验证的随机波分析链。
analyses.limitations: 算子与噪声设定限于有界光滑区域、加性 trace-class 噪声和文中能量次临界幂次；点值密度结论还要求 $d=1、s>1/2$ 以使用连续嵌入。聚焦情形只在给定初值/能量符号与停止时间条件下得到爆破或局部解结论，不能推及任意非线性、乘性噪声或非光滑区域。

steps.claim: 混合算子在没有共同对角基的情况下仍产生可控的有限维能量系统，且 Galerkin 空间稠密于能量空间。
steps.route: 将 Laplace 特征函数作为坐标，仅把分数阶二次型写成非对角矩阵；谱分数型二次型的正性和相对上界给出矩阵 $A^(N)$ 的双边能量控制，保证有限维系统可解。

steps.claim: Galerkin 近似具有统一能量界，并沿整个序列强收敛到混合随机波方程的能量解。
steps.route: 对有限维系统应用 Itô 公式，散焦非线性贡献非负并与 trace-class 噪声项分离，得到期望能量和路径能量界；差分方程结合局部 Lipschitz 控制与 Gronwall 论证强收敛和唯一性。

analyses.title: On the effective sharp stability of the Faber-Krahn inequality
analyses.abstract: We prove the sharp quantitative Faber--Krahn inequality with a computable dimensional constant, resolving a problem posed by Brasco and De Philippis~\cite[Open Problem~2]{brasco2017spectral}. In contrast with the known proof of the sharp estimate, our argument avoids indirect compactness arguments and selection principles. It runs through a new level-set proof of the Saint--Venant inequality, using that the torsional deficit controls both the average isoperimetric deficit and the oscillation of the gradient magnitude along the boundaries of level sets. An effective local strong isoperimetric estimate for confined sets then yields the result.
analyses.workSummary: 本文给出开集 $\Omega \subset R^n$ 上 Faber–Krahn 不等式的有效尖锐稳定性。作者以 torsion function 的超水平集为主线，先通过 co-area 公式把 torsional deficit 分解成 level-set 的等周亏损与梯度振荡，再证明适用于受限集合的有效局部强等周估计，最后逐层积分并与 Kohler–Jobin 不等式结合，得到每个 $n\ge 2$ 都有可计算常数的尖锐定量 Faber–Krahn 估计，并说明同一机制给出相应 Sobolev 稳定性推论。正文明确处理了无界或仅有限测度开集的延拓。

analyses.title: Concavity Properties of Robin Solutions on $C^{3,1}$ Uniformly Convex Domains
analyses.abstract: We prove that, on a bounded uniformly convex domain of class $C^{3,1}$, the first Robin eigenfunction is strictly log-concave and the Robin torsion function is strictly $1/2$-concave for all sufficiently large Robin parameters. This means that Conjecture 1.1 of Andrews, Clutterbuck and Hauer holds for uniformly convex $C^{3,1}$ domains in any dimension, and settles an open problem posed by Crasta and Fragalà when the domain has $C^{3,1}$ regularity. Our proof derives suitable uniform $C^2$-decay estimates by maximum principle arguments, thereby removing the imposed higher-order boundary regularity assumption required previously.

analyses.title: Modified Scattering and Asymptotics for Perturbed One-Dimensional Cubic NLS
analyses.abstract: We study the long-time dynamics of small solutions to the one-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation \[ i\partial_t v+\partial_x^2v-β\abs{v}^2v +\cW(x)\abs{v}^4v+γi\partial_xv=0, \] where $\cW$ is spatially localized. The cubic nonlinearity is long range and produces the logarithmic phase correction, whereas the localized quintic term is short range at leading order. We construct a global forward modified wave operator for small complex asymptotic profiles and prove quantitative final-state estimates. For small data in the weighted energy space, we also establish global existence, sharp $t^{-1/2}$ decay, and forward modified scattering with a unique asymptotic profile. The principal new phenomenon occurs beyond this leading law. The exact Duhamel tail generated by the localized quintic term admits a quantitative inner scaling limit at the distinguished frequency $ζ=-γ/2$ on the scale $\abs{ζ+γ/2}\sim t^{-1/2}$. Its universal shape is explicit and depends on the value of the scattering profile on the distinguished ray and on the zeroth moment of $\cW$. When both quantities are nonzero, the limit is nontrivial, belongs optimally to $C^{2,1}_{\mathrm{loc}}$, and is not $C^3$ at the center. Away from the corresponding self-similar ray $ξ=-γ$, we construct rigorously defined higher-order outer expansions through every integer order allowed by the decay of $\cW$, and to each fixed finite order when $\cW$ is rapidly decreasing.
analyses.workSummary: 本文分析一维带空间局部五次项和输运项的 cubic $NLS：i\partial t$ $v+\partial x^{2}v-\beta |v|^{2}v+W(x)|v|^{4}v+\gamma i\partial xv=0$。作者先通过平移/规范化和显式 Schrödinger 波包识别 cubic 共振，再把其不可积 $t^{-1}$ 项吸收到对数相位；局部化五次项则由 Duhamel 尾项和加权估计控制。正文由此构造小散射剖面的前向修正波算子，证明小加权能量数据的全局解$、t^{-1/2}$ 衰减与唯一修正散射剖面，并在 $\zeta =-\gamma /2$ 的 $t^{-1/2}$ 内尺度上得到局部五次尾项的普适剖面及远离该射线的高阶展开。

analyses.title: Asymptotic stability of viscous shock for the outflow problem of 3D Navier-Stokes system
analyses.abstract: We establish the asymptotic stability of planar viscous shock waves for the outflow problem of the three-dimensional barotropic compressible Navier--Stokes equations in a half-space, with periodic boundary conditions imposed in the transverse directions. For a weak shock located sufficiently far from the boundary, we prove that, under small perturbations in $H^{2}$, the outflow problem admits a unique global-in-time solution and that the solution converges uniformly to the viscous shock, up to a dynamical shift, whose velocity time-asymptotically decays. This provides the first shock-stability result for the multidimensional outflow problem. Our proof combines the $a$-contraction method and higher-order energy estimates adapted to the half-space boundary. The boundary trace remaining in the zeroth-order estimate is controlled by differentiating the perturbation system in the tangential directions and exploiting the favorable sign of the outflow flux. The highest-order normal derivatives are then recovered from the time and tangential derivatives through the momentum equation, while the boundary terms generated by the dynamical shift are controlled using the exponential decay of the viscous shock tail.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究 $R+\times T^2$ 半空间中三维柱对称平面黏性激波的 outflow 初边值稳定性。作者以体积变量和有效速度重写扰动系统，用带动态平移的 a-contraction 控制零阶相对熵；再沿横向微分获得边界迹耗散，用动量方程从时间/切向导数恢复最高法向导数。由于固定平移 $\beta $ 把激波前沿置于远离边界的位置，激波尾部的指数小量可吸收动态平移产生的边界项，最终对足够弱激波和小 $H^2$ 扰动闭合高阶能量估计，得到唯一全局解、相对动态平移的均匀收敛以及平移速度趋于零。

analyses.title: Global Strong Solutions for Maxwell-Stefan Diffusion with Additive Friction Coefficients
analyses.abstract: We study Maxwell-Stefan diffusion with additive friction coefficients $f_{ij}=g_i+g_j$. In mass fractions, the system isolates the constrained pair-friction block; in mole fractions, it is the classical ideal isothermal/isobaric Maxwell-Stefan system at constant total molar concentration. Additivity makes the constrained pair-friction dissipation species-diagonal; conversely, species-diagonality on one interior barycentric constraint space forces a pair-sum representation. At operator level, the positive constrained relaxation operator is a scalar shift of a compression of $G=diag[g_1,\ldots,g_N]$. Its scalar resolvent yields both an explicit constrained inverse and interlacing spectral roots, which form global real-analytic coordinates on the open simplex and whose differentials are left eigen-covectors. In root coordinates the principal part is diagonal, no self-square gradient term occurs, and scalar comparison yields invariant rectangles and separation from the simplex boundary. For regularity we introduce entropy-stabilized one-sided multi-EPD truncations: Euler-Poisson-Darboux entropies cancel mixed quadratic production, while for $N\ge4$ a truncation-weighted mixing-entropy correction supplies transverse coercivity. Caccioppoli and logarithmic estimates, shrinking, and critical mass yield Hölder continuity up to the Neumann boundary. The mixing entropy also symmetrizes the moment system; frozen conormal estimates give spatial Lipschitz bounds. Together with time Hölder control and short-interval maximal regularity, this yields global strong solvability on bounded $C^{2+α}$ domains with $0<α<1$, for each $N\ge2$, $d\ge2$, and $p>d+2$, for all uniformly positive, compatible initial concentrations in the natural trace class. Solutions become classical for positive times and converge exponentially to equilibrium in relative entropy, $L^2$, and $C^1(\barΩ)$.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究二元摩擦系数满足 $f_ij=g_i+g_j$ 的 Maxwell–Stefan 扩散系统，并在有界 $C^{2+\alpha }$ 区域、均匀正初始浓度和齐次 Neumann 条件下建立无小数据限制的全局强解理论。正文先在受约束的摩擦空间上显式压缩并反演算子，以 interlacing roots 作为全局谱坐标；这些坐标把主部对角化并由标量比较保持在远离单纯形边界的矩形内。随后作者用单侧 multi-EPD 熵得到根变量的 De Giorgi Hölder 正则性，用混合熵 Hessian 对仿射矩变量系统化，再结合冻结 conormal 估计与短区间最大正则性排除有限极大时间，并推出相对熵、L2 和 C1 的指数趋于平衡。

analyses.title: Gradient estimates for the fractional $p$-Laplacian in the supercritical regime
analyses.abstract: We prove a pointwise gradient estimate for the fractional $p$-Laplace equation with measure data. Let $n\ge 2$, $p>1$ and $\max\{n/p,1/p'\}<s<1$, where $p'=p/(p-1)$. Suppose $u\in W^{s,p}(\mathbb R^n)$ is a weak solution of \[ (-Δ_p)^s u=μ\quad\text{in }Ω, \] with $μ\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{loc}}(Ω)$. Set $γ=s-(p-1)/p$. If $B_{2R}(x_0)\SubsetΩ$ and $\mathcal{W}_{γ,p}^{|μ|}(x_0,2R)<\infty$, then $u$ is Fréchet differentiable at $x_0$, and \[|\nabla u(x_0)|\le C\bigl[\mathcal A(u;x_0,2R)+\mathcal{W}_{γ,p}^{|μ|}(x_0,2R)\bigr], \] where $\mathcal{W}_{γ,p}^{|μ|}$ denotes the truncated Wolff potential, and $\mathcal A$ depends on the local oscillation of $u$ and its nonlocal tail. The proof uses a comparison with fractional $p$-harmonic replacements and an affine decay estimate for homogeneous solutions, with constants independent of the affine slope. In the large slope regime, the affine decay estimate follows from a Schauder estimate for the linear nonlocal equation satisfied by the affine remainder.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究带局部 Radon 测度右端的分数阶 p-Laplace 方程，并在 max{n/p,1/p'}<s<1 的超临界区间证明点态梯度估计。核心结论是：若以 x0 为中心的截断 Wolff 势有限，则弱解在 x0 Frechet 可微，梯度由局部振荡加非局部 tail 与 Wolff 势控制。正文先比较解和同球内 fractional p-harmonic replacement，再定义带最佳仿射函数的 affine excess；对斜率受控情形调用齐次 $C^{1,\alpha }$ 估计，对大斜率情形减去仿射函数并线性化非局部核，取得与斜率无关的 affine decay，最后将 replacement 误差迭代为势积分并收敛到点值梯度。

analyses.title: Qualitative analysis of positive radial singular solutions on hyperbolic space
analyses.abstract: We investigate positive radial solutions with an isolated nonremovable singularity for the semilinear elliptic equation \begin{align*} Δ_{\mathbb{H}^N} u+λu+u^p=0 \qquad\text{in }\mathbb{H}^N\setminus\{Q\}, \end{align*} where $N\geq 3$, $p>1$, $λ\le \frac{(N-1)^2}{4}$, and $Q\in\mathbb{H}^N$ is a prescribed pole. Our purpose is to describe how the locally Euclidean singular behavior near ${\{Q}\}$ interacts with the genuinely hyperbolic dynamics at infinity, and how this interaction changes across the Serrin and Sobolev critical exponents. For $\frac{N}{N-2}\le p<\frac{N+2}{N-2}$, we construct a family of positive radial singular solutions selecting the fast exponential mode at infinity. At the pole, these solutions exhibit the logarithmically corrected fundamental-solution profile when $p=\frac{N}{N-2}$, and the standard power-law profile when $\frac{N}{N-2}<p<\frac{N+2}{N-2}.$ At the conformally invariant pair $(p,λ)=(\frac{N+2}{N-2},\frac{N(N-2)}{4})$, we obtain an explicit singular solution and nonconstant Fowler-type solutions, and we classify all positive radial solutions with a nonremovable singularity via the positive periodic orbits of an associated autonomous equation. In the supercritical regime $p>\frac{N+2}{N-2}$ with $λ\le\frac{ N(N-2)}{4}$, we prove existence and uniqueness of the global positive radial singular solution, derive its two-term local asymptotic expansion near the pole, and establish a sharp trichotomy for its behavior at infinity.
analyses.workSummary: 本文对双曲空间 $H^N\{Q}$ 上的半线性径向方程 $u''+(N-1)coth(r)u'+\lambda u+u^p=0$ 进行完整的奇异性与远场分析。作者按 Serrin 与 Sobolev 临界指数分区：次临界至临界之间用反演 $s=log$ coth(r/2) 和加权 Euclidean 方程构造在极点奇异、在无穷远选择快衰减模态的解；超临界区先围绕 L(sinh $r)^{-m}$ 以固定点构造局部奇异剖面，再借助 Pohozaev 恒等式和耗散能量延拓；共形临界对则通过 Emden–Fowler 型变量化为自主 Hamilton 系统，分类常数剖面与 Fowler 周期轨道。

analyses.limitations: 结果限于径向正解$、N\ge 3、\lambda \le (N-1)^2/4$，并只研究单个孤立极点；共形临界的完整分类只适用于特定 $(p,\lambda )$，超临界唯一性只覆盖 p>pSob 且 $\lambda \le N(N-2)/4$。非径向奇异解、多个极点及超出这些参数范围的正解不在结论内。

analyses.title: Asymptotic behavior for the damped Schrödinger equation with nonlinear dissipation
analyses.abstract: We consider large time asymptotics of solutions to the damped Schrödinger equation with the nonlinear dissipation in the mass-subcritical case. We prove that the optimal $L^2$-decay rate of the nonlinear solution coincides with that of the corresponding linear solution even in the presence of nonlinear dissipation. Moreover, we give the optimal convergence rate for scattering for any power in the mass-subcritical regime.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究质量次临界范围 1<p<1+4/n 的带线性阻尼和复系数非线性耗散 Schrödinger 方程。通过 $v=e^{at}u$ 变换，方程化为非线性系数随时间指数衰减的 Schrödinger Cauchy 问题。正文先用 Strichartz 估计建立 L2 全局适定和散射态，再在 Im $\lambda <0$ 时利用质量耗散恒等式排除散射态消失，最后对 Duhamel 项做精细时空分解，在散射态属于 $L^{2p/(2p-1)}$ 时取得精确的 $t^{-n(p-1)/2}e^{-apt}$ L2 散射误差上下界。
techniques: 指数共轭变换消除线性阻尼
Strichartz 估计与全局 mild 解
质量耗散恒等式
自由 Schrödinger 波包/色散估计
Duhamel 尾项的双侧渐近估计
analyses.breakthrough: 论文证明在存在非线性耗散时，线性阻尼仍完全决定质量的最优指数衰减；并在全质量次临界区间给出精确的 L2 散射误差阶 $t^{-n(p-1)/2}e^{-apt}$，这拓展了此前只覆盖特殊幂次或更强函数空间的结果。
analyses.limitations: 参数限于 1<p<1+4/n、a>0 且 Im $\lambda \le 0$；精确散射速率还要求非零散射态属于 $L^{2p/(2p-1)}$。研究是全空间 Cauchy 问题的前向时间结论，Im $\lambda <0$ 时反向终态问题因质量放大可能爆破，作者明确未解决。

steps.claim: 变换后的方程在质量次临界范围内存在唯一全局 L2 解和散射态 $\phi $。
steps.route: 用 $v=e^{at}u$ 把阻尼变成可积的系数 $e^{-a(p-1)t}$，再将 Duhamel 映射放入 Schrödinger admissible Strichartz 空间；时间衰减使局部解可连续延拓，并令尾积分收敛到 $\phi $。

steps.route: 由质量恒等式，假设范数趋零会迫使加权非线性耗散积分耗尽全部初始质量；结合 Strichartz 控制和尾部时间区间上的衰减，证明该积分不足以达到该质量，得到反证。

analyses.title: On Analyticity of Solitons for the Periodic Dispersion-Managed Nonlinear Schrödinger Equation
analyses.abstract: We explore the regularity of energy maximizers for the Lagrangian of a periodic dispersion managed fiber optic at fixed intensity, on a torus of length $L$ and with vanishing average dispersion. We show that the Fourier coefficients decay at a polynomial rate, and then upgrade this to exponential decay, so that the maximizers are analytic in space for large enough $L$. In addition, by an asymptotic comparison to the optimizers on the real line, we prove that the solutions are non-trivial. We also consider a conjecture that the maximizer necessarily has an underlying symmetry inherent to both the energy functional and the resulting Euler-Lagrange equation. All of our results are supported with illustrative numerical experiments.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究零平均色散的周期 dispersion-managed NLS 在大周期 L 上的固定质量能量最大化问题。将周期传播算子写入四线性泛函 Q 后，作者先得到最大化器的 Fourier 方程；Moyua–Vega 型双线性估计及其分离支撑改进给出 Fourier 模式随 |k| 的多项式衰减，再以频率壳层 bootstrap 将衰减提升为指数衰减，因此所有弱解都具有空间解析性。最后把周期问题与实线优化器作大 L 渐近比较，证明最大化常数有正下界，故大周期最大化器不能是平凡常数解；数值部分只用于展示不同对称类的非平凡解。

Fourier 模式 Euler–Lagrange 方程

analyses.limitations: 指数衰减和非平凡性要求周期 L 足够大且平均色散取 $dav=0$；衰减常数不对 L 统一，作者也未证明 Conjecture 1.5 的对称性唯一性。数值实验不替代解析存在性，本文结论限于周期固定点/最大化器，不直接覆盖实线上唯一优化器或一般平均色散。

analyses.title: Long-term behaviour of the CAO-system: Optimal polynomial $H^1$-convergence to degenerate equilibria
analyses.abstract: This article is concerned with a definitive analysis of its long-term dynamics of the CAO-system. We establish the convergence of global strong solutions to constant equilibria in the full $H^1$-topology in the non-perturbative regime. Remarkably, we demonstrate that the CAO-system exhibits a polynomial rate of decay and we determine the optimal rate. This phenomenon stands in stark contrast to the exponential convergence typically expected for uniformly parabolic systems on bounded domains. This algebraic slowing is shown to be a purely nonlinear effect, driven by the emergence of a slow manifold (center manifold) induced by nonlinear coupling conditions. To the best of our knowledge, this provides the first instance of a global polynomial decay result for a non-gradient, non-local dissipative system on a bounded domain.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究耦合大气–海洋 primitive equations 的 CAO 系统在非线性风驱界面条件下的长期动力学。依托已有的任意 $H^1$ 初值全局强适定性，作者先识别总能量严格 Lyapunov、总动量守恒以及四维慢流形上的退化平衡；随后建立适配界面跳跃的 Poincare 不等式和 Hessian–Laplacian 恒等式，构造平衡附近的 trapping region。进入该区域后，能量微分不等式给出 L2 的 $t^{-1}$ 收敛，耗散量再经初步梯度估计和有限次 bootstrap 提升为梯度 $t^{-3/2}$ 收敛，最终得到完整 $H^1$ 拓扑的最优多项式衰减。
techniques: 能量 Lyapunov 与总动量守恒
耦合界面跳跃的 Poincare 不等式
Hessian–Laplacian 边界恒等式

analyses.breakthrough: 论文证明该有界域、强抛物但非梯度的 CAO 系统存在由非线性界面耦合诱导的慢流形，并在任意全局强解上给出最优的 $H^1$ 多项式衰减：速度本身为 $t^{-1}$、梯度为 $t^{-3/2}$。这解释了为何系统不具备通常预期的指数趋近平衡。
analyses.limitations: 分析限于 Hilbert 情形 $p=q=2$、固定周期层域、原始非线性风驱界面条件及已有全局强解框架；方法尚未扩展到完整 (p,q) 尺度或更一般几何/耦合。作者明确指出更精细的速度均值差渐近仍未证明，且某些特殊初值会解耦并呈指数衰减。

analyses.title: The Sharp $C^{1,1}$ Target Threshold for Minimizing Constraint Maps
analyses.abstract: Let $K\subset\R^m$ be the closure of a bounded domain whose boundary is a compact embedded hypersurface, and let \( \overline M=\R^m\setminus\operatorname{int}K \) be the allowed target. We prove that if $\partial K$ is of class $C^{1,1}$, then every $\overline M$-valued local minimizer of the Dirichlet energy $E(u;B):=\int_B|Du|^2\dd x$ is locally $W^{2,\infty}$, and hence locally $C^{1,1}$, on its continuity set. For every $0<α<1$, we also construct a convex body with $C^{1,α}$ boundary and an everywhere continuous global minimizer that is not $C^{1,1}$. Thus $C^{1,1}$ is the sharp target regularity threshold in the Hölder scale.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究目标空间含有 $C^{1,1}$ 障碍边界的 Dirichlet 能量约束映射。作者在连续性集上先用正到达几何和近似非扩张投影把目标约束转成带有单侧二次支持的变分不等式，再通过调和替换与两次 Campanato 迭代从连续性提升到局部 Lipschitz。随后由接触集恒等式得到有界标量反应项和向量 Euler 方程，最后用旋转法向抵消与 Newton 势估计控制 Hessian，证明 $C^{1,1}$ 目标边界时局部 $W^{2,\infty }$；另构造 $C^{1,\alpha }$ 凸障碍及连续全局极小映射，说明阈值不可降低。

调和替换与 Campanato 迭代

analyses.title: The stability conjecture for the Bernoulli problem in dimension four
analyses.abstract: We prove that every global classical stable solution to the one-phase Bernoulli problem in $\mathbb R^4$ is one-dimensional. In particular, if nonempty, its free boundary consists of one or two parallel hyperplanes. This settles the stability conjecture for the Bernoulli problem in dimension four. As consequences, we obtain universal local Hessian and free-boundary curvature estimates for classical stable solutions in $\mathbb R^4$, as well as axial symmetry of global classical solutions with finite Morse index in $\mathbb R^4$.
analyses.workSummary: 本文解决四维一相 Bernoulli 问题的稳定性猜想：任意全局经典稳定解都必须是一维，故非空自由边界只能是一条或两条平行超平面。证明先以 blow-down 和一阶齐次稳定锥分类把大尺度模型压到 half-space 或 vee；再在非平坦假设下定义 neck 中心、横向稳定性缺陷和 neck charge，构造带对数传播的 Gaussian Weiss excess。通过选择幂次、中心和尺度建立 dyadic free-boundary ball tree，将 vee 两侧组织成带可控通量误差的有符号区域，最后以 Neumann 线性化和 flat-scale 改善把两侧曲率能量推入严格次临界范围，产生与初始归一化 Hessian 矛盾的衰减。

analyses.title: Global Dynamic Patterns of Entropy Solutions for One-dimensional Pressureless Euler System
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we are concerned with the fine properties of entropy solutions of the Cauchy problem for the one-dimensional pressureless Euler system, wherein the initial density $ρ_0$ is a locally finite Radon measure and the initial velocity $u_0\in L^\infty_{ρ_0}$. We employ the solution formula introduced by [F.M. Huang and Z. Wang, Comm. Math. Phys. 222(1) (2001), 117--146.] for this Cauchy problem to analyze the entropy solutions and obtain various new fine properties of entropy solutions; these can be summarized in four aspects: (i) Characteristics and initial waves for the Cauchy problem; (ii) Fine local structures of entropy solutions; (iii) Divides and global structures of entropy solutions; (iv) Invariants and asymptotic behaviors of entropy solutions including the asymptotic profile and the corresponding decay rates. Through these results (i)-(iv), we establish the global dynamic patterns of entropy solutions of the Cauchy problem for the $1$-D pressureless Euler system with general initial data $ρ_0$ being locally finite Radon measures and $u_0\in L^\infty_{ρ_0}$.
analyses.workSummary: 本文利用 Huang–Wang 的广义势解公式，研究任意局部有限 Radon 初始密度和相对于密度本质有界初速度的一维无压 Euler 熵解。正文先以质量原函数 m 和广义势的最小点集合描述特征线，再给出特征生成及十一类初始波的判据；随后分析反向特征三角形内的局部结构、间断点方向极限和 $\delta -shock$ 的左右导数。对全局结构，作者引入相对于质量的动量全局凸包刻画 divides 及其位置速度，并以此分解所有间断分支；最后建立无限质量/有限质量不变量，推导有 divides 时的无冲击 Burgers 渐近剖面、无 divides 时的单一 $\delta -shock$ 极限及相应衰减率。

analyses.title: Rate of convergence of the $p$-torsion function to the distance function
analyses.abstract: We prove that the Dirichlet $p$-torsion function $u_p$ converges to the distance to the boundary $d$ at the rate $O(1/p)$ in the uniform norm, on every bounded domain and with a constant depending only on the dimension and the diameter. The upper bound comes from a radial barrier with its pole at a boundary point, which is an admissible comparison function for $p>n$ and needs no boundary regularity; the lower bound comes from an inscribed ball. On the ball the error equals $(1+\log n)/p+O(p^{-2})$, so the order $1/p$ cannot be improved in general. Under a uniform exterior ball condition an annular barrier gives $u_p\le K_Ω^{1/(p-1)}d$ for every $p>1$, with $K_Ω$ explicit in the dimension, the diameter and the exterior radius; on convex sets the constant is the diameter, and a multiple of $d$ is a supersolution whenever $-Δd$ has a positive distributional lower bound. On $C^2$ domains, the same barrier and the classical gradient maximum principle give $\norm{\nabla u_p}_{L^\infty}^{p-1}\le K_Ω$. When $-Δd$ is a measure of finite total variation, which we prove for $C^1$ domains with a uniform exterior ball, the gradients converge in $L^q$ at the rate $O(p^{-1/2})$ for $q\le2$ and $O(p^{-1/q})$ for $q\ge2$; these exponents are not claimed to be sharp. The explicit ball profile shows that the gradients do not converge uniformly.
analyses.workSummary: 本文量化 Dirichlet p-扭转函数 $u_p$ 向边界距离 d 的 $p\to \infty $ 收敛。最一般的有界域上，作者以边界点为极点的径向上障碍和内切球下障碍夹住 $u_p$，得到仅依赖维数和直径的 $||u_p-d||\infty =O(1/p)$ 且证明球上的误差展开说明阶数不可改善；有统一外球条件时再用环形障碍得到线性于 d 的上下界。在 $C^2$ 域上，外障碍结合退化 p-Laplace 的梯度最大值原理控制 $||\nabla u_p||^{p-1}\infty $；若 $-\Delta d$ 是有限总变差测度，能量恒等式和距离函数近似进一步给出有限 Lq 梯度收敛率。

analyses.title: Well-posedness and a sign-graph limit for an active Cahn--Hilliard equation on Riemannian manifolds
analyses.abstract: We establish a weak solution theory and a singular constitutive limit for a non variational Cahn Hilliard evolution on compact Riemannian manifolds, possibly with boundary. The model combines the classical double well chemical potential with an active correction concentrated in diffuse transition layers and sensitive to the sign of the Laplace Beltrami operator, together with a monotone anchoring mechanism toward a prescribed reference state. The active correction breaks the passive gradient flow structure and introduces a nonlinear dependence on second derivatives not identified by the natural weak compactness estimates. For square integrable initial data and sufficiently integrable reference data, we construct weak solutions in arbitrary dimension. A Galerkin level one sided comparison argument, using monotonicity of the classifier and anchoring law together with biharmonic coercivity, yields strong convergence of the approximate Laplacians and hence strong second order compactness. This identifies the nonlinear active term in an ordinary weak formulation, without a second derivative defect. In two dimensions we prove uniqueness and continuous dependence. The estimates depend only on the bound and monotonicity of the classifier, not on its slope, and are therefore uniform for increasingly steep arctangent classifiers. Their singular limit is governed by the maximal monotone sign graph acting on the Laplace Beltrami operator. In arbitrary dimension we obtain subsequential strong second order convergence to a weak solution of the resulting differential inclusion. In two dimensions the limiting state is unique, so the entire steep classifier family converges; uniqueness of the constitutive multiplier on the zero Laplacian set is not asserted. This is a constitutive steepness limit at fixed diffuse interface thickness, rather than a sharp interface limit.
analyses.workSummary: 本文在紧致带边界 Riemann 流形上研究含主动 constitutive 项 $a(\Delta _g$ $u)|\nabla _g$ u| 的非变分 Cahn–Hilliard 演化。作者先对 Galerkin 解建立能量、时间导数和双调和 coercivity 估计，关键地以 classifier 与 anchoring law 的单调性作单侧比较，获得 $\Delta _g$ $u_m\to \Delta _g u$ 的强 L2 紧性，从而在普通弱形式中识别主动通量。二维时 Agmon 不等式使立方双稳势差可控，给出唯一性和稳定性；对 $a_N(r)=2\pi ^{-1}arctan(Nr)$ 的陡峭化序列，则提取 $Sign(\Delta _g$ u) 图的弱极限，在二维进一步由状态唯一性把子序列收敛提升为全序列收敛。

analyses.title: An improved strong comparison principle for singular $p$-Laplace equations, with applications
analyses.abstract: We consider positive weak solutions of $-Δ_p u=f(u)$, with $f$ positive and locally Lipschitz continuous. In the singular case $1<p<2$, the Harnack-type inequalities, the strong maximum principle for the linearized operator, the description of the critical set and the strong comparison principle established by Damascelli and Sciunzi [Calc.\ Var.\ Partial Differential Equations \textbf{25} (2006), 139--159] have been available, for more than twenty years, only under the restriction $\frac{2N+2}{N+2}<p<2$, a range that shrinks to the empty set as $N\to\infty$. We remove the dependence on the dimension and prove all of these results for $\frac32<p<2$. Since the strong comparison principle is used as a black box throughout the qualitative theory of $p$-Laplace equations, the improvement propagates. We show in particular that the assumption $\frac{2N+2}{N+2}<p<2$ may be replaced by $\frac32<p<2$ in the resolution of Gibbons' conjecture for $-Δ_pu=f(u)$ by Esposito, Farina, Montoro and Sciunzi [Math.\ Ann.\ \textbf{382} (2022), 943--974] and in their monotonicity theorem in half-spaces for changing-sign nonlinearities [Calc.\ Var.\ Partial Differential Equations \textbf{61} (2022), art.\ 154]; further applications are given in the body of the paper.
analyses.workSummary: 本文把正解 $-\Delta _pu=f(u)$ 的奇异区间 1<p<2 的强比较理论从依赖维数的 p>(2N+2)/(N+2) 推进到维数无关的 p>3/2。核心是对负梯度幂建立统一 Morrey 估计：对任意临界集中心$，∫|Du|^{-\sigma }\le Cr^{N-2+\kappa }，\kappa >0$；该估计通过加权 Caccioppoli 和临界集分支分析得到，再与 Adams 型 trace/Sobolev 不等式结合，在权测度中运行 Moser 迭代，获得线性化算子的弱 Harnack、强最大原理和强比较原理。作者还给出临界集结构、Gibbons 猜想等应用，并用平面临界集的径向/平面模型说明 3/2 是该加权线性化框架的真实阈值。

analyses.limitations: 主结果针对正解、f>0 且局部 Lipschitz 的标量 p-Laplace 方程，并在奇异情形使用 p>3/2；作者明确未解决 $1<p\le 3/2$ 的强比较问题。该阈值对其 $H^{1,2}_\rho $ 加权线性化方法是最优障碍，不能据此断言 PDE 本身在低 p 区间失败。

analyses.title: Existence and strong-field asymptotics of skyrmions in a fourth-order model of frustrated ferromagnets
analyses.abstract: We study a fourth-order variational model for two-dimensional frustrated ferromagnets with competing exchange interactions and an applied magnetic field of strength $H>0$. For every $H>1/4$, we prove that the energy admits minimizers in the topological classes $Q=\pm1$ and that every minimizing sequence is precompact in $H^2$ modulo translations. The main difficulty is that spectral coercivity degenerates as $H\downarrow1/4$. Using a Helmholtz circle-mean identity, we prove that the residual energy of every nonzero-degree configuration has a uniform positive lower bound, even at the degenerate endpoint. Together with a sphere-valued $H^2$-splitting construction, this provides a threshold-stable binding inequality and yields compactness throughout the coercive regime. We also identify $H=1/4$ as the sharp spectral threshold. Below it the energy is unbounded from below, whereas at the threshold nonzero-degree configurations retain a positive energy barrier and degree-zero Weyl sequences lose compactness. Finally, in the strong-field regime, rescaled minimizers approach those minimizers of the limiting functional that maximize the Dirichlet energy, while topological-charge and normalized-energy measures concentrate on the $H^{-1/4}$-scale.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究二维受挫铁磁体四阶变分模型在磁场 H>0 下的 skyrmion。把空间尺度重标度为 $\epsilon =H^{-1/2}$ 后，作者在拓扑度 $Q=\pm 1$ 类中用残差分解、Helmholtz 圆均值恒等式和球值 $H^2$ 截断证明每个 H>1/4 都存在极小器，且极小序列除平移外强 $H^2$ 紧。残差项给出非零度的阈值稳定正能垒，从而排除二分；在 $H=1/4$ 识别 degree-zero Weyl 序列导致的失紧性，在强场极限则通过 $\epsilon \to 0$ 的 $\Gamma $ 型比较、Pohozaev 平衡和缩放得到极小器剖面与拓扑能量集中。

analyses.title: Global asymptotic stability of KdV-Burgers fronts in a weakly two-dimensional model
analyses.abstract: We study front-type solutions of nonlinear dispersive-dissipative PDEs modeling the propagation of undular bores in a channel in two dimensions. The system extends the Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers (KdVB) equation by incorporating weak transverse motion, and admits the KdVB fronts as one-dimensional solutions. We investigate their stability under general two-dimensional perturbations. We prove that a one-dimensional front is a global asymptotic attractor in the weakly two-dimensional setting when the channel is sufficiently narrow in the transverse direction and the relative dispersion parameter lies in a range for stability to one-dimensional perturbations. Particularly, the front is unique up to spatial translations. The proof extends the energy method for temporally-modulated perturbed solutions, developed previously in the one-dimensional setting, to accommodate the transverse dynamics.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究弱二维 KdV–Burgers 条带系统中一维前沿在任意二维扰动下的全局渐近稳定性。作者以时间调制的 front 位置 x0(t) 分解 $u=\phi (x-x0(t))+w$，并将横向变量 v 一并纳入 L2 能量；调制方程消除平移零模，谱假设和足够窄的条带使线性化算子正半定。能量耗散先给出梯度耗散可积，再通过梯度微分不等式排除反复 excursions，最后用 Poincare/Gagliardo–Nirenberg 型不等式和 Sobolev 插值将梯度衰减转成 Lp 前沿扰动衰减，并在更强 x 权重下得到代数速率。

analyses.title: Modified scattering for semiclassical Bose-Fermi mixtures
analyses.abstract: The Vlasov-Hartree system models a mixture of bosons and fermions interacting via Coulomb forces in which the bosons are described quantum-mechanically, while the fermions are described classically. For small initial data, we prove that the system exhibits modified scattering, i.e. the bosonic and fermionic subsystems each converge to solutions of the free Schrödinger and Vlasov equations respectively, but with coupled logarithmic corrections owing to the long-range nature of Coulomb interactions. We use a mixed Lagrangian and Fourier-based approach to derive explicit descriptions of the asymptotic dynamics of the solution and associated fields and Lagrangian trajectories. Notably, due to our purely Lagrangian analysis on the Vlasov side, we require no derivatives on the initial fermion density, the asymptotic fermionic profile is as regular as the initial data, and convergence occurs in almost the same space as the initial data.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究三维 Coulomb Vlasov–Hartree 混合系统的小初值长期动力学，其中 boson 由 Schrödinger 方程描述、fermion 由 Vlasov 输运描述。作者先以 Galilean 向量场和 Fraunhofer 公式控制 Hartree 波函数的 $t^{-3/2}$ 衰减，提取 Fourier profile 的 $t^{-1}$ 长程相位并证明耦合电场和密度衰减；在 fermion 侧使用纯 Lagrangian 特征流，不对初始密度要求导数，分析速度和空间轨迹的对数修正。两侧耦合后得到 boson 的 logarithmic phase、fermion 的 modified free flow、渐近流映射和 profile，且在更高初始正则性下给出显式收敛速率。

analyses.title: Logarithmic capacity and torsion in planar shape optimization
analyses.abstract: We study a family of functionals involving a product of logarithmic capacity and torsional rigidity. Using several geometric inequalities, we identify the discs as the only maximizers among planar convex sets for certain values of the parameters. Finally, we prove regularity of maximizers in the non-critical case. This is done by establishing a shape-differentiability theorem for the logarithmic capacity in the class of planar convex bodies.
analyses.workSummary: 本文在二维有界开凸集上研究结合扭转量 T、对数容量 Cap、面积和周长的泛函 $H_\alpha (\Omega )=T(\Omega )^{1/2}Cap(\Omega )/(|\Omega |^\alpha P(\Omega )^{3-2\alpha })$。正文先用 Saint-Venant、Makai 以及容量不等式控制归一化族的直径和退化，再在临界指数 $\alpha =3/2$ 下证明极大器存在；随后把尺度参数 $p=P(\Omega )/(2\pi )$ 代入容量比估计，得到圆盘在 $\alpha \le 9/8$ 时的唯一性。最后通过凸集的 Lipschitz 变形、平衡测度和对数势能的一阶变分，把极大性写成边界积分方程，并以两次正则性 bootstrap 得到极大凸集边界 $C^{1,1}$。
techniques: 扭转量与对数容量的尺度归一化
Saint-Venant/Makai 几何不等式
凸集的 Blaschke 紧性与下半连续性
平衡测度的变形与对数势能一阶变分
边界积分方程和 $C^{1,1}$ bootstrap
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把对数容量在一般 $W^{1,\infty }$ 凸变形下的 $C^1$ 变分公式与抽象边界正则性框架接起来：平衡测度给出的非局部导数先产生初始 Hölder 正则性，随后同一个积分方程可再次提升到有界密度，从而不需逐段 cap-cut 构造就得到全部极大器的 $C^{1,1}$ 边界；同时用显式的周长比估计把圆盘唯一性推进到 $\alpha \le 9/8$。
analyses.limitations: 论证始终限于平面有界开凸集，使用对数容量的二维势论结构，不能直接覆盖非凸集或高维 Newton 容量。圆盘唯一性只由正文给出的估计保证到 $\alpha \le 9/8（$作者指出可优化至约 1.152），并未解决整个 $\alpha <3/2$ 区间$；C^{1,1}$ 结论针对已存在的凸极大器，数值实验只用于辅助判断而不是唯一性证明。

steps.claim: 临界泛函 $H_{3/2}$ 在非空有界开凸集类中存在极大器。
steps.route: 先把面积归一为 $\pi $；扭转量、周长和容量不等式分别排除直径趋于无穷及细长退化，因而归一化极大序列保持在统一有界的凸集族内。对该序列取 Hausdorff/Blaschke 收敛，利用扭转量与容量的相应连续或上半连续性质，把极限的比值传回并达到上确界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第3–9页，Proposition 2.1–2.4、Proposition 3.1 以及 Theorem 3.3。

steps.claim: 存在 $\alpha *=9/8$，使 $\alpha \le \alpha *$ 时圆盘是平移和缩放意义下的唯一极大器。
steps.route: 在面积归一后令 $p=P(\Omega )/(2\pi )$，把 $H_\alpha (\Omega )/H_\alpha (D)$ 分解成 $H_{3/2}$ 的比值乘 $p^{-(3-2\alpha )}。Proposition$ 3.1 给出的关于 p 的上界与等周、扭转和容量等式条件共同迫使 $p=1$；等式情形再由凸几何等式刻画为圆盘。
steps.evidence: PDF 第8–10页，Theorem 4.1、Proposition 4.2、Theorem 4.3 及公式(4.2)–(4.3)。

steps.claim: 对任意足够小的 $W^{1,\infty }$ 变形 h，对数势能 $I(h)=I(\Phi _h(E))$ 可作 $C^1$ 变分，导数由平衡测度给出。
steps.route: 把变形后的能量通过 $\Phi _h$ 拉回固定集合 E，得到随 h 变化的核 $K_h$；平衡测度的极小性控制奇异核的双重积分，差分商在均匀可积意义下收敛。对方向 q 取极限后，核的距离差分产生 $(\Phi _h(x)-\Phi _h(y))\cdot (q(x)-q(y))$ / $|\Phi _h(x)-\Phi _h(y)|^{2}$，从而得到明确的一阶公式。
steps.evidence: PDF 第10–12页，Section 5.2 的 Proposition 5.2、公式(5.1)及其前后的平衡测度定义。

steps.claim: 每个 $\alpha <3/2$ 的凸极大器具有 $C^{1,1}$ 边界。
steps.route: 极大性的一阶条件把周长、扭转和容量导数合并为边界参数上的积分方程；Theorem 5.8 先把该方程的右端带来的可积性提升为 $W^{2,p}$，得到 $C^{1,\beta }$ 边界。此时平衡测度密度变为有界，重新把 p 提升到无穷并回代同一方程，最终得到 $C^{1,1}$。
steps.evidence: PDF 第10页 Theorem 5.1；PDF 第16–18页证明中的公式(5.26)、Step 3–4、Theorem 5.8 和 Remark 5.9。

analyses.title: Carleman Estimates for Wave Equations on the Half-Line: AI-Assisted Weights and Applications
analyses.abstract: We develop an AI-assisted search-and-certification workflow for constructing Carleman weights for wave equations on semi-infinite domains. Starting from a weighted cross-term identity used to derive the Carleman estimate, we derive explicit analytical screening conditions and use an AI system to propose symbolic candidate weights subject to those conditions. The search identifies a logarithmic weight structure with concrete parameter values; the subsequent human verification by the authors then retains this structure, derives the admissible parameter range, and rigorously certifies the selected weight by verifying the required quantitative conditions. Based on the identified and certified Carleman weight, the subsequent proofs, analysis, and applications are carried out entirely by the authors: we establish a global Carleman estimate for the wave operator on the half-line and derive a weighted conditional lateral Cauchy stability result. The proposed weight is further used in a finite-depth one-sided reconstruction problem for semilinear wave equations on the half-line, where the initial-time flux induces an endpoint graph stabilizer and a contractive frozen nonlinear reconstruction map. Numerical experiments support the predicted contraction behavior and show improved robustness to noisy data from the Carleman weighting, with the induced endpoint graph term providing further stabilization at higher noise levels.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究半轴上一维常速波方程的 Carleman 权函数、侧向 Cauchy 稳定性以及有限深度逆问题。作者先从加权交叉项恒等式推出对对数型 $\psi $ 的显式筛选条件，固定 $\lambda 、\beta $ 的可行区间后证明全局加权估计，再用时间 cutoff 把有限矩形估计传到半轴并得到条件稳定性。有限深度部分把非线性项冻结成图映射 $\Phi _s$，在带初值和边界迹的仿射空间上构造正则化二次泛函；Lax–Milgram 给出唯一极小元，Carleman coercivity 将 $\Phi _s$ 变成压缩映射。带噪版本沿用相同差分估计，并以数值实验检查收缩和噪声鲁棒性。
techniques: 对数型 Carleman 权与共轭波算子
半轴极限与时间 cutoff 的边界项控制
加权条件 Cauchy 稳定性
Lax–Milgram 正则化极小化
图映射压缩与带噪稳定性
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把 AI 仅用于提出候选符号权函数的搜索阶段，随后由作者把筛选条件化为可验证的 $\lambda 、\beta $ 参数区间，并完成半轴全局 Carleman 估计；这一估计进一步给出有限深度图映射的严格压缩因子，使逆问题算法的迭代收敛由解析不等式而非搜索输出保证。
analyses.limitations: 模型是半轴上的一维常速波方程，参数必须满足 $-1/3<\lambda <0$ 及正文给出的 $\beta $ 上界，稳定性是带权且条件性的。有限深度逆问题需要相容的边界、初值和噪声迹，并依赖大负 s 的局部压缩；数值部分不能替代解析收敛证明。AI 只提出候选 ansatz 或润色文字，证明、认证、算法和实验均由作者完成，结论未扩展到变速或高维波算子。

steps.claim: 对满足参数范围的对数权，半轴矩形 $Q_{R_0}$ 上成立与 $R_0$ 无关的全局 Carleman 估计。
steps.route: 将波算子作用于 $e^{s\phi }v$ 后展开时间和空间导数交叉项；参数条件使主二次型中的 $|v_t|^{2}、|v_x|^{2}$ 和 $|v|^{2}$ 系数保持正，边界通量只留下 $x=0$ 的可观测项。对 $Q_{R_0}$ 积分并吸收低阶项，常数不依赖截断半径。
steps.evidence: PDF 第7–11页，Section 3.3–3.5、Lemma 3.2、Theorem 3.1，尤其公式(3.13)–(3.22)。

steps.claim: 时间区间 I 上的半轴解满足带权条件 lateral Cauchy 稳定性。
steps.route: 给解乘以在 $I^*$ 内支撑、在 I 上恒等于一的 cutoff $\eta $；其导数产生的换算项集中在 $I^*\I$，可由全局估计右端的加权残差吸收。令 $R_0$ 趋于无穷并使用全局有限能量正则性，得到只含 $x=0$ 迹、方程残差和 cutoff 误差的半轴估计。
steps.evidence: PDF 第11–14页，Corollary 3.2 与 Section 4 的 Theorem 4.1、公式(4.1)–(4.3)。

steps.claim: 有限深度图映射 $\Phi _s$ 在正则化范数下是压缩映射，因而存在唯一固定点。
steps.route: 在满足边界和初始迹的仿射空间上最小化带权残差加 $\epsilon ||v||^{2}$ 与初始迹惩罚的二次泛函；Lax–Milgram 先给出唯一极小元。比较 $\Phi _s(U)、\Phi _s(V)$ 的 Euler 方程，差值属于齐次迹空间，Carleman coercivity 与非线性 Lipschitz 控制使其范数不超过 $\theta <1$ 倍的输入差。
steps.evidence: PDF 第14–17页，Section 5.1–5.2、公式(5.13)、(5.19)及 Theorem 5.2。

steps.claim: 相容的带噪数据下，正则化迭代仍给出噪声依赖的稳定估计。
steps.route: 将精确仿射类替换为带噪数据的 $A^\delta $，两个候选解的差仍满足相同齐次边界关系，故 Theorem 5.2 的压缩证明不变。把噪声残差和正则项分别用 lifted-noise 假设及加权最小化控制，再对固定点误差求和，得到 Theorem 5.3 的稳定界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第17–20页，Section 5.3、Theorem 5.3 及公式(5.26)–(5.27)；PDF 第20–22页 Section 6 的数值检验。

analyses.title: Generalized Whiting transform and Flux Estimates for Wave Equations in Subextremal Kerr
analyses.abstract: All recent advances \cite{DRS}, \cite{S-Rita1}, \cite{S-Rita2}, \cite{Millet}, \cite{MaS}, \cite{MaS2} on the boundedness and decay for wave equations on subextremal Kerr spacetimes $\KK(a,m)$, with non-small angular rotation, rely in an essential way on Whiting's groundbreaking discovery of a powerful integro-differential transformation with the help of which he ruled out exponentially growing modes in \cite{W} (see also \cite{Yacov}, \cite{AMPW} and \cite{Rita} for further developments). We give a purely \textit{physical space}, generalized version, of the transformation which takes general solutions of {spin-$\sk$} wave equations in $\KK=\KK(a,m)$ to solutions of a secondary wave equation on a new metric manifold $\KKt=\KKt(a,m)$ with two stationary, asymptotically flat, ends. Moreover, for a certain subdomain $\DDt\subset\DDt_-$, which can be identified as the exterior of a black hole region, the new metric $\gt$ of $\KKt(a, m)$ is Lorentzian and the time translation $\T $ is timelike. Using the geometric properties of the two ends one can then deduce, by classical asymptotic Fourier analysis techniques, the desired bound for the flux of $ψ$ at the future event horizon. This estimate played a crucial role in our companion paper \cite{He-K1}.
analyses.workSummary: 本文在次极端 Kerr 时空 |a|<m 上构造物理空间的 generalized Whiting transform，并用它证明无穷远能量如何控制事件视界通量。作者先对带时间 cutoff 的自旋 s 波解施加积分变换，得到带两个渐近端的新流形和变换后的波算子；随后分析变换度量的 Lorentz 性、T 向量场的类时区域以及 X<−2 与 X>0 两条分支。负分支用 T 能量和共形能量控制非超辐射及有界超辐射频率，正分支用加权共形估计与局部椭圆估计控制大超辐射频率，最后把互补频段合成为纯物理空间的 horizon-flux estimate，并说明可推广到非零自旋方程。
techniques: 物理空间 generalized Whiting 积分变换
双渐近端变换流形的度量几何分析
时间 cutoff 与变换源项控制
T/共形能量和局部椭圆估计
互补频段拼接的事件视界通量估计
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把原 Kerr 解的事件视界通量转译成变换几何两个渐近端的辐射通量：X<−2 和 X>0 两个分支分别承担不同频率区间，最终无需在主定理中保留频率分解就得到物理空间的全通量估计，并为 Teukolsky 型高自旋方程保留相同的变换结构。
analyses.limitations: 结论限于次极端 Kerr（|a|<m）、满足 acceptable 条件且经过合适时间 cutoff 的解，并以 Morawetz、能量和源项范数表达通量，不能单独替代完整衰减定理。变换流形含有改变 Lorentz 特征的区域和 r-Hilbert 变换源项，作者只建立一侧的 mirror correspondence；高自旋部分主要说明算子结构和能量估计如何延伸，未在全文重新展开所有自旋分量的细节。

steps.claim: 广义 Whiting 变换把 cutoff 后的 Kerr 波解送到两端变换流形上的次级波方程，并在指定区域保持 Lorentz 结构和 T 类时性。
steps.route: 先用改造时间函数局部化解，使径向积分定义收敛；再把径向核与角变量卷积写成 W，并验证原算子与变换算子的 intertwining 关系。计算新度量的系数和其 X 分支的符号，得到 X<−2、X>0 两个可用渐近端及 T 的类时区域。
steps.evidence: PDF 第8–10页 Section 1.2；PDF 第19–33页 Section 3、Proposition 3.6、3.10、3.11 和 3.15。

steps.claim: 变换方程产生的源项可以通过变换场的积分双线性恒等式转回原 Kerr 的能量/Morawetz 范数。
steps.route: 对变换后的场及其 T、Z 导数做积分分部，利用变换算子的对称性整理出双线性恒等式；时间 cutoff 的误差进入右端，r-Hilbert 项作为已识别的非局部项保留。随后将 $W[|q|^{2}N]$ 的 $L^{2}$ 量用原解的源项、能量和局部衰减范数估计。
steps.evidence: PDF 第34–38页 Section 3.4、Proposition 3.20 及其后的源项讨论；PDF 第55–58页 Proposition 6.2 的变换源项界。

steps.claim: X<−2 分支的辐射通量控制非超辐射及有界超辐射频率的原视界通量。
steps.route: 先用变换流形上的 T-energy identity 取得正定的基础能量，再用共形乘子补足无穷远的时间/径向权重；对 $\beta _+$ 的有界窗口做频率投影，原视界上的 $T+T^{2}$ $\psi $ 项通过变换辐射场在该端的通量被控制。

steps.claim: X>0 分支控制剩余大超辐射频率，并与负分支合成 Theorem 6.1 的全视界通量估计。
steps.route: 正分支先用加权共形能量把远端场推向可控的衰减权，再用局部椭圆估计恢复缺失的径向导数，从而得到大超辐射窗口的 Proposition 5.5。两个分支覆盖互补频率后，选择足够大的 $r_0$ 吸收局部误差，把频率估计重新写成 cutoff 后的纯物理空间不等式，完成 Theorem 6.1。
steps.evidence: PDF 第48–54页 Proposition 5.1、5.3、5.5；PDF 第55–65页 Proposition 6.2、Theorem 6.1 及公式(6.4)。

analyses.title: Short-time existence for the Schouten flow
analyses.abstract: Let $(M^n,g_0)$ be a closed smooth Riemannian manifold, with $n\geqslant 3$. We prove short--time existence and uniqueness for the "critical" {\em Ricci--Bourguignon flow} \begin{equation} \partial_t g=-2\operatorname{Ric}_g+\frac{R_g}{n-1}g\,. \end{equation} Up to a constant rescaling of time, this is the {\em Schouten flow}, since the right--hand side of the equation is $-2(n-2)$ times the Schouten tensor. At the critical parameter, however, the principal symbol of the linearization of the operator that we obtain after the usual "DeTurck modification" still has a zero eigenvalue. We resolve this degeneracy by adjoining an independent scalar unknown $r$, intended to represent the scalar curvature, and considering an "extended" system consisting of a strictly parabolic equation for the metric coupled to a transport--reaction equation for $r$ with a curvature--square forcing. The extended system belongs to the class of nonlinear composite parabolic--hyperbolic systems studied by Vol'pert and Khudyaev~\cite{VolpertKhudyaev1972}. Then, a standard compact--manifold adaptation of their theorem yields a unique smooth solution of the extended system. Finally, the difference $R_g-r$ satisfies a homogeneous linear parabolic equation, so the scalar--curvature constraint "propagates" and the original critical Ricci--Bourguignon flow is recovered. This settles the short--time existence and uniqueness problem at the critical ``Schouten'' value $ρ=1/(2(n-1))$, which was left open by the previous Ricci--Bourguignon theory in~\cite{CatinoEtAl2017}.
analyses.workSummary: 本文解决临界 Ricci–Bourguignon 参数下闭流形 Schouten flow 的短时间存在唯一性。普通 DeTurck 修正仍有一个零特征值，作者因此把标量曲率 r 作为独立未知量，构造度量 g 与 r 耦合的 extended system：度量方程在 DeTurck 坐标下严格抛物，r 方程是输运–反应型并带曲率平方源项。复合抛物–双曲系统的局部理论给出平滑解后，作者对 $z=R_g-r$ 推导齐次线性抛物方程，利用 $z(0)=0$ 证明约束传播。最后通过谐映射热流和反向微分同胚把 DeTurck 解还原到原几何流，并用同一构造证明唯一性。
techniques: 临界参数下的 extended DeTurck system
复合抛物–输运反应方程局部理论
标量曲率变分公式与 Bianchi 恒等式
约束差 $z=R_g-r$ 的最大原理
谐映射热流和时间依赖拉回
analyses.breakthrough: 论文用独立标量曲率变量绕过临界 DeTurck 线性化的零特征值：严格抛物的度量块负责局部正则性，随后 $z=R_g-r$ 的齐次方程把独立变量强制锁回真实标量曲率。这个“先扩展、再传播约束、最后拉回”的链条闭合了临界 Schouten flow 的短时理论。
analyses.limitations: 结论限于闭光滑流形和临界参数，得到的是短时间平滑解；extended system 的局部理论依赖紧致性和文中光滑初值，未讨论带边界、低正则初值或长期奇性。DeTurck 解与原几何流的对应依赖局部谐映射流保持微分同胚。

steps.claim: 加入标量曲率未知量 r 后的 extended DeTurck system 具有适合局部存在的严格抛物度量主部。
steps.route: 用背景连接展开 Ricci 张量与 DeTurck Lie 导数，二阶项合并为 $g^{ij}\nabla _i\nabla _j g$，所有其余项至多含一个背景导数；r 方程只含输运、反应和 $|Ric_g|^{2}$ 源项，因此落入复合抛物–双曲系统的局部理论。
steps.evidence: PDF 第3–5页 Section 2、Lemma 2.1、extended system (2.1) 及 Theorem 2.3。

steps.claim: 若初始 $r(0)=R_{g0}$，则扩展解始终满足 $r=R_g$。
steps.route: 对度量方程使用标量曲率变分公式，把 contracted Bianchi 恒等式代入，得到 $R_g$ 的演化；减去 r 方程后$，z=R_g-r$ 满足无源线性抛物–输运方程，初值 $z=0$。最大原理/唯一性遂给出 z恒为零。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5–6页 Proposition 3.1，标量曲率变分计算及 z 方程。

steps.claim: extended DeTurck 解经时间依赖微分同胚拉回后满足原始临界 Ricci–Bourguignon/Schouten flow。
steps.route: 对任意原方程解运行以张量场 W(g) 为速度的谐映射热流，局部保持微分同胚；其逆映射 $\phi $ 的导数产生 $L_{W(g)}g$ 项。时间依赖拉回公式与 Ricci、标量曲率的自然性抵消 DeTurck 项，得到原几何流。
steps.evidence: PDF 第6–8页 Section 3、公式(3.2)–(3.4)及 Theorem 1.1 的存在性收束。

steps.claim: 原始几何流具有短时间唯一性。
steps.route: 给两条同初值的原流分别构造谐映射热流，拉回到同一个背景后得到相同 extended system；局部唯一性使拉回度量一致，谐映射速度的 ODE 唯一性再使两张映射一致，故原度量一致。对共同存在区间重复构造并用 open–closed 延拓。
steps.evidence: PDF 第7–8页 Theorem 1.1 唯一性证明、谐映射方程(3.2)–(3.3)及 Corollary 3.2。

analyses.title: Strong maximum principle for nonlocal diffusion in measure spaces: new characterization and population dynamics applications
analyses.abstract: We study the existence of nontrivial solutions to nonlocal semilinear diffusion equations of the form \[ a_0(x)u(x)-\int_Ωk(x,y)\big(u(y)-u(x)\big)\,dμ(y)=F(x,u), \quad u\geq 0, \] on a general measure space $(Ω,M,μ)$, where the kernel $k$ is nonnegative and symmetric. In this framework, a major challenge is establishing the strict positivity of solutions. To this end, we provide a novel complete characterization of the strong maximum principle in terms of a connectivity structure induced by the kernel, which leads to a decomposition of the domain into independent components. We also develop the method of sub- and supersolutions in this setting, obtaining existence, uniqueness, and nonexistence results, as well as a regularity result that ensures the continuity of solutions under suitable assumptions. The main interest of working within an abstract measure space lies in its rich applicability, as it unifies and extends a wide variety of frameworks, including discrete, continuous, and hybrid models, or systems interacting across different dimensions. Finally, numerical experiments are presented to illustrate the potential of our theoretical results.
analyses.workSummary: 本文在一般测度空间上研究带对称非局部核的半线性扩散方程。作者先把核的正连接关系闭包成等价类，证明强最大值原理恰好由整个域只有一个等价类刻画；谱部分用自伴非局部算子的主谱值建立最大原理和分块可解性。随后在主谱值条件下构造上下解的单调迭代，获得半线性方程的最小、最大解及唯一性判据，并在连续核和局部紧空间假设下提升解的连续性。最后把框架应用到各等价类上的非局部 logistic 方程，展示不同类可同时存在零解和严格正解。
techniques: 测度空间上的非局部核连接关系与等价类
自伴积分算子的主谱值和 Fredholm 分析
强最大值原理与非局部正性传播
上下解单调迭代法
连续核下的解正则性与 logistic 应用
analyses.breakthrough: 论文给出了强最大值原理的结构性充要条件：不是要求核处处正，而是要求由核的正支撑生成的等价类只有一个且没有残余区域。这个判据随后直接控制上下解迭代的正性，并解释了 logistic 解为何能在多个互不连通的类上独立选择零解或严格正解。
analyses.limitations: 抽象定理依赖有限测度、核的对称性/有界性及文中给定的主谱值和单调性条件；不覆盖非对称核或一般非有界反应项。连续性结论还要求局部紧 Hausdorff 空间、连续系数和连续核。数值例子用于展示等价类分解和迭代行为，不能扩大这些假设下的存在唯一性范围。

steps.claim: 强最大值原理成立当且仅当核正支撑生成的域只有一个等价类且不存在残余区域。
steps.route: 把指标集合中存在正核连接的点对组成无向图，再取有限链生成的等价关系；在每个类内，非负超解若在一处为零，积分算子方程会沿每条正核边把零值传播到整类。若有两个类或残余集合，则在一个部分上取零、另一部分取正即可构造违反严格正性的函数，从而得到必要性。
steps.evidence: PDF 第8–13页，Section 4 的 Definition 4.2、Proposition 4.3、Definition 4.4 及 Corollary 4.9。

steps.claim: 主谱值为正时，线性非局部算子满足最大原理并可在各等价类上独立求解。
steps.route: 用二次型定义主谱值，将方程乘以负部或适当截断后的函数并积分；正谱隙迫使负部范数为零。等价类间核项不耦合，因此限制算子分别可逆，Fredholm alternative 再给出每个类上方程的唯一 $L^{2}$ 解。
steps.evidence: PDF 第4–8页 Theorem 4.1；PDF 第12–14页 Theorem 4.6 及公式(10)、(13)–(14)。

steps.claim: 满足上下解、截断单调性和谱条件的半线性问题存在介于上下解之间的解，并具有最小解与最大解。
steps.route: 先用谱平移把 $\gamma $ 单调性吸收到算子中；从下解和上解开始，分别解线性化的两列方程。线性最大原理保持序关系，使下迭代单调上升、上迭代单调下降$；L^{2}$ 有界性和反应项的可积控制使极限通过积分方程，得到两个极限解夹住所有其他解。
steps.evidence: PDF 第13–17页，Theorem 4.15、公式(19)–(23)及其证明中的两列迭代。

steps.claim: 在各等价类上，非局部 logistic 方程的严格正解存在唯一性由主谱值符号决定，并可在连续核条件下提升为连续解。
steps.route: 将 logistic 反应项代入上下解定理，零点附近的线性斜率与无穷远的负增长分别提供下解和上界；若 $\lambda _p(L-\lambda I)<0$，正迭代不退化并给出严格正解，比较两个正解对应的线性化算子则排除差异。连续核使积分项在局部一致控制下连续，最后把 $L^{2}$ 解提升到 $C^{0}$。
steps.evidence: PDF 第18–21页 Theorem 5.1、5.3、5.4；PDF 第21–24页 Theorem 5.5–5.6 及 logistic 示例。

analyses.title: Geometric regularity for semi-convex viscosity solutions to the special Lagrangian equation
analyses.abstract: We prove that the gradient graph of any $W^{2,1}$ semi-convex viscosity solution to the three-dimensional subcritical special Lagrangian equation is area-minimizing and smooth. Furthermore, we prove the smoothness of $W^{2,1}\cap C^{1,1/3+}$ semi-convex viscosity solutions. This yields progress on the conjecture proposed by Wang--Yuan [WY13]. The corresponding results in higher dimensions are also established.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究三维及高维次临界 special Lagrangian 方程的半凸粘性解。作者用 Lewy–Yuan 旋转和 Legendre 变换把半凸梯度图转换到具有有界 Hessian 的旋转势函数，再借助 Hessian measure 的弱连续性和对偶公式控制原势函数 Hessian 的退化集合。由此证明 $W^{2,1}$ 情形下梯度图面积极小；半凸性和相位区间排除多个最大 Hessian 特征值的正测度集合。正则性部分对旋转势做 blow-up、均匀椭圆估计和极小图锥刚性，得到旋转势光滑，再用 $\alpha >1/3$ 的 Legendre 反演非退化引理把光滑性传回原解。
techniques: Lewy–Yuan 梯度图旋转
Legendre 变换与 Hessian measure 对偶性
退化集合上的秩和面积公式
极小 Lagrangian 图的 calibration
blow-up、均匀椭圆估计与反演正则性
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把低正则度 $W^{2,1}$ 与半凸粘性结构结合起来：Hessian measure 对偶性把旋转坐标中退化 Hessian 的秩限制转化为原坐标中的不可行情形，从而先得到面积极小性，再在三维和相应高维相位区间内获得光滑性。这推进了 Wang–Yuan 猜想中半凸解的正则性范围。
analyses.limitations: 三维主结论需要次临界相位、半凸性和 $W^{2,1}$；高维结果要求 $W^{2,k}$ 及更强的相位相关半凸性，且一般维度的 Hessian 有界条件只在 Theorem 1.6 中显式给出$。\alpha >1/3$ 是 Legendre 反演步骤的阈值，论文不声称覆盖任意半凸粘性解或临界/超临界相位。

steps.claim: Lewy–Yuan 旋转后的势函数具有可用的凸性、相位和 Hessian measure 对偶结构。
steps.route: 把半凸势加上二次项变为凸函数，再按固定角度旋转梯度图；在新坐标中用 Legendre 变换交换原变量和梯度变量。Hessian measure 的 Steiner 公式和弱连续性把 $W^{2,k}$ 的信息传递到旋转势的 $\sigma _k(D^{2}u)$ 测度。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5–9页 Section 2.1–2.2、Proposition 2.1–2.2 及公式(2.1)–(2.2)。

steps.claim: 三维 $W^{2,1}$ 半凸粘性解的梯度图是面积极小的 Lagrangian 子流形。
steps.route: 假设旋转势的 Hessian 在正测度集合上出现允许的退化；Hessian measure 对偶公式先迫使相应秩层集合像集测度为零，再由粘性方程的相位不等式得到至少两个最大特征值与次临界相位矛盾。退化集合因而为零，旋转解成为 $C^{1,1}$ 强解，最后用 special Lagrangian calibration 得到面积极小性。
steps.evidence: PDF 第9–11页 Section 3、Lemma 3.2、Theorem 1.4 的证明及公式(3.1)–(3.2)。

steps.claim: 在相应维数和 Hessian 有界条件下，旋转后的 $C^{1,1}$ 粘性解是光滑的。
steps.route: 以任意点为中心做二次尺度 blow-up，利用 $C^{1,1}$ 界取得局部收敛；均匀椭圆 $W^{2,\delta }$ 估计把 Hessian 差收敛提升到任意有限 $L^p$。极小图的单调性公式使极限梯度图成为锥，而三、四维的刚性（或高维给定 Hessian 界）将该锥化为二次多项式，反向推出原势的光滑性。
steps.evidence: PDF 第11–12页 Section 4.1、Proposition 4.1 的 blow-up 证明及其 $W^{2,\delta }$ 估计。

steps.claim: 若原势属于 $C^{1,\alpha }$ 且 $\alpha >1/3$，旋转势的光滑性可通过 Legendre 变换传回原势。
steps.route: 假设旋转势 Hessian 在一点退化，则沿零特征方向其梯度增量由 Taylor 展开为 $O(t^{3})$；原梯度的 $C^\alpha $ 逆映射又给出 $|t|\le C|t|^{3\alpha }$，当 $3\alpha >1$ 时矛盾。因此 Hessian 非退化，逆函数定理使梯度映射局部光滑，原势随之光滑。
steps.evidence: PDF 第12–13页 Section 4.2、Lemma 4.2 及“Proof of the remaining part of Theorem 1.4 and Theorem 1.6”。

analyses.title: Construction of three-solitons with logarithmic distance for the mass-critical gKdV equations
analyses.abstract: For the mass-critical generalized Korteweg-de Vries equation, \begin{equation*} \partial_{t}u+\partial_{x}\left( \partial_{x}^{2}u+u^{5}\right)=0,\quad (t,x)\in [0,\infty)\times \mathbb{R}, \end{equation*} we prove the existence of three-soliton solutions with logarithmic relative distance and with the choice of signs $(+,-,-)$. The choice of the number three and the signs of solitons are related to the solvability of the ODE system generated by the nonlinear interactions between the three solitons and some non-localized profiles. In particular, these special behaviors are due to strong interactions between the three solitons. That is, the dynamics of each soliton is perturbed at leading order by the presence of other solitons.
analyses.workSummary: 本文构造质量临界广义 KdV 方程的一组三孤子全局解，其相对距离按对数增长且符号为 (1,−1,−1)。作者先把三个孤子的相互作用投影到平移、尺度和速度模态，得到带 $e^{-r_k}$ 耦合的有限维 ODE；该符号组合使 ODE 具有显式的对数间距渐近。随后在移动坐标中取三孤子近似 S(t) 加误差 $\epsilon $，施加正交条件并建立带空间权的局部能量；线性化算子的 coercivity、非线性残差估计和 ODE 单调性共同闭合向后 bootstrap。最后对截断时间解作 $H^1$ 弱紧性极限，借助 gKdV 流的弱连续性获得定义于 $[T_0,\infty )$ 的真实三孤子。
techniques: 孤子参数调制与相互作用 ODE
移动框架中的近似三孤子构造
线性化 gKdV 的正交 coercivity
带权单调能量和非线性残差估计
$H^1$ 弱紧性与全局极限构造
analyses.breakthrough: 论文给出了质量临界 gKdV 在强相互作用区间的首个三孤子例子：三个孤子并非保持固定间隔，而是以对数距离分离，并由唯一可显式求解的符号组合 (1,−1,−1) 支持。证明把精确的有限维耦合 ODE 与无限维误差能量锁定在同一 bootstrap 中，最终得到真正的全局解而非仅有形式渐近。
analyses.limitations: 构造针对质量临界 gKdV、三个孤子和符号 (1,−1,−1)，ODE 分析表明其他符号一般没有当前方法所需的显式结构。误差控制依赖大时间 $T_0$、特定正交条件、指数局部化和 $H^1$ 弱连续性，不能直接推出任意多孤子或其他色散方程的同类结论。

steps.claim: 符号 (1,−1,−1) 的三孤子调制参数满足产生对数相对距离的显式相互作用 ODE。
steps.route: 把相邻孤子尾部的指数重叠投影到各个 $Q_k、\Lambda Q_k$ 和平移模态，得到系数含 $e^{-r_k}$ 的参数方程；选定符号后相邻距离的差分方程可积分，给出 $r_1\approx 15 log$ $t、r_2\approx 12 log t$ 及相应速度、尺度修正。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–5页 Theorem 1.1、公式(1.7)–(1.8)与 Subsection 1.5；PDF 第43–45页 Appendix A 的符号 ODE 分析。

steps.claim: 存在在有限时间区间上逼近三孤子轨道的解，并满足统一的参数与误差估计。
steps.route: 在移动坐标中令 $w(t,y)=u(t,y+t)$，将近似 S 的参数误差分解投影到三个孤子模态；用正交条件消除不可控的核方向。线性化算子的局部 coercivity 控制 $\epsilon $ 的 $H^1$ 加权范数，参数方程则控制 $x_k、\nu _k、b_k$ 与理想 ODE 的偏差。
steps.evidence: PDF 第14–18页 Section 3；PDF 第25–33页 Proposition 4.1、正交条件(3.25)及局部 coercivity 估计。

steps.claim: 带权能量和相互作用残差估计能够闭合 Proposition 4.1 的向后 bootstrap。

analyses.title: The $\mathrm{L}^1$-Stokes Semigroup
analyses.abstract: We study the Stokes operator with no-slip boundary conditions on the spaces $\mathrm{L}_{σ,n}(Ω)$ and ${\mathrm{L}^1(Ω,\mathbb{C}^d)}/{\nabla \mathrm{W}^{1,1}(Ω,\mathbb{C})}$, where $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ is an arbitrary bounded $\mathrm{C}^{1,α}$-domain. We show that the Stokes operator on $\mathrm{L}^1_{σ,n}(Ω)$ does not generate a $\mathrm{C}_0$-semigroup, even though the resolvent problem is uniquely solvable. In stark contrast, its realization on ${\mathrm{L}^1(Ω,\mathbb{C}^d)}/{\nabla \mathrm{W}^{1,1}(Ω,\mathbb{C})}$ generates a compact, analytic $\mathrm{C}_0$-semigroup, which leaves $\mathrm{L}^1_{σ,n}(Ω)$ invariant. The key point is that these two realizations, which are canonically identified for $1<p<\infty$ through the Helmholtz decomposition, cease to be equivalent at the endpoint $p=1$. This leads to genuinely different functional analytic properties. Our result provides the first positive generation theorem for the Stokes operator with no-slip boundary conditions in a pure $\mathrm{L}^1$-setting on a bounded domain and settles a problem that had remained open for nearly fifty years; see, e.g., \cite{Koz:01,DHP:01}. In this sense, it completes the theory of the Stokes semigroup across the full scale of solenoidal Lebesgue spaces on (smooth) bounded domains. As an intermediate step, some results on the space of Radon measures are obtained. The proof combines the sun-dual construction with a precise analysis of the failure of the Helmholtz decomposition in $\mathrm{L}^1$, the celebrated result of Abe and Giga \cite{AG:12} on the Stokes semigroup on $\mathrm{C}_{σ,0}(Ω)$ and the regularity theory refinements for the Stokes operator recently developed by Breit and the second author \cite{BG:25}.
analyses.workSummary: 本文分析有界 $C^{1,\alpha }$ 域上无滑移 Stokes 算子在端点 $L^1$ 的两个实现。对无散向量场空间 $L^1_{\sigma ,n}(\Omega )$，作者证明算子闭、稠密定义、可逆且谱为正，但负算子不生成 $C_0$ 半群；对商空间 $L^1(\Omega ;C^d)/\nabla W^{1,1}(\Omega )$，则通过 $C_{\sigma ,0}$ 的 sun-dual 构造得到有界、紧且解析的 $C_0$ 半群，并证明其保持嵌入的无散子空间。核心差异来自 $L^1$ 中 Helmholtz 分解失效：商实现可由对偶半群控制，而向量场实现会在缩放到半空间后违反已知 resolvent 障碍。
techniques: 端点 $L^1$ 的 Stokes resolvent 正则性
Helmholtz 分解失效与梯度商空间
sun-dual 半群与 Radon 测度对偶
紧解析半群的嵌入不变性
边界局部缩放和半空间 resolvent 反证
analyses.breakthrough: 论文首次在有界域的纯 $L^1$ 框架中同时厘清两个自然 Stokes 实现的相反行为：无散向量场实现不生成 $C_0$ 半群，而梯度商实现生成紧解析 $C_0$ 半群。这个端点分裂说明 $p=1$ 时把商空间与无散场“规范识别”会丢失半群性质，而 sun-dual 正好提供了可工作的替代空间。
analyses.limitations: 结果限于有界 $C^{1,\alpha }$ 域和无滑移边界条件；商空间半群的 $L^1$ 具体刻画依赖有界域的紧性，作者明确指出不能无缝推广到无界域。非生成结论针对 $C_0$ 半群，不等同于所有弱拓扑或更细商空间拓扑下都不存在演化。

steps.claim: 无散 $L^1$ Stokes 算子 A 稠密定义、闭且可逆，谱包含于正实轴。
steps.route: 先用域上的 Stokes resolvent 正则性把 $L^1$ 无散数据提升到 $W^{1,1}_0$ 及压力表示，再由 coercive resolvent 估计得到闭性、稠密性和逆算子；与 $L^{2}$ 自伴理论比较，谱隙和正谱位置传递到端点实现。

steps.claim: 梯度商空间上的 Stokes 实现生成有界、紧、解析的 $C_0$ 半群，并嵌入无散 $L^1$ 子空间。
steps.route: 把 $C_{\sigma ,0}(\Omega )$ 的对偶识别为 Radon 测度模梯度 BV，再取其 sun-dual 部分得到 $L^1$ 模梯度 $W^{1,1}$ 的空间。Abe–Giga 半群的紧解析性和 resolvent 紧性传到 sun-dual，闭图定理给出商实现的生成性质；嵌入的密性及已知不变性则保持无散子空间。

steps.claim: $L^1$ 向量场实现不能生成 $C_0$ 半群。
steps.route: 反设 −A 生成 $C_0$ 半群，则 Hille–Yosida 给出 $\lambda R(\lambda ,-A)$ 在 $L^1$ 无散空间上一致有界。把半空间测试场经边界点平移、正交变换和尺度缩放嵌入越来越小的域，利用 $C^{1,\alpha }$ 边界趋于半空间，得到半空间 Stokes resolvent 的同样 $L^1$ 一致界。

steps.claim: 上述半空间 resolvent 界与已知半空间非生成定理矛盾，从而完成端点非生成结论。
steps.route: 对缩放解的压力、无散条件和 $L^1$ 范数逐项变换，令尺度趋于零后得到真正的半空间 resolvent 估计；该估计与 Desch–Hieber–Prüss 的半空间障碍冲突，故初始的 Hille–Yosida 界不可能成立。

analyses.title: Transport and flow for horizontal Sobolev contact velocities in Carnot groups
analyses.abstract: We establish new well-posedness results for transport and flow equations driven by contact vector fields on Carnot groups. The velocity fields are assumed to have horizontal Sobolev regularity, namely Sobolev regularity only along the horizontal directions determined by the stratified geometry of the group. In the broader sub-Riemannian setting, results of this type were previously known only for Heisenberg groups. Our proof relies on the theory of renormalized solutions as originally introduced by DiPerna and Lions in the Euclidean setting.
analyses.workSummary: 本文把 DiPerna–Lions 的输运方程重整化理论推广到 Carnot 群中的水平 Sobolev contact 速度场。作者先在分层 Lie 代数上把左不变向量场换成右不变表达，利用 contact 条件控制高阶换序项；随后用群卷积 mollifier 展开输运方程的 commutator，把误差写成水平差商和由接触结构消失的余项。关键引理证明 commutator 在局部 $L^1$ 中趋于零，因此每个有界分布解都是 renormalized solution。最后结合 renormalization 与散度、增长条件，得到 $L^\theta $ 分布解的存在唯一性，并进一步得到 regular Lagrangian flow 的存在和唯一性。
techniques: Carnot 群分层与左右不变场换算
水平 Sobolev 差商展开
群卷积 mollification commutator
contact 条件下余项消去
renormalization 到 Eulerian/Lagrangian well-posedness
analyses.breakthrough: 论文证明在一般 Carnot 群中，只沿水平方向具有 Sobolev 正则性的 contact 速度场就足以恢复输运方程的 renormalization；接触条件精确补偿了缺失的竖直导数。由此把此前主要在欧氏空间或 Heisenberg 群成立的分布解与流理论推进到完整的分层非交换几何。
analyses.limitations: 速度场需要 contact 结构、水平 Sobolev 可积性、散度的时间积分 $L\infty $ 控制及正文(6.4)中的增长条件；结论针对 Carnot 群和相应 Haar 测度，不能直接用于任意次黎曼流形。commutator 论证依赖有限步长分层结构，未覆盖仅有 BV 水平正则性或缺少接触约束的速度场。

steps.claim: contact 水平速度场可在 Carnot 群坐标中转写为适合差商分析的左右不变系数系统。
steps.route: 利用分层 Lie 代数的括号关系，把左不变水平场表示成右不变场的多项式组合；contact 条件 $[b,V_1]\subset V_1$ 使高层系数只由允许的水平差分递归产生，从而把输运算子的几何换序误差限制在有限阶差商。

steps.claim: 群卷积 mollification 的 commutator $C_\epsilon $ 在局部 $L^1$ 中趋于零。
steps.route: 将 mollified 输运方程中的误差拆为 $C_\epsilon ^1+C_\epsilon ^2$；逐项写成 b 的水平差商乘以 u、测试函数和卷积核。水平 Sobolev 收敛控制主差商，contact 条件让高阶余项在有限步分层递归中抵消，最后用局部截断和 dominated convergence 得到 $C_\epsilon \to 0$。

steps.route: 对方程做群卷积后乘以光滑截断 $\beta '(u_\epsilon )$，利用 commutator 的局部 $L^1$ 收敛让 $\epsilon \to 0$；链式法则在极限中恢复 $\beta (u)$ 的输运方程，并由任意紧支集测试函数得到 renormalized identity。

steps.claim: 在散度和增长条件下，输运方程及其 regular Lagrangian flow 均存在且唯一。
steps.route: 先把 renormalization 与连续性方程的 $L^\theta $ 对偶估计结合，比较两个分布解的差并得到唯一性，再用标准近似构造存在解。将 Eulerian 唯一性应用于由速度场生成的 push-forward 密度，结合压缩性估计，得到流的存在；两个流诱导同一 renormalized 解，故几乎处处唯一。
steps.evidence: PDF 第18–21页 Section 6.3、Theorem 6.6–6.7 及条件(6.4)。

analyses.title: On 2D Scattering for a Critical Nonlinear Schrödinger Flow
analyses.abstract: We study modified scattering for the two-dimensional defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLS) with the gauge-invariant, scattering-critical nonlinearity $|u|u$. We prove that the remodulated interaction representation has a local $L^2$ limit for general data in $Σ=H^1\cap\F^{-1}H^1$. For radial data, we prove convergence in $L^p(\R^2)$ for every $2<p<\infty$.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究二维 defocusing、散射临界非线性 |u|u 的 NLS 在一般 $\Sigma =H^1\cap F^{-1}H^1$ 数据下的 modified scattering，并在径向数据下加强到所有 $2<p<\infty $ 的 $L^p$ 收敛。作者先利用已有的 Fourier-side modified profile 极限，把自由演化 U(−t) 与非线性长程相位 $e^{i\Phi _t(u)}$ 分离；通过 dyadic annulus 分解将 $F^{-1}(\dot$ $B^{-1}_{2,\infty })$ 收敛转换成局部 $L^2$ 和加权 $L^2$ 收敛。径向部分把修正 profile 分解成三个由 $(1-\Delta )^{-1}$ 控制的项，利用径向性保持、二维散射估计和 Strauss–Lions 点态衰减得到远场 $L^p$ 收敛，再以局部 $L^\infty $ 有界性与局部 $L^2$ 收敛插值处理原点。
techniques: 长程相位修正的 interaction representation
Fourier-side homogeneous Besov/dyadic 分解
$(1-\Delta )^{-1}$ resolvent 三项分解
径向 spherical-harmonic 保持
Strauss–Lions 衰减与局部插值
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把大数据二维临界 NLS 的 modified scattering 从局部/加权 $L^2$ 结论推进到径向数据的全局 $L^p$ 收敛：径向性使非线性相位导数项落入可控的 degree-one spherical-harmonic sector，配合 resolvent 分解提供远场衰减，而局部 $L^2$ 结论补足了原点区域。
analyses.limitations: 一般数据结论是局部 $L^2$ 与加权 $L^2$ 收敛，所有 $L^p（2<p<\infty ）$的增强需要径向对称性和额外 $F^{-1}H^1$ 条件。结果针对二维 defocusing 的 |u|u 临界流及已知的全局解，不覆盖非径向大数据的全局 $L^p$ 收敛、聚焦情形或散射算子的逆构造。

steps.claim: 任意满足 $F^{-1}H^1$ 的全局解存在唯一修正散射态 $u_+$，并在局部 $L^2$ 与加权 $L^2$ 中收敛。
steps.route: 调用 Fourier-side interaction representation 的 Besov 极限，令 $g_t=U(-t)e^{i\Phi _t(u)}u(t)-u_+$；对空间 dyadic annulus $A_j$ 分别估计其 $L^{2}$ 质量。低频环的几何面积给局部半径因子，高频环乘 $⟨x⟩^{-s}$ 后形成可求和级数，于是 Besov 极限推出局部和加权 $L^{2}$ 收敛。

steps.claim: 径向解的修正 profile v(t) 可分成三个保持径向/角动量结构的 resolvent 项。
steps.route: 由 $(1-\Delta )^{-1}(1-\Delta )=I$ 把 v 写成 $f_1+f_2+f_3$；相位和解的径向性使 $f_2、f_3$ 保持径向，而相位梯度乘 u 是 degree-one spherical-harmonic 向量场，Appendix C 的谱保持性质再使散度后的 $f_1$ 径向。

steps.claim: 三个分量具有足够的 Sobolev/衰减控制以得到远场 $L^p$ 收敛。
steps.route: 对 $f_1$ 使用二维 dispersive $estimate、(1-\Delta )^{-1}\nabla \cdot $ 的 $L^q\to W^{1,q}$ 有界性和相位梯度的 Hölder 分解，得到 $t^{-1/2+2/q}$ 衰减$；f_2、f_3$ 由酉性和 $H^1$ 守恒获得 $H^1、H^2$ 界。径向 Strauss–Lions 估计把 $W^{1,q}$ 界变成 $|x|^{-1/q}$ 点态衰减，进而控制 |x|>1 的加权 $L^p$ 差。

steps.claim: 径向 modified profile 在每个 $2<p<\infty $ 中收敛到 $u_+$。
steps.route: 远场部分由上一步的点态和加权 Hölder 插值趋于零；原点部分沿用 Theorem 1.1 的局部 $L^{2}$ 收敛，并用 $f_i$ 的局部 $W^{1,q}/L^\infty $ 统一界做 $L^{2}–L^\infty $ 插值。两区域合并得到全空间 $L^p$ 收敛，同时唯一性来自局部 $L^{2}$ 极限。

analyses.title: Stable determination of damping and potential coefficients in a semilinear wave equation
analyses.abstract: We consider an inverse problem for a semilinear wave equation with time-independent damping, linear potential, and nonlinear potential coefficients in a bounded domain of $\mathbb{R}^n$ for $n\geq 2$. The main objective is to establish stability estimates for the simultaneous recovery of these coefficients from the associated Dirichlet-to-Neumann map. Our approach combines second-order linearization with suitably constructed geometric optics and asymptotic solutions. We establish Hölder-type stability estimates for the recovery of each of the three coefficients appearing in the semilinear wave equation under suitable a priori bounds on these coefficients. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first stability result for simultaneous determination of time-independent damping, linear and nonlinear potentials in a semiliner wave equation.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究有界域中带时间无关阻尼、线性势和非线性势的半线性波方程，并从非线性 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 映射同时稳定恢复三个系数。作者先对 DN 映射作一阶和二阶线性化，利用伴随问题得到含系数差的积分恒等式；再构造带大频率参数的 geometric optics 与渐近解，把恒等式化为沿光线的衰减 X-ray/射线变换估计。阻尼差先由加权射线积分恢复，线性势借助已知阻尼估计消去误差后恢复，非线性势则从二阶项和二次能量估计得到。最后用射线变换稳定性和 Sobolev 插值得到三个系数的 Hölder 型 $L\infty $ 稳定性。
techniques: DN 映射的一阶/二阶线性化
伴随波方程积分恒等式
geometric optics 与高频渐近展开
衰减 X-ray/射线变换稳定性
Sobolev 插值提升 $L\infty $ 系数界
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把同一个非线性 DN 映射中的三种系数按线性化阶数分层恢复：阻尼由一阶项的带衰减射线积分确定，线性势在扣除阻尼误差后确定，非线性势由二阶线性化的主振荡项确定。由此获得同时恢复三系数的定量 Hölder 稳定性，而不只是唯一性。

analyses.title: Speed and stability of segregated waves in a pressure-based model of heterogeneous cell populations
analyses.abstract: We consider a minimal pressure-based model of heterogeneous cell populations consisting of proliferative and non-proliferative cells with different mobilities. The model is formulated as a system of reaction--cross--diffusion equations describing the spatio-temporal dynamics of the cell densities. The model is known to admit one-dimensional travelling wave solutions with strictly segregated components: non-proliferative cells occupy a finite region at the leading edge, while proliferative cells remain at the rear. However, the speed, parameter dependence, and stability of these waves remain poorly understood. In this work, we derive an almost explicit variational bound on the wave speed by reformulating the problem as a free-boundary problem for a generalised porous--Fisher equation. The estimates we obtain apply to general pressure laws and growth kinetics, agree closely with the results of numerical simulations, and become sharp in the incompressible limit, where we formally recover a fully explicit characterisation of the wave speed. We then analyse the stability of the waves to show that segregated waves are stable only when non-proliferative cells are more mobile than proliferative cells. Finally, motivated by numerical observations of finger-like protrusions, we investigate the stability of incompressible segregated circular waves through asymptotic shape-perturbation analysis. This yields explicit expressions for the pressure, interface velocity, and growth rates of angular modes, thereby making evident the destabilisation mechanisms that may lead to the emergence of fingering instability. Interestingly, we find that, in contrast with the one-dimensional case, the stability of such circular waves is not determined solely by the relative value of the mobility coefficients, and thus instabilities may arise irrespective of which cell type has the larger mobility.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究压力驱动的异质细胞群模型中严格分离的一维行波和不可压圆形波。作者把两类细胞的反应–交叉扩散系统化为自由边界压力问题，在行波坐标中用单调剖面和 $w(u)=-u'$ 将波速问题化为带移动边界的广义 porous–Fisher 方程；Benguria–Depassier 型试验函数给出一般压力律和增长率下的变分波速上下界。随后在 $\gamma \to \infty $ 的不可压极限中形式求出显式波速和压力/界面速度，并线性化圆形界面，按角向 Fourier 模式计算扰动增长率。数值实验比较波速界和指状不稳定性。

analyses.title: Pathwise Global-in-Time Existence for the generalised KPZ Equation in the Full Subcritical Regime
analyses.abstract: We provide a pathwise proof of global-in-time well-posedness for the generalised KPZ equation in the full subcritical regime by an adaptation of the strategy recently applied to the generalised Parabolic Anderson Model in [ES26]. Since this strategy relies crucially on the assumption that control of the supremum norm is sufficient to continue the solution, the main additional ingredient required is a treatment of the initial layer for gKPZ with merely $L^\infty$ initial data, rather than the more usual setting of $C^θ$ initial data with $θ> 0$. Our approach is based on an expansion around a deterministic profile followed by the introduction of an integrating factor in order to remove the terms which have critical scaling at time $0$. For pedagogical purposes, we first demonstrate the proof techniques in the case of the standard $(1+1)$-dimensional KPZ equation before turning to the more computationally involved case of generalised KPZ.
analyses.workSummary: 本文证明空间周期广义 KPZ 方程在完整次临界范围内的路径级全局存在性和局部 Lipschitz 解映射。作者在正则结构框架中先处理平滑模型，利用对称性和模型重整化定义；对一般 $C^\theta $ 初值，短时固定点理论给出局部解与爆破替代。关键初始层分析把解展开在只含梯度平方的确定性 profile 周围，引入积分因子消除 $t=0$ 附近临界缩放的交叉项，并验证这些变换与重整化兼容。平滑模型上建立 supremum norm 比较原理和不爆破估计，再通过模型逼近把结论传给任意对称模型。

analyses.breakthrough: 论文解决了广义 KPZ 在仅有 $L\infty $ 初值初始层的关键障碍：围绕确定性 profile 的积分因子把本来 $t^{-1}$ 临界的梯度交叉项变为可吸收项，并在逐模型证明后与重整化相容，从而把局部爆破替代提升为全局 $C^\theta $ 控制。
analyses.limitations: 结论针对空间周期、对称重整化模型和满足文中噪声 Hölder/次临界条件的驱动，初值正则性需 $0<\theta <\alpha +2$；全局性依赖 supremum norm 足以继续解的机制，不覆盖非对称模型、非周期域或超临界参数。AI 工具仅用于少量表格/机械计算、文献检索和校对，证明策略和主体证明由作者完成。

analyses.title: Long-time asymptotics of nonlinear Fokker-Planck equations with inhomogeneous diffusion and natural boundary conditions
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the long-time asymptotics for nonlinear Fokker-Planck equations with spatial inhomogeneous diffusion, based on the law of energy dissipation. First, we derive a priori positive lower and upper bounds for solutions of the equations. Next, we give a sufficient condition for deriving the exponential decay of the dissipation function. Finally, we investigate whether the given sufficient condition is essential or not by numerical computation.

analyses.title: Well--posedness for the continuum Calogero--Moser equations by parabolic regularization
analyses.abstract: We prove that the focusing and defocusing continuum Calogero--Moser equations are globally well-posed in $H^s_+(\mathbb R)$ for every integer $s\geq 3$. In the focusing case, this requires the initial data to satisfy the mass condition $$\|q_0\|_{L^2}^2<2π.$$ Our proof is based on a parabolic regularization of the equation, uniform \textit{a--priori} estimates for the regularized solutions, and a Bona--Smith type approximation argument.
analyses.workSummary: 本文用抛物正则化证明连续 Calogero–Moser 方程在 $H^s_+(R)、s\ge 3$ 中的全局适定性。作者先利用 Cauchy–Szegő 投影的尖锐乘积估计建立低阶能量的 coercivity，聚焦情形正好要求质量 $||q_0||^{2}_2<2\pi $。对加入 $-i\epsilon \partial _x^{2}$ 的正则化方程，收缩映射给出光滑局部解；守恒量和投影乘积交换估计依次控制 $L^{2}、Ḣ^{1/2}、H^{2}$ 及更高 $H^s$ 范数，并用 bootstrap 把界延拓到任意有限时间。最后对频率截断初值采用 Bona–Smith 比较，证明 $q_\epsilon $ 在 $C_tH^s$ 中 Cauchy，极限满足原方程；差分能量给出唯一性和连续依赖。
techniques: Cauchy–Szegő 投影尖锐乘积估计
抛物正则化和收缩映射
守恒量驱动的 Sobolev a priori bounds
非局部投影交换/乘积估计
Bona–Smith 频率截断逼近
analyses.breakthrough: 论文给出一条完全基于抛物正则化的 CCM 高正则全局构造：正则化耗散同时提供局部光滑解和可传递的 uniform bounds，尖锐质量阈值控制聚焦能量，Bona–Smith 极限则把这些 bounds 可靠地传到无耗散非局部方程。
analyses.limitations: 聚焦情形必须满足严格质量阈值 $||q_0||^{2}_2<2\pi $，结论针对整数 $s\ge 3$ 的 $H^s_+$ 数据和一维全空间；论文不处理阈值等号、低于三阶正则性或质量超阈值的聚焦解。正则化和极限证明依赖 Cauchy–Szegő 投影结构，不能直接迁移到一般非局部非线性。

steps.claim: 低阶 CCM 能量在聚焦质量阈值下具有 coercivity。
steps.route: 将非线性项写成 $C_+(|q|^{2})$ 的投影乘积，应用尖锐估计 $||C_+(fg)||_2\le (2\pi )^{-1/2}||f||_2||$ $|\partial |^{1/2}g||_2$，把非线性负项吸收到 $Ḣ^{1/2}$ 主项；严格质量小于 $2\pi $ 保证剩余系数为正。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5–7页 Section 2、Lemma 2.1–2.2 及引言中质量阈值说明。

steps.claim: 抛物正则化方程具有光滑局部解，并且其 $L^{2}、Ḣ^{1/2}、H^{2}$ 估计在 $\epsilon $ 上一致。
steps.route: 正则化线性部分带 $\epsilon \partial _x^{2}$ 平滑，收缩映射给出局部解$；L^{2}$ 能量因耗散项 $-2\epsilon ||q_x||^{2}$ 单调下降。随后用守恒量、投影交换估计和低阶 coercivity 同时闭合 $Ḣ^{1/2}$ 与 $H^{2}$ bootstrap，再逐阶提升到 $H^s$。
steps.evidence: PDF 第7–10页 Section 3；PDF 第10–20页 Proposition 4.1–4.6，特别是 $(CCM\epsilon )、(4.2)、(4.16)–(4.17)$。

steps.claim: 正则化解可在任意有限时间内保持统一 $H^s$ 界并延拓。
steps.route: 先用 Proposition 4.6 的 $H^{2}$ bootstrap 排除低阶范数爆破，再对高阶导数的能量逐项积分；Cauchy–Szegő 非局部项通过专门的交换引理避免导数落到最低正则因子，得到 $sup_{t\le T}||q_\epsilon ||_{H^s}\le C_T$ 与 $\epsilon $ 无关。
steps.evidence: PDF 第18–22页 Section 4、Proposition 4.6 及高阶能量估计(4.14)–(4.17)。

steps.claim: 频率截断正则化解在 $C([0,T];H^s)$ 中收敛到唯一 CCM 解，并连续依赖初值。
steps.route: 对 $q_\epsilon -q_\delta $ 写差分方程$，L^{2}$ 能量先给出 Cauchy 率；再利用低阶收敛、统一 $H^s$ 界和差分高阶能量把收敛提升到 $H^s$。极限中 $\epsilon \partial _x^{2}q_\epsilon $ 消失，非线性项在 Banach 代数 $H^{s-1}$ 中收敛，得到原方程；两解差分的 Gronwall 估计给唯一性，类似估计给连续依赖。

analyses.title: Gradient estimates for the Lagrangian mean curvature equation with Lipschitz critical phase
analyses.abstract: Let $n\ge3$. We prove a priori interior gradient estimate for the Lagrangian mean curvature equation \[ \sum_{i=1}^n\arctanλ_i(D^2u)=θ(x) \] under the critical and supercritical phase condition $θ\ge (n-2)π/2$, assuming only that the Lipschitz norm of the prescribed phase is bounded.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究相位函数仅具 Lipschitz 正则性时的 Lagrangian mean curvature 方程 ∑ arctan $\lambda _i(D^{2}u)=\theta (x)$。在临界/超临界相位 $\theta \ge (n-2)\pi /2$ 下，作者利用相位水平集的 (n−1)-凸性、特征值对称多项式的迹估计和 $p=(1+|Du|^{2})^{1/2}$ 的加权散度不等式，控制临界相位附近可能退化的区域。对 p 乘以截断函数并积分分部，结合半凸性给出的点值梯度估计和 Lipschitz 相位振荡，得到 $B_1$ 内梯度由 osc u 与 Lip $\theta $ 控制的内估计；再结合已有 Hessian 估计和逼近，推出二阶界与连续粘性解的正则性。
techniques: 临界相位下的 (n−1)-凸性
Hessian 特征值对称多项式迹估计
截断积分与 Lipschitz 相位误差控制
半凸性点值梯度估计
analyses.breakthrough: 论文去掉了临界相位附近通常要求的二阶相位导数或 $|D\theta |$ 随 $\theta -\Theta _c$ 衰减的附加条件，只假设 $\theta $ 的 Lipschitz 范数有界；关键是把相位梯度误差直接放进加权散度不等式，并用相位缺口的截断尺度吸收它。
analyses.limitations: 定理针对光滑解的内梯度估计，要求 $n\ge 3、\theta \ge (n-2)\pi /2、\theta <$ $n\pi /2、u$ 振荡有界及 $\theta $ 的 Lipschitz 界；连续粘性解需额外通过逼近使用结果，不覆盖次临界相位或边界梯度估计。Hessian 界还依赖外部已有的 critical-phase Hessian theorem。

steps.claim: 临界/超临界相位条件使 Hessian 特征值满足可用于积分估计的 (n−1)-凸性和特征值序关系。
steps.route: 把相位方程写成 arctan 特征值之和，利用 $\theta \ge \Theta _c$ 的相位几何得到 $\sigma _j(D^{2}u)\ge 0（j\le n-1）$以及最大特征值控制最小特征值。代入线性化矩阵和 Newton 变换的迹，得到 Q、F 的非负性及统一迹上界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–4页 Section 1–2、相位几何引理及公式(2.6)–(2.7)。

steps.claim: $p=(1+|Du|^{2})^{1/2}$ 满足带相位 Lipschitz 误差的散度不等式。
steps.route: 对 p、方程和线性化系数逐项微分，使用相位方程消掉二阶导数的主组合；剩余的 $D\theta $ 项由 $|D\theta |\le K$ 控制，Newton 矩阵迹估计把它压成 tr Q。由此得到 $div(FDp)\ge -C K tr Q$，并可在截断区域对 p 的高值部分进行积分。
steps.evidence: PDF 第4–6页 Lemma 2.1、公式(2.8)及其证明中的相位微分计算。

steps.claim: 对高梯度区域的截断积分给出 $B_1$ 内 |Du| 的统一上界。
steps.route: 选取 $\phi =\theta -\Theta _c$ 的局部缺口并在 $\phi >0$ 区域用半径 $\delta =min(1/4,\phi /(2K))$，这样相位在小球内保持正缺口，方程给出 $D^{2}u$ 的下半界。半凸性点值估计把 |Du(x)| 转换成振荡项加 $\delta $ $cot(\delta /2)$ 项；对 $\phi $ 的分层积分再用散度不等式控制总量，最终使所有层的贡献只依赖 n、M、K。
steps.evidence: PDF 第6–8页 Theorem 1.1 证明，尤其公式(3.6)及 $\phi 、\delta $ 的截断参数构造。

steps.claim: 梯度界可与 Hessian 估计结合，产生内二阶界和粘性解正则性。
steps.route: 将 Theorem 1.1 的梯度上界代入 critical/supercritical 相位的已有 Hessian 估计，得到 $B_{1/2}$ 的 $D^{2}u$ $L\infty $ 界。对连续粘性解用严格超临界相位和光滑逼近，统一继承梯度/二阶估计后取极限。
steps.evidence: PDF 第1–2页 Corollary 1.2；PDF 第8–10页结尾的 approximation/viscosity regularity 讨论。

analyses.title: A counterexample to Kenig's conjecture for the Laplace double-layer operator
analyses.abstract: Layer potentials provide a classical approach to boundary value problems for Laplace's equation on Lipschitz domains. Kenig's 1994 spectral-radius conjecture for the double-layer operator would ensure operator-norm convergence of the associated Neumann series on mean-zero $L^2$ densities when the boundary is connected. We disprove this conjecture by constructing a bounded simply connected planar Lipschitz domain whose double-layer operator on arclength $L^2$ has essential spectral radius strictly greater than $1/2$. More precisely, for every $t>1/2$ sufficiently close to $1/2$, we obtain such a domain with $\pm i t$ in its Fredholm essential spectrum. The construction starts from smooth graphs whose shapes repeat under translation. In the limit of separated scales, refinement makes solutions of adjoint resolvent equations grow with fixed forcing. The graph slopes remain uniformly bounded. A computer-assisted certificate proves this growth through an inequality for Hermitian $2\times2$ matrices. Its strict margin at $- i/2$ persists at nearby spectral parameters. Normalisation and a Floquet transform then give compactly supported densities with small residuals on the full graphs. We insert rescaled segments of successive graphs into one bounded boundary, where these densities form a weakly null sequence of approximate eigenvectors. The same spectral conclusion holds on a single periodic Lipschitz graph. The certificate combines continuous estimates, exact rational arithmetic and rigorous interval enclosures.
analyses.workSummary: 本文反驳 Kenig 关于平面 Lipschitz 域 Laplace 双层算子谱半径的猜想。作者先在周期光滑图上研究双层算子的 Floquet/周期分解，把自相似图形的 resolvent 问题转化为由局部周期算子组成的块算子。一个经过计算机辅助验证的 Hermitian $2\times 2$ 矩阵不等式保证在 −i/2 附近存在固定强迫下增长的 adjoint resolvent；周期密度经 Floquet 变换得到小残差的近似本征向量。随后把不同尺度的图段按几何衰减插入一个有界单连通 Lipschitz 边界，使这些密度弱趋零而残差趋零，故 $\pm it$ 属于 Fredholm essential spectrum，essential spectral radius 大于 1/2。
techniques: 周期图双层算子和 Floquet 变换
块 Toeplitz/直接积分算子极限
Hermitian $2\times 2$ 矩阵计算机辅助证书
resolvent 增长与近似本征向量
多尺度图段嵌入 Lipschitz 边界
analyses.breakthrough: 论文构造出保持统一 Lipschitz 斜率、却含无穷多分离细尺度的有界单连通域；这些尺度把周期图上的 resolvent 增长转化为边界双层算子在 $\pm it（t>1/2）$处的 Fredholm essential spectrum，从而真正否定谱半径$\le 1/2$ 的猜想。
analyses.limitations: 反例是二维平面上的特定 Lipschitz 域，结论依赖 arclength $L^{2}$ 双层算子及计算机辅助矩阵证书，不能推出一般光滑域或其他边界积分算子的谱性质。构造给出谱半径下界和非收敛性反例，不提供所有 Lipschitz 域的完整谱分类。

steps.claim: 周期光滑图上的双层算子可分解为适合 Floquet 分析的周期核/直接积分算子。
steps.route: 对形如 $F(x)=mx+h(x)$ 的平移周期图，将跨周期核按整数平移求和并在 period-one 密度空间定义 $P_F；Floquet$ 变换把全图算子拆成准动量参数族，便于把局部图形改变写成算子块的强收敛极限。
steps.evidence: PDF 第4–7页 Section 2.1–2.3、周期图定义及 Proposition 2.1–2.3。

steps.claim: 存在固定强迫使周期图 adjoint resolvent 在 −i/2 附近具有严格增长。
steps.route: 把候选周期密度的 Fourier 模式代入 resolvent 方程，连续估计归结为一个 Hermitian $2\times 2$ 矩阵的正定/负定不等式；计算机辅助区间证书给出严格余量，因此解的范数相对于固定右端可任意放大。严格余量对邻近谱参数保持，得到 t>1/2 的同样增长。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–4页摘要和 Theorem 1.1 策略；PDF 第8–12页 Section 3、Proposition 3.1–3.3 及矩阵证书。

steps.claim: 周期图上可构造归一化密度序列，其双层算子残差趋于零而密度弱趋零。
steps.route: 将大尺度周期 resolvent 解截断并用 Floquet 变换恢复到物理图，归一化后残差由截断边界和周期近似误差组成并趋于零；平移不同周期段后，支撑逐渐分离，故在 $L^{2}$ 中弱收敛到零。
steps.evidence: PDF 第10–15页 Section 3–4、Floquet 变换、resolvent 归一化构造和 Theorem 1.1 的近似本征向量讨论。

steps.claim: 把多尺度周期图段嵌入单一有界 Lipschitz 边界后$，\pm it$ 属于 Fredholm essential spectrum。
steps.route: 在 $x=0$ 附近插入按几何尺度缩放的周期图段，斜率统一有界且边界保持 Lipschitz；将每个周期近似本征密度搬到对应段，残差仍趋于零且序列弱零。Weyl/Fredholm 判据于是排除 $D_\Gamma \mp it I$ 的 Fredholm 性，得到 $\pm it\in \sigma _ess$，并推出 $r_ess\ge t$。
steps.evidence: PDF 第1–3页 Theorem 1.1；PDF 第12–16页多尺度边界构造、Theorem 1.1 证明及公式(1.3)。
