analyses.title: Shape optimization of light structures with general Hooke's laws
analyses.abstract: For the minimum-compliance shape optimization problem it was established recently [\textit{Duke Math.\ J.} 172 (2023), 43--103] that a sequence of approximately optimal shapes of exact volume \(\e\) converges to a limiting generalized shape, which is represented by a possibly diffuse probability measure, as \(\e \todown 0\). This generalized shape minimizes the so-called light-structures compliance functional, which --- as conjectured by Bouchitté --- is expressed in terms of a relaxed integrand, reflecting that optimal shapes must only involve ``lower-dimensional'' structures, like the Michell-type trusses that are well known in the engineering domain. However, the aforementioned result only applies for the simplest isotropic quadratic energy density, that is, the squared Frobenius norm, in dimensions two and three. The present work extends the relaxation result to the entire class of (isotropic or anisotropic) elasticity tensors and to any dimension, thus solving Bouchitté's conjecture in full generality. Since the previous work relied on explicit formulas for the relaxed integrands (due to Allaire, Kohn, and Strang), which are not available in the general case, several new arguments and substantial modifications of the original approach are required. We also significantly simplify and streamline other parts of the original argument, in addition to clarifying some related statements in the literature.
analyses.workSummary: 本文解决一般各向同性或各向异性 Hooke 定律、任意维数下轻结构最小顺应度问题的 relaxation。作者把精确体积 $\epsilon $ 的结构编码为材料概率测度与对称应力场，先建立带 div 约束的极限泛函和 relaxed integrand；补偿紧性与 Young measure 给出近似极小结构的弱*紧性。下界部分利用应力–测度对的紧性$、H^{-1}$ 散度控制和 Reshetnyak 下半连续性得到极限顺应度不低于 relaxed 泛函；上界则从极限最优测度和应力恢复序列，通过周期局部单元、Fourier/Legendre 估计和体积修正构造 recovery sequence。最后证明最小值收敛并得到概率测度意义下的最优广义形状。
techniques: 应力测度化与 div 约束
凸分析/Hashin–Shtrik 负界
补偿紧性与 Young measures
Reshetnyak 下半连续性
恢复序列与体积修正
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把轻结构 compliance 的 Bouchitté relaxation 从二维/三维 Frobenius 能量推广到任意维和一般正定 Hooke 张量，不依赖 Kohn–Strang 可显式计算的特殊 integrand；抽象 relaxed integrand、div-quasiconvex 结构和恢复序列共同给出完整的 $\Gamma $ 型上下界。
analyses.limitations: 极限对象是概率测度和应力场表示的广义形状，未保证由普通可测实体结构实现；恢复序列和最小值收敛依赖线性弹性、正定 Hooke 张量、固定载荷和精确体积约束。文章不解决有限 $\epsilon $ 的唯一最优形状、工程制造尺度或非线性材料。

steps.claim: 极限 compliance 泛函可由应力测度和 relaxed integrand 表示，并存在一个极限最优概率测度。
steps.route: 把材料密度 $\epsilon ^{-1}L^n⟂\omega $ 与支撑在对称矩阵上的应力 $\sigma $ 组合成 $(\sigma ,\mu )$，用 $div(\sigma \mu )=f$ 的分布约束描述平衡；正定性给出总变差控制，直接法和 Reshetnyak 下半连续性得到极限应力/测度对及其最小值。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–5页 Theorem 1.1、Section 2、Proposition 2.5 及极限问题(1.5)、应力表示(5.1)。

steps.claim: 任意近似最小结构的材料概率测度沿子列弱*收敛到极限最优测度，且给出下界。
steps.route: 对近似结构选取伴随应力 $\sigma _\epsilon $，使能量有界并令 $div(\sigma _\epsilon $ $\mu _\epsilon )$ 在 $H^{-1}$ 有界；补偿紧性保证 $\mu _\epsilon 、\sigma _\epsilon \mu _\epsilon $ 同时收敛，div 约束传到极限。对 $j^*$ 的积分使用凸性和 Reshetnyak 下半连续性，得到 $C(\mu )\le liminf$ $C_\epsilon (\mu _\epsilon )$。
steps.evidence: PDF 第6–9页 Proposition 3.1、Proposition 3.2 及公式中的 $\mu _\epsilon /\sigma _\epsilon $ 紧性条件。

steps.claim: 每个极限最优测度都有满足精确体积的 recovery sequence，给出上界。
steps.route: 先由最优应力测度的极分解和 div 约束构造有限网络/局部周期应力单元，使单元平均匹配 $\sigma $；再用 Hooke 张量的一般凸对偶估计控制单元能量，最后通过小尺度稀释和体积修正把材料量调回 $\epsilon $。该序列的概率测度弱*趋于 $\mu $，能量上 limsup 不超过 $C(\mu )$。

analyses.title: The Trudinger inequality is true for $M^{1,s}$ spaces
analyses.abstract: We prove the Trudinger inequality with exponent $\frac{s}{s-1}$ for $M^{1,s}$ Sobolev spaces on metric measure spaces under the sole measure growth assumption $μ(B(x,r))\ge br^s$. This improves the previously known exponential integrability with power one. Our argument also yields sharp asymptotic bounds for the Sobolev constants as $p\uparrow s$. On doubling spaces, we further remove the connectedness assumption from the Trudinger inequality associated with a $(1,p)$-Poincaré inequality when $p<s$. An Ahlfors regular counterexample shows that this extension fails at the critical exponent $p=s$.
analyses.workSummary: 本文在仅假设球测度下界 $\mu (B(x,r))\ge b$ $r^s$ 的一般度量测度空间中证明 $M^{1,s}$ 的 Trudinger 指数可积性，并给出 p↑s 时 Sobolev 常数的精确渐近。作者从 Hajłasz 梯度不等式出发，用 g 的 dyadic level sets 和 Chebyshev 估计构造分层振荡控制；在临界 $p=s$ 时把每层增量累加成指数级尾界，得到指数 $s/(s-1)（s\le 1$ 时为连续性）估计。对局部球和 doubling 空间，作者将该分层论证与 (1,p)-Poincaré 不等式拼接，去掉传统连通性假设；最后给出 Ahlfors 正则反例说明临界 $p=s$ 下更强的 Poincaré 推论会失败。

dyadic level-set 分解

analyses.title: The equivalence of solutions to fractional and logarithmic Helmholtz equations
analyses.abstract: We show the following equivalence of solutions to general fractional Helmholtz equations: $u$ is a solution to $$A^su=λ^su$$ for \textit{some} fixed $0<s<2$ and some $λ>0$ if and only if $u$ is a solution to the same equation for \textit{all} $s\neq0$. Furthermore, we show as well that $u$ equivalently solves the logarithmic Helmholtz equation $$\log(A)u=(\logλ)u.$$ Here, $A$ is a nonnegative, linear operator on a Banach space $X$. In particular, our results hold whenever $A=-L$, where $L$ is the infinitesimal generator of a $C_0$-semigroup in a Banach space $X$ satisfying mild assumptions that are typical in applications. As a particular case, we recover known results for the fractional Laplacian $(-Δ)^s$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$. More importantly, we provide a list of examples of other fractional power operators in settings where the Fourier transform is not available and for which our theorems apply. These include fractional powers and logarithms of second order elliptic operators in bounded domains, Laplace--Beltrami operators on Riemannian manifolds, space-time master equations, the discrete Laplacian, and fractional derivatives.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究一般 Banach 空间上的非负线性算子 A 的 fractional Helmholtz 方程 $A^s$ $u=\lambda ^s u$ 与 logarithmic Helmholtz 方程 $log(A)u=(log$ $\lambda )u$。作者利用 Balakrishnan 积分定义正分数幂，并通过分数幂的闭合/组合关系证明：若某个 0<s<2 的幂方程成立，则所有正指数和在可定义范围内的幂方程都成立；当 A 可逆时，负幂方程与由负幂半群生成元定义的 log(A) 方程等价。随后用 s→0 的导数定义建立正幂到对数方程的蕴含，并在 $C_0$ 半群生成元、椭圆算子、Laplace–Beltrami、离散 Laplacian 等例子中说明适用范围。

analyses.title: Nonlinear Schrödinger systems with all attractive forces
analyses.abstract: In this paper we investigate in a systematic way the solution structure of nonnegative solutions for coupled nonlinear Schrödinger systems in the all attractive regime. For all frequencies equal case we obtain results on Morse index of synchronized positive vector solutions and nonnegative semi-vector solutions as well as their kernel of linearized systems at these solutions. We establish a variational characterization of synchronized positive vector solutions and as applications we give a new existence result about positive vector solutions for the general systems with arbitrary frequencies. We also examine the synchronization phenomenon of positive vector solutions, and prove that if the interaction matrix has exactly one positive eigenvalue, any positive vector solution is synchronized. Finally we provide examples of domains for which synchronization of positive solutions fails to hold if the interaction matrix has at least two positive eigenvalues. Our results reveal the effect of the spectral information of the interaction matrix of the couplings and geometry of a domain on the solution structure.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究所有耦合项为吸引作用的非线性 Schrödinger 系统，重点分析同步正向量解、Morse 指标和同步破缺。等频率情形先沿标量正解 U 的同步方向与其正交分解线性化，把系统 Hessian 的谱拆成标量线性化算子与交互矩阵特征值的张量组合，从而计算同步解和半向量解的 Morse 指标及退化条件。变分部分把同步正解刻画为一个余维一 Nehari 型约束上的全局极小器，并利用交互矩阵列凸包条件推广到不等频率系统。最后通过正解比值测试、Perron–Frobenius 和交互矩阵正特征值结构证明“一正特征值”时所有正解同步；当正特征值至少两个时，构造区域和非同步正解说明唯一性失败。

analyses.title: Completion of DNA replication is constrained by the spatiotemporal organisation of origin firing
analyses.abstract: DNA replication requires the coordination of origin firing and fork progression to ensure the entire genome is timely duplicated before cell division. Yet origin firing is stochastic, giving rise to the classical random completion problem of how probabilistic local events can nevertheless ensure reliable genome duplication. Although several biological mechanisms have been proposed to resolve this problem, a quantitative account of how heterogeneous initiation and fork speed govern the persistence of the final unreplicated regions is still lacking. To address this gap, we introduce a population-level kinetic framework that extends KJMA nucleation-and-growth models by tracking unreplicated intervals over size, genomic position and time. We establish well-posedness of the resulting mean-field system and global existence for compatible data. Notably, by introducing a local initiation mass function, we quantify how the density and spatial organisation of origin firing constrain replication completion, yielding novel and sharp upper bounds on both the worst-locus unreplicated fraction and locuswise near-completion time. These results provide a rigorous and computable foundation for mapping vulnerabilities in replication completion and relating persistent unreplicated regions to replication stress and genome instability.
analyses.workSummary: 本文把随机复制起点和复制叉推进写成一维群体平均动力学。作者先从带长度、位置和时间变量的未复制区间密度出发，通过左右复制叉的输运和起点/合并项把尺寸变量积分消去，得到未复制比例、叉密度与给定起点率 I(x,t)、叉速 v(x,t) 的耦合系统。正文先用固定点证明局部温和解唯一且连续依赖初值，再把叉密度除以未复制比例，沿特征线化为线性输运，从而延拓到任意有限时间。最后用反向因果锥上的起点质量 $m_I$ 给出最坏位置的未复制率和近完成时间 $T\epsilon $ 上界，并将该界用于期望复制时间和 Repli-seq 型数值比较。

analyses.title: Remarks on a Liouville-type theorem by Chae and Wolf for stationary Navier-Stokes equations
analyses.abstract: In this note, we revisit a Liouville-type theorem of Chae and Wolf for stationary Navier-Stokes equations in $\mathbb{R}^3$ [J. Differential Equations 261 (2016) 5541-5560]. We show that their logarithmic improvement of the classical $L^{9/2}$ condition is part of a substantially broader weighted framework. More precisely, we prove that a solution $u\in\dot H^1(\mathbb{R}^3)$ is necessarily trivial whenever $$ \int_{\mathbb{R}^3}|u(x)|^{9/2}\,ω(|u(x)|)\,dx< +\infty, $$ for every positive, nondecreasing and bounded weight $ω$ satisfying a mild growth condition near the origin. This structural condition encompasses the logarithmic weight due to Chae and Wolf, as well as a hierarchy of iterated-logarithmic weights and (genuinely) non-logarithmic examples, including a dyadic weight. Our result identifies a broader class of weighted integrability conditions under which the triviality of stationary Navier-Stokes solutions follows, and shows that the mechanism underlying the Chae-Wolf improvement is not intrinsically tied to a specific logarithmic weight or to a single logarithmic scale.
analyses.workSummary: 本文重新证明静态三维 Navier–Stokes 的 Liouville 型结论。作者允许权函数 $\omega $ 为连续、单调且有界，并只要求其在速度趋零处满足 $\omega (s)^{-1}$ 不超过对数增长；在 $u\in Ḣ^{1}(R^{3})$ 且 $∫|u|^{9/2}\omega (|u|)<\infty $ 时证明 u 恒为零。证明先用 Sobolev 嵌入和权函数的逆函数性质把加权临界可积性提升到一族 $L^p$ 控制，再在大环带上对方程作截断测试，把梯度项 $I_{2}$ 与压力/对流项 $I_{1}$ 分开。Chae–Wolf 的环带衰减引理控制 $I_{2}$，权函数分层和 Hölder/Young 估计控制 $I_{1}$，最后令环带半径趋于无穷使两项消失。
techniques: 权函数 $\omega $ 的单调性与对数增长条件
Sobolev 嵌入和权函数逆函数估计
大环带截断测试与 $I_{1}/I_{2}$ 分解
Chae–Wolf 环带梯度衰减引理
Hölder、Young 与吸收估计
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把 Chae–Wolf 的单一对数权推广为满足(H1)–(H3)的整个权函数类，并明确展示对数迭代权和非对数 dyadic 权都足以触发平凡性；因此 Liouville 判据的改进来自权函数在小速度区的可控退化，而不依赖某个固定的对数公式。
analyses.limitations: 结论只针对全空间 $R^{3}$ 的静态、无外力方程和 $u\in Ḣ^{1}$ 的解，权函数必须满足连续单调有界及(H3)的小参数对数上界；核心环带估计使用三维 Sobolev 与特定压力/对流结构，不能直接覆盖时变 Navier–Stokes、有限区域、外力或任意非单调权。

analyses.title: A globally defined polyconvex isotropic energy satisfying the true-stress-true-strain monotonicity condition (TSTS-M++)
analyses.abstract: Polyconvexity is a standard ingredient in the variational existence theory of finite elasticity, whereas true-stress-true-strain monotonicity (TSTS-M++) requires a positive incremental Cauchy-stress response. These two constitutive restrictions are independent, and Wollner, Holzapfel and Neff left open whether a compressible isotropic energy defined on the whole of $\mathrm{GL}^{+}(3)$ can satisfy both. We give an explicit affirmative answer. For every $μ>0$ and $k>0$, the stored-energy function $W_k(F)=\fracμ{2k}\bigl[\exp\bigl(k(\lVert F\rVert^2+3J^{-1}+J-7)\bigr)-1\bigr]$, $J=\det F$, is polyconvex and strictly rank-one convex. Its Cauchy-stress response satisfies TSTS-M++ globally if and only if $k\ge 1/(8\sqrt{3})$. In this regime every symmetric Cauchy stress corresponds to a unique positive-definite stretch, while the reference stretch is stress free with positive infinitesimal shear and bulk moduli. Stress bijectivity has the strictly smaller sharp threshold $k_{\mathrm{B}}\approx 0.00827233304$: at equality the stress map is a global homeomorphism with a nondifferentiable inverse, and above it the map is a global $C^{\infty}$ diffeomorphism. Thus, for $k_{\mathrm{B}}\le k<1/(8\sqrt{3})$, the map $V\mapstoσ(V)$ remains globally bijective while TSTS-M++ fails at finite strain. In the TSTS-M++ regime, every prescribed inner radius of a finite plane-strain annulus with a traction-free outer wall has a unique radial equilibrium, and its inner pressure increases smoothly and strictly from zero to infinity.
analyses.workSummary: 本文给出三维 GL⁺(3) 上一个显式压缩各向同性储能族，并同时分析 polyconvexity、严格 rank-one convexity、TSTS-M++ 和应力可逆性。能量把 $||F||^{2}、3(det$ $F)^{-1}$ 与 det F 组成内函数，再套用随参数 $\kappa $ 变化的凸增指数；作者先在独立 minor 变量(F,Cof F,det F)上构造凸延拓，证明全域 polyconvexity 和沿 rank-one 线的严格凸性。随后改用正定伸长的 Hencky 对数变量，计算主应力切线和非共轴模量，将 TSTS-M++ 化成一个正定性判据，得到精确阈值 $\kappa *=1/(8\sqrt 3)$。最后通过 properness、局部微分同胚和单连通覆盖证明应力映射的全局双射，并另行求出较小的应力双射阈值 $\kappa B$。

rank-one 线二阶导数与 polyconvexity

正定矩阵/不变量判据确定 TSTS 阈值
properness 与覆盖空间的全局反演
analyses.breakthrough: 该构造首次在整个 GL⁺(3) 上以有限值、光滑且 polyconvex 的显式能量同时实现全局 TSTS-M++；更细的结果把“应力双射”与“增量单调性”分成两个锐阈值，证明 $\kappa B<\kappa *$ 的区间中应力仍全局可逆但 TSTS-M++ 已在有限应变失效。
analyses.limitations: 结果限于三维、各向同性、可压缩的这一指数能量族和正定伸长变量；阈值是该族的构成本征结论，不等于所有材料模型的普适常数。文中全局应力反演不直接给出任意边值问题的能量极小器存在性，环形/球形平衡还需附加几何与无摩擦边界设定；失效构造也只说明 TSTS-M++ 的有限应变阈值。

analyses.title: Determination of Wave Speed from interior sources
analyses.abstract: We consider the wave equation with variable wave speed in Euclidean space, with point sources modeled by Dirac delta initial displacement data. There are three special subsets of the whole space: (1) the source set where the delta initial conditions are supported, (2) the unknown set where the wave speed is not known a priori, and (3) the receiver set where the waves are measured. The inverse problem is to reconstruct the wave speed uniquely in the unknown set from an unlabeled collection of waves generated by point sources and measured in the receiver set. We use propagation of singularities and sharp finite speed of propagation to reduce this data to geometric travel-time data, whose form depends on how the three sets lie in relation to each other. We give three scenarios where this procedure leads to unique determination of the wave speed.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究由未知介质中的内部点源激发、在接收集合上观测的变速波方程。源集合、未知集合和接收集合可以彼此不同，波的标签也被抹去。作者把点源 Dirac 初值产生的波视为时空双曲算子的分布解，先用全局双曲性、分布初值适定性和尖锐有限传播速度确定波到达前的空区，再用实主型算子的奇性传播识别首次到达时刻。核心 Theorem 1.1 证明无标记波数据等价于从源到接收点的 Riemannian travel-time 数据；随后在全数据、简单流形和严格凸域等三种布局中调用相应距离刚性结果，得到波速唯一性。
techniques: 双曲时空的全局双曲性与分布初值适定性
尖锐有限传播速度
实主型算子的波前集/奇性传播
首次到达时间与共形 Riemann 距离识别
无标记 travel-time 数据的几何刚性
analyses.breakthrough: 论文的关键推进是无需给源和振幅逐一配标签，仍能从每个接收点附近的波前首次出现时间恢复源到接收点的距离函数；这把一个无标记 PDE 逆问题直接降为几何距离数据，并在全数据情形不要求简单性、凸性或非捕获假设即可得到唯一波速。
analyses.limitations: 波速需为满足统一上下界(1)的 $C\infty $ 正函数，源和接收集合是 $R^n$ 中非空开集，观测时间 T 需超过 M 倍欧氏直径。部分数据的 Corollary 1.3–1.4 还要求简单 Riemann 度量、光滑域、严格凸性或域外波速已知；结论是唯一性而非稳定重建，也没有覆盖不光滑系数或有限噪声。

steps.claim: 点源波的支集在到达距离锥之外为空，并且其 Cauchy 问题在分布意义下唯一适定。
steps.route: 把变速波算子写成共形 Lorentz 度量的正常双曲算子；Lemma 2.1 给出每个时间切片为 Cauchy 超曲面，Lemma 2.2 用光滑初值逼近定义唯一分布解，Lemma 2.3 再把因果支集性质延伸到 Dirac 初值。

steps.claim: 点源解在初始光锥上的波前集正好是 lifted light cone LLC。
steps.route: 传播奇性定理把解的波前集限制在主符号的特征集，并沿零双特征线延拓；从(0,y)的 Dirac 奇性出发，Proposition 3.4 证明所有且仅有沿该光锥的特征协向量保持奇性，因而接收点首次可见的奇性不能早于也不会晚于相应零测地线。
steps.evidence: 第3节 Proposition 3.4 及式(19)–(24)（PDF 第9–10页）；第2节 Lemma 2.5 的奇性传播（PDF 第8页）。

steps.claim: 首次到达时间 Tc(y,z) 等于共形度量 gc 的 Riemann 距离 dc(y,z)。
steps.route: 有限传播先给 $Tc\ge dc$；再用 Hopf–Rinow 选取从 y 到 z 的最短 gc 测地线，把它提升为 Lorentz 零测地线，并用 Proposition 3.4 的光锥波前集在该时刻构造不可消去奇性，得到 $Tc\le dc$，二者合并即得等式。

steps.claim: 相同的无标记波数据必给出相同的 travel-time 数据，进而在给定几何布局下唯一确定波速。

analyses.title: Notes on linear elliptic equations with $L^2$-gradient perturbations and singular zero-order coefficients
analyses.abstract:
In this paper, we study the existence, uniqueness, and quantitative estimates for weak solutions to linear elliptic Dirichlet problems of the form \[ -\operatorname{div}(γ
abla u)+\langle 
ablaφ+\mathbf{H},
abla uangle+(c+α)u=f \quad	ext{ in }U, \quad\; u=0 \quad	ext{on }\partial U, \] where $U\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ is bounded, $γ\in[1,\infty)$ is a constant, $φ\in H^{1,2}(U)\cap L^\infty(U)$, $\mathbf{H}\in L^p(U,\mathbb{R}^d)$ for some $p \in (d, \infty)$, and $c\in L^1(U)$ with $c\ge0$. A key feature of this setting is that the drift contains the low-regularity term $
ablaφ$, which is only assumed to belong to $L^2(U,\mathbb{R}^d)$, while the zero-order coefficient is merely integrable. We prove that, even under these rough assumptions, well-posedness and quantitative energy and $L^2$ estimates remain valid. In addition, by using a previously established interpolation result, we characterize a trade-off between the integrability of the source term $f$ and that of the zero-order coefficient $c$, and show that well-posedness together with the corresponding quantitative estimates hold under these interpolated assumptions.
analyses.workSummary: 本文处理有界区域上的线性椭圆 Dirichlet 问题，其中漂移含仅在 $L^{2}$ 中的梯度项 $\nabla \phi +H$，零阶系数 c 只要求 $L^{1}$ 且非负。作者的主要构造是指数权 $\eta =k$ $exp(-\phi /\gamma )$：将原弱形式乘以 $\eta $ 后$，\nabla \phi $ 项与权导数抵消，方程变成扩散系数 $\gamma \eta $、漂移 $\eta H$ 和零阶项 $\eta (c+\alpha )$ 的加权椭圆方程。借助该变换，正文把已有的粗系数适定性和 divergence-free/Harnack 估计迁移回来，得到存在唯一性$、L^{2}/$梯度$/L\infty $ 量化估计；再结合插值定理，给出源 f 与 c 的可积性折衷及相应正则性。
techniques: 指数权变换吸收 $L^{2}$ 梯度漂移
加权弱形式与系数等价性
正解/Harnack 控制与 divergence-free 估计
截断逼近和弱紧性
源项/零阶项可积性的插值估计

analyses.title: Threshold for the existence of scattering states for inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equations without gauge invariance
analyses.abstract: We consider the asymptotic behavior of solutions to inhomogeneous nonlinear Schrödinger equations with non-gauge-invariant nonlinearities. The spatial coefficient in the nonlinear term may have different orders of singularity at the origin and decay at infinity. Under a coercivity condition involving the coefficient and the nonlinearity, we show that no scattering states exist for the equation below a Strauss-type threshold determined by the decay at infinity. Our class includes nonlinearities with a dominant non-oscillatory component. We also prove a complementary small-data scattering result above this threshold, using non-admissible Strichartz estimates in Lorentz spaces adapted to the singular coefficient.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究不具 gauge invariance 的非线性非齐次 Schrödinger 方程 $i\partial tu+½\Delta u=K(x)F(u)$。系数 K 在原点和无穷远允许不同幂次，非线性满足 Lipschitz 型条件(A1)，并在(A2)中要求 K(x)F(z)具有固定相位的强制性下界。作者证明：当 p 低于由 K 在无穷远衰减决定的 Strauss 型指数 $pst(b\infty )$ 时，满足指定渐近条件的非零散射态不存在；当 p 高于同一阈值并满足参数兼容性时，借助适配奇异系数的非可容许 Lorentz–Strichartz 估计，对自由演化小的数据做压缩映射，得到全局解和 $L^{2}$ 散射。两部分分别由时空测试函数矛盾法与 Duhamel 固定点完成。

analyses.title: Rate of convergence of a fully discrete structure-preserving midpoint scheme for the stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation
analyses.abstract: The stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (sLLG) equation is a strongly nonlinear stochastic PDE with a non-convex pointwise constraint arising in the theory of micromagnetics. We analyse a fully discrete, structure-preserving finite element approximation of the sLLG equation with coloured multiplicative Stratonovich noise on a bounded interval. The method utilises continuous piecewise affine finite elements, mass lumping, and midpoint time discretisation to preserve the unit-length constraint exactly at the finite element nodes. Under suitable regularity assumptions on the initial data and the noise, we establish uniform higher-moment stability and develop an error analysis for the scheme. The analysis exploits the geometric structure of the equation and the stochastic midpoint discretisation. For every $γ\in(0,\frac12)$, we prove first-order spatial convergence and temporal convergence of order $γ$ in the natural discrete energy norm, locally in mean square on events of arbitrarily large probability and, consequently, in probability. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first convergence-rate result for a fully discrete structure-preserving finite element scheme solving the stochastic Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation.
analyses.workSummary: 本文分析一维有色乘性 Stratonovich 噪声下随机 Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert 方程的全离散有限元 midpoint 方法。作者采用质量集中的连续 P1 元和时间中点离散，使每个节点的磁化长度严格保持为1；随后以离散拉普拉斯能量测试配合离散 BDG 不等式，得到与网格 h、时间步 k 无关的高阶矩稳定性。误差被分成插值误差和离散误差，漂移项用质量集成/乘积插值估计，随机 midpoint 缺陷则在停止事件上逐项改写成 Itô 积分、增量平方项和双增量项。最终在任意 $\gamma <1/2$ 下得到能量范数中的 $h+k^\gamma $ 收敛（局部大概率事件上均方，进而依概率）。

analyses.title: Singular Extremal Solutions on Thin Ellipsoids with Varying Nonlinearities
analyses.abstract: Let $N=m+1$ and consider the thin ellipsoid \[ Ω_\varepsilon=\{(y,x_N)\in\mathbb R^m\times\mathbb R:\ |y|^2+\varepsilon^{-2}x_N^2<1\}. \] We prove that in every sufficiently large dimension, for every sufficiently small $\varepsilon>0$, there exists a smooth positive, strictly increasing, strictly convex, superlinear nonlinearity $f_\varepsilon$ for which the extremal solution in $Ω_\varepsilon$ is an unbounded $H^1_0$ solution. Combining this result with Dancer's thin-domain regularity theorem for the Gelfand nonlinearity $f(t)=e^t$, we obtain on the same sufficiently thin ellipsoids a bounded Gelfand extremal solution and an unbounded extremal solution for another nonlinearity. Thus, in this two-part sense, Brézis' Open Problem~6.1 is resolved in every sufficiently large dimension.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究高维薄椭球上的半线性 Dirichlet 极值解。作者先把薄椭球缩放为圆柱域，围绕常边界问题 $-\Delta q=\Lambda _{0}(q+q^{2})$ 构造随边界参数变化的最小正解分支，再用三种尺度的 blow-up 分析控制分支的径向幅度和尾部。高维条件 $m\ge m1\ge 17$ 使 Hardy 不等式与薄方向 Poincaré gap 合起来给出分支一致的 Jacobi 算子 coercivity；加权 Lyapunov–Schmidt 构造也提供阈值附近的模型。最后把边界参数推进到极值端点：若端点有界，椭圆正则性和统一谱隙会继续分支，矛盾，因此得到 $H01\cap L3$ 但不属于 $L\infty $ 的半稳定极值解，并与 Gelfand 非线性的有界性结果组合解决 Brézis 问题的两部分。

三种区域的 blow-up 与径向尾部估计

analyses.limitations: 结论要求横向维数 $m\ge m1\ge 17$、厚度 $\epsilon $ 足够小，并允许非线性 $f\delta $ 随 $\epsilon $ 选择且 $\delta \le Cm\epsilon ^{2}$；奇异极值解的函数空间是 $H01\cap L3$，证明依赖轴对称/偶对称 profile、半稳定性和薄椭球的特定几何。结果不说明固定任意非线性在所有维数或厚度下都奇异，也不提供端点的 $L\infty $ 之外更高正则性。

analyses.title: Solutions of Duhamel's formula with a sum of mappings
analyses.abstract: Semilinear evolution equations are solved by means of the variation of constants formula under the action of smoothing linear operators and a finite number of nonlinearities operating between chosen Banach spaces of a given family. Admissible spaces of initial conditions are determined for the existence and uniqueness of a suitable notion of solution. Its maximal time of existence, short time and blow up time profiles, global extendibility and regularity are analyzed. For extrapolated fractional power scale of Banach spaces the fulfillment of the corresponding Cauchy problem is shown. Chosen applications to the modified viscous Cahn-Hilliard equation in R^N, the evolution of cell population of varying genotype and the semilinear Schrödinger equation are presented.
analyses.workSummary: 本文建立带有限个非线性映射之和的 Duhamel 公式抽象理论。在线性解析半群生成的外推分数幂 Banach 标度 $E\sigma $ 中，作者允许每个 Fi 作用于不同的相空间 $E^{\alpha i}$ 并落在 $E^{\beta i}$，用奇异卷积指数 d(·,·) 描述半群平滑和非线性增长的匹配。正文先估计 Duhamel 映射的积分项和时间连续性，再在带 $t^{d(\gamma ,\alpha i)}$ 权的 Banach 球上做压缩映射，得到局部唯一 $\gamma -solution$；通过时间平移、Volterra 型差分估计和有限时刻范数控制，延拓为最大解并给出有限爆破时范数发散。外推分数幂尺度中还证明该积分解具有时间导数，随后应用于高阶 Cahn–Hilliard、细胞群体和 Schrödinger 模型。

analyses.limitations: 抽象定理要求 C0 解析半群、各 Fi 的幂型局部 Lipschitz/增长条件及严格的指数兼容关系(1.8)、(1.11)、(1.12)/(1.16)。所得解是相对于 $E\gamma $ 与时间权定义的 $\gamma -solution$，最大时间可能有限；具体 PDE 应用还需逐项验证半群估计，不能自动涵盖非解析半群、临界兼容指数或任意非局部非线性。

analyses.title: The Dirichlet problem for a non-commutative elliptic operator in the ball
analyses.abstract: In this paper we establish a necessary and sufficient condition for the solvability of the Dirichlet problem in the unit ball $\mathbb{B}$ for the second order system $\partial_{\underline{x}} f\partial_{\underline{x}}=0$, where $\partial_{\underline{x}}$ stands for the Clifford-algebra valued Dirac operator in $\mathbb{R}^m$. We prove that the problem admits a solution whenever the boundary data belong to $C^1(\partial\mathbb{B})$. Conversely, we construct explicit counterexamples showing that solvability may fail if this smoothness assumption on the boundary is not satisfied. Moreover, in contrast with the standard commutative setting, we show how that solutions exhibit a regularity one order less than the boundary data, when the latter belong to $C^{k,ν}(\partial\mathbb{B})$.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究 Clifford 代数值 inframonogenic 函数在单位球中的 Dirichlet 问题，方程是 sandwich 算子 $\partial x f$ $\partial x=0$。作者先利用 Dirac 算子平方为负 Laplacian、Clifford 反自同构 $\Psi $ 的代数恒等式以及 Almansi 型分解，把零边界的三次单调部分写成 $(1-|x|^{2})\eta $，其中 $\eta $ 是双侧 monogenic 函数。由此将一般边界值解表示成 Poisson 延拓 P[g] 加上 $\Psi ^{-1}(\partial xP[g]\partial x)$ 的显式修正项。该表示给出连续边界数据的必要充分极限条件；对 $C^{1}$ 边界数据，调和函数 Hessian 的边界衰减保证条件成立并得到唯一解；构造 Fourier 级数型调和函数展示连续但非 $C^{1}$ 数据可能失败，并进一步证明 $C^{k,\nu }$ 数据的解损失一阶 Hölder 正则性。

analyses.limitations: 主要结论针对单位球、Clifford 代数值 inframonogenic 方程和文中定义的 sandwich 算子；显式 $\Psi ^{-1}$ 在奇维与偶维的代数性质不同，偶维部分只能给出简短处理。边界正则性结论依赖球的 Poisson 核和光滑球面，不直接覆盖一般区域、非零下阶项或低于连续边界数据的函数空间。

analyses.title: Asymmetric Periodic Water Waves in Finite Depth
analyses.abstract: We consider the full two-dimensional water-wave equations in finite depth, with and without surface tension. Water waves have been studied mathematically for more than two centuries. Reflection symmetry remains a common assumption in constructions of periodic steady waves, although asymmetric profiles have been observed in experiments and numerical computations. We construct families of periodic stationary solutions whose free surfaces have no axis of reflection, in both the pure-gravity and capillary--gravity cases. To the best of our knowledge, this provides the first rigorous construction of asymmetric periodic pure-gravity waves for the full two-dimensional water-wave problem in finite depth. The proof combines localized vorticity laws with a Lyapunov--Schmidt reduction. In the pure-gravity case, we introduce a small background shear flow to obtain an invertible boundary operator and couple the interior and free-surface approximations at leading order.
analyses.workSummary: 本文构造有限深二维 Euler 水波方程中的周期稳态自由表面，并证明表面没有任何竖直反射轴。作者把局部涡量集中在若干小圆盘中，用 Green 函数和周期镜像构造主近似；纯重力情形加入小背景剪切，使边界算子可逆，并把内部涡量与自由表面条件在首阶耦合。正文先建立非局部混合边界问题的 Schauder 可解性，再对近似场的误差做压缩映射修正。Lyapunov–Schmidt 约化把剩余有限维方程化为周期 Kirchhoff–Routh 函数的临界点条件，最后用非退化临界点随 $\epsilon $ 扰动的位置选择消去涡核系数，得到纯重力及毛细–重力两类无轴对称周期波。

analyses.title: Necessary and Sufficient Condition of Existence for the Quadrature Surfaces Free Boundary Problem in Riemannian Geometry
analyses.abstract: We generalize to the setting of compact Riemannian manifolds a recent result of Barkatou on quadrature surfaces. Following the geometric and variational framework recently developed by Djité and Seck, we formulate the quadrature surface free boundary problem as a shape optimization problem on a compact Riemannian manifold. Using the Riemannian $RC$-GNP condition introduced in \cite{DjiteSeck2026} and the stability results established therein, we prove that the quadrature surface problem $QS(f,k)$ admits a solution strictly containing the totally convex hull $C$ of the support of $f$ if and only if the following integral condition holds: \[ \int_C f(x)\,dv(g) > k |\partial C|_g, \] where $dv(g)$ is the Riemannian volume element and $|\partial C|_g$ is the perimeter of $C$ with respect to the metric $g$. This work extends the results of Barkatou et al. (2005) by replacing the Euclidean space with a Riemannian manifold. We also provide explicit examples on the round sphere where the condition can be verified explicitly. This paper complements the recent works \cite{DjiteSeck2026} and \cite{DjiteSeck2026b} by establishing a sharp necessary and sufficient condition in the spirit of the Euclidean result of Barkatou.
analyses.workSummary: 本文把紧致非负曲率 Riemann 流形上的 Laplace–Beltrami quadrature surface 自由边界问题转成域形状优化。给定非负源 f、其全凸包 C 和边界通量常数 k，作者在满足 RC-GNP 的 admissible class 中以 Dirichlet 能量减去 $k^{2}$ 体积构造泛函。紧性和 Dirichlet 解对域的 $H^{1}$ 稳定性使直接法得到最优域；形状导数给出自由边界上的梯度条件。随后用 C 与候选域的接触比较、Hopf 边界引理以及非负曲率下周长严格增大性质，证明若且唯若 ∫C f $dv_g>k|\partial C|_g$，则最优域严格包含 C 且在新边界满足 $|\nabla u|=k$。
techniques: RC-GNP 几何紧性与 Hausdorff 收敛
Dirichlet 问题 $H^{1}$ 稳定性
直接法和能量下半连续性
形状导数与自由边界最优性
比较原理、Hopf 引理和全凸包接触分析
analyses.breakthrough: 论文把欧氏 quadrature surface 判据推广到紧致非负曲率 Riemann 流形，并得到精确的必要充分条件 $∫_C$ $f,dv_g>k|\partial C|_g$；曲率假设正好用于把严格包含 C 的域的边界测度与 C 分开，从而闭合充分性与必要性的几何缺口。
analyses.limitations: 结果要求紧致、连通、单连通且截面曲率非负的流形，源 $f\in L^{2}_g$ 为正且支集全凸包 C 严格凸；admissible class 必须满足 RC-GNP 和稳定性假设，边界正则性与经典形状导数也需额外满足。论文给出存在性判据而非稳定性、数值算法或一般曲率符号下的完整理论。

analyses.title: Necessary and Sufficient Condition of Existence for the $p$-Laplacian Quadrature Surfaces Free Boundary Problem in Riemannian Geometry
analyses.abstract: We generalize the necessary and sufficient condition of existence for the quadrature surfaces free boundary problem to the case of the $p$-Laplacian operator in Riemannian geometry. Following the shape optimization approach of Barkatou for the Euclidean case and the Riemannian framework recently developed by Djité and Seck, we formulate the $p$-Laplacian quadrature surface problem as a shape optimization problem on a compact Riemannian manifold. Using the Riemannian $RC$-GNP condition, the stability results, and the $p$-Laplacian shape derivative formula from \cite{DjiteSeck2026b}, we prove that the $p$-Laplacian quadrature surface problem $QS_p(f,k)$ admits a solution strictly containing the totally convex hull $C$ of the support of $f$ if and only if \[ \int_C f(x)\,dv(g) > k^{p-1} |\partial C|_g, \] for $1 < p < \infty$, under suitable regularity and stability assumptions. This extends the Euclidean result of Barkatou for $p=2$ and the Riemannian result of Djité and Seck to the nonlinear $p$-Laplacian setting. Explicit examples on the round sphere are provided, including the computation of the radial $p$-harmonic solution and the boundary flux.
analyses.workSummary: 本文将 Riemann 流形上的 quadrature surface 自由边界问题从 Laplace–Beltrami 算子推广到 p-Laplacian。给定 $f\in L^p$、全凸包 C 和常数 k，作者在满足 RC-GNP 与 boundary-flux stability 的 admissible class 中以 p-能量减去 $k^{p}$ 体积建立形状泛函。首先证明域紧性和 p-Laplacian Dirichlet 解的 $W^{1,p}$ 稳定性，直接法得到最优域；接着通过 p-能量形状导数和第一阶变分获得边界梯度条件。最后用 p-Laplacian 比较原理、Hopf 引理和接触处几何比较，证明存在严格包含 C 的解当且仅当 ∫C $f,dv_g>k^{p-1}|\partial C|_g$。

p-Laplacian 单调性和 $W^{1,p}$ 稳定性

p-Laplacian 比较原理和 Hopf 边界引理
analyses.breakthrough: 论文得到 p-Laplacian 版本的几何必要充分判据，把欧氏 $p=2$ 结果和 Riemann Laplace 结果统一为 ∫C $f,dv_g>k^{p-1}|\partial C|_g$；严格包含性由全凸包接触分析与 p-通量的单调性共同保证。
analyses.limitations: 结论要求紧致连通单连通、非负截面曲率的 Riemann 流形$，f\in L^p$ 非负且 C 严格凸，并假设 admissible class 满足 RC-GNP 与 (SC) 边界通量稳定性。p-Laplacian 的边界正则性和 Hopf 引理需文中光滑性/非退化梯度条件；未覆盖一般曲率、退化接触或不稳定 admissible 类，也未研究稳定性与数值近似。

analyses.title: Interior $W^{2,p}$ regularity for the sigma-$2$ equation
analyses.abstract: We prove that continuous $2$-convex solutions of the $σ_{2}$ equation with a density bounded above and below by positive constants belong to $W^{2,1}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ in every dimension. If, in addition, the density is continuous, the solutions belong to $W^{2,p}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ for every $1<p<\infty$.
analyses.workSummary: 本文证明 $\sigma _{2}$ Hessian 方程的连续 2-凸解具有内部二阶 Sobolev 正则性。对 Hessian 测度满足 $\lambda \le f\le \Lambda $ 的解，作者先用 2-凸性和 Hessian 测度弱连续性得到分布 Hessian 的局部 $W^{1,1}$ 控制，并将方程写成凹算子 $G(D^{2}u)=\sqrt \sigma _{2}(D^{2}u)$。随后在球内构造带截断的光滑近似方程，使密度从粗糙数据逐步逼近目标；对线性化方程使用 trace-dependent quotient 计算、最大值原理与局部边界 Hessian 估计，获得 $D(H^{p/2}(Du))$ 的统一局部界。紧性和弱极限把该估计传回原连续解，给出任意有界正密度下 $W^{2,1}_loc$，以及连续密度下所有有限 p 的 $W^{2,p}_loc$。

凹算子 $G=\sqrt \sigma _{2}$ 的线性化结构

analyses.breakthrough: 论文把 $\sigma _{2}$ 方程从光滑/严格椭圆框架推进到连续 2-凸解：密度仅上下有界时得到 $W^{2,1}_loc$，密度连续时升级为任意有限 p 的 $W^{2,p}_loc$，并允许不依赖先验严格凸性的测度解。
analyses.limitations: 结论是内部正则性，要求 u 连续且 2-凸、密度正且有界$；W^{2,p}$ 版本还要求 f 连续并依赖其局部模连续性。证明在球内进行，不给出边界正则性、全局估计、密度仅可测时的 p>1 提升，也不处理 $\sigma k(k\ne 2)$ 的同样结论。

analyses.title: Second-order regularity for weighted widely degenerate problems with explicit $u$-dependence
analyses.abstract: We consider local weak solutions of widely degenerate elliptic PDEs of the type \begin{equation} \label{equazione mia} \mathrm{div}\Biggl(|x|^β(|Du|-1)^{p-1}_+\frac{Du}{|Du|}\Biggr)=\frac{|u|^{q-2}u}{|x|^α} \ \ \text{ in }Ω, \end{equation} where $2\leq p<n$, $α,β>0$ are fixed exponents, $Ω$ is an open subset of $\mathbb{R}^n,$ that contains the origin, $n>2,$ and $( \ \cdot \ )_+$ stands for the positive part. We establish a higher differentiability result for the composition of the gradient with a suitable function that vanishes in the unit ball for the gradient, under appropriate assumptions on the datum. The novelty here with respect to previous papers on the subject is that the right-hand side explicitly depends on the solution $u$ and we have a mismatch between the weight on the left-hand side and the right-hand side.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究含双重空间权和显式 u 依赖的广泛退化椭圆方程。方程的主部是 $|x|^\beta (|Du|-1)_+^{p-1}Du/|Du|$，右端含 $|x|^{-\alpha }|u|^{q-2}u$，原点同时存在退化权与奇异源。作者证明局部弱解的梯度经过截断函数 $H^{p/2}_s$ 后获得一阶 Sobolev 可微性。核心先在正则化权 $\epsilon +|x|^\beta $ 和平滑源上，对局部差商测试建立 $H^{p/2}(Du)$ 的统一估计；广义 Hölder 与无权 Sobolev 嵌入把两个空间权解耦。最后令平滑和非退化参数消失，通过弱紧性、局部强收敛及边界数据恢复原解的局部估计。
techniques: 退化/奇异空间权的双尺度分离

analyses.title: Dimension free weak-type endpoint estimates for the vectors of the Dunkl--Riesz transform
analyses.abstract: Let $R\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ be a reduced root system, $G$ the associated finite reflection group, and $k\ge0$ a $G$-invariant multiplicity function. We develop a Dunkl analogue of the obstacle/partial-balayage method of Ouyang, Spector, and Stockdale (https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.18068) for the Euclidean fractional Laplacian. For $0<s<2$, nonnegative $f\in L^1(ν_k)\cap L^2(ν_k)$, and $λ>0$, we obtain a decomposition \[ f=μ+(-Δ_k)^{s/2}u, \qquad 0\leμ\leλ, \] with $μ=λ$ on $Ω=\{u>0\}$ and \[ λν_k(Ω)\le\|f\|_{L^1(ν_k)}. \] As an application, we prove that the vector Dunkl--Riesz transform $\mathcal R_k=\nabla_k(-Δ_k)^{-1/2}$ is of weak type $(1,1)$ with constant at most $(M_k+2)$, where \[ M_k=\#\{α\in R_+:k(α)>0\}. \] For $G$-invariant functions, the reflection terms vanish and the same argument gives the universal constant $2$. We further establish a dimension-free weak-type $(1,1)$ estimate for the Dunkl--Schrödinger Riesz transform.
analyses.workSummary: 本文把 Ouyang–Spector–Stockdale 的 obstacle/partial-balayage 思路推广到 Dunkl 分数 Laplacian。对非负 $f\in L^{1}(\nu k)\cap L^{2}(\nu k)$，作者在 $0\le v\le \lambda $ 的凸集上最小化分数 Dunkl 能量减去 ∫fv 和 $\lambda ∫v$，先用正跳核表示、Markov 性质和 $L^{1}–$能量插值得到 coercivity，再以弱紧性取得唯一障碍势 u。Euler–Lagrange 关系在接触区 {u>0} 给出余量 $\mu =\lambda $，且 Dunkl 反射项使自然梯度只在反射扩张 $\Omega ♯$ 外消失。最后把 $\mu $ 与 $A_k^{s/2}u$ 的分解代入热半群/平方函数表示，利用 $L^{2}$ 等距和反射局部化控制超水平集，得到向量 Dunkl–Riesz 变换的弱型(1,1)常数 Mk+2；G 不变数据时反射项消失，常数降为2。
techniques: Dunkl 分数能量的正对称跳核表示
障碍泛函的 coercivity 与严格凸性
弱紧性和 Euler–Lagrange 接触条件

analyses.breakthrough: 论文获得了对任意根系和非负重数的向量 Dunkl–Riesz 变换维数无关弱型端点界，常数显式为 Mk+2；在 G 不变子空间上反射损失完全消失，恢复普适常数2，并同时给出 Dunkl 障碍分解。
analyses.limitations: 一般数据的 Mk+2 上界未被声称最优，反射扩张是方法带来的损失；分解要求 $f\in L^{1}\cap L^{2}、0<s<2$ 和非负障碍上界 $\lambda ，G$ 不变的常数2 只适用于对称数据。结果基于固定 Euclidean 根系、Dunkl 测度和全空间算子，不直接覆盖非对称势、有限域或端点 $s=2$。

steps.route: Proposition 2.1 将 $E_{k,s}$ 写为 $J_{k,s}(x,y)\ge 0$ 的双积分；非负函数不交支持时交互项非正，1-Lipschitz 截断不增能量，因而正负部分和障碍截断仍在能量空间并可用于变分比较。

analyses.title: Planar Gross--Pitaevskii traveling waves at every subsonic speed
analyses.abstract: For every subsonic speed $c\in(0,\sqrt2)$, we prove the existence of a finite-energy traveling wave for the planar Gross--Pitaevskii equation. This resolves the longstanding problem of the existence of prescribed-speed traveling-wave solutions in two dimensions, explicitly stated as open by Mariş (Ann. of Math., 2013) and Bellazzini and Ruiz (Amer. J. Math., 2023). The proof relies essentially on the energy estimate \begin{equation*} E(ψ)\le C_J\bigl(I_c(ψ)+\ind(ψ)\bigr), \qquad c\in J, \end{equation*} where $E$ is the energy, $I_c$ the action at speed $c$, $\ind$ the real Morse index, $J$ is any compact interval contained in $(0,\sqrt2)$, and $C_J$ is a positive constant depending only on $J$. We also prove finite-bubble compactness, including splitting of the energy, action, potential energy, and momentum, and attainment of the action among nonconstant waves of Morse index at most one.
analyses.workSummary: 本文解决二维 Gross–Pitaevskii 行波的预定速度问题。作者把有限能量行波的二维方程沿水平线切片为带横向残差的复值一维方程，先用一维精确解的刚性和固定长度 cell 分类，把横向能量、残差、负方向与几何增长分别记账；再用 Morse 指标限制负 cell 的总数，得到 $E(\psi )\le C_J(I_c(\psi )+ind(\psi ))$。这个估计控制了几乎处处速度序列的能量逃逸，结合局部非消失和 Fatou 极限，遂把 Bellazzini–Ruiz 的几乎处处存在提升到每个 $0<c<\sqrt 2$，并进一步证明有限 bubble 分解和指标至多一的最小作用量波。

一维稳定解刚性和固定长度 cell 分类

Morse 指标与不交负测试函数计数

analyses.breakthrough: 关键新结论是对任意有限 Morse 指标的二维行波建立统一能量估计，完全不要求零点数量、拓扑度或零点位置受控；因此排除了预定速度逼近序列中能量向无穷远逃逸的缺口，首次覆盖整个次声速区间。
analyses.limitations: 论证在平面 $R^{2}$、归一化有限能量解以及严格次声速 $c\in (0,\sqrt 2)$ 内进行，常数依赖速度的紧子区间；存在性沿用已有几乎处处速度解和非消失结果，未覆盖声速端点、超声速、一般维数或唯一性/动力学稳定性。

analyses.title: A growth gap for anisotropic minimal graphs
analyses.abstract: We prove a growth gap for the gradient of entire anisotropic minimal graphs. For each $n\geq2$ and each smooth uniformly elliptic parametric integrand $Φ$ on $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$, there is an exponent $α=α(n,Φ)>0$ such that every smooth nonaffine entire $Φ$-minimal graph $u:\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}$ satisfies $\sup_{B_R^n}|Du|\geq cR^α$ for all $R\geq R_0$, for some constants $c>0$ and $R_0<\infty$ depending on the solution. In particular, gradient growth $o(R^α)$ forces flatness, resolving a conjecture of Mooney and the author. The result holds in every dimension, without any assumption that $Φ$ is close to the Euclidean area integrand.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究一般光滑、正一齐次且一致椭圆的各向异性最小图。作者先把整个图的下方集通过校准转成全局各向异性周长极小集，再建立 Jacobi 场与其倒数满足的椭圆不等式。均值估计排除归一化次解把最大值集中到零测集，墙刚性和极小边界紧性把任何退化极限识别为半空间；由此证明倒数竖直 Jacobi 场在固定尺度上要么由中心值控制、要么在放大半径后至少翻倍。迭代这个比较得到梯度的幂次增长间隙，低于该幂次的整个图只能是仿射。
techniques: 校准与全局各向异性周长最小性
各向异性 Jacobi 方程和倒数次解
Sobolev/Moser 均值估计
墙接触刚性与极小边界紧性
固定尺度倍增迭代与 Liouville 结论
analyses.breakthrough: 论文在不要求 integrand 接近欧氏面积、也不要求偶对称的条件下，给出所有维数统一的梯度增长间隙：非仿射整个图必有 $sup_{B_R}|Du|\ge cR^\alpha $。证明把奇异极限处的最大值集恢复和墙刚性结合起来，得到此前缺少的固定尺度倍增机制。
analyses.limitations: 结果要求图光滑、参数 integrand 固定且光滑正一齐次并一致椭圆$；\alpha $仅由紧性论证存在，未给出有效数值、最优值或接近面积 integrand 时的定量行为。二维情形调用已有 Bernstein 定理，本文新紧性机制的非平凡范围主要是 $n\ge 3$，且不处理非光滑图或一般极小流。

steps.claim: 整个光滑各向异性最小图的下方集是全局各向异性周长极小集，其边界的倒数竖直 Jacobi 场 v满足 $Lv\ge Qv\ge 0$。

analyses.title: Non-uniqueness for the Complex Ginzburg-Landau Equation
analyses.abstract: We show that singularities of the three-dimensional cubic complex Ginzburg-Landau equation developing from smooth initial data can induce non-uniqueness of solutions after the time of blowup. The solutions we study start as backward self-similar solutions, and the source of the non-uniqueness is an unstable eigenvalue of the linearization around the forward self-similar profile generated by the singularity. We establish the existence of this eigenvalue, and hence the non-uniqueness, by a computer-assisted proof for specific values of the parameters in the equation. The work is in part motivated by similarities to conjectured behavior for the Navier-Stokes equation, with which the complex Ginzburg-Landau equation shares several important properties, such as an energy inequality and the scaling symmetry.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究三维立方复 Ginzburg–Landau 方程在奇异时间后的非唯一延拓。作者先以径向常微分方程和区间 Newton 方法构造 backward 自相似剖面 Q，再匹配具有相同无穷远主项的 forward 剖面 Q̂；对 Q̂ 的线性化算子把谱问题写成零点函数 $H(\lambda )$，用解析性、区间包围和绕数一证明存在正实部不稳定特征值。随后在加权 $H^{2}$ 空间将线性化半群分解为稳定/不稳定子空间，以 Duhamel 映射压缩构造衰减但非零的扰动 $\phi $；缩放回原变量后，未扰动 forward 解与含 $\phi $ 的解在 $t=0$ 具有同一初值，却在 t>0 不同，并满足局部适定弱解性质。

analyses.title: The entropy production is not always monotone for the Kac equation
analyses.abstract: In 1966, McKean conjectured that the entropy production of Kac's caricature of a Maxwellian gas is nonincreasing in time \cite{McKean66}. We disprove this conjecture for the standard uniform-angle Kac equation. Our counterexamples are smooth, strictly positive, even mixtures of two Gaussians at different temperatures. We also show that every entropy derivative beyond the first violates its expected sign at some time along the same solution. The initial densities can be chosen with unit mass and second moment. mass and second moment.
analyses.workSummary: 本文考察均匀散射角的一维 Kac 方程，构造出熵产生导数反号的光滑反例。初值是两个不同温度的 Maxwell 高斯混合 $f_R=(1-p)M_1+pM_R$；作者先用高斯碰撞增益公式把解表示为温度测度的混合，保证全局光滑正密度并允许逐次求导。熵产生导数的精确公式含有负的 $Q^{2}/f$ 项和碰撞算子对数项，后者再通过 $G_R、A_R$ 与两次高斯卷积化为可估计平均。一个单温度邻域贡献 $\Lambda _R\approx (1/2)log R$，而其他温度项消失，得到 $Ḋ(f_R)=p(1-p)(1-2p)log$ $R+O_p(1)$，并用熵有界性推出所有更高阶预期交替符号也会在某个正时间失败。

analyses.title: An Inverse Problem for Determining the Piston Speed from a Given Lipschitz Leading Shock
analyses.abstract: We analyze an inverse problem for determining the piston speed and the associated flow field from a prescribed leading shock and the initial data in a shock tube. The gas flow is described by the isentropic Euler equations (i.e., the $p$-system), while the trajectory of the leading shock is prescribed as a given Lipschitz curve. Under an Oleĭnik-type entropy condition on the leading shock, we develop a modified wavefront tracking scheme to construct the flow field behind the shock. This construction enables us to determine the corresponding piston speed and the associated flow field.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究一维等熵 Euler p-system 的逆活塞问题：给定小 BV 扰动的 Lipschitz 领先激波轨迹和初始静止气体，反推出活塞速度及激波后的熵解流场。作者围绕领先激波后的参考状态建立两族波曲线和 forward-backward Riemann 解，将激波速度的变化转成小的 1、2 族弱波。再用带总弱波强度、相互作用乘积和活塞速度变差项的 Glimm 型泛函控制波相互作用；Oleinik 型速度条件确保反向稀疏波强度衰减，同族波前通过特征线距离估计保持分离。离散参数趋零后，近似流场在局部 L1 收敛、活塞速度在 BV 中收敛，得到满足熵条件的逆问题解和速度稳定性估计。

analyses.title: Non-decaying weak solutions to the 2D quasi-geostrophic equations
analyses.abstract: We investigate weak solutions to the two-dimensional quasi-geostrophic equations without dissipation. We establish global existence of weak solutions for temperature bounded and lacking spatial decay and velocity in the space $L^2_{ul}(\mathbb{R}^2)$. Our methods rely on a spectral Serfati identity, which we use to establish uniform $L^2_{ul}$ bounds on a sequence of velocities satisfying the dissipative equations. These bounds, combined with a maximum principle on the scalar temperature, allow us to pass to the zero-dissipation limit, giving global-in-time weak solutions.
analyses.workSummary: 本文在温度有界、速度仅具有 uniformly local $L^{2}$ 控制且不衰减的框架下，构造二维无耗散 SQG 的全局弱解。作者先对黏性 SQG 解做 Littlewood–Paley 低/高频分解，推导频率版 Serfati 恒等式，把低频输运项、高频核项和黏性项分别控制，得到与黏性参数无关的 $L^{2}_ul$ 速度界。随后对初值做低频平滑，取 $\nu \to 0$ 的光滑解子列；最大原理给出温度 $L\infty $ 界，弱星紧性和时间测试函数估计给出候选极限。最关键的非线性项收敛通过固定频带、截断高频尾和核的 $L^{1}/$衰减估计完成，最后恢复齐次 constitutive law、散度约束和 Serfati 恒等式。

analyses.title: Local Well-Posedness of the Boundary Layer Equations for Dilatant Power-Law Fluids
analyses.abstract: We establish the local-in-time existence and uniqueness of monotone solutions to the two-dimensional nonstationary boundary-layer equations for a dilatant power-law fluid in a periodic half-space for $1<n<\frac{7}{3}$. Under Oleinik's monotonicity condition and suitable weighted Sobolev assumptions on the initial data and outer flow, we construct solutions through tangential regularization and derive uniform a priori estimates. A suitable good unknown compensates for the loss of one tangential derivative caused by the normal velocity. By combining weighted energy estimates, the Faà di Bruno formula, and the maximum and minimum principles, we control the nonlinear degenerate diffusion term $\partial_y^2(ω^n)$, whose effective diffusion coefficient vanishes as $ω=\partial_yu$ decays at infinity, and propagate the weighted monotonicity of the vorticity. Within this exponent range, our result partially resolves the eleventh open problem posed by Oleinik and Samokhin \cite{OAO} on the existence and uniqueness of solutions to nonstationary boundary-layer systems for dilatant fluids.
analyses.workSummary: 本文证明周期半空间中稀释型幂律流体二维非定常边界层方程的局部存在唯一性。对满足 Oleinik 单调性 $\partial _y$ u>0 的解，作者把非线性扩散写成退化系数 $n\omega ^{n-1}\partial _y^{2}\omega $，并加入小切向黏性 $\epsilon ^{2}\partial _x^{2}$ 构造正则化系统。法向导数使用加权能量估计，纯切向最高阶导数因法向速度 $v=-\partial _y^{-1}\partial _x u$ 产生导数损失，于是引入 good unknown $g^s_\epsilon =\partial _x^s\omega _\epsilon -(\partial _y\omega _\epsilon /\omega _\epsilon )\partial _x^s(u_\epsilon -U)$ 消除主损失。配合 Faà di Bruno 展开、边界兼容性、最大/最小值原理，得到独立于 $\epsilon $ 的加权 Sobolev 和单调性界；Aubin–Lions 极限给出原方程，最后对差解用通量平均线性化和 ḡ 能量不等式证明唯一性。

加权法向能量估计

analyses.title: Rotating vortex patches: rigidity, bifurcation, and unified structures
analyses.abstract: This monograph presents a systematic account of several classical and recent developments in the theory of rotating vortex patches, or V-states, for the two-dimensional Euler equations and related active scalar models. Its purpose is both expository and structural: we revisit some of the foundational results of the subject, provide detailed proofs and alternative formulations, and present more recent results within a common analytical framework. We begin with Euler vortex patches and the contour dynamics formulation of rigidly rotating solutions. We then develop two complementary approaches to the V-state equation, based on Cauchy integrals and conformal mappings, and discuss their connections with potential theory and Faber polynomials. These tools are used to revisit classical examples, including Rankine vortices and Kirchhoff ellipses, as well as rigidity and classification results. A substantial part is devoted to Burbea construction of noncircular V-states via bifurcation theory. The final part develops a unified approach to rotating patches for a broad class of incompressible active scalar equations. Structural properties of the interaction kernel, in particular complete monotonicity and the resulting spectral factorization, yield a common bifurcation framework encompassing the Euler, generalized surface quasi-geostrophic, quasi-geostrophic shallow-water, and related models.
analyses.workSummary: 这部专著系统整理二维 Euler 旋转涡斑和相关 active scalar 的 V-state 理论。前半部分从 Cauchy–Pompeiu/Plemelj 公式和外部共形映射出发，把刚性旋转边界方程改写为 Cauchy 积分、Faber 多项式和边界泛函；由此给出椭圆刻画、角速度刚性及 Burbea m 重对称分支的 Hölder/解析正则性证明。后半部分把相同构造推广到一类径向相互作用核：完全单调性先通过 Bernstein 表示把线性化 Fourier 系数因子化为通用函数 $ϕ_n$ 的积分，再用二阶 ODE 比较原理证明 $ϕ_n$、谱系数的正性和严格递减，从而确定简单核、Fredholm 指数零与横截性，最后再次应用 Crandall–Rabinowitz 得到各 m 的局部分支。

analyses.limitations: 主要结论是单连通圆盘附近的局部分岔与特定角速度刚性，全球分支、角点/自接触极限、多连通涡斑和时间准周期动力学仍列为开放方向。统一理论依赖径向核的完全单调性及相应正则性，未覆盖不满足该结构的 active scalar；专著也不声称分岔指数或全局几何的统一定量描述。

analyses.title: Polynomial mixing for the 3D damped cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation with degenerate noise
analyses.abstract: We prove polynomial mixing for the defocusing damped cubic stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the three-dimensional torus under saturating smooth finite rank Brownian forcing. The mixing rate is measured in the $p$-Wasserstein metric induced by the $H^1$ distance for every $1\le p<\infty$. We also obtain sharp geometric characterizations of saturation. The proof is based on a polynomial mixing criterion built on a stable--compact decomposition of the exact solution differences with polynomial moment control of the logarithmic path amplification. Dense Malliavin range allows the compact defect to be compensated by finite-dimensional Cameron--Martin shifts, producing a block multiplier with negative mean logarithm. A logarithmic transportation gauge, combined with a renewal--reset coupling scheme, then yields mixing at every prescribed polynomial order in the weaker $L^2$ distance. A stationary regularity gain to $H^{2-}$ then enables us to upgrade the convergence to $H^1$.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究三维环面上的 defocusing damped cubic stochastic NLS，在噪声仅作用于有限个光滑空间剖面的退化情形下建立任意阶多项式混合。作者先对精确解差构造 Bogoliubov 型 stable–compact 分解，将不可收缩部分压缩为紧缺陷；再用终点 Malliavin 导数的稠密值域以有限维 Cameron–Martin 位移补偿该缺陷，得到平均对数收缩。统一不可约性提供重置，抽象判据把局部负对数漂移转为任意多项式速度；最后用平稳四波恒等式得到 $H^{2-}$ 正则性，把 $L^{2}$ 耦合提升到 $H^{1}$ Wasserstein。

analyses.title: MIT bag model and infinite mass limit in non-smooth domains
analyses.abstract: The work is devoted to the study of Dirac operators with MIT bag boundary conditions in Euclidean domains with compact Lipschitz boundaries in arbitrary dimensions. It is shown that such operators are self-adjoint on suitable definition domains and can be recovered as the norm-resolvent limits of Dirac operators in the whole space with a large mass term outside the domain, under the assumption that an associated Robin-Laplacian eigenvalue has a prescribed asymptotic behavior with respect to a parameter in the boundary condition. This assumption is shown to hold for a class of non-smooth domains, which includes convex domains and, more generally, domains that can be "locally convexified" by suitable diffeomorphisms. To the best of our knowledge, this represents the first infinite mass interpretation for the MIT bag model in the sense of resolvent convergence for non-smooth domains. Most results are extended to the generalized MIT bag boundary conditions with the help of the recently established congruence transform.

analyses.title: Polynomial mixing for the weakly damped stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the whole space
analyses.abstract: We consider the weakly damped stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS) equation on the real line, driven by a noise that is white in time and smooth in space. Assuming that the noise is sufficiently non-degenerate, we prove that the equation has a unique stationary measure in the class of probability measures concentrated on $H^2$, and establish polynomial mixing in the dual-Lipschitz metric over $H^1$. We do not impose any restriction on the size of the damping. The proof is based on a coupling argument, whose key ingredient is a Foiaş-Prodi-type estimate in the $H^1$-norm, derived by means of a Lyapunov functional adapted to the linearized NLS dynamics. To compensate for the loss of compactness, we combine this estimate with a truncated Poincaré inequality and a space-time weight function quantifying the spatial decay of solutions.

analyses.title: Stability of Magnetizable Piezoelectric Beam Systems with Two Fractional Infinite Memory Terms
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we investigate a class of magnetizable piezoelectric beam systems with two fractional infinite memory terms, whose fractional orders are denoted by \(θ_1, θ_2 \in [0,1]\). By introducing the Dafermos history variable, we construct an augmented state space and reformulate the system as an abstract evolution equation. The well-posedness of the system is established via semigroup theory. Through a frequency-domain analysis, we characterize the asymptotic behavior of the solutions. We show that the system is exponentially stable if \(θ_1 = θ_2 = 1\), and is polynomially stable in all other cases, with the explicit decay rate \(t^{-\frac{1}{2-2θ_0}}\), where \(θ_0 = \min\{θ_1, θ_2\}\). Furthermore, the optimality of the obtained decay rate is verified.
analyses.workSummary: 论文把带两个分数阶无限记忆项的磁化压电梁抽象为含位移、速度、电位移、速度及两条历史变量的 Hilbert 空间演化方程。Dafermos 历史变量把 Volterra 记忆变为自治生成元，作者先用耗散性、Lumer–Phillips 定理和 Lax–Milgram 证明收缩 C0 半群适定；再用频域反证和分数阶插值证明当任一记忆阶低于1时的多项式衰减，并在指数型核下用谱序列验证最优性。两阶都等于1时，虚轴预解一致有界，得到指数稳定。

analyses.title: Continuation and reduction of steady vortex sheets under metric deformations on a disk
analyses.abstract: We study the local continuation of a steady vortex sheet under a prescribed deformation $g_s= e^{2σ_s}g_{\mathrm{e}}$ of a conformal metric on the unit disk. Representing the moving sheet by a normal graph, we formulate the streamline and Bernoulli conditions as a nonlinear residual whose two components have different Sobolev orders. If the two one-sided tangential velocities of the reference sheet do not vanish simultaneously, the derivative of the unnormalized residual is Fredholm of index two. Fixing the mean normal displacement and the total circulation gives an index-zero problem; when the normalization differential restricted to the unnormalized kernel is onto $\mathbb{R}^2$, we obtain a parameter-dependent Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction. This yields a locally unique normalized branch in the nondegenerate case and explicit first- and second-order necessary conditions in the degenerate case. For a rotationally symmetric reference metric and a concentric circular sheet, the linearized problem separates into Fourier blocks and only finitely many modes can be resonant. In the constant-curvature disk family, every mode $k\geq2$ is nonresonant, whereas the first mode produces a two-dimensional reduced problem. The two first-mode kernel profiles are normal traces of ambient Killing fields, but they do not generate fixed-boundary symmetries or, by themselves, a nonconcentric branch.

analyses.title: Modulated Gibbs Measure and Mean-Field Limit for 3D Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck Equations
analyses.abstract: We introduce a modulated Gibbs measure for the usual tensorized initial data for stochastic Newton's systems with singular repulsive interactions. Using the uniform-in-$N$ partition-function estimates of Wang--Zhao \cite{wang2026uniform}, we show that the modulated Gibbs measure and its tensorized reference are $O(N^{-1})$-close in normalized relative entropy. A stability argument then transfers propagation of chaos from modulated Gibbs measures to tensorized data and other initial laws at the same entropy scale. Combined with the weighted BBGKY estimates of Bresch--Jabin--Soler \cite{bresch2025new}, this yields the first cutoff-free mean-field limit and propagation of chaos for the three-dimensional Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck (VPFP) equation on an $N$-independent short-time interval.
analyses.workSummary: 论文为具有奇异排斥 Riesz 相互作用的随机 Newton 系统引入相对于给定单粒子密度的 modulated Gibbs 初始律。均匀 N 无关的配分函数界把 Gibbs 倾斜与张量积参考律之间的归一化相对熵控制在 $O(N^{-1})；modulated$ free energy 的演化恒等式把该控制传给带速度扩散的 N 粒子方程。作者用熵稳定性和 Donsker–Varadhan 不等式先把 Gibbs 初律的 chaos 转移到一般熵相近初律，再调用加权 BBGKY 估计，得到三维无截断 VPFP 在 N 无关短时间内的 mean-field limit。

analyses.title: On the cost of reaching an attainable state for the boundary-controlled 1-D heat equation
analyses.abstract: We consider the heat equation in an interval of the real line, with null initial condition, and Dirichlet boundary controls. We study the cost of reaching an attainable state at some time $T>0$. Precisely, given a state in the interval that we know is reachable by suitable boundary controls, we estimate the size of the smallest controls that reach it, in terms of an appropriate norm of this state. Our estimate is optimal in some sense as the time horizon goes to $0$.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究一维区间上零初值、两端 Dirichlet 边界控制热方程的可达状态控制代价。作者利用已知可达空间等于菱形复域上的 Bergman 函数限制，把控制构造转化为两个复域 Bergman 空间在重叠正方形上的分离问题。核心是对加权限制算子的伴随建立带 $exp(\kappa *L^{2}/T)$ 的下界：先解无界象限/菱形上的 Poisson 方程并控制分离奇点，再通过 Aikawa–Hayashi–Saitoh 积分变换把两份全纯函数还原成边界热控制，得到任意可达目标的快速时间控制代价，并进一步推出零可控估计。

analyses.title: Nonlinear profiles on solutions to the surface quasi-geostrophic equation
analyses.abstract: The quasi-geostrophic equation is well known as a model for predicting potential temperature around low-pressure systems in high-latitude regions. When diffusion effects are added to this equation, it serves as a model for potential temperature at the sea surface. In either case, the nonlinear term represents the effect of the Coriolis force. This paper yields nonlinear profile in solutions to the surface quasi-geostrophic equation. This profile is determined uniquely from the perspective of large-time behavior of solutions. Components of solutions are arranged sequentially from slow to fast decay based on the parabolic scale. Then such an expansion is determined uniquely. Since the equation is subcritical in the context of large-time effects, the main components exhibit linear features. Nonlinear characteristics appear in components that have a smaller effect on solutions. From the perspective of the correlation between spacetime variables, nonlinear profiles exhibit characteristics that are distinctly different from those of linear profiles. Moreover, the nonlinear effects of this equation are expected to be weaker than those of other equations with the same scale due to their spatial structure. The main theorem publishes minute, but unique rotational flow arising from the Coriolis force.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究二维耗散表面准地转方程 $\theta t+R⊥\theta \cdot \nabla \theta =\Delta \theta $ 的大时间展开。在线性热核轮廓 $\Theta _{0}、\Theta _{1}、\Theta _{2}、\Theta _{3}$ 之外，作者从非线性卷积中提取一个具有旋转结构的三阶 profile $J3=J3L+J3H$；其中低频部分表现为二阶热核导数，高频部分由含时间积分和 resolvent 型核的非局部表达给出。通过 Riesz 变换加权估计、时间卷积分解、矩消去和重整化，证明在 $|x|^{3}$ 初始矩有限时余项达到 $o(t^{-\gamma q-3/2})$，再增加四阶矩得到 $O(t^{-\gamma q-2}log$ t) 误差。

analyses.title: A model of a multiphase medium based on the closure of moment chains for the Vlasov-Poisson equations
analyses.abstract: We propose a method for closing moment chains for the Vlasov-Poisson kinetic system (the Landau fluid model), which yields a hyperbolic system of equations at each subsequent step. This system is interpreted as a multicomponent medium, where each component has its own density, velocity, and pressure. The coupling between the components is mediated by an electric field. The principle of closing moment chains is that the final component of the fluid is assumed to be pressureless.
analyses.workSummary: 论文提出一维无碰撞 Vlasov–Poisson 方程的 Landau-fluid 多相矩链闭合。作者从动理学方程导出所有 Hamburger 矩方程，在奇数阶 $j=2k-1$ 处令 Hölder 不等式取等价条件 $(M_j)^2=M_{j-1}M_{j+1}$，从而递归表达更高矩。闭合矩系统具有一个重复特征值和零特征值，随后改写成 k 个密度/速度/压力组分通过电场耦合的守恒形式，并证明后续矩方程成为前面系统的结果。文末用冷等离子体、双流体热流和高斯分布说明不同闭合层级的含义。
techniques: Vlasov–Poisson 矩方程积分
Hölder 等号条件闭合
矩变量到多相密度/速度/压力变量的变换
非严格双曲矩阵谱计算
守恒律与分布假设下的示例闭合
analyses.breakthrough: 提出一种可在任意奇数阶闭合、保持非严格双曲结构且让后续矩方程成为逻辑后果的多相 Landau-fluid 模型；最后一个组分自然呈现为无压力介质，给出从动理学矩链到多相守恒系统的统一解释。
analyses.limitations: 这是基于矩链等号假设的模型构造，论文不证明该闭合系统逼近原 Vlasov–Poisson 解，也不分析闭合系统的完整适定性、稳定性或 Landau 阻尼；多相变量中的高阶“密度/速度”具有模型含义，未必对应真实粒子相。

steps.claim: Vlasov–Poisson 方程的矩满足递推方程 (2)，其中第 i 阶方程依赖 $M_{i+1}$。
steps.route: 将动理学输运方程乘以 $v^i$ 后对速度积分，速度导数项分部产生 $-iEM_{i-1}$，空间输运产生 $M_{i+1}$ 的通量，因此得到未闭合矩链。

steps.claim: 在任一奇数闭合阶 $j=2k-1，Hölder$ 等号给出 $M_{j+i}=M_j^i/M_{j-1}^{i-1}$ 的递归闭合。
steps.route: Hölder 不等式给出 $(M_{2k-1})^{2}\le M_{2k}M_{2k-2}$；取等价条件使 $\lambda _j=0$，并把同一等价关系递归施加到更高矩，得到公式(4)，所以 j 之后的矩方程由低阶系统推出。

steps.claim: 闭合矩通量矩阵的谱由一个二重特征值 $M_j/M_{j-1}$ 与 j−1 重零特征值构成。
steps.route: 矩阵前 j 行是移位结构，最后一行只含 $M_j/M_{j-1}$ 与 $-M_j^{2}/M_{j-1}^{2}$ 两个系数；对该 companion-like 矩阵直接计算特征多项式即可得到两个不同实特征值，其中非零值重数为2。

steps.claim: 闭合系统可写成 k 个相互通过电场耦合的流体组分，并保留无限守恒律。
steps.route: 定义 $n_i=M_{2i-2}$, $U_i=M_{2i-1}/M_{2i-2}$, $P_i=n_{i+1}-n_iU_i^{2}$，把矩方程逐项改写为质量和动量守恒式；闭合条件恰好令末组分 $P_k=0$，再用矩方程与 $E_t+U_1E_x=U_1$ 组合出两族守恒律。

analyses.title: Ill-Posedness of the Euler Equations Linearized around Homogeneous Steady States
analyses.abstract: Let $L^2_m(\mathbb{R}^2)$ be the space of square-integrable functions on $\mathbb{R}^2$ with $m$-fold rotational symmetry. Let $\overlineω(r,θ) = r^{-α}f(θ)$ be a homogeneous steady state of the two-dimensional incompressible Euler equations with $(m\cdot l)$-fold rotational symmetry. If $f(θ)$ is a constant function we say that $\overlineω$ is a radial power-law vortex. We prove that the incompressible Euler equations in vorticity form, linearized around any homogeneous steady state $\overlineω$ that is not a radial power-law vortex, are ill-posed on $L^2_m(\mathbb{R}^2)$ for any $m\geq 2$, any $l\geq 1$ and $α\in (0,1)$.
analyses.workSummary: 论文考察二维不可压 Euler 涡量方程在非径向幂律齐次稳态附近的线性化。对于 $\alpha \in (0,1)、m-fold$ 对称扰动和背景的 (m·l)-fold 对称性，作者将线性化写成输运算子 L0 加 Biot–Savart 非局部项 K。齐次流函数在奇异射线上有简单零点，使背景涡量角向奇异；作者先构造适配的局部 X/Y 空间与射线迹定理，证明 K 的定义域落在严格闭子空间，随后用径向积分把 $Lϕ\omega \in L^{2}$ 转为一个角变量分布方程，显示若速度迹不为零则解必有不可积奇异，从而 Lϕ 的最大定义域不稠密，线性 Cauchy 问题不适定。
techniques: 齐次 Euler 稳态的极坐标结构
Biot–Savart 映射的局部 Sobolev 控制
射线迹算子 X→Y
奇异射线角向分布方程
非稠密定义域与 C0 半群生成判据
analyses.breakthrough: 证明所有非径向幂律的齐次稳态在指定对称 $L^{2}$ 空间上的 Euler 线性化都因定义域不稠密而不适定，明确把 ill-posedness 归因于奇异射线上的速度迹障碍，并排除了将这些稳态用于 Vishik 非唯一性机制的路径。
analyses.limitations: 结论限于 $\alpha \in (0,1)、m\ge 2$ 及背景具有 (m·l)-fold 对称且扰动位于 $L^{2}_m$；端点 $\alpha =1、\alpha >1$ 的分布解释以及完全去除对称限制均未处理。径向幂律涡旋和 $\alpha =3/2$ 的椭圆族也不在结论内。

steps.claim: 非径向齐次稳态在 $\alpha \in (0,1)$ 的奇异射线附近具有角函数 g 的简单零点，涡量因而产生不可积的导数奇异。
steps.route: 齐次流函数写成 $r^{2-\alpha }g(\theta )$，稳态方程给出 $f=(1-\alpha )B$ $g^{-\alpha /(2-\alpha )}/(2-\alpha )$；分类结果保证非径向背景有零射线$，\alpha \in (0,1)$ 时该零点简单，故 f′ 的奇异阶强于 f。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5–6页公式(2)–(4)及关于简单零点的论述。

steps.claim: Biot–Savart 非局部项 K 的定义域不稠密于 $L^{2}_m$。
steps.route: 把 $K\omega $ 在极坐标写成 $r^{-1-\alpha }(f'v\theta -\alpha fvr)$，比较 g、f 和 f′ 在奇异角度的幂次；若该奇异性可消去，则必有角速度迹在射线上为零。Biot–Savart 映射到 X 加射线迹 X→Y 连续，于是 D(K) 落在严格闭子空间 ker(T∘KBS*)。
steps.evidence: PDF 第7页 Proposition 3.1；PDF 第8–10页 Proposition 3.3 与 Lemma 3.2，尤其公式(5)–(7)。

steps.claim: 若线性化 $Lϕ\omega =L0\omega +K\omega $ 属于 $L^{2}$，则速度角分量在每条奇异射线上的迹必须为零。
steps.route: 假设存在非零速度迹，选径向测试函数 ϕ 并把极坐标方程(8)乘以 rϕ 后积分，定义 W,A,H,U,V 五个角函数；分部积分把问题化为 $g'A-(2-\alpha )gW'-f'V+\alpha fU=H$，再利用 $V(\theta _{0})\ne 0$ 提取主奇异项。
steps.evidence: PDF 第10–11页 Lemma 3.4 及公式(8)–(9)。

steps.claim: 上述角向分布方程迫使 $W\notin L^{2}$，产生矛盾，因此 Lϕ 最大定义域不稠密并且线性问题不适定。
steps.route: 在简单零点坐标 $x=\theta -\theta _{0}$ 下，方程化为 $xB'(x)=I(x)-V(\theta _{0})x^{-2/(2-\alpha )}$；将其从 x 积分到固定端点$，L^{2}$ 的 I 只能产生 $x^{-1/2}$ 型可控项，而非零 V 项强迫 $B(x)~x^{-2/(2-\alpha )}$。由于指数小于−1，B 不在 $L^{2}$，排除非零迹；稠密性随即失败，不能生成强连续半群。
steps.evidence: PDF 第11–12页公式(9)后的渐近积分论证及 Theorem 1.1（PDF 第4页）。

analyses.title: Large-time behavior of solutions to bipolar Euler-Poisson equations with space-dependent damping
analyses.abstract: This paper is concerned with the Cauchy problem for the one-dimensional bipolar Euler-Poisson equations with space-dependent damping, which arise in the hydrodynamic model of semiconductors. Notably, the two pressure functions are allowed to be different, and the doping profile is nonzero. By means of the time-weighted energy method with carefully chosen weights, we prove that if the initial perturbation around a constant steady-state is small enough, the Cauchy problem admits a unique global smooth solution, which converges to the constant steady-state at algebraic decay rates. We show that the decay rates coincide with those established for the constant-coefficients damping case, thereby overcoming the influence of spatially dependent damping on the decay rates of the solutions. A key feature is that no smallness of the space-dependent damping coefficients is required.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究带空间依赖阻尼的一维双极 Euler–Poisson 半导体模型。两种压力函数允许不同，掺杂剖面取常数，阻尼系数 $\alpha _i(x)$ 仅要求正、有界并趋向同一正常数，且其偏离与导数满足 $H^{1}/L^{1}/L\infty $ 控制。作者先从远场 ODE 识别电流的指数尾部，构造紧支撑修正 (n̂,Ĵ) 消除由非零远场电流造成的 $L^{2}$ gap；再以密度扰动的反导数 $N_i$ 和电场 E 建立强耦合二阶系统。三组时间权重能量估计分别控制低阶、时间导数和高阶空间导数，Gronwall 闭合小数据延拓，最终得到全局光滑解及与常系数情形相同的代数衰减。

紧支撑质量/电流修正
密度扰动反导数变量
时间加权高阶能量法

analyses.breakthrough: 在不要求空间阻尼系数小的条件下，证明双极 Euler–Poisson 方程受空间依赖阻尼影响时仍保持常系数阻尼的代数衰减指数：密度和电场为 $(1+t)^{-3/4}$，电流为 $(1+t)^{-5/4}$。
analyses.limitations: 结论要求平坦常掺杂 $D(x)=D̂$、压力函数 $C^{3}$ 且严格递增、两端阻尼趋向同一正常数，并且初始扰动及远场电流足够小；非平坦掺杂会带来未处理的能量障碍。结果是在一维全空间小数据框架下，未覆盖大数据、边界域或不同远场阻尼极限。

steps.route: 在 $x\to \pm \infty $ 处令空间导数消失，连续性方程固定 $n_i^\pm =ñ_i$；动量方程与 Poisson 积分给出 $J_i^\pm 、E^\pm $ 的 ODE，零质量差使 $E^+$初值和导数为零，故 $E^+≡0、J_i^\pm =J̃e^{-\alpha ̄t}$。

analyses.title: The periodic Wulff problem in two dimensions
analyses.abstract: We characterize the minimizers of the anisotropic perimeter in the flat torus under an area constraint. We show that, depending on the area, the periodic global minimizer undergoes two phase transitions, changing from a droplet (a rescaled Wulff shape) to a flat band wrapping around the torus in a preferred direction determined by the anisotropy (lamellar phase), and finally to a bubble (the complement of a rescaled Wulff shape). For certain non-symmetric surface tensions, the lamellar phase is absent altogether; for other non regular surface tensions, there exist infinitely many minimizing configurations coexisting with the lamellar phase.
analyses.workSummary: 论文完整刻画二维平坦环面上给定面积的各向异性周期 Wulff 问题。用 Wulff 形 K 的格宽 w(K) 和临界面积 $\alpha (K)=w(K)^2/(4|K|)$，作者证明小面积最小集是缩放 Wulff 形，中间面积是由最优整数方向决定的斜向条带，大面积是反向缩放 Wulff 形的补集；当 $\alpha (K)>1/2$ 时条带相变区消失。对均匀椭圆表面张力，正则性和各向异性平均曲率先迫使边界曲率恒号，再按凸集、平行线分类；一般张力通过统一椭圆近似与 BV 紧性传递存在性。非椭圆情形可能出现额外甚至无限多个最小构型。
techniques: 各向异性 Wulff 不等式
格宽与 Minkowski/几何数论估计
有限周长集的一阶变分与曲率符号
均匀椭圆正则性
表面张力统一椭圆逼近与 BV 紧性
analyses.breakthrough: 给出任意二维表面张力下周期 Wulff 最小值的三相面积公式，并识别晶格方向决定的层状相变；同时明确区分均匀椭圆情形的唯一性与非正则张力下额外无限最小构型的可能性。
analyses.limitations: 对一般非均匀椭圆表面张力，论文证明列出的构型确为最小者，但不声称它们穷尽全部最小者；唯一性仅在 uniformly elliptic 条件下成立。结果限于二维平坦环面和各向异性周长，Ohta–Kawasaki 应用只覆盖小 $\gamma $ 且层状相唯一的情形。

steps.claim: 缩放 Wulff 形、斜向层状集和补集的各向异性周长分别是 $2\sqrt (M|K|)、w(K)$ 和 $2\sqrt ((1-M)|K|)$。
steps.route: 用 Wulff 不等式计算平面缩放 K 的周长，用整数方向 z 的环面直线长度 |z| 计算层状集边界周长 ϕ(z)+ϕ(−z)，再对 z 取最小得到格宽；补集通过反射张力 $ϕ̃(x)=ϕ(-x)$ 把面积 M 转为 1−M。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2–3页公式(1.3)–(1.6)；PDF 第13–14页 Definition 3.2、公式(3.1)–(3.6)。

steps.claim: 均匀椭圆张力下任一最小集的边界为 $C^{2}$，且欧氏曲率恒号。
steps.route: 先用平面各向异性周长最小者的 $C^{1}$ 正则性，再对局部图函数做保面积一阶变分，得到 $\partial _{2}ϕ(-u',1)$ 的导数等于常数；椭圆性保证该方程可解为 $C^{2}$，并使 u″ 的符号固定，从而全边界欧氏曲率恒号。

analyses.title: Gradient flow approach to Landau equation: A cross-product structure
analyses.abstract: We introduce a cross-product Landau gradient that commutes with Gaussian mollification. For the hard-potential interaction kernels of the form $A(|v-v_*|)\sim \langle v-v_*\rangle^γ|v-v_*|^2$ with $γ\in(-\infty,1]$, this construction yields a variational characterisation of the gradient-flow structure of the spatially homogeneous Landau equation. The cross-product gradient induces the same gradient-flow geometry as that introduced by Carrillo, Delgadino, Desvillettes and Wu (2024), while providing a different representation of the Landau gradient. The main advantage of this formulation is that it requires only weighted $L^1$-control. We also discuss a similar variational characterisation for the GENERIC structure of the fuzzy Landau equations.
analyses.workSummary: 本文处理空间齐次 Landau 方程的梯度流表示。作者把投影张量 $|v-v*|^{2}\Pi ⊥$ 改写为叉积 $(v-v*)\times (\cdot )\times (v-v*)$，在三维速度空间定义 cross-Landau gradient，并围绕该结构分析高斯卷积、作用量和熵链式法则。正文先建立与高斯卷积精确交换的球面微分结构，再用径向核的卷积界控制 A0，随后对测度曲线和 grazing rate 做正则化、链式法则极限，最终得到作用量加熵耗散的变分不等式及等号刻画；文末说明同一机制如何延伸到 fuzzy Landau 的 GENERIC 结构。
techniques: 叉积型 Landau 梯度与球面微分
质心/相对坐标变换
高斯卷积交换子恒等式

analyses.breakthrough: 核心新结论是：在 $A0(|v-v*|)∼〈v-v*〉^\gamma 、\gamma \le 1$ 的正则化硬势核下，叉积梯度与高斯 mollifier 的交换性足以把 Landau 梯度流的变分刻画降到加权 L1 控制，并且其二次型、曲线作用量和原投影梯度产生同一 Onsager 几何。由此 Theorem 1.1 的等号条件精确恢复 H-solution，而不再依赖既有方法中的额外 Lp 沿曲线假设。
analyses.limitations: 主证明固定三维空间，虽在 Remark 1.2 给出用斜对称矩阵推广到 $d\ge 3$ 的形式，但未在正文展开完整高维论证。核必须满足 (1.2) 的正则化径向比较；作者明确指出奇异幂核 $A0=|v-v*|^\gamma $ 的一般范围不享有所需交换子界。定理还要求加权 L1、有限初始熵和作用量/耗散可积性，结论是变分刻画而非独立的全局存在唯一性定理。

analyses.title: Littlewood--Paley operators and semigroup maximal operators on CMO spaces associated to Schödinger operators
analyses.abstract: Let $L=-Δ+V$ be a Schrödinger operator on $\mathbb{R}^n$, where $Δ$ is the Laplacian and $V$ satisfies the reverse Hölder inequality ${\rm RH}_q$ for some $q>n/2$. In this paper, we study the behavior of the Littlewood--Paley operators $s_L$ and $S_L$, as well as the semigroup maximal operator $T^*_L$, on the space ${\rm CMO}_L(\mathbb{R}^n)$ associated with the Schrödinger operator $L$. It is known from previous work that these operators are bounded on ${\rm BMO}_L(\mathbb{R}^n)$. Our main result shows that they are, in fact, mappings from ${\rm CMO}_L(\mathbb{R}^n)$ into itself. To prove this, we develop several equivalent characterizations of ${\rm CMO}_L(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and employ a refined decomposition that partitions the parameter interval at $r_Bρ(x_B)$, instead of the customary $r_B^2$ or $ρ(x_B)^2$. The new strategy allows us to overcome a key technical obstacle that arises when applying existing methods to the ${\rm CMO}_L$ setting.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究 Schrödinger 算子 $L=-\Delta +V（V\in RH_q、q>n/2）$关联的 $CMO_L(R^n)$ 端点空间。作者先从 $BMO_L$ 的五个消失条件出发，建立带小尺度、大尺度和中心位置约束的等价刻画，再逐一处理 Littlewood–Paley 方函数 $s_L$、面积函数 $S_L$ 与半群极大算子 $T_L*。s_L$ 的难点是常数部分 $s_L(1)$ 在 $r_B\le \rho (x_B)$ 时的控制，正文用 $r_B\rho (x_B)$ 分裂时间积分并结合 $tLe^{-tL}$ 的消去与平滑估计$；S_L$ 和 $T_L*$ 则把同一球分解、热核尾部界和 $L^{2}/$极大函数有界性改造成对应端点估计，最终证明三类算子都保持 $CMO_L$。

analyses.title: Classification of Solutions to a Critical Fourth-Order Equation on Complete Non-compact Manifolds
analyses.abstract: We study the critical biharmonic equation \[ Δ^2 u=u^{\frac{n+4}{n-4}}, \] on a complete, connected, and non-compact Riemannian manifold \((M^n,g)\) of dimension \(n\geq 5\) with non-negative Ricci curvature. We establish an optimal pointwise second-order derivative estimate by Bernstein's method and the continuity method. Using invariant tensors, we derive a differential inequality that yields a rigidity result. More precisely, if there exists a positive finite energy solution, then the manifold is isometric to the Euclidean space \(\mathbb{R}^n\), and the solution is given by \[ u(x)= \frac{ \left[λ^2 n(n-4)(n^2-4)\right]^{\frac{n-4}{8}} } {\left(1+λ|x-x_0|^2\right)^{\frac{n-4}{2}}}, \qquad λ>0,\quad x_0\in\mathbb{R}^n . \]
analyses.workSummary: 论文分类非紧完备流形上的临界四阶方程 $Delta^2$ $u=u^{(n+4)/(n-4)}$。在 $n>=5、Ricci$ 曲率非负的条件下，作者先用最大值原理和 Bernstein 连续性论证得到 Delta u 的符号与 Hessian 控制，再构造不变量张量并对其微分不等式做截断积分，迫使流形达到欧氏刚性；最后在 $R^n$ 上解等式情形并得到标准 bubble。

analyses.title: The Short Wave equation on the half-line by the Unified Transform Method
analyses.abstract: We study the initial-boundary value problem for the Short Wave equation on the half-line $x\ge 0$. A distinctive feature of this problem is that the boundary $x=0$ cannot be characterized \emph{a priori} as an inflow or outflow boundary: its character is determined dynamically by the sign of the unknown trace $u(0,t)$. This leads to different analyticity properties of the associated eigenfunctions and, consequently, to different spectral formulations in the regimes $u(0,t)\le0$ and $u(0,t)\ge0$. Using the Unified Transform Method (aka the Fokas method), we formulate the solution in terms of matrix Riemann--Hilbert problems. We construct the associated spectral functions, derive the global relations, and show how the solution is reconstructed from the corresponding Riemann--Hilbert problem. In the case $u(0,t)\le0$, the solution is determined by the initial data alone (assuming an appropriate decay as $x\to \infty$), whereas for $u(0,t)\ge0$, compatible boundary data are also required for the construction.
analyses.workSummary: 本文用统一变换法处理半直线上的 Short Wave 方程初边值问题。边界 $x=0$ 的入流/出流性质由未知迹 u(0,t) 的符号动态决定，因此作者分别构造 $u(0,t)\le 0$ 和 $u(0,t)\ge 0$ 两套特征函数解析性、谱函数和全局关系。正文先对 Lax 对在 $k=\infty 、k=0$ 附近作变换并建立初值/边界谱映射，再以全局关系拼接谱数据，形成带实轴或附加小圆跳跃的矩阵 Riemann–Hilbert 问题；最后通过 RH 解在 $k=0、\infty $ 的展开恢复 u、m 和坐标变换，并证明负边界迹时初值唯一决定解、非负时在兼容边界数据和 RH 可解条件下存在唯一表示。

矩阵 Riemann–Hilbert 跳跃与留数条件
Liouville 定理的唯一性论证
$k=0、\infty $ 展开及参数坐标重构
analyses.breakthrough: 论文的具体新结论是把边界迹 u(0,t) 的符号识别为半直线 SW 问题的谱分叉机制：负号区间的 RH 问题只需初值谱数据，正号区间则出现由边界谱函数决定的小圆跳跃并必须满足兼容关系。由此得到两套不同解析结构下的重构、唯一性和条件存在性结果，而不是把边界预先固定成单一入流类型。
analyses.limitations: Theorem 7.13 明确是条件性的，依赖相应 RH 问题在全部重构域可解以及谱函数无共同零点等条件；作者只给出小范数情形的充分可解准则。分析还要求 $H^4/H^{2,1}$ 正则性、m+1>0 和边界迹符号在所选时间半条带内保持不变；若符号变号，需要分段重启，正文没有给出跨变号点的统一单一 RH 公式。

steps.claim: Lax 对经规范化和变量变换后产生适合 $k=\infty 、k=0$ 分析的特征函数，并由正性 m+1>0 保证所需解析结构。
steps.route: 先用 G 变换把二阶谱方程写成一阶矩阵系统，再引入相位 p(x,t,k) 和守恒关系 $\nu (t)=\nu (0)-\eta (t)；Volterra$ 积分方程由不同基点定义各特征函数，Neumann 展开给出边界/无穷远渐近。

steps.route: 把 $x=0、t=0$ 的特征函数分解关系代入各自的谱系数，沿边界相位传播后得到全局关系；边界符号改变特征函数在上/下半平面的可解析列及是否需要圆形轮廓，因此分别形成两组 jump data。

analyses.title: Solvability of Semilinear Elliptic Equations on Infinite Graphs
analyses.abstract: We develop a constructive method for solving semilinear elliptic equations $Δu(x)=f(x,u(x))$ on locally finite, connected infinite graphs with layered structure. Using Eidelheit's theorem, we establish coupling criteria ensuring that arbitrary initial-layer data extend to global solutions for every $f$. We apply combinatorial criteria to prove solvability on leafless infinite trees, integer lattices, the triangular and hexagonal lattices, and a Cayley graph of the discrete Heisenberg group. We further establish solvability for a broad class of Cayley graphs of semidirect products $G\cong\mathbb Z\ltimes_θH$. In particular, $Δu=e^u$ has infinitely many solutions on $\mathbb Z^2$, but none of finite energy. We also extend the method to the bi-Laplacian under two-step coupling conditions, to the $p$-Laplacian under a unique-neighbor condition, and to magnetic Laplacians.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究局部有限、连通且具有分层结构的无限图上 $\Delta u=f(x,u(x))$ 的全局可解性。作者把图拉普拉斯按层写成相邻层耦合算子，利用 Eidelheit 定理把每个耦合算子的有限行独立性转成满射，再逐层解出下一层，从而任意指定一层或两层数据都能延拓为全局解。正文又用有限子式和唯一完美匹配给出组合判据，应用于无叶树、整数/三角/六边形格点、离散 Heisenberg 图及半直积 Cayley 图；最后说明双拉普拉斯、p-拉普拉斯和磁拉普拉斯的相应延拓机制。
techniques: 分层图与块三对角拉普拉斯
Frechet 空间上的 Eidelheit 满射定理
有限行独立与有限子式判据
唯一完美匹配和三角矩阵
逐层构造全局非线性解
两步耦合及 p-拉普拉斯标量反演
analyses.breakthrough: 主要新结论是一个对任意非线性 f 的构造性全局延拓定理：在全球耦合条件成立时，N 分层图上任意初始层数据、Z 分层图上任意相邻两层数据，都可逐层延拓为全局解。有限行独立被精确等价为非零满行子式，唯一完美匹配提供可检验的图组合充分条件；因此 $Z^{2}$ 上 $\Delta u=e^u$ 有无穷多个全局解，但有限能量条件反而不可能成立。
analyses.limitations: 结论在全体乘积空间 $R^V$ 的逐点拓扑中成立，不提供正性、增长、可和性或能量控制；作者在第5节明确留下加权 ℓp/指定增长空间中的定量右逆问题。双拉普拉斯需要两步耦合条件$，p\ne 2$ 时一般有限行线性满射不能直接替代唯一邻居的逐点反演；Cayley 图的判据也依赖给定分层与生成集。

steps.claim: 分层图上的方程可化成只含相邻三层的块递推，并把求下一层转化为耦合算子的满射问题。
steps.route: 按 $V_n$ 限制 u 和 $\Delta $，把层内项收进 $\Delta _n$；由于边只跨同层或相邻层$，V_n$ 方程整理为 $M_{n,n+1}u_{n+1}=f(\cdot ,u_n)-\Delta _nu_n-M_{n,n-1}u_{n-1}$，右端在已知两层后完全确定。
steps.evidence: PDF 第3–4页 Definition 2.1、式(4)–(5)及 Section 3.1。

steps.claim: 耦合算子满射当且仅当其每个有限行子集线性独立，并等价于存在非零满行子式；唯一完美匹配给出直接充分条件。
steps.route: 将每层函数空间识别为可数乘积 Frechet 空间，验证 Eidelheit 定理的连续性和有限支撑半范数条件；有限行独立即坐标泛函独立。对有限 U 去掉零列后应用最大子式判据，唯一匹配使 Leibniz 展开只剩一个非零项。
steps.evidence: PDF 第4–6页 Lemma 3.2、Proposition 3.3、Theorem 1.3 及其证明。

steps.claim: 全球耦合条件使任意初始层数据逐层延拓，并在双向分层中同时向两侧延拓。
steps.route: N 分层从 u0 开始，已知 $(u_{n-1},u_n)$ 后由满射选取 $u_{n+1}$，且该选择只影响尚未施加的层方程；Z 分层先给定 $(u_{-1},u0)$，分别用正向/反向耦合解 u1 和 u−2，再归纳向两端推进。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5页 Definition 3.5 和 Theorem 1.2 的完整证明；第6页 Proposition 4.1。

steps.claim: 这些组合条件确实导出具体图上的全局解存在性及扩展版本。
steps.route: 在 $Z^d$ 中层间算子是恒等映射，得到两层数据到全局解的双射；在树和格点图中选唯一子节点或构造三角子矩阵验证行独立。对半直积图用左序把有限子式排成块三角并以极值纤维块的行列式闭合；双拉普拉斯和 p-拉普拉斯则分别用两步外耦合和 $\Phi _p$ 的单调双射递推。

analyses.title: Fefferman--Stein type inequalities via area and maximal functions for Schrödinger operators with applications
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we establish a Fefferman--Stein inequality in terms of area function and non-tangential maximal function associated with the Schrödinger operator $\mathcal{L} = -Δ+ V$ on stratified Lie groups $\mathcal G$, where $Δ$ denotes the sub-Laplacian on $\mathcal G$ and $V$ is a nonnegative locally integrable function. As an application, we extend this inequality to the tensor product $\mathcal G_1 \times \mathcal G_2$ of two stratified Lie groups and develop atomic decompositions associated with the Schrödinger operator for functions in the Orlicz space $L\log^{+}L(\mathcal G_1 \times \mathcal G_2).$ Using these atomic decompositions, we further prove weak-type endpoint estimates for the area integral operator and the Riesz transforms associated with the Schrödinger operator on $L\log^{+}L(\mathcal G_1 \times \mathcal G_2),$ thereby extending the celebrated result of R.\,Fefferman and E.M.\,Stein \cite{FSt1982} to the setting of singular integrals with non-smooth kernels.
analyses.workSummary: 本文在分层 Lie 群上研究 Schrödinger 算子 $L=-\Delta +V$ 的面积函数与非切向极大函数之间的 Fefferman–Stein 型分布不等式，并将其推广到两个群的张量积。正文先用子拉普拉斯 Poisson 半群作用于水平集指示函数，构造适配非交换群和非负势的截断函数，再通过能量恒等式、弱导数和 $good-\lambda $ 区域分解得到 Theorem 1.1。产品空间上作者重复这一机制并得到 Theorem 1.2 和面积函数弱端点估计，随后构造 L $log^+L$ 的算子适配原子分解，最后用 Davies–Gaffney 衰减、原子估计和 Journe 覆盖证明面积算子及双 Riesz 变换的弱型端点界。
techniques: Schrödinger/子拉普拉斯 Poisson 半群
非切向极大函数与面积函数分布不等式
水平集 $good-\lambda $ 截断与能量积分
弱导数、Tonelli/Fubini 和热核估计
产品空间原子分解
Davies–Gaffney 衰减与弱端点估计
analyses.breakthrough: 论文的核心进展是把 Fefferman–Stein 分布不等式推进到带非负局部可积势的分层 Lie 群，并进一步在产品群上获得 L $log^+L$ 弱端点理论。关键构造不是沿用欧氏 bump 函数，而是用 $e^{-t\sqrt -\Delta }(\chi _{E_\lambda })$ 的取值范围设计截断；这同时适应非交换几何与 L 的非卷积势项，并支撑后续算子适配原子和非光滑核 Riesz 变换的全球端点估计。
analyses.limitations: 假设是分层 Lie 群$、V\ge 0$ 且 V 局部可积，端点结论针对文中定义的 Schrödinger 面积/极大函数和产品算子；原子分解还要求 L $log^+L\cap L^{2}$。作者指出欧氏证明中的紧支撑卷积恒等式在一般分层群不存在，因此不能把其证明直接延伸到更一般的非自伴算子或任意核；文章也不提供超出这些算子设置的定量强型端点范围。

analyses.title: On the singular limit of the Camassa-Holm equation
analyses.abstract: We study the singular limit of the Camassa--Holm equation as the length scale $\ell$ tends to zero. Although the formal limit is the Burgers equation with flux $3u^2/2$, we show that, for a class of smooth initial data, convergence to entropy solutions fails after the shock formation, even along subsequences in local space-time $L^1$.
analyses.workSummary: 本文研究 Camassa–Holm 方程长度尺度 ℓ→0 的奇异极限。形式上方程趋于通量为 $3u^{2}/2$ 的 Burgers 方程；作者选取初始动量 $u0-\ell^{2}u0$ 在所有小 ℓ 上保持同号的非平凡 $H^{3}\cap L^{1}$ 数据，借此得到全局光滑 CH 流。证明先从动量符号、质量和三次 Hamiltonian 导出 uℓ 与 ℓuℓx 的统一 Lp 界，再用局部能量守恒和空间截断建立能量紧性；若假设震后收敛到 Burgers 熵解，则能量损失迫使缺陷密度 $w\ell=\ell^{2}(u\ellx)^{2}$ 留下正质量，极限方程又强迫 $w_x=0$，有限空间质量与正质量矛盾，因而不存在该收敛子列。
techniques: Helmholtz Green 函数与动量输运
质量/三次 Hamiltonian 守恒
统一 Lp 与斜率尺度估计
局部能量守恒和空间尾部紧性
缺陷密度弱极限
Burgers 熵解冲击与分布极限
analyses.breakthrough: 具体突破是证明光滑、守恒的 Camassa–Holm 流在 Burgers 冲击时间之后，即使取任意 $\ell_n↓0$ 子列，也不能在局部时空 $L^{1}$ 强收敛到 Burgers 唯一熵解。障碍由 $\ell^{2}u_x^{2}$ 形成的正缺陷能量承担：它不能逃到无穷远，却在极限方程中被迫空间均匀，最终只能为零，与能量损失留下的正质量冲突。
analyses.limitations: 定理要求 $u0\in H^{3}\cap L^{1}$ 非平凡且所有小 ℓ 的初始动量同号；结论只排除趋向 Burgers 熵解的子列，不排除 CH 族向别的极限收敛。证明针对全局光滑同号动量流，不能直接覆盖会波破的初值或耗散弱解；文中也明确对比了另一种 Hamiltonian regularized Burgers 方程。

steps.claim: Burgers 熵解在 TB* 之后形成跳跃并严格损失二次能量。
steps.route: 用 Lax–Oleinik 极小点公式证明冲击处存在两个不同极小点，得到向下跳跃；再对二次熵对使用 BV 链式法则和 Rankine–Hugoniot 速度，跳跃集上的熵产生为 $-(u--u+)^{3}/4$，从而积分得到严格能量损失。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2页 Theorem 1.1 中 TB* 定义；第5–6页 Theorem 2.2、式(2.2)–(2.3)及熵产生计算。

steps.claim: 同号初始动量保证 CH 流全局存在，并给出独立于 ℓ 的质量、斜率和 Lp 控制。
steps.route: 动量方程保持符号，卷积表示 $u\ell=G\ell*m\ell$ 给出 $\ell|u\ellx|\le |u\ell|$；质量守恒与局部能量/三次 Hamiltonian 守恒分别控制 L1、H1 和 L3，插值得到 uℓ 与 ℓuℓx 在 $p\in [1,3]$ 的统一界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第2页 Theorem 2.6；第7–8页式(3.1)–(3.9)和 Uniform estimates 小节。

steps.claim: 局部时空 L1 收敛假设会升级为全局时空 L2 收敛，并迫使尺度能量缺陷 $w\ell=\ell^{2}(u\ellx)^{2}$ 保留正质量。
steps.route: 用统一 L3 界和 Burgers 的 L2 控制将局部 L1 假设提升为局部 L2；再用局部能量守恒式、通量 L1 界和空间 cutoff 得到远场尾部统一消失。震后 Burgers 的严格能量损失与 CH 能量守恒相减，给出 wℓ 的正总质量$；L^{3/2}$ 有界性取弱极限 w。

analyses.title: An Inverse Random Source Problem for the Moore-Gibson-Thompson Equation Driven by Fractional Brownian Motion
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we consider an inverse random source problem for the stochastic Moore-Gibson-Thompson equation driven by fractional Brownian motion with Hurst index $H \in (0, 1)$ of the form $f_1(x)g_1(t)\dot{B}^H(t)+f_2(x)g_2(t)$. Given the random source, existence and uniqueness of mild solutions are verified. For the inverse problem, the uniqueness of recovering the strength $f_i(x)$ if the time functions $g_i$ are known and $g_i(t)$ if the spatial functions $f_i$ are known when $H \in(0,1)$ from the boundary flux on a special nonempty open subset is proved.
