analyses.title: Exact Asymptotics for the 2D Euclidean Random Matching Problem
analyses.abstract: We determine the exact first-order asymptotics of the expected optimal cost in two-dimensional random bipartite matching, for every finite power cost $q \ge 1$, on the flat torus. In the endpoint case $q=1$, this answers a question by Talagrand, in the periodic case. The argument involves the closely related asymptotics of the energy of the solution of the $p$-Poisson equation with a regularized white-noise source. In the limit of vanishing regularization parameter, we identify this energy as the solution of a Variational Martingale Problem on a limiting Gaussian filtration, whose value is characterized by a parabolic Monge-Ampère flow.

analyses.title: Low-Temperature Large Deviations for the Two-Dimensional Wick-Ordered Cubic Wave Equation
analyses.abstract: We prove a trajectory large deviation principle, in the low-temperature limit, for the two-dimensional Wick-ordered defocusing cubic nonlinear wave equation, with initial data drawn from the invariant Gibbs measure. We further show that asymptotically vanishing high-frequency perturbations of the Gibbs initial data, with the same static rate function, generate a continuum of distinct mass-shifted trajectory rate functions.

analyses.title: Controllability for 2D water waves: effects of bottom topography and constant vorticity
analyses.abstract: In this paper we consider two-dimensional water waves, under the action of gravity and surface tension. We prove a controllability result for irrotational waves in a fluid domain with finite depth and general bottom topography. The result holds for an open and dense set of bottom topographies in $H^{s+1/2}(\mathbb{T})$ (where $s$ is sufficiently large) that do not touch the free surface. We point out that the bottom topographies that we allow for are not necessarily small perturbations of the flat bottom case: this leads to many technical difficulties, since the eigenvalues of the Dirichlet-Neumann operator at a still free surface with general bottom topography are not explicit, nor are they necessarily close (for low frequencies) to the eigenvalues of the corresponding operator for the flat bottom case. In turn, this leads to a more involved argument to prove Ingham-type estimates, which are needed to prove observability, and motivates the restriction mentioned above on the admissible bottom topographies. We also prove a controllability result for waves with constant vorticity in a fluid domain with flat bottom topography.

analyses.title: The capillary $L_p$ dual Minkowski problem for $p>q$ in higher dimensions
analyses.abstract: We prove existence and uniqueness for the capillary $L_p$ dual Minkowski problem for $p>q$ and contact angle $θ\in (0,\fracπ{2})$ in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$, $n\geq 3$. We reduce it to a Monge-Ampère type equation with a Robin boundary condition on the unit spherical cap, by building a new auxiliary function to obtain the $C^2$ estimate for $p>q$ in $\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ ($n\geq 3$), we then prove that there exists a unique smooth solution that solves this problem provided $θ\in (0, \fracπ{2})$.

analyses.title: Exact high-order GPT cancellation in noncircular multilayers
analyses.abstract: This paper is concerned with exact high-order generalized polarization tensor (GPT) cancellation in two-dimensional noncircular multilayers with finite positive isotropic coating conductivities. We first prove that, for every admissible cyclically symmetric core--shell geometry, there exists a unique positive coating conductivity for which the structure is weakly neutral to every uniform incident field. For higher orders, we establish locally unique coating conductivities that cancel the complete \(K\)-contracted GPTs (K-CGPTs) block on a broad class of fixed noncircular multilayers with cyclic symmetry. This includes homothetic multilayers generated by strictly star-shaped symmetric domains, without assuming that the geometry is close to concentric disks. We also replace the near-background condition by a small-core condition covering finite, insulating, and perfectly conducting cores. By varying selected interface modes together with the coating conductivities near a radial GPT-vanishing structure, we further construct exact families with neither rotational nor reflection symmetry. For three coatings, the relevant nondegeneracy conditions and an explicit chiral example are rigorously certified. Finally, we show that the resulting cancellation yields enhanced near-cloaking for every entire harmonic incident field. A set of certified numerical examples fully corroborates the theoretical predictions established in this work.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究二维非圆形多层导体中的高阶广义极化张量精确消除。作者先用循环对称性和复调和模态把 CGPT 块化为有限维材料映射，再证明一次均匀场弱中性所需的涂层电导唯一存在；随后在径向 GPT 消失点线性化该映射，以隐函数和度理论处理非圆形、有限核、绝缘核和导体核，并把小散射估计推广到任意整函数入射场。第 6 节还用界面模态扰动构造无旋转及无反射对称的手性族。

analyses.title: Chain rule symmetry for singular SPDEs from multi-indices to decorated trees
analyses.abstract: In these lecture notes, we review the recent results around the chain rule for the generalised KPZ equation and the geometric KPZ equation. We introduce the main ideas of Regularity Structures via a B-series type expansion and the two main combinatorial sets for encoding this expansion: decorated trees and multi-indices. Then, we explain how the chain rule was first understood via integration by parts and diagrammatic computations. For the generalised KPZ equation, a scalar-valued equation, we use multi-indices to derive a characterisation in terms of iterations of covariant derivatives. The same characterisation for decorated trees is more involved and requires the use of operadic and homological tools. We summarise the main arguments of this proof.
analyses.workSummary: 这份讲义整理奇异 SPDE 中从多重指标到装饰树的 chain rule symmetry。作者先用正规性结构和 B-series 展开编码广义 KPZ 的重整化项，再用积分分部和 elementary differentials 建立多重指标的链式法则；随后定义由微分同胚作用不变的几何子空间，证明它是组合映射 $phi_hat_geo$ 的核。最后以组合协变导数生成该核，并通过带微分的 operad 同调把它识别为 Lie-admissible operad，从而解释几何 KPZ 反项的局部性。

analyses.title: The Fenchel Game of Underdamped Langevin Dynamics: Insights into Accelerated Convergence
analyses.abstract: For $(Q_t,P_t)$ governed by suitably damped underdamped Langevin dynamics, we quantify the convergence in KL divergence of the positional marginal to a $σ$-strongly log-concave target $π(dq) = \frac{1}{Z}e^{-V(q)}dq$ as \begin{align*} \operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_t) \| π) \leq e^{-\sqrtσ t}\operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_{0}, P_{0})\, \|\, Π_0), \end{align*} where $Π_0$ denotes an appropriately selected reference measure. When $π$ is merely log-concave, the estimate \begin{align*} \operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_t) \| π) \leq \frac{τ^2}{t^2}\operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_τ, P_τ)\, \|\, Π_τ) \end{align*} is derived, where $Π_τ$ denotes another correspondingly chosen reference measure at time $τ> 0$. Both rates match precisely the canonical rates of the corresponding accelerated gradient flows in $\mathbb{R}^d$. They are achieved by the novel interpretation of the underdamped Langevin dynamics as a combination of strategies in an online sampling game and by estimating the KL divergence using a cost function informed by fictitious competitors.
analyses.workSummary: 论文把欠阻尼 Langevin 动力学解释为一个连续时间 Fenchel 在线博弈，并由此证明对数凹目标的加速 KL 收敛。凸情形中，Y 玩家采用跟随领导者的梯度策略而零 regret，X 玩家以最优传输映射和条件高斯参考测度构造 KL 能量；熵-输运 Cramer-Rao 不等式使该能量单调。选择 Nesterov 权重后博弈变量变回物理 Langevin 方程。强凸情形加入二次项和 Polyak 权重，所有时间误差项消失，得到指数速率。

analyses.title: Global mild solutions and the semiclassical limit for the Fermi--Dirac BGK model
analyses.abstract: We prove global existence of mild solutions to the spatially inhomogeneous Fermi--Dirac BGK equation for arbitrary-size Pauli-admissible initial data with finite mass and kinetic energy, allowing both vacuum and locally saturated zero-temperature states. The construction relies on a moment-compatible regularization of the local equilibrium that preserves the Pauli bound and uniform moment control while remaining consistent up to the saturation boundary. The solutions satisfy mass, momentum, and energy conservation and, under an additional finite spatial second-moment assumption, an entropy-gap H-theorem on the full Pauli interval. Under uniform moment and entropy bounds, we further prove that, after extraction of a subsequence, quantum mild solutions converge strongly in phase space, uniformly on bounded time intervals, to a mild solution of the classical BGK equation.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究空间非齐次 Fermi-Dirac BGK 方程。对任意满足 Pauli 约束、有限质量和动能的初值，作者先刻画可实现的质量-动量-能量区域及饱和边界，再在宏观参数层面对局部平衡作保持 Pauli 上界的正则化；沿特征线构造近似方程并以紧性取极限，得到全局温和解、守恒律和熵缺口不等式。最后在一致矩和熵界下令 hbar 趋于 0，通过截断、速度尾部控制和强收敛识别为经典 BGK 温和解。

analyses.limitations: 全局存在依赖三维无界相空间、固定 hbar 下的 Pauli 上界和 BGK 局部平衡结构；半经典结论只在统一二阶空间和速度矩及熵界下抽取子序列，零温饱和族会集中成单速度测度而被排除。没有给出不抽子序列的极限、速率或更一般碰撞算子的结果。

analyses.title: Well-posedness and exponential stability for abstract evolution equations with delay in the nonlinear source: frictional and viscoelastic cases
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we establish the well-posedness and exponential stability of a class of semilinear neutral abstract evolution equations with constant time delay. Two damping mechanisms are considered: frictional damping of the form $CC^*u_t$ and viscoelastic damping with memory. Under suitable assumptions, we prove global well-posedness and exponential decay of solutions for sufficiently small initial data. This result is of considerable importance, as it provides a unified framework for the analysis of a wide class of neutral systems arising in structural mechanics, seismic isolation, and control theory. The abstract results are illustrated by some concrete examples. The analysis relies on a combination of semigroup theory, energy estimates, Duhamel's formula, and Gronwall-type arguments.
analyses.workSummary: 论文建立带常时滞和非线性源的半线性中性抽象演化方程的局部适定性、全局小数据解和指数稳定性。摩擦阻尼与带记忆的黏弹阻尼分别由两个抽象模型表示；作者把方程改写到历史状态 Hilbert 空间，先用稳定半群和 Duhamel 公式得到局部解，再对含延迟源能量加入历史积分项，通过 Gronwall 和小数据 bootstrap 延拓并得到指数衰减。最后把抽象结果应用于 Duffing 梁、地震隔离黏弹波和板方程。

analyses.title: Formation and structural stability of nondegenerate neckpinches
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we study the formation, precise asymptotics, and structural stability of neckpinch singularities in mean curvature flow. Motivated by the static rigidity of cylindrical self-shrinkers established by Colding, Ilmanen and Minicozzi, we first prove a dynamical rigidity result: mean curvature flow of hypersurfaces that are initially graphically close to a generalized cylinder on a sufficiently large scale, subject to a localized quadratic upward bending, inevitably develop a neckpinch singularity in finite time. We also establish sharp asymptotic expansions for the profile functions of these locally evolving graphs. We show that the rescaled graphical radius converges to a specific polynomial profile with quadratic bending, proving that the resulting singularities are nondegenerate. Finally, we establish an openness theorem showing that nondegenerate neckpinches are structurally stable under C^2 perturbations of the initial data. Combined with recent density theorems for the 3-dimensional mean curvature flow by Szekelyhidi, our results confirm that nondegenerate neckpinches constitute a generic and stable phenomenon in 3-dimensional mean curvature flow.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究平均曲率流中非退化 neckpinch 的形成、渐近和结构稳定性。初始超曲面在大尺度上是带局部二次向上弯曲的圆柱图；作者先用伪局部性和重标度图估计保持圆柱接近，再以 L2 模态分解、屏障和角向旋转选择控制误差。funnel 中的正负不稳定模态由退出引理和度数非零的 shooting 选择被消除，中心模态留下精确的二次渐近；最后将已有非退化颈缩流在 C2 初值扰动下重新缩放，证明其严格稳定。

analyses.title: Quantitative Estimates of the Field Excited by an Emitter in the Narrow Region Between Two Strictly Convex Inclusions in Two Dimensions
analyses.abstract: We consider the field enhancement due to the presence of an emitter of the dipole type near two perfectly conducting inclusions with $C^{2,γ}$ boundaries in two dimensions. We derive estimates of field enhancement in the narrow region and prove that the field is enhanced by a factor $\varepsilon^{-1/2}$ in the region far from the emitter. We construct a harmonic barrier to control the dipole term instead of using the Kelvin transformation. We also study how the location of the emitter affects the field on the shortest line segment connecting two inclusions.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究二维两个严格凸完美导体夹缝中点偶极发射器激发的场增强。作者把解分解为 Neumann 偶极场、夹缝几何场和校正调和场，先精确估计基本夹缝函数 q 的梯度，再用积分恒等式把系数 c 化为发射器位置处的 grad q，最后构造不依赖圆形几何的调和屏障控制校正项。由此得到发射器附近、远离发射器和过渡区的梯度界，并比较水平与垂直偶极方向以及发射器离开接触点时短线段上的场。
techniques: 夹缝基本调和函数估计
Green 恒等式与系数识别
Kelvin-free 调和屏障

analyses.limitations: 结论限于二维、两个相互接触后平移的严格凸 C2,gamma 完美导体，且发射器需位于窄区并满足距边界下界；作者明确指出关键 Lemma 3.2 和 3.3 未必在三维成立，结果也未宣称一般三维尖端几何下的锐性。

analyses.title: On solutions of the modified Helmholtz equation in a planar domain
analyses.abstract: A criterion for the convexity of a two-dimensional domain is proved in terms of the solution of a boundary value problem for the modified Helmholtz equation.
analyses.workSummary: 论文证明二维有界 Lipschitz 域的凸性可以完全由边界值为 1 的 modified Helmholtz 解 $v_mu$ 的梯度判据刻画。必要性从 $w_mu=-mu^{-1} log$ $v_mu$ 出发：梯度不等式使 $w_mu$ 超调和，Varadhan 极限把它送到边界距离函数，非凸域构造出的内切圆弧违反超调和性。充分性先在光滑凸域用局部坐标和最大值原理验证所有 mu 的边界梯度不等式，再以外逼近和单调比较去除边界光滑性。
techniques: 对数变换与超调和性
Varadhan 边界距离极限
平均值性质反证
最大值原理边界梯度估计
Lipschitz 域光滑逼近
analyses.breakthrough: 把原先只要求光滑边界的高参数判据提升为二维 Lipschitz 域的充要凸性标准，并且在凸域一侧证明判据对所有 mu>0 都成立。
analyses.limitations: 结论针对二维有界 Lipschitz 域及常数 Dirichlet 边界数据，必要性使用大 mu 渐近，充分性依赖二维几何和 modified Helmholtz 标量方程；没有处理非恒定边界值、无界域或高维的一般 Lipschitz 版本。

steps.claim: 若不等式 |grad $v_mu|<=mu$ $v_mu$ 对所有充分大的 mu 成立，则 $w_mu=-mu^{-1}log$ $v_mu$ 是超调和函数。
steps.route: 由方程 Delta $v_mu-mu^2$ $v_mu=0$ 计算 -Delta $w_mu=mu^2-|grad$ $v_mu|^2/v_mu^2$；代入梯度假设使右端非负，得到 $w_mu$ 的超调和性。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 2 页 Section 2、equation (1) 和 log transform proof。

steps.claim: 非凸域会违反上述判据。
steps.route: 选择边界端点连成但穿出域外的线段，在其上构造从内部相切且曲率为负的光滑子域；其距离函数在接触点附近 Laplacian 为正。若判据成立，Varadhan 极限会使该距离函数超调和，矛盾。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 2-3 页 Section 2，内切圆构造及 Lemmas 14.16-14.17 的应用。

steps.claim: 在光滑凸域中，不等式对每个 mu>0 成立。
steps.route: 在边界点用内法向坐标和凸性控制二阶边界曲率，结合 $v_mu=1$ 的边界值得到法向导数的 Hopf 型上界；再用最大值原理把 |grad $v_mu|^2-mu^2$ $v_mu^2$ 的内部正部排除。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 3-4 页 Section 3、boundary claim and maximum-principle argument。

steps.claim: 二维有界 Lipschitz 域满足判据当且仅当其凸。

analyses.title: Uniform bounds for a thermo-diffusive system beyond exponential growth
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we prove a global-in-time uniform bound for solutions to a thermo-diffusive system in the whole space with bounded nonnegative initial data. The result allows exponential reaction rates and a range of superexponential rates determined by the diffusivities. This extends the recent results of La, Roquejoffre, and Ryzhik \cite{LRR24} and of Leontev and Ryzhik \cite{LR26} beyond their strictly subexponential range.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究全空间 thermo-diffusive 系统 $u_t=nu$ Delta u-u $g(v)、v_t=kappa$ Delta v+u g(v) 在温度扩散快于燃料扩散时的长期有界性。作者将反应源的两个热势写成 $F=G_nu*q$ 和 $H=G_kappa*q$，沿抛物锥把 H 分成近锥有界部分和远锥小 BMO 部分；John-Nirenberg 指数积分把 BMO 控制提升为温度分布尾界，增长指数由两种高斯衰减平衡给出 $rho*=kappa/(kappa-nu)$。最后结合 hot-cold 迭代、Martin-Pierre 平滑估计和局部抛物正则性完成全局温度界。

analyses.title: Liouville Theorem for the Constant $Q/R$-Curvature Equation
analyses.abstract: We study positive entire solutions of the flat constant $Q/R$-curvature equation in dimension $n\geq5$. We prove that the weak superharmonicity condition $-Δu\geq0$ already forces every nonconstant solution to be admissible. With this automatic admissibility, we classify all such solutions as positive constants or standard bubbles. We also show that the weak superharmonicity condition is structurally necessary. Once it is removed, there is a one-parameter family of positive radial entire solutions near every positive constant. These solutions converge to a positive constant at infinity, while both $-Δu$ and $-Δ(u^{(n-2)/(n-4)})$ change sign infinitely many times.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究 $n>=5$ 维平坦常数 Q/R-曲率方程的正整解。作者先在弱超调和条件 -Delta $u>=0$ 下将方程改写成协作椭圆系统，利用势表示、Kelvin 变换和移动平面得到可去奇点与球对称刚性；随后以 P-function 升级重新获得 admissibility，最终分类为正常数或标准 bubble。作者还精确构造去掉符号条件后靠近常数的一参数径向散射族，说明弱超调和性是结构性必要条件。

analyses.title: Generalized functions in a Non-Archimedean field
analyses.abstract: Ultrafunctions are generalized functions defined on a non-Archimedean field extending R. They provide a framework for treating problems that fall outside the classical theory of distributions. In this paper we introduce an improved notion of ultrafunctions which refines the previous constructions. This new approach allows a more flexible functional framework than the one used in other papers and yields a more flexible functional setting. In particular, this approach allows us to prove the existence of ultrafunction solutions for several classes of ill-posed evolution problems arising in partial differential equations.
analyses.workSummary: 论文提出在扩张实数的非阿基米德域上构造改进 ultrafunction 的统一框架。作者先建立有序非阿基米德场、Lambda-limit 和 Euclidean numbers，再以 hyperfinite 函数空间定义点值积分、广义导数、正则/光滑子空间及反导数；多变量部分证明积分、Poincare 不等式、Gauss 散度定理和与 Schwartz 分布的对应。应用章节把该框架用于边值问题、变分最小化和 ill-posed 演化方程，最后给出 hyperfinite grid 模型与逼近引理。

analyses.title: Global large solutions of the Cauchy problem for the NS-NPP equations with Fujita-Kato type initial data
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we prove the global well-posedness of the Cauchy problem for the NS-NPP equations with some large Fujita-Kato type initial data. Specifically, we show that there exist two positive constants $c_{0}$ and $C_{0}$ such that if the initial data $(u_{0}, N_{0}, P_{0})$ satisfies the following condition: \begin{equation*} \left(\|u_0\|_{\dot{H}^{-1+\frac{d}{2}}}+\|N_{0}-P_{0}\|_{\dot{H}^{-2+\frac{d}{2}}}\right)\exp\left\{C_{0}\big(\|N_{0}+P_{0}\|_{\dot{H}^{-2+\frac{d}{2}}}^2+1\big)\right\} \leq c_{0}, \end{equation*} then the NS-NPP equations admits a unique global solution. This result implies global existence of solutions without any smallness conditions imposed on the sum of initial particle densities of negative and positive electric charge in the framework of Sobolev spaces.
analyses.workSummary: 论文证明全空间 NS-NPP 方程在临界齐次 Besov 空间中可由大幅度总电荷初值产生全局唯一解。作者先用 $v=N-P、w=N+P$ 把系统改写为对称结构，其中 w 方程是由 u、v 驱动的线性输运扩散方程；局部解由热方程 Besov 估计建立。证明核心是先估计 w，再对 v 引入由 w 的时间加权 L2 范数定义的指数权重，最后用 Leray 投影估计 u，并以 bootstrap 反证排除有限最大时间。

analyses.title: On the Invertibility of the Potential-Density Mapping for the Vlasov-Poisson System in Analytic Spaces
analyses.abstract: We develop the mathematical analysis of the Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory introduced by Manfredi [J. Plasma Phys., 86.2 (2020), 825860201] in the setting of Vlasov equations with a time-dependent exterior potential. In this context, we establish the invertibility of the potential-density mapping for the Vlasov-Poisson system on $\mathbb{T}^d \times \mathbb{R}^d$ when the exterior potential is (real-)analytic in the space variable. We also recover a Runge-Gross type Theorem for the Vlasov-Poisson equation for smooth (real-)analytic in time exterior potential. The surjectivity of the potential-density mapping is an inverse problem for the Vlasov-Poisson equation: we find the electric field that generates a given density profile on a given time interval.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究环面乘速度空间上的 Vlasov-Poisson 势-密度映射。空间变量解析的情形下，作者用质量守恒和动量守恒导出外势差满足带密度权的椭圆方程，再对两条相同密度解的差在解析范数中做时间依赖半径的 Gronwall 估计，证明映射单射；时间解析情形通过逐阶 Taylor 系数恢复 Runge-Gross 型结论。对给定目标密度，作者反向耦合 Vlasov 方程和椭圆外势方程，以 Cauchy-Kowalevski 型迭代构造势，证明局部满射，并给出有限正则性逆映射非 Hölder 的障碍。

analyses.title: Strong convergence rates of tamed exponential Euler schemes for superlinear hyperbolic SPDEs
analyses.abstract: In this paper, we prove pathwise uniform convergence at rates up to $1/2$ for tamed exponential Euler schemes for semilinear hyperbolic stochastic evolution equations with superlinearly growing nonlinearities and multiplicative noise. We take the term hyperbolic to mean that the leading operator generates a contractive $C_0$-semigroup but no parabolic smoothing occurs. Under local Lipschitz, polynomial growth, coercivity, and monotonicity conditions on the nonlinearities, we establish pathwise uniform strong error estimates of the form \begin{equation*} \Big(\mathbb{E}\max_{0\le j \le N} \|U(t_j)-U^j\|_X^p\Big)^{1/p} \lesssim \sqrt{k} \end{equation*} on a Hilbert space $X$ for $p\in [2,\infty)$. Here, $U$ is the mild solution and $U^j$ is the tamed exponential Euler approximation at time $t_j=jk$ with step size $k>0$. This extends previous convergence results for non-parabolic SPDEs from globally to locally Lipschitz nonlinearities, allowing both drift and diffusion to grow polynomially. In a stochastic Kato framework, we further establish local and global well-posedness as well as uniform a priori estimates for the mild solution and its approximation. Applications to nonlinear stochastic transport, Airy, wave-type, and dissipatively damped nonlinear Schrödinger equations are included, covering different nonlinearities-stopped and fractionally tamed schemes. For the Klein-Gordon equation with cubic velocity damping, this complements previous results obtained for additive noise.

analyses.title: Differentiability of Lipschitz mappings into metric spaces: area and co-area formulas
analyses.abstract: We give a self-contained exposition of metric differentiability for Lipschitz mappings from sets in Euclidean spaces into arbitrary metric spaces, together with the corresponding area and co-area formulas. The novelty is a new metric implicit function theorem for mappings into metric spaces, which is then used to give a direct and geometric proof of the co-area formula for Lipschitz mappings into metric spaces.

analyses.title: Fluctuating Kinetic Theory: A Poissonian Stochastic Boltzmann Equation
analyses.abstract: We introduce a nonlinear Poissonian fluctuating Boltzmann equation whose noise encodes both the fluctuations and the path large-deviation rate function of the underlying hard-sphere gas. Unlike the Gaussian-noise equations commonly studied in fluctuating hydrodynamics, the present equation raises a new difficulty: a Poisson random measure produces jumps that may destroy the nonnegativity of the solution. To address this problem, we construct a finite-dimensional coarse-grained jump process and prove its well-posedness and nonnegativity. For each fixed mesh, this process satisfies a good path large-deviation principle. We then fix a regularized velocity cutoff and study the asymptotic behavior of the discrete rate functions as the mesh is refined. On a class of biased regular paths, their limit is the corresponding cutoff Boltzmann large-deviation rate function associated with the hard-sphere gas. This establishes the consistency of the coarse-grained fluctuating Boltzmann model with the underlying particle system at the level of path large deviations.
analyses.workSummary: 论文构造带 Poisson 碰撞噪声的随机 Boltzmann 模型。作者先把速度空间截断并划分有限网格，用守恒的输运通道和碰撞通道定义有限维跳跃过程；再证明非负性、质量守恒、非爆炸和路径唯一性。固定网格时，Poisson 变分表示把跳跃过程的概率代价写成受控骨架方程上的相对熵积分，从而得到良好路径大偏差原理。随后在固定速度截断下，将网格密度和控制插值到连续碰撞空间，证明离散速率函数在 biased regular paths 上具有下极限和恢复序列，收敛到截断 Boltzmann 大偏差作用。

analyses.title: Exact Analytic Solution for the Time-Fractional Hunter-Saxton Equation with Caputo derivative
analyses.abstract: A time fractional extension of the Hunter Saxton equation is examined, in which the temporal derivative of u_x is replaced by a Caputo derivative of order 0 < alpha <= 1. This modification introduces memory effects into a model traditionally associated with director field dynamics in nematic liquid crystals. By employing a fractional separation of variables strategy together with the exponential spatial profile phi(x) = exp(b+x), which cancels the nonlinear structure exactly, the governing nonlinear partial differential equation is reduced to a fractional relaxation ODE, whose closed form solution is the one-parameter Mittag Leffler function. The exact analytic solution is derived algebraically from the separation process. This appears to be the first exact closed form solution of the Caputo time fractional Hunter Saxton equation. The result is validated symbolically using the MathHandbook computer-algebra system. Quantitative analysis in both the fractional (0 < alpha < 1) and classical (alpha -> 1) limits demonstrates how fractional-order memory slows temporal relaxation relative to the exponential baseline. The solution provides a reliable benchmark for numerical schemes and clarifies how fractional dynamics influence nonlinear wave propagation in orientationally ordered fluids.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究带 Caputo 时间分数阶导数的 Hunter–Saxton 方程。作者从可分离形式 $u(x,t)=psi(t)phi(x)+c$ 出发，选取满足 phi $prime=phi$ double $prime=phi$ 的指数空间模态 $phi(x)=exp(b+x)$，使两个二次非线性项逐项抵消，原偏微分方程因此退化为 Caputo 分数阶松弛方程。该方程由一参数 Mittag–Leffler 函数精确求解，作者随后用初值、经典 $alpha=1$ 极限和 MathHandbook 符号展开核验残差，并比较分数阶记忆造成的慢衰减。

analyses.title: Semilinear wave equations on the Witten bubble spacetime
analyses.abstract: We initiate the study of nonlinear wave equations on the Witten bubble spacetime (also known as the "bubble of nothing"), which is an $\mathrm{SO}(3,1)\times \mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric solution to the Einstein vacuum equations in $(4 + 1)$ dimensions. This spacetime was introduced by Witten to model the semiclassical instability of the Kaluza--Klein spacetime $\mathbf{R}^{3+1}\times S^1$ (which is classically stable by work of Huneau--Stingo--Wyatt (arXiv:2307.15267)). We prove a small-data global existence result without symmetry assumptions and an improved decay result for $\mathrm{U}(1)$-symmetric solutions to a class of semilinear equations satisfying a version of the null condition. Key to the proof are novel estimates for the linear wave equation, which has been studied in the physics literature by Bhawal and Viveshwara and in the mathematics literature by Bachelot (arXiv:1601.03682).
analyses.workSummary: 论文在 Witten bubble 时空上研究线性及满足 null condition 的半线性波方程。作者先把几何写成适合 constant-tau 与 hyperboloidal foliation 的坐标和能量，利用 twisted current 得到基本 $\partial tau$ 能量估计；在 U(1) 对称部分进一步建立 rp 型加权估计，处理 bubble 附近的零模和边界通量，导出能量与点态衰减。随后以 U(1) 对称/非对称分解和 bootstrap 控制半线性源项：小初值在非对称情形全局存在但允许多项式时间增长，在 U(1) 对称情形获得全局存在、无穷远极限及改进衰减。

twisted current 的 $\partial tau$ 能量估计

analyses.limitations: 结果针对固定 Witten bubble 背景、充分光滑衰减的小初值和满足特定 null condition 的二次导数非线性；非 U(1) 对称部分只得到多项式时间增长，改进衰减需要对称性。论文没有处理大数据、背景几何扰动、任意二次非线性或由此产生的散射完备性。

analyses.title: Wasserstein Stability and Free Boundaries in Measure-Parameterized Bilevel Obstacle Problems
analyses.abstract: We study obstacle-constrained variational problems whose reduced energies depend on a probability law through a lower-level optimizer. Uniform strong convexity yields a single-valued Lipschitz follower response, while convexity and a Poincare inequality give a unique upper-level policy. A type-Lipschitz reduced marginal then implies Lipschitz continuity of the policy map from the 1-Wasserstein metric to the energy space. In a one-dimensional linear-obstacle subclass, the policy derivative is the positive part of a cumulative forcing. Single crossing makes the coincidence set an interval. An algebraic crossing of order m gives a $W_1^{1/m}$ modulus for its endpoint; odd-power examples show that this exponent is sharp, while a transversal crossing recovers Lipschitz stability. For empirical laws on compact subsets of $\mathbb{R}^k$, dimension-dependent Wasserstein bounds yield finite-sample rates for policies and thresholds. At a transversal population root, the empirical threshold is asymptotically linear, with an explicit influence function and central limit theorem. For higher-dimensional regular patches, a conditional level-set argument gives local Hausdorff stability when a nondegenerate switching function is available. An explicit quadratic firm response produces a nonlinear corporate-tax schedule with an endogenous zero-tax region and a Wasserstein-stable threshold. The tax illustration is analytic and uses no empirical calibration.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究概率律参数化的双层障碍变分问题。下层 follower 问题在一致强凸和参数 Lipschitz 假设下有唯一响应，作者将其代回上层能量，利用 Poincare 不等式和凸性得到唯一的 obstacle policy，并证明从 1-Wasserstein 距离到能量空间的 Lipschitz 稳定性。在一维线性障碍子类中，政策导数写成累计 forcing 的正部，单交叉使 coincidence set 成为区间；进一步用横截或高阶代数交叉控制自由边界的 Lipschitz/Hölder 位移，并将这些确定性界传递到经验测度和企业税率例子。

障碍变分不等式和 Poincare coercivity
Wasserstein 耦合稳定性

analyses.limitations: 稳定性依赖一致强凸、可积参数 Lipschitz 导数、Poincare 条件及相应的 obstacle 正则性；一维精确自由边界公式需要连续单交叉或累计 forcing 假设，高维结果只在预先给定的非退化 level-set patch 上成立。论文的经验测度速率也受紧支集和类型空间维数限制。

analyses.title: Neumann--Dirichlet eigenvalue comparison at the first Dirichlet threshold in the plane
analyses.abstract: Let $Ω\subset\mathbb R^2$ be a bounded connected Lipschitz domain, and let $\{μ_j(Ω)\}_{j\geq1}$ and $\{λ_j(Ω)\}_{j\geq1}$ denote the Neumann and Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalues, respectively, counted with multiplicity. We prove that $$ μ_3(Ω)<λ_1(Ω), $$ thereby removing the simple-connectivity assumption from the previously known planar result at the first Dirichlet threshold. We also establish a three-spectrum counting inequality relating the Dirichlet, Neumann, and conductivity spectra.
analyses.workSummary: 论文证明任意有界连通平面 Lipschitz 域的第三个 Neumann 特征值严格小于第一个 Dirichlet 特征值，因而去除了既有结果对单连通性的要求。核心做法是把多连通域的谐一形式缺陷吸收到边界各分量取常值的 conductivity gradient 空间，建立相对 Helmholtz 分解；随后构造一阶算子，其标量侧平方分解为 conductivity 与正 Neumann 拉普拉斯，向量侧的 div–curl 形式又包含两份 Dirichlet 试探空间，由 min–max 得到三谱计数不等式。最后在 conductivity 第一特征值与 Dirichlet 第一特征值的两种相对位置下，分别用尖锐等周估计或各向同性子空间论证排除等号。

conductivity 边界条件谱

analyses.limitations: 定理针对二维有界连通 Lipschitz 域和标准 Laplacian；核心计数依赖边界分量常值的 conductivity 空间及平面 div–curl 结构，不能直接给出高维或一般曲面上的同样严格结论。AI 辅助过部分证明，作者说明相关论证随后由作者修订和检查。

analyses.title: Compact implicit high-resolution numerical scheme for multicomponent transport problems with Langmuir sorption
analyses.abstract: We present a compact implicit high-resolution finite volume scheme for one-dimensional multicomponent transport problems with nonlinear Langmuir sorption. The method combines a second order compact implicit discretization with WENO reconstruction and a time limiter for the treatment of steep gradients and discontinuities. A special attention is given to the Courant number used in the limiter, where local characteristic Courant numbers based on the eigenvalues of the inverse retardation matrix are considered. The compact implicit schemes are compared with analogous explicit first and second order methods. Numerical experiments show second order convergence for smooth solutions and demonstrate that the implicit approach can be used with significantly larger Courant numbers. The method is also applied to a three-component displacement chromatography problem with sharp concentration fronts.
analyses.workSummary: 论文提出用于带 Langmuir 吸附的多组分一维输运系统的紧致隐式高分辨率有限体积方法。守恒变量在新时间层通过局部二阶紧致界面公式更新，每个网格单元只需局部 Newton/Gauss–Seidel 求解；WENO 重构根据局部平滑性调节空间 stencil，time limiter 在大 Courant 数或陡峭前沿处把二阶修正压回稳健的一阶上风形式。数值部分比较隐式/显式、一阶/二阶和 WENO 变体，并用高斯初值、线性 benchmark 和三组分 displacement chromatography 测试收敛、效率与尖锐前沿捕获。

analyses.title: High-Dimensional Families of Minimal Surfaces of Arbitrary Genus in Round Spheres
analyses.abstract: We prove the existence of arbitrarily high-dimensional families of minimal surfaces of any prescribed genus and conformal structure in even-dimensional round spheres. More precisely, let $n\geq2$ and let $Σ$ be any closed Riemann surface of genus $g$. We construct a sequence of degrees $d_\ell\to+\infty$ such that, for every $\ell$, there exists a complex manifold of complex dimension $2d_\ell+n^2(1-g)$ consisting of linearly full branched superminimal immersions of $Σ$ into $\mathbb S^{2n}$ of degree $d_\ell$. In particular, this yields parametrized families of linearly full branched minimal immersions whose dimensions tend to infinity.

analyses.title: Assessing Nonlinear Elimination Preconditioning for Trust-Region Phase-Field Fracture
analyses.abstract: Each quasi-static load step of phase-field fracture is a bound-constrained minimization of a nonconvex, coupled displacement-damage energy under an irreversibility bound on the damage. Monolithic Newton stalls once the nonlinearity localizes at the advancing crack front, and staggered (alternate-minimization) schemes converge slowly there. We present an on-demand nonlinear-elimination preconditioned trust-region Newton method: an energy Steihaug-Toint trust region, a primal-dual active set for irreversibility, and a bound-constrained field-split sweep that eliminates an algebraically-identified "hard set" spanning both fields before each step. The elimination is applied on demand -- triggered by the coupled Newton's own stalling and otherwise skipped -- so the method reduces to monolithic Newton at no surcharge where the step is already healthy. We find the robustness to come from the energy trust region: with that globalization fixed, monolithic Newton already completes every loading history without cutbacks, where residual-merit Newton death-spirals, alternate minimization stalls, and the full-field sweep loses robustness. Against that well-globalized baseline, the on-demand elimination cuts outer nonlinear iterations by 19-25% (brittle) and 17% (ductile), with always-on elimination reaching 26-28% and about $39\%$ at the ductile nucleation step. Measured machine-independently, as a full-mesh-equivalent assembly-work proxy rather than wall-clock, it is competitive with -- not faster than -- monolithic Newton (within about 10%), whereas an always-on sweep adds up to 30%. Nonlinear elimination is thus an iteration-reduction mechanism whose overhead the on-demand gate bounds, with no demonstrated total-work advantage over well-globalized monolithic Newton.
analyses.workSummary: 论文评估相场断裂的 on-demand nonlinear-elimination trust-region Newton 求解器。每个准静态载荷步被写成带 damage irreversibility bound 的 displacement–damage 能量最小化；外层采用 Steihaug–Toint trust region 和 primal–dual active set，非线性消元只在耦合 Newton 由 crack-front hard set 引起停滞时触发，并用 KKT residual merit 做 sweep safeguard。作者在 AT1、AT2 脆性和强耦合延性 E-P-PD 试验上比较 MONO、MSPIN 与 NEPIN，报告 outer nonlinear iterations 减少，但 full-mesh-equivalent assembly-work 与 well-globalized monolithic Newton 近似持平。

analyses.title: Asymptotics of Ground States for Helium-Like and Bosonic Atoms in a Two-Cluster Region
analyses.abstract: We study the asymptotic behavior of positive ground states of $N$-particle atomic Coulomb Hamiltonians in a two-cluster region. For the $N$-particle ground state $ψ$, its one-particle density $ρ$, and $(N-1)$-particle ground state $φ$, we show that for $0<α<1$, as $|x_N|\to\infty$, $ψ(x_1,\dots,x_N)/\sqrt{ρ(x_N)}= φ(x_1,\dots,x_{N-1})+O(|x_N|^{-2+α} \ln |x_N|)$ uniformly in the region $|x_i|\le |x_N|^α$. In the region $|x_i|\le R_0\ln |x_N|$, the convergence rate is $O(|x_N|^{-2} (\ln |x_N|)^2)$. We also establish an $O(|x_N|^{-2})$ bound on the squared $L^2$ error. These results hold both below the essential spectrum and at threshold.
analyses.workSummary: 论文研究 Coulomb 原子 N 粒子正 ground state 在一个粒子远离其余粒子的 two-cluster 区域中的定量因子化。设 $u(x_N)$ 是 N−1 粒子 ground state phi 与 N 粒子波函数 psi 的投影，作者用 Feynman–Kac 表示把 psi 与 $e^(-t(H_{N-1}-Delta_N/2-U-E_N))psi$ 比较，并以 Brownian 最大不等式和 Coulomb 势的精细替换控制误差，在膨胀区域 $|x_i|\le |x_N|^alpha$ 上得到 $O(|x_N|^(-2+alpha)$ $log|x_N|)$ 的比值误差。另一路对一粒子密度 rho 和投影 u 建立分布不等式与有效势微分不等式，再用最大值原理得到 L2 误差 $O(|x_N|^-2)$，因此结果同时覆盖束缚态和阈值情形。

analyses.title: On Besov and Triebel-Lizorkin spaces associated with the Grushin operator
analyses.abstract: In this article, we define classical and non-classical Besov and Triebel--Lizorkin spaces associated with the Grushin operator with or without drift. We establish various characterisations of these spaces, and study their complex interpolation, embedding properties, and fractional Leibniz rules.
analyses.workSummary: 论文在带或不带 drift 的 Grushin 算子框架下定义 classical 与 non-classical Besov/Triebel–Lizorkin 空间。作者用热半群核估计、频率分解和加权平方函数建立这些空间的范数刻画，再将 dyadic pieces 的估计组合成嵌入、实插值和复插值定理。随后通过差分/热半群表示获得 fractional Leibniz 规则，并区分非临界指数条件与端点失败情形。整个论证的主线是先控制 Grushin 热半群在各向异性尺度上的衰减，再将单尺度估计累加为函数空间结构。

analyses.title: A discontinuous Galerkin approximation of the Dean--Kawasaki equation
analyses.abstract: We introduce and analyse an arbitrary order spatial discontinuous Galerkin (dG) method for the Dean--Kawasaki equation, a highly singular SPDE modelling density fluctuations of $N$ diffusing particles in the regime of large particle number $N \gg 1$. Our starting point is a general procedure for discretising multiplicative, divergence-form noise on finite element spaces whilst preserving its cross-variation structure at the discrete level; the construction is explicit, elementwise, applies to continuous and discontinuous spaces alike, and extends to general mobilities. Using it, we prove weak error estimates of order $O(h^p)$ between fluctuations of the semi-discrete scheme and those of the underlying particle system, together with a correction that is exponentially small in the scaling regime $Nh^d \gg 1$ and arises because the scheme does not preserve positivity. The resulting method is locally and globally conservative and applies on unstructured simplicial meshes. Quantitative numerical experiments support the analysis, and further experiments illustrate the method beyond the scope of the theory: indicator function observables, external and interaction potentials, convection-dominated regimes and reflecting boundary conditions.
analyses.workSummary: 论文为奇异 Dean–Kawasaki SPDE 构造任意阶空间 discontinuous Galerkin 近似。核心是把 divergence-form 的乘性噪声按有限元梯度空间分解，利用加权质量矩阵的正半定平方根逐单元构造离散 noise，使 cross-variation 在离散层面保持正确结构。作者证明半离散 dG-DK 方程的弱存在与矩估计，并给出全局/局部质量守恒。弱误差分析用连续和离散 backward heat flows 抵消 drift，再以 dG energy norm、L-infinity 概率界和 moment recursion 比较粒子经验测度与数值 fluctuation，得到 $O(h^p)$ 数值误差及 N $h^d$ 大时指数小的负值误差。
techniques: 加权质量矩阵平方根的噪声构造
对称 interior-penalty dG 离散
Dean–Kawasaki cross-variation 保持
backward adjoint heat flow
moment recursion 与 L-infinity 概率估计
analyses.breakthrough: 给出适用于任意多项式阶、连续或不连续有限元空间的显式结构保持噪声 lifting，并首次把它与 dG Dean–Kawasaki 方案的弱误差分析结合，证明 $O(h^p)$ fluctuation 误差和在 N $h^d≫1$ 区域指数小的负密度修正。
analyses.limitations: 理论是空间半离散的，未分析时间离散；interior-penalty dG 没有离散 maximum principle，因此需要 Assumption dG2 的网格/粒子尺度限制，数值解可能出现负值。弱误差定理主要针对多项式 moment observables、扩散粒子和规则周期网格，外势、相互作用、反射边界等实验超出主定理范围。

analyses.title: Interface foliation near a minimal isoparametric hypersurface for the Allen-Cahn equation
analyses.abstract: Let $(M,g)$ be a closed Riemannian manifold of positive Ricci curvature. Let $f$ be a proper isoparametric function on $M$, and $Γ$ the unique level set of $f$ which is a minimal hypersurface. For any positive integer $k$, and $λ>0$ large enough, we construct a solution of the Allen-Cahn equation $ Δu + λ(u-u^3 ) =0$ which is constant along the level sets of $f$ and has exactly $k$ nodal components. We prove that the nodal components approach the minimal isoparametric hypersurface $Γ$ as $λ\rightarrow \infty$ and the energy is uniformly bounded for all such solutions.
analyses.workSummary: 论文在正 Ricci 曲率闭 Riemann 流形上研究沿 proper isoparametric function 的 Allen–Cahn 解。对 level-set 常值的 f-invariant 函数，作者把椭圆 PDE 化为带单调 mean-curvature coefficient h 的一维 ODE，并用 shooting/phase-plane 构造任意固定 nodal multiplicity k 的全局解。通过 discrepancy D(w) 的单调性、临界点衰减、Sturm comparison 和区间分解，证明大 lambda 时所有零点集中到唯一 $h=0$ 的 minimal isoparametric hypersurface；最后控制每个单调区间的梯度与势能，得到固定零点数下的统一能量界。
techniques: isoparametric level-set 降维
Allen–Cahn ODE shooting
discrepancy function 单调性
Sturm–Picone comparison
相图角度与能量区间估计

analyses.limitations: 构造限制在 positive Ricci、proper isoparametric foliation 和严格递减 mean curvature 的对称子空间，不能直接覆盖一般 minimal hypersurface 或无对称 PDE 解。零点聚集和能量界针对固定 nodal 数 k；没有给出非 f-invariant 扰动的稳定性或完整 moduli 描述。

analyses.title: A class of port-Hamiltonian systems with general time delays
analyses.abstract: We define a class of infinite dimensional linear port-Hamiltonian delay systems, give a characterization for such systems, and provide an easily verifiable sufficient condition to belong to this class, thereby extending the study by Breiten, Hinsen and Unger in [IEEE Trans. Autom. Control vol. 69, no. 12 (2024), pp. 8924-8930, doi: 10.1109/TAC.2024.3464332]. The results rely on the operator semigroup theoretic treatment of linear delay PDEs.
analyses.workSummary: 论文定义带一般时间延迟的无限维线性 port-Hamiltonian 系统。延迟由有限变差算子值测度表示，作者把原 delay equation 提升到 $H\times L2([-tau,0];H)$ 的抽象 Cauchy 问题，证明相应算子生成 C0-semigroup，从而得到 classical/mild well-posedness。随后在延迟历史上引入由正自伴算子 Omega 加权的 Hamiltonian，利用积分分部把 port-Hamiltonian 条件化为一个耗散不等式；该不等式给出一般延迟核的充要刻画。若无延迟部分相对于延迟测度足够耗散，则选择 $Omega=|d$ eta|I 得到易检查的充分条件，最后将结论专门化到有限/无限离散 point delays。
techniques: 延迟算子值测度与 L2 phase space
抽象 Cauchy 问题和 C0-semigroup
加权 Hamiltonian 耗散性
Hilbert 空间积分分部

analyses.limitations: 理论针对线性系统、有限时间延迟窗和有界变差延迟算子，Hamiltonian 权重需正自伴；论文没有处理非线性、无限时间 horizon、一般 Hamiltonian 或 delay-dependent stability 的完整理论。离散延迟的矩阵判据在无限维情形仍需额外算子域与可和性条件。

analyses.title: Continuum Limit of Nonlocal Electrostatics in Random Media
analyses.abstract: We derive a two-scale continuum limit for the electrostatic energy of random charge density fields that are stationary and ergodic under lattice translations. Each microscopic cell is charge neutral in every realization, while its dipole moment may fluctuate and have a nonzero mean. Under assumptions on the stationary microscopic potential and the finite-volume fields, the local and nonlocal energies converge almost surely to deterministic limits. The local limit consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic Coulomb energy and a cell-depolarization term, whereas the effective polarization determines the nonlocal limit. The cell-depolarization terms cancel in the total energy, which consists of the ensemble-averaged microscopic cell energy and the macroscopic electrostatic field energy. The deterministic specialization recovers the periodic two-scale limit. For an independent-cell random-displacement model, we verify the assumptions of the continuum-limit theorem and show that centered microscopic fluctuations can change the local energy without changing the effective polarization or the nonlocal energy.
analyses.workSummary: 论文建立具有晶格平移平稳遍历性的随机电荷密度场的两尺度连续静电能极限。每个微观 cell 在每个 realization 中电中性，但 dipole 可随机波动；作者用 lattice ergodic theorem 将 cell dipole 平均识别为确定性 effective polarization p。局部能量的 thermodynamic limit 保留 ensemble-averaged microscopic Coulomb energy，并出现 cell depolarization 项；非局部材料点相互作用先收敛到 polarized-cell 离散能，再在 epsilon 趋零时收敛到由 p 生成的宏观 electrostatic field energy。局部的正 depolarization 与非局部的负项相消，得到总能量的 deterministic continuum formula，并在 periodic 与 independent-cell random-displacement 模型中验证假设。
techniques: lattice stationary ergodic averaging
两尺度 local/nonlocal energy decomposition
cell polarization 与 Poisson field

analyses.limitations: 结果依赖固定立方 reference cell、晶格平移遍历性、电中性和 Section 3 的微观势/有限体场正则性假设；独立位移模型是静态 ensemble，不是含时间相关性的 atomistic Gibbs dynamics。论文没有覆盖非立方材料点、带长程 cell correlations 的动力学随机场或脱离这些假设的边界几何。

analyses.title: Polynomial Bohnenblust--Hille bounds for product of cyclic groups
analyses.abstract: Fix an integer $K\ge2$, and let $C_K^n =\{(e^{\frac{2πij}{K}})_{j=0}^{K-1}\}^n$ be the product of cyclic groups of order $K$. For a Fourier character $χ_α$, let $s(α)$ be the number of active coordinates. We give a self-contained proposed proof that the dimension-free Bohnenblust--Hille constants governed by interaction order grow polynomially: if $p_d=2d/(d+1)$ and \[ γ_2=\frac12, \qquad γ_K=\frac{K\log(K-1)}{4(K-2)}\quad(K\ge3), \] then the $\ell^{p_d}$ norm of Fourier coefficients $\{\hat f(α)\}$ is bounded by $L^\infty$ norm of $f$ multiplied by $C(K) d^{4γ_K+5}$. The constant $C(K)$ is actually at most of the order $K^{5/2}$.
analyses.workSummary: 论文提出 product of cyclic groups 上 polynomial Bohnenblust–Hille bound 的一条 self-contained proof route。对 interaction order 分层后，作者把 Potts hypercontractivity、固定低阶 spectral projection 和 mixed-norm interpolation 接入加权 graded square function。随机把 active coordinates 二染色，保留每个局部 Fourier degree 并以 exact ancestry 回收 parent coefficient；binomial central capture 与 Potts entropy contraction 控制高 interaction levels。低阶层先单独闭合，高阶部分通过 uniform contraction 和 bootstrap 得到 weighted square-function $O(d^3)$，最后将权重还原为 coefficient $l^p$ 范数，得到固定 K 时 $C(K)d^(4$ $gamma_K+5)$ 的 proposed polynomial bound。
techniques: Potts hypercontractivity
interaction-order Fourier projections
weighted row–column square-function bootstrap
random coordinate bicoloring and exact ancestry
binary-entropy contraction
analyses.breakthrough: 将 support-layer 的随机坐标二染色与 Potts hypercontractivity 结合，建立统一收缩常数小于 1 的加权 bootstrap，从而把 cyclic-group Bohnenblust–Hille 的 degree dependence 从既有 subexponential 机制推进到固定 K 下的 polynomial exponent 4 $gamma_K+5$；作者同时明确指出该结果不 uniform in K。
analyses.limitations: 论文标题和 Theorem 1.1 将结果称为 proposed proof，结论只对每个固定 K 成立，常数和指数均随 K 变差；证明依赖既有 Potts hypercontractivity、低 interaction-level estimate 和 projection estimate，不能直接宣称 uniform-K 或非交换群版本。AI 曾参与 Section 5 [19] 的探索性证明开发，但数学内容由作者核验并编辑。

steps.route: 用 $T_rho$ 的谱作用把 interaction order r 的 Fourier layer 衰减为 $rho^r$；对 $r=1,2,3$ 直接调用 support-sensitive bound，对一般 r 用负 Potts interval 保持 L-infinity contraction，并以一维 Markov kernel 的正性控制 projection。

steps.claim: 混合范数插值和 row–column square function 将二块 Fourier 系数控制为 weighted bootstrap 递推。
steps.route: 对随机二分后的两块 interaction degrees 使用 fractional two-block interpolation，把行和列的系数范数分别放入混合 $l^p/l^2$ 范数；再用 variable-angle summation 和 weighted square function 汇总所有 balanced bidegrees，产生带 entropy weight 的递推量 Gamma。

steps.route: 每个 active coordinate 整体分配到 x 或 y block，局部频率不被合并；因此子系数的支持并集唯一恢复 parent index。二染色计数服从 Bin(r,1/2)，中心区概率至少为 1/3，结合中央 entropy contraction 得到 Proposition 8.1 的高层递推。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 14-15 页 Section 7 Lemma 7.1，equations (47)–(50)，以及 Proposition 8.1 equation (52)。

steps.claim: uniform contraction 使 weighted square function bootstrap 闭合，并推出 polynomial Bohnenblust–Hille bound。
steps.route: 取 $B_K=4$ $gamma_K+2$ 后，显式计算 contraction $c_star=0.820772...<1$；将低层常数与高层递推相加并移项，得到 $Gamma\le D_K$ $M^3$。最后按 $p_r\le p_d$ 的单调性把每层系数求和，恢复 $d^(4$ $gamma_K+5)$ 的 $l^p$ 估计。
steps.evidence: PDF 第 16-17 页 Lemma 8.2、Theorem 8.3、Theorem 9.1，equations (54)–(63)。
